༄༅// nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi dri gzhi lnga brgya/kun dgas bsgyur/(stod/)krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/deb 'di'i nang dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang nub gling du byung ba'i deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi rlabs rgyun gtso bo mtshon rtags ring lugs dang /rtog pa rang yan pa/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs/ mngon mtshon ring lugs/ta ta ring lugs/ dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs/ gzhi grub ring lugs/ brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra ba/ tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar/gnya' chag mi rabs gcig nag po'i dgod bro/ dngos yod sgyu 'phrul ring lugs sogs grub mtha' che chung 44yi rnam gzhag rags bsdus dang /dpe mtshon rtsom pa po/ tshab mtshon brtsams chos bcas ngo sprod mdor bsdus byas yod pa red/ 1857lor deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig dngos su dar 'go tshugs pa nas bzung nub gling gi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la lo brgya lhag ring gi 'phel rgyas byung yod na'ang bod yul du da phan 'di'i skor ngo sprod cha tshang byed pa'i 'gyur rtsom legs gras byung ma myong bas ha cang phangs pa'i gnas lags na/da cha bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong bla lhag yong phyir gzhan la dpe lta dang dpyad bsdur byed rgyu gnad du che bas/ dus rabs nyer gcig gi nyi 'od gangs ri'i rtse la 'khyud pa'i dus bzang 'dir dpyod ldan kun dga' lags kyi 'gyur rtsom stod smad bam po gnyis kyi bdag nyid can de kun gyi gzigs mor phul ba 'di bod rig pa 'phel ba'i rgyu ru gyur cigadape skrun byed ring rtsom sgrig pa mog chung phur bas 'gyur rtsom 'dir 'go nas mjug bar 'gyur zhus dang par zhus nan tan byas pa bcas gzhan yang mthun rkyen skrun mkhan dang thugs khur gnang mkhan rnam pa lhan rgyas la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu rgyu bcas/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /

dkar chaganub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi// ji 'dra zhig la deng rabs smra ba zer ba dang / de'i byung 'phel gyi 'o/ rgyus/ ji /rdorwa////du /bye/dro:ཿspro/ /pa/sdo(35༷// /du / //2 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi bas/ma/ blo'i nang don gang red dam// (5)3 deng rabs/ smra ba'i rtsom rig 'a sgyu rtsa' gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam// (9)/ deng rabs/ smra ba'i rtsom/ rig 'a gangeng 'jog ji 'dra bya dbos/ sa/ma/ ( / 2)5 ji 'dra 'ig 'a phyi dar ngeng rabs smra ba zer ram ( /5)6 deng rabs/ smra ba'i rtsom/ rig de'i dar 'aso dus gang nas/ rtsi dbos/ sa ma// ( /8)7 deng rabs/ smra ba'i rtsom ris si phyi tshad ji tsam 'a ngos 'dzin byed dbos sam/ (2 / )8 dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs/ nyi shu sum cu'i nang rang rgyal la nub phyogs deng rabs/ smra ba'i rtsom/ rig bi shugs rkyen phog pa'i rtsom nga/ po ji 'dra yod dam / (23)9 su/'u ko la ti'i ma/tshan nyid rig nga/'i lta ba gtso bo gang yin nam// (26)/ 0 ngo/ 'a thu'u 'a/ rigs pa/'i gzhung lugs ji 'dra yod dam// (30)/ / ya li si tu'o te'i mdzes rig si bsam blo gang red dam/ (3 /)/spri hru pun hwa yi 'dun nga/ kho na smra bar nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/ (37)/ 3 khang te'i sngo na rtogs sems/ gtso ring 'u gas gang red dam// ( /0)/ / nyi tsha'i yi 'phags/ mi'i mtshan nyid rig par nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/ ( / /)/ du po ko sen ni ji lta bu'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba 'is red dam// ( /7)/6 po ko sen gyi thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs la nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam//(50)/ 7 po ko sen gyi bdas nyid kyi lta ba 'es pa de gang red dam/ (53)18 ngo/ ko sen gyi yu la dus kyi lta ba nyagang red dam/ (56)

/9 po ko sen gyi mdzes rig gi lta ba gang red dam/ (59)20 po ko sen gyi tshe srog mtshan nyid rig pa gang red dam/ (62)2/ hphu lu'o dbyi te ni mkhas pa ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (65)22 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa 'es pa gang red dam/ (68)23 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i 8mi gshis kyi grub cha khag gsum :zhes pa/ de gang red darma// (7/ )27/ hphu lu'o dbyi te'i 〈〈rmi 'a ma zhib 'grel 〉〉gyi nang don gtso bo gang red dam/ (7du)25 chu lu'o dbyi te'i gzhung lugs kyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la shugs rkyen ga re sprad yod dam/ (77)26 chu lu'o dbyi te'i rig rtsal gyi lta ba gang red dam/ (8/ )27 chu lu'o dbyi te'i 〈gsar rtsom pa/ dang nyin mo'i rmi lam 〉zhis nga der nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam// (86)28 a te le'i gzhung lugs kyi nang don gtso bo gang red dam/ (9/)29 rung ko'i gzhung lugs kyi nang don gtso bo gang red dam/ (9 /)30 le len kran mu 'u si'i sems khams rig pa'i nang don gtso bo gang yin nga/ dang /de dang deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig bar 'brel ba ga re yod dam/ (98)mtshon rtags ring lugs/ 3/ ji 'dra zhig la mtshon rtags ring lugs zer ram (/01)32 mtshon rtags ring lugs la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/ (106)33 mtshon rtags ring lugs kyis ji ltar dngos yod ring 'u/gas kyi srol rgyun gtor te rtsom stangs thad phyi rol dngos po'i 'jig rten nas nang gnas bsarme pa'i 'jig rten la bsgyur pa yin nam/ (/07)344 mtshon rtags ring lugs kyis ji ltar 'char yan ring lugs dor te mtshon rtags dang shugs bstan gyi thabs rtsal spyad pa/ yin nam/ (109)35 mtshon rtags ring lugs kyis rnam bden ring lugs dang rang byung ring lugs la sun 'byin gyis rang ngos kyi shes rtogs nus pa dang sgyu rtsal bsam 2

bkod kyi gsar rtsom/ nus nga/ra mthong che byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/ (/ /2)36 mtshon rtags ring lugs pas snyan tshig gi rol dbyangs rang ba'in nan bshad byed nga/'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/ (/ 1 /)37 mtshon rtags ring lugs la lkog gyur ring lugs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/ (1 /8)38 mtshon rtags ring lugs pas mdzes pa'i mtshan nyid ji 'dra zhig bton pa yin nam/ ( /2/)39 mtshon rtags ring 'u gas pa/sa ji ltar byas te brjod bya'i khyab khongs rgya cher btang ngam// (/2 /)/0 ji 'dra 'ig la/ ljang gsar dus skabs kyi ma/tshon rtags ring lugs zer ram/ (/26)// per the 'a nga ni rtsom/ pa/ po ji 'dra 'ig red dam/ (/30)/2 〈ma/tshan mo'i mun nag khrod kyi mi ca si pa 〉tshes pa/'i brtsams chos/ de ji 9rwa(/tres /jisnosmras/ 1jodroḥdo/ sprebashe(5ga// (//)/)) 3 a'e lun pho ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (/38)1 / na'e war 'es pa ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (/ /2)/5 ji 'dra zhig la sngon byon dus kyi mtshon rtags ring lugs zer ram/ (/ / /)//6 po te la 'e er ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (/ /6)/7 〈mi dge me tog )〉ces pa/ nge brtsams chos ji 'dra 'ig red dam/ (/55)/8 〈mi dge me tog 〉〉bi nang don gang yin nam/ (/56) /9 〈〈mi dbe me tog 〉la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra ldan yod dam/ (16/ )50 〈〈mi dge me tog 〉gi bsam blo'i nang don gang red dam/ (/66)5 ji 'dra 'ig la snga dar mtshon rtags ring lugs zer ram/ (169)52 ler lun ni rtsom pa/ po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (170)53 lan po ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (/76)51 lan po yis mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan tshig dar 'phel gtong rgyur :skugazug skre)sa :dro khuradra sdon95 skyedusprad ཿnica// (/76)3

55 〈ma dbyangs 〉〉ces nga/ de snyan ngag ji 'dra 'is red dam// ( /8/ )56 (〈myos/ gru 〉'es/ pa de snyan tshig ji 'dra tshig red dam/ ( /87)du7 ma/ la me ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra 'ig red dam// ( /90)du8 ma/ la me yis mtshon rtags/ ring lugs kyi snyan tshig 'phe' rgyas 'gro rgyur legs skyes ji 'dra phul yod dam/ ( /93)59 ma/ 'a me yi snya na ngag rna' ma/ la khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/ ( /97)60 78/'brog lha'i phyi dro 〉'es nga/ de snya na tshig ji 'dra 'ig red dam / ( /98)6/ wer ha 'u na ni rtsom/ nga/ ngo/ ji 'dra 'ig red dam// (20/ )62 rma le ya si dang ma/tshon rtags/ ring lusas dbar 'brel ba ga re yod dam// (203)63 me the ling bo ni rtsom pa ngo/ ji 'dra 'ig red dam// (206)6 / )) bya sngo na ))ches/ pa de brtsam/sa chos/ ji 'dra 'is red dam// (209)65 'ing ko mi rtsom/ pa po ji 'dra chig red dam / (2/3)66 ji 'dra 'ig 'a/ phyi dar ma/tshon rtags ring lugs/ zer ram / (2/ /)67 pa la 'e li 'es/ pa ni rtsom pa/ ngo ji 'dra 'ig red dam / (2 /7)68 ma/tsho 'gam si dar sa/ 'es/ pa de snyan tshig ji 'ad 'ig red dam// 91 〉/ )ni spyo rig (pe phra sari ༅ 7 zu ri rigs la tsho 69 slar kho ni rtsom/ pa ngo/ ji 'dra 'ig yin nga/ dang / khos ma tshon rtasas ring 'u gas/ 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur lesas/ skyes/ ji 'dra phul yod dam// (223)70 ye kri ni snya na ngag pa ji 'dra 'i4 yin nga/ dang / khos/ ma/tshon rtags ring 'u gas/ 'phe' rgyas 'gro rgyur lesas skyes ga re phu' yod dam// (228)7/ a'e lu'e the ni rtsom/ pa ngo/ ji 'dra 'is red dam// (232)72 a/'e lu'e the'i rang nyid can ma/ yin pa/'i gzhung lugs zer ba de gang yin nam// (236)73 ji 'dra 'ig la phyi don do ma/nyam dngos ngo nyazer ram/ (2 /0)7 / 〈 'brog stong 〉gi nang don gang red dam// (2 // )75 〈'brog sto nga 〉la sgyu rtsa' gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam// (2 /6)76 kho lo ta'e er ni rtsom pa/ ngo/ ji 'dra 'ig red dam/ (2du0)

71 theng chung phe si ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (25/)78 tu'o phu'u the man ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (253)79 phyi dar mtshon rtags ring lugs la rim 'gyur ga re byung yod dam/ (255)80 su ru su'i mtshon rtags ring lugs de ji ltar grub pa dang 'phel rgyas song ba yin nam/ (260)8/ po lu'o kho ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (262)82 〈dmag mi bcu gnyis 〉zhes pa de brtsams chos ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (265)83 pu li'u su'o hphu ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (268)rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung /84 ji 'dra zhig la rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung zer ram (27/)85 6 rtog pa rang yan pa'i rtsom rig gi 'byung rtsa gang yin nam/ (276)86 rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi sems khams rig pa'i thebathang thaka/ce/ tha/pange (1)skuni cadazug/ (277)81 we len kran mu'u sis rtog pa rang yan nga 'i brtsams sgrung thon rgyur legs khye)sa ji 'dra phul yod dam/ (28/)88 chu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed kyi gzhung lugs dang rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung 'byung ba'i bar 'brel ba ji 'dra yod dam/ (283)89 rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i rtsa khungs /jidro 9spro//dus 3)sdeḥbashe ཿrdo/25// (2)/rte5)90 rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung bi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la nang 1rdordocad rjiX khurachos ((1snang/ cadacom// (287)9/ heng li kran mu'u si'i ‘‘bden pa'i rnam bshad nya ces pa gang red dam/ (289)92 heng li kran mu'u si'i thu dkyus gcig 'brel gyi gong bu'i rnam bshad ’nyaces tshopa/ ཿsa/ཿpa/ 1)rdosnang/ ཿrdo/25// (shā)/)/)93 heng li kran mu'u si'i ‘4brjod 'bri'i zur tshad smra ba zhes pa gang 5

red dam/ (292)9 phu'u lu'u si the'i 6‘rang snang bden pa'i rnam bshad ’ ces pa gang yin nam/ (294)9/5 phu'u lu'u si the'i 6 dus tshod kyi lta tshul 〉’zhes pa gang yin nam/ (297)96 cha'o dbyi si'i 6‘mdzes tshor zhi 'jags kyi rnam bshad ’’ces pa gang yin namakho299)97 4 er hphu'i sna‘dus rabs 'pho 'gyur gyi rnam bshad ’’ces pa gang yin nam/ (302)98 lu'u er hphu'i 8‘mi sna lte gnad kyi rnam bshad ’ ces pa gang yin nam/ (304)93 wu'u er hphu'i ‘‘nang gnas bden pa'i rnam bshad ’’ces pa gang yin nam/ (306)100 lu'u er hphus ‘‘dngos po ring lugs mi dang lho bsam pa ring lugs ’’skor :dro 2ltabasdo ste1pardo spusasprod tshodazug/ (309)/0/ wu'u er hphu'i ‘6nyams zhib ring lugs mi’zhes pa gang yin nam/ (3/0)/02 wu'u er spus lha thun mong ma yin pa'i gsar gtod rang bzhin ’’skor :zu no//bsdo /blo/spyang shesatshod tshodazug/ (3/2)/03 wu'u er hphu'i ‘‘nang don dang rnam pa'i gcig gyur gyi lta ba ’’zhes pa slob//ཿཿrdo /)/////she (1/()pa// (/)/74)/04 chu kho na'i 44'khrul med dngos tshor gyi rnam bshad ’’ces pa gang yin nam/ ( 3/5)/05 6 kho na'i ‘ dus tshod kyi lta tshul ’’zhes pa gang yin nam/ (3/6)/06 pa'o wun gyi 6‘zlos gar rang bzhin gyi ‘da lta ri ’zhes pa gang yin nam/ (3/7)/07 rteg pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi tshod lta'i dus skabs zhes pa ཿsa/ཿཿ( (1sgothebasdo ()sdocarngo// (()2())/08 lu'o tu'o zhi li khra sen ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (32 2)/09 teng li kran mu'u si ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (3rta〉4)/ /0 rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi dar po che ba'i dus skabs rnga//ཿpa( (1sgothebasdo can/(5// (3rta //nye)/ // phu'u lu'u si the ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (35〉6)/ /2 〈chu 'gros lang hrū dran gso 〉gsar rtsom dang par skrun gyi brgyud rim /jidro 9bku/du 1re/tshod/ spyadazug/ (339) 6

/ /3 〈chu 'gros lang pho dran gso 〉yi nang don gang red dam/ (332)/ /4 〈chu 'gros lang tsho'i dran gso 〉zhes par sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/ (336)//5 〈chu 'gros lang ཿ dran gso 〉yi bsam blo'i nang don ji 'dra red dam/ (340)/ 6 wu'u er hphu ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (342)/ /7 lu'u er hphu ni rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung lo rgyus thog gi phul byung dpa' rgod cig red zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/ (345)/ /8 lu'u er hphus /9/9lor 'grems spel byas pa'i rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi gtso bo'i nang don ji 'dra yin nam/ (349)/ /9 〈sgron stegs su bskyod pa 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos kyi nang don rags bsdus ji 'dra yin nam/ (352)/20 cha'o dbyi si ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (355)/2/ 〈gzhon nu sgyu rtsal pa'i 'dra par 〉〉zhes pa de ni brtsams chos ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (358)/22 〈yi'u li zhi si 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos de ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (36/)/23 〈yi'u li zhi si 〉zhes pa'i khrod kyi sgrung gtam de zla 6tshes /6nyin byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci dang /dpe skrun gyi dus tshod de zla 2tshes 2nyin bdams dgos don ci yin nam/ (366)/24 〈chun ne ken tsho'i dran rnyed 〉ces pa de brtsams chos ji 'dra zhig red dam/367)/25 chu kho na ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (369)/26 〈ku co dang zing slong 〉zhes pa de brtsams chos ji 'dra zhig 1)/rdo:rdordo/ /rdob//sbyang// 〈du//)/77shādherdoX//27 〈ku co dang zing slong 〉zhes par sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/ (374)/28 o'u tshi ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ (377)/29 rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra ldan //(115/sdo ཿpa/shethe pa// /du//)/skyi)/du///7

nyi ma'i rigs dang dwangs gsal kyi rtsom rig4() 2 ji 'dra 'ig la nyi ma'i rigs dang dwangs gsal rigs kyi rtsom rig zer ram// ( / /73)stong bsam kyal rtsed smra ba/493 ji 'dra 'is la/ stong bas/ma kya'/ rtsed smra ba zer ram/ ( / /77)4 (34 thung cing khang 'u nga ni rtsom/ pa/ po ji 'dra 'ig red dam/ ( / /78)4ni/du (lar rgya ma/tsho'i ma/tsho lam gyi dam/ga 'khrug 〉ces pa/ de brtsam/sa/ chos ji 41//༷du /jesnocas/ 11droskyud ཿde/zungag / ( / /8())4()6 cing hrang zha ni rtsom pa/ po ji 'dra 'ig red dam/ ( / /8/ )gsar 'gyur ring lugs/497 ji 'dra 'ig 'a gas/ra 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa zer ram/ ( / /82)498 gas/ra 'gyur ring 'u gas gas/ra pa'i rtsom pa pos ji ltar brtsams sgrung gi khyab khongs/ su/ bskyod pa yin nam// (/ /87)499 gas/ra 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i brtsams chos rtsom lugs la khyad chos /cedro (rngodi/tre/ (11snangashe 〉pa/(54/ ( / /)rwape)500 gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa dang gnas zhu'i rtsom rig gnyis dbar mi 'dra ba'i /rmid par ci yod dam/ ( 1 195)50/ gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i sgyu rtsal pa'i blo stobs de phyogs gang gi thad nas mtshon gyi yod dam/ (/7/98)502 ‘gsar 'gyur ring lugs gsar pa'i rtsom pa ngo/'i shes yon de phyogs gang gi thad nas mtshon gyi yod dam/ (/502) 30

nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi// ji 'dra zhig la deng rabs smra ba zer ba dang / de'i byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus ji 'dra red dam/ deng rabs smra bar gdong len smra ba yang zer zhing nub phyogs deng :retherdzo tshor /rga /) byengehāre shāni zerdo 2de:derabs dang da lta ma rag da gal grub mtha' ga da/ khor rkyang du gnas pa'i grub mtha' zhig ma yin par srol rgyun rtsom rig la sun 'byin byed pa'i grub mtha' mang po'i spyi ming zhig red/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig ni ma rtsa ring lugs de btsan rgyal ring lugs su bskyod pa'i dus skabs su byung ba zhig red/ rang mos ma rtsa ring lugs de 'phel rgyas phyin nas sger sdem ma rtsa ring lugs (btsan rgyal ring lugs )kyi dus rim du slebs pa'i rjes su ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs nyin bzhin rno ngar je cher ru 'gro bzhin yod pa red/rgyal nang du sger sdem 'byor ldan gral rim dang rgya che'i mi dmangs bar dang lhag par bzo pa gral rim bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag je cher gyur nas dpal 'byor gyi nyams nyen rgyun chad med par thon pa dang / dbul phyug mtha' gnyis su gyes pa'i gnas tshul tshabs je cher song ba/ chab srid kyi rnam pa ya yom che zhing lhing 'jags med pa/ ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab dbar mi ser

spel yul 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i gnad don bcas 'gal ba sna tshogs bstud mar lhags pa sogs rgyal khab phyi nang gi rno ngar rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'gapa ba sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi bsam pa'i nyams nyen bslangs pa red/ de lta bu'i gnad don du ma phung por spungs pa'i don dngos kyi mdun du shes yon can mang por phugs bsam wu ba ltar yal ba dang / 'tsho ba don gyis stong ba/ bsam pa gdung bas non pa bcas kyi tshor snang byung ste/ ‘‘dus rabs stong kha'i skyo gdung ’’zhes pa de byung ba red/'bring rim dang dma' rim gyi shes yon can mi nyung ba zhig gis phyogs gcig nas mthong chos su gyur pa'i dngos don de tshor yid thang chad de mdun lam nyag phra zhing mdun bskyod kyi lam bu med par snyam pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas spyi tshogs ring lugs la go ba mi lon zhing yid mi ches par ma zad bzo pa'i gsar brje'i las 'gul la skrag snang dang bcas sems gtso ring lugs kyi langs phyogs thog nas don dngos de tsho ni go ba len thabs bral ba dang khungs lung med pa zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ kho pa tshos bsam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khrod du phyir bshol nas / rang sger ’’gyi g.yul sa de nyid srung 'dzin byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang shes yon can gzhon skyes 'ga' zhig ni srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs dang don stong ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen phog ste sems shugs che na yang byang cha de tsam mi mnga' ba dang / srol gsar lugs gzhan gtod rgyur dga' bas de snga'i rtsom rig gi shul dngos yod tshad khas mi len par 'byung 'gyur ram dngos yod las brgal ba'i rtsom rig gsar gtod bya dgos zhes ku co chen po sgrog pa bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og da gzod deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig ces pa thon pa red/ 2

deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' thon snga shos de mtshon rtags ring lugs yin zhing / de'i sngon byon pa ni hpha ran si'i po te la'e er ( /82/—/867)red/ kho pa'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos 〈〈mi dge me tog 〉〉〈rtsozolo〉ces pa de mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i rtsom rig tu 'bod kyi yod/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang hpha ran sir mtshon rtags ring lugs pa'i dar cha dngos su 'phyar bar ma zad rim bzhin grub mtha' de'i rtsom pa po'i gsung khag cig thon pa red/'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i snga rjes su nub phyogs ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs rno ngar can du song ba dang sbrags deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' rnam mang snga rjes su thon te lo rabs nyi shur slebs skabs mtho rlabs shig chags pa red/ de'i grub mtha' gtso bor phyi dar mtshon rtags ring lugs dang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs/ dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs/ rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung sogs yod pa red/ skabs der 'dzam gling du bag chags ldan pa'i phul byung rtsom pa po khag gcig thon yod pa ni 'di lta ste/ brtsams sgrung thad o si khru yi kha hphu kha dang / er lan gyi cha'o dbyi si/ hpha ran si'i phu'u lu'u si the dang / zlos gar thad a ri'i a'o nyir dang / per ljam/ gyi me the ling kho/ 'jar man gyi hu'o phu'u the man/ snyan tshig thad a ri'i phang te dang / dbyin ji'i a'e lu'e the dang ye kri sogs yod/lo rabs sum cu nas bzhi bcu'i dus 'go bar hi the les tshab byed pa'i hpha shi si ring lugs shin tu smyo ham che zhing / hpha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i dmangs gtso'i rtsom pa pos dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig dar 'phel 3

'gro rgyur skul 'ded btang yod/ skabs der deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig ni rba rlabs mar chag pa'i dma' rim gyi dus skabs su gnas/'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi nyam dmas bsam blo slar 'go btegs pa dang / spyi tshogs thog gang sar ngan sems dang skyo shas kyi rnam pas khengs pa/ gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo gang sar mched pa bcas kyi rkyen gyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig dpyid dpal bzhad pa ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dus mtshams la slebs pa red/ dus mtshams de'i ring gi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la 6‘phyi dar deng rabs smra ba mi’zer zhing / grub mthar dbye na sa the dang ca mi'o yis tshab byed pa'i hpha ran si'i gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi rtsom rig dang / yi'u na'e si khu'u (pho ran si )dang / pe kho the (er lan )ar pi (a ri )sogs kyis tshab byed pa'i tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar/ a lan lu'o pu'u —ko li yes (pho ran si )tshab byed pa'i brtsams sgrung gsar pa'i grub mtha' smra ba/ ha'e le dang hpheng nyi kos tshab byed pa'i a me ri kya'i nag po'i dgod slong smra ba dang a'o si pun gyis tshab byed pa'i dbyin ji'i ra‘khong khro 'bar ba'i gzhon nu ’ sogs rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa red/bsam blo'i thad mang che ba gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang 'brel ba yod la/ sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thad phan tshun srol gsar lugs gzhan 'dzugs spel 'gran pa sogs rang rang gi khyad chos re bzung yod/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig ni deng skabs bar sngar bzhin nub phyogs rtsom rig gi gal che'i grub mtha' zhig red la 'dzam gling yongs la rgya khyab kyi bag chags ldan pa zhig kyang red/ 4

2 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i nang don gang red dam/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i nang don thad gsham gsal gyi khyad chos ldan yod de/gcig blang dor med par smra ba'i ring lugs (thokhrismotsho tshozo zo)sgrog spel byed pa/ de ni deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig dang srol rgyun rtsom rig gnyis mi 'dra sa'i khyad chos chen po de red/ yo rob tu rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs kyi mi chos ring lugs kyi rtsom rig nas dus rabs bcu dgu dang /dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bar gyi mtha' dpyod dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig bcas tshang mas blang dor smra ba (1tsho tsho)dar spel dang / blang dor smra ba'i ring lugs kyi dar cha mthor bsgrengs byas yod/ deng rabs smra bas de las ldog ste blang dor gyi 'jug ldog khas mi len pa dang / phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten dang chos nyid khas len gyi med/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i sngon gyi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa por gtso bo mtshan nyid rig pa hru pun hwa dang / po ko sen/ nyi tshale sogs kyi sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i shugs rkyen phog pa dang dus mtshungs/ sems khams rig pa ba hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed rig pa'i shugs rkyen yang phog yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes kyi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa por gtso bo gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i shugs rkyen phog pa dang dus mtshungs/ de min gyi sems gtso ring lugs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang sems khams rig pa 'ga' zhig gi shugs rkyen yang phog yod pa red/5

hru pun hwa yis 'tsho 'dod kyi 'dun pa (yang na 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa'am tshe srog gi 'dun pa zhes kyang 'bod )nan bshad byed cing 'dun pa de ni 'jig rten dngos po kun gyi 'byung rtsa dang / blang dor gi tshod 'dzin mi phog pa zhig tu 'dod la/ 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa ni 'jig rten gyi 'dun pa yin la mi'i 'dun pa'ang yin par ngos 'dzin/ mi'i 'dun pa zhes pa ni ‘‘bdag nyid kyi 'dun pa mi1zhes pa de red/ kho pas 64'dzam gling ni nga'i 'dun pa red lta ces brjod kyi yod pa ni bdag nyid kho na smra ba 'ud sgrog byed pa gsal po red/ da dung kho pas mi tshe ni 'dun pa yin pas 'dod sred kyi gzhan dbang du gyur/ 'dod sred ni mtshams tshad med la nam yang tshims thabs med pa zhig yin pa 'dis sdug bsngal skye bar byed pas na/ mi tshe ni thog mtha' bar gsum du sdug bsngal gyis khengs shing/ skyo gar las ma 'das pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de bzhin deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la nyi tsha'o yi skyo snang ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen yang phog yod/po ko sin gyis tshe srog gi ngar shugs ni 'jig rten gyi dngos/ po kun kha lo sgyur mkhan yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed cing / kho pas lkog tu gyur pa'i tshe srog gi ngar shugs kyis dngos po kun skyed par byed pa zhes pa'i thog nas dngos rigs kyi grub tshul dang 'phel 'gyur gyi skor 'grel bshad byed pa dang /mngon sum 'dzem med kyi sgo nas blang dor smra ba'i ring lugs la sun 'byin gyis mi'i rigs kyi blo rig gis 'jig rten ngos 'dzin byed mi thub pa dang /blo rig ni brtan gnas dang / bltos bcas/ phyi don gyi dngos po bcas yin pas 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog 'gro ba'i tshe srog gi ngar shugs shes rtogs byed mi thub pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ kho pas tshan rig khas mi len pa dang / gal te tshan rig gi go don de blo rig gi go don yin na de 6

'dra'i go don ni mis bzos pa'i brda rtags tsam du zad pas de nyid kyis 'jig rten gyi ngo bo mtshon mi thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ dus mtshungs kho pas lkog gyur gyi thad rtogs ring lugs sgrog spel byed cing /thad rtogs de ‘‘blo rig gi 'phro 'dur mi’brtsi ba ste/ de ni mi'i sems gting gi nyams len zhig dang / nang gzugs dang phyi gzugs yongs su 'phrod sbyor mnyam bsres su gyur pa'i dbyer med yul khams shig yin par 'dod/thad rtogs ring lugs kyis mi'i mngon sum shes pa dang / blang dor gyi ('jug ldog )shes pa/ de bzhin lag len bcas khas mi len pas de ni rang snang sems gtso ring lugs 'khrul med cig yin pa smos ci dgos/ der brten deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la po ko sen gyi lkos gyur thad rtogs ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen cung che tsam thebs yod do/nyi tshale yis smyo ham chen pos 88dbang shugs kyi 'dun pa smra ba ri’dang /'phags mi'i mtshan nyid rig pa dril bsgrags dang / stobs che bas stobs chung ba dbang bsgyur byed dgos pa 'ud sgrog byed pa ma zad/ sgyu rtsal thad 4‘sgyu rtsal ni sgyu rtsal rang yin pa rimedang / 46sgyu rtsal ni thams cad las mtho ba mi yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ kho pa'i bdag nyid kho na'i ring lugs dang sgyu rtsal kho na smra ba'i lta bas kyang deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la shugs rkyen sprad yod/sems khams rig pa ba hphu lu'o dbyi tes kyang blang dor smra bar sun 'byin dang / rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i nus pa nan bshad byed pa ste/ sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos ni rtog pa 'og 'gyu las byung zhing / de ni rtsom pa po'i sems nang gi rtog pa 'og 'gyu de mngon gsal can dang gzugs 'gyur byas pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyi yod/ der brten deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la kho 7

pa'i rig gzhung de'i shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs yod/gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pas sngon la rang snang 'du shes byung ba dang de'i rjes phyi don gzhi grub byung ba'i 'dod tshul sgrog spel shugs chen byed pa ma zad/ 'jig rten ni khungs lung med pa dang / mi tshe ni sdug bsngal du 'dod pa'i rang snang sems gtso ring lugs dang nyams dmas ring lugs kyi bsam blo de deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi rtsom yig mang po'i khrod du sim bsres byung yod/gnyis/ bdag nyid mngon par mtshon dgos pa nan bshad byed pa/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gis khor yug 'bri 'god bya rgyur mthong chen mi byed par mi sna'i rang snang 'jig rten mngon mtshon bya rgyu gtso bor 'dzin gyi yod/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos mi'i sems nang gi 'tsho ba de brtsam bya'i gtso gnad du brtsis nas mi'i sems khams kyi 'gul skyod zhib 'god legs 'bri dang / mi sna'i sems shugs/ 'brel dran/ 'char sgo/ 'khrul snang de bzhin brtse dung gi 'gyur ba phra mo sogs mtshon thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos rtag tu mi sger gyi nang sems 'tsho ba brjod bya gtso bor 'bri ba dang / kho pa tshos yin min go ldog dang nya yung mnyam bsres byed pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs khrod du mi ni mi ma yin par gyur zin la/ mi rang nyid kyi ngo bo yang gyur zin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed par brten/ kho pa tsho'i rnga/sar rtsom de'ang 6‘bdag nyid 'tshol ba'i )rtsom rig tu gyur cing / der brten kho tshos sor mo'i 'du byed las thon pa'i mi sna rnams kyang ma rabs tha shal dang / ya ma gzugs/ tha na spyi tshogs kyi phyi rol du gnas 'cha' ba'i ljongs rgyu ba bcas shig red/ 8

3 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la gsham gsal gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos ldan yod de/ gcig srol rgyun gyi dngos yod ring lugs la sun 'byin dang /dpe mtshon khor yug khrod kyi dpe mtshon mi sna 'bri 'god bya rgyur sun phyung ste/sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thad blo rgya chen pos gsar gtod bya dgos rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ kho pa tshos rnam pa'i thad srol gsar lugs gzhan 'jugs rgyu kho na don gnyer byed pas/ rnam pa ring lugs kyi 'ching rgyar tshud rgyu ni g.yol thabs med pa zhig red/ brtsams chos 'ga' zhig gi mi sna'i snang brnyan de kha thor ya bral dang rab rib zang zing gi rkyen pas klog pa pos mi sna gtso bo yang snying pho mo gang yin shes rtogs mi thub pa dang / brtsams chos 'ga' zhig gi khrod du ming gcig yin pa gzhir bcas/ skabs re de skyes par go la yang skabs re bud med la zer ba 'dra ba/ yang brtsams chos 'ga' zhig gi rtsom yig cha tshang ni deb gzugs su 'tshem sgrig ma byas pa'i shog bu sil ma las grub pa sha stag yin stabs/ klog pa pos de'i khrod kyi shog bu gang 'dra zhig nas 'go btsugs te ci dgar klog chog pa sogs rnam pa dpe gsar yin la nang don ci yin rtogs mi thub pa'i brtsams chos 'di rigs la rtsom rig gi rin thang zhes pa gleng thabs bral lo/gnyis/ mtshon rtags te deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos rtag tu mtshon rtags kyi 'bri thabs spyod kyi yod/ mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos mtshon rtags de mtshon byed gtso bo zhig tu brtsi bar ma zad/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom pa po dang tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar bas kyang 'bri 9

thabs de nyid spyod rgyur dga' po yod/ kho pa tshos rang mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan la brten te spyi mtshan gyi go don mtshon par byed pa dang / dngos po'i tshor ba yod pa'i gzugs brnyan la brten te dpog dka' ba dang khong du sbed pa'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon par byed kyi yod/ deng rabs smra bas mtshon rtags kyi 'bri thabs spyod skabs ga dus yin rung rang gi thad po'i tshor ba dang dmigs bsal gyi myong goms la brten gyi yod pas rang snang gang bsam gyi rang bzhin shin tu chen po yod pa ste/ dper na gshags bcos stegs bu'i thog sbrid sman brgyab ste bzhag pa'i nad pas sa sros kyi dus mtshon par byed pa lta bu klog pa pos go ba len thabs med pa de 'dra red/ deng rabs smra bas tshor ba la brten nas bsam blo mtshon par byed pa dang / bsam blo de tshor ba la phyir ldog bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ kho pa tshos dngos yod ring lugs kyi dpe mtshon can la sun 'byin par ma zad/ 'char yan ring lugs kyi brtse dung thad kur mtshon thabs la'ang sun 'byin gyis rang mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan la brten te sems gting gi bsam pa'i brtse dung mtshon dgorjeg par 'dod pa dper na/ ye kri'i snyan tshig tu 6‘nga tsho'i khrag dron la brten na/ da bzod rgya se'i sdong po gso thub minyaces pa'i rgya se'i sdong po ni skabs 'dir snyan ngag pas dga' zhen byed pa'i mes rgyal er lan gyi mtshon rtags yin pa lta bu'o/gsum/ rtog pa rang yan pa/ (hrū kāshā po/ ) sems rgyun rgyu ba yang zer/'di ni deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos yongs khyab tu spyod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'bri thabs shig red/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gis rang snang 'jig rten mtshon rgyu gtso cher 'dzin par brten sems khams 'bri 'god bya rgyur mthong che byed cing / kho pa tshos bsam pa'i chig lab dang rang mos 'brel dran la /0

brten te mi sna'i rnyog 'dzing che la dpog dka' ba dang / rgyun chad med par 'gyur ldog 'gro ba'i sems khams kyi 'gul skyod mtshon par byed la/ mi sna'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu 'gul skyod 'tshol zhib kyis mi sna'i rtog pa dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i rgyun chad med par 'khor skyod byed pa'i rnam pa mtshon thabs byed kyi yod/ rang snang rtog pa'i 'gul skyod 'di rigs la rang 'dod kyi rang bzhin dang / mchong bskyod kyi rang bzhin shugs che ldan pa ma zad/ ska bas re zang zing mgo mjug 'khrugs pa'ang yong gi yod/ rtog pa rang yan pa'i 'bri thabs kyis rang mos 'brel dran bya rgyu gtso bor bzung ste dngos yod dang rmi lam 'khrul snang dang / de ring dang sang nyin/ rtog pa dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu bcas zung 'brel byed pa dang / yul dus kyi thad la/ rtag tu dus tshod kyi go rim go ldog dang / yul gyi dbye mtshams mnyam bsres byed kyi yod/'bri thabs 'di rigs kyis mi'i sems gting gi gsang ba dang bang rim mang ba'i sems khams kyi 'gul skyod mtshon thub la/ sems khams 'bri 'god kyi 'khor rgya cher bskyed pas/ de ni deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos chen po zhig tu grub yod/bzhi/ tshul 'chal/ 'di ni bya dngos de nyid dpe med kyi ya mtshan zhig tu sgro 'dogs byed pa'i 'bri thabs shig red/ rtsom pa pos thabs mkhas kyis tshul 'chal gyi 'bri thabs 'di spyad pa brgyud bya dngos kyi ngo bo gsal ston byed thub pa dper na/ yi'u na'e si khu'u yi 'khrab gzhung 〈chub stegs 〉zhes par cha mtshon na/ sdings cha'i thog rkub stegs kyis khengs pa'i bar mtshams su rgad po gnyis dka' sdug chen pos dal bur 'gul skyod byed pa de ni/ rtsom pa pos tshul 'chal gyi bya thabs spyad pa brgyud dngos pos mir gnya' gnon gtong ba'i brjod bya gtso bo de gsal ston byas pa lta bu red/

tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar bas rtag tu zur za'i ri mo lta bu'i sgro 'dogs kyi 'bri thabs spyod pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos kyang rgyun du tshul 'chal gyi don rkyen 'bri 'god byed kyi yod/ sgyu rtsal gyi bya thabs 'di rigs bed spyod legs po gtong thub na/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas brtsams chos kyi brjod bya gtso bo gsal ston dang / klog pa po'i gcig mthun gyi mnyam grags kyi spro ba bsrings thub pa/ kho jo'i mno sems la skul 'ded gtong thub pa bcas byed thub/4 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la gdeng 'jog ji 'dra bya dgos sam/rang rgyal gyi dpyad gtam las rigs khrod du deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi dpyad brjod thad bsam 'char gcig mthun byung yod pa ma red/'ga' zhig gis de khyon yongs nas khas mi len par rgyug pa gzhu thengs gcig la gsod rgyu'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis mos bkur tshad med kyi sgo nas de ni rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs rig rtsal 'phel rgyas kyi kha phyogs yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ cung yongs khyab kyi bsam 'char ni/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi lta ba gzhir bzung deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos la zhib phra'i dbye zhib kyi thog nas dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi gdeng 'jog bya dgos rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod pa de ni yang dag pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig red/ nga tsho'i ngos 'dzin ltar na/ nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig ni spyir bshad na phyi bzang krung spyod kyi khyab khongs su gtogs gshis/ nga tshor mtshon nas bshad na/ deng rabs smra ba'i brtsams chos mang por shes rtogs 12

kyi rin thang dang dpyad gzhi'i nus pa ldan pa zhig red/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi spyi tshogs rmang gzhi ni sger sdem ma rtsa ring lugs yin pas/ de ni spyi tshogs ya ma gzugs kyi khrod nas byung ba'i rtsom rig ya ma gzugs shig yin la des kyag kyog dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i spyi tshogs nang gi mi'i gzhan 'gyur gyi snang tshul gsal ston byas yod pa dper na/ kha hphu kha'i grags can brtsams sgrung 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉zhes pa'i nang / mi 'bur 'gyur ba'i mtshon rtags rang bzhin gyi snang brnyan thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod kyi mi sna chung gras tsho'i ya nga ba'i gnas bab mtshon par byas yod/ kho pa 'bur gyur rjes mi skad smra mi shes pas/ sdug bsngal yod kyang shod thabs bral ba dang / dngul gsog ma thub pas tha na rang gi gnyen nyes kyang yal bar dor ba sogs/ brtsams chos 'di 'dra bklags na/ nga tshos ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs shes rtogs bya rgyu gting zab tu gtong thub pa ma zad/ rang gi spyi tshogs ring lugs mes rgyal la de bas dga' zhen yong thub/ he'i le'i 〈dmag khrims don tshan nyer gnyis pa 〉zhes pa bklags rjes/ nga tshos a ri'i dmag dpung nang khul gyi mun nag gi snang tshul mang po mthong thub pa ma zad/ gnam rgya sa rnyi btab pa lta bu'i sger sdem 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid dbang 'og tu non pa'i mi dmangs rnams ni dbugs gtong len dka' ba'i gnas su lhung yod pa rtogs thub/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi sge'u khung 'di brgyud de nga tshos nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi spyi tshogs kyi nyes skyon dang mi khag gcig gi bsam blo'i rnam pa gsal rtogs byed thub pa bcas ni de'i shes rtogs kyi rin thang red/ de min deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal gyi rnam par mthong che dang/ mngon mtshon gyi 'bri thabs thad gsar gtod la dang zhen che bas/ 'bri thabs 'ga' zhig nga tshos dpyad /3

gzhir rung ba zhig kyang yin te/ dper na rtog pa rang yan pa dang / mtshon rtags/ 'brel dran/ 'char sgo/ bang rim mang ba'i grub cha sogs gal te nga tshos bed spyod 'os 'tshams byed thub na/ brtsams chos kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon shugs mthor 'degs kyis sgyu rtsal gyi phan 'bras gang legs thon thub pa yong gi red/ rang rgyal gyi grags can rtsom pa po wang meng dang ru'u kri con sogs tshang mas gsar rtsom gyi khrod du deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi 'bri thabs dpyad gzhir bzung yod/ kho tsho'i lag len gyi thog nas rtog pa rang yan pa sogs kyi 'bri thabs brgyud na brtsams chos kyi rnam pa gsar 'byed btang nas/ mi rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog thub pa'i ra 'phrod byung yod/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la gdeng 'jog bya dgos na/ sngon la nges par de nyid shes rtogs bya dgos pa dang / nan tan gyis zhib 'jug cig bya dgos/ de snga dus yun ring po zhig gi nang du nga tshos deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la rgyus mnga' de tsam med pa nas/ skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su nga tsho'i rig rtsal las rigs kyis bsam blor bcings bgrol btang ba dang / 'ching rgya 'ga' zhig med pa bzos thog nub phyogs kyi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig rgya khyab ngang ngo sprod dang der nan tan gyis zhib 'jug byas yod/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la gdeng 'jog yang dag pa bya rgyu ni shin tu gal 'gangs che ba'i don gnad cig red/ tshags par dang dus deb sogs kyi thog la'ang gnad don 'dir gros sdur tsha tsha 'ur 'ur byas yod/ nga tsho'i bsam par deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig khrod kyi dmangs gtso'i rang bzhin gyi snying bcud rnams khas len gang legs dgos pa dang dus mtshungs/ de'i khrod kyi don stong ring lugs dang skyo snang ring lugs sogs phan med kyi grub cha rnams la'ang nges par du /4

sun 'byin gyi rnam 'gyur 'dzin dgos/ deng rabs smra ba'i brtsams chos khrod kyi rnam pa gsar la klog pa pos dga' bsu zhu ba'i mtshon byed kyi 'bri thabs rnams blo rgya chen pos dpyad gzhir bzung ste/ rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur skul 'ded gtong dgos/5 ji 'dra zhig la ‘‘phyi dar deng rabs smra ba ’ zer ram/'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes kyi deng rabs smra ba la/ ra phyi dar deng rabs smra ba'am ri’yang na 64phyi dar deng rabs ring lugs mi zhes 'bod kyi yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs shi rmas kyi gnas tshul tshabs che zhing / yo rob kyi grong khyer mang po de snga'i rjes shul tsam du gyur pa/ yo rob dang a me ri kha gling chen gyi rgyal khab khag dpal 'byor dar rgyas 'gro zhan pa dang / ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'jig rten hril po 'gal bas khengs te mi rnams kyis 'od snang mthong mi thub la/ mdun bskyod kyi lam bu yang mthong mi thub pas/ phyogs bzhi khor mo yug mun nag gis dkrigs shing mdun lam nyag phra ba'i tshor ba byung ste/ sems shugs chag pa dang / skyo snang yid chad kyi bsam pa byung ba red/ de lta bu'i gnas tshul 'ogagazhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo spyi tshogs thog khyab 'phel byung zhing / rig rtsal las rigs thad rnam pa 'dra min gyi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' thon pa de rigs la/ 8 phyi dar deng rabs smra ba ’ zhes zer/sna phyi dar deng rabs smra ba ’ de hpha ran sir sa the dang ca mi'o yis tshab byed pa'i gzhi grub smra ba'i ring lugs kyi rtsom rig dang / yi'u na'e si khu'u dang pe kho thes tshab byed pa'i tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar/ a lan lu'o /5

pu'u—ko li yes tshab byed pa'i brtsams sgrung gsar pa'i grub mtha' smra ba sogs yod la/ grub mtha' de dag 'dzam gling gi khyon du bag chags ldan pa zhig red/ a rir ‘‘phyi dar deng rabs smra ba'i ri stobs shugs ha cang chen po yod pa dang / grub mtha' yang shin tu mang po yod de/ tshul 'chal smra ba'i zlos gar yod pa ma zad/ tshul 'chal smra ba'i brtsams sgrung yang yod pa dang /de min da dung nag po'i dgod bro smra ba'i brtsams sgrung dang / gnya' chag mi rabs gcig gzhi grub ring lugs kyi brtsams sgrung / brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra ba/ gsar dar 44brtsams sgrung gsar pa nya smra ba/ rim 'das brtsams sgrung smra ba/ spyi mtshan brtsams sgrung smra ba/ dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs kyi brtsams sgrung smra ba sogs yod pa red/ nag po'i dgod bro smra ba'i brtsams sgrung de a rir khyab gdal che shos dang bag chags zab shos ldan yod/thu phyi dar deng rabs smra ba'i mi’rtsom pa po spyir bshad na tshang mar gzhi grub ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i shugs rkyen phog stabs/ bsam blo nyams dmas sgyid lug gi dri mas non pa zhig red/ gzhi grub ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ni rang snang sems gtso ring lugs kyi khongs su gtogs pas/ rang nyid kyis tshor shes thub pa'i gzhi grub de da gzod gzhi grub ngo ma yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ mtshan nyid rig pa 'di rigs kyis bdag nyid lte bar byed pa dang / mi sger de thams cad las mtho bar brtsi ba/ spyi tshogs dang mang tshogs la mthong chung dang rtsis med kyi rnam 'gyur bcangs te 'jig rten ni khungs lung med pa dang / mi tshe ni sdug bsngal yin pa/ 'jig rten steng 'tsho ba rol ba'i mi phan tshun 'khon 'dzin kho na byed pa las phan tshun shes rtogs med pa dang / mi tsho'i mdun du lhags pa'i 'jigs snang che /6

shos ni 'chi ba'i 'jigs snang yin stabs/ mi 'jig rten thog gnas pa de mi rtag 'chi ba sgug sdod bya rgyu de tsam yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ dper na pe kho the'i 'khrab gzhung 〈se ma/ mdzes sdug gi nyin mo 〉zhes pa de ni/ mi rnams da lta gson bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang gom pa re re bzhin 'jig rten phyi mi'i lnga lam du bzhud kyin yod pa 'ud sgrog byed pa zhig yin te/zlos gar 'go 'dzugs skabs sdings cha'i steng rgad mo zhig yod pa de'i gzugs po phyed ka sa ser gyi khrod du sbas zin/ 'on te rgan mos rang nyid 'chi khar phyogs bzhin pa ha lam tshor shes med pa lta bus sngar bzhin rgyun gtan gyi goms gshis ltar skra shad pa dang / gdong dang so 'khrud pa ma zad kha nas da dung 〈e ma/ mdzes sdug gi nyin mo )〉zhes bsngags brjod byed kyi yod pa red/ a ri'i nag po'i dgod bro smra ba'i brtsams sgrung gis dngos yod spyi tshogs khrod kyi mun nag gi snang tshul sna tshogs ther 'don byed pa dang dus mtshungs/ rtsom pa pos 'dzems bag dang bral ba'i stobs shugs ngan par ga byed 'di byed med pa lta bu'i sgyid lug gi bsam pa yang mtshon gyi yod/kho pa tshos khong khro dang / sdug bsngal/ yid chad bcas byed pa ma zad/gad mo bgad de mig chu 'gebs pa dang / dgod bro'i zlos gar gyi rnam par brten nas skyo gar mtshon thabs byed kyi yod/ kho pa tshos chag sgo yong grabs yod pa dang / mdun lam nyag phra bar gyur par snyam pa de ni gzhi grub ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/sna‘phyi dar deng rabs smra bas ’’sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal thad 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i sngon gyi deng rabs smra ba'i mtshon rtags dang / rtog pa rang yan pa/ rmi lam 'khrul snang sogs kyi 'bri thabs rgyun 'dzin byas pa ma zad/ 'phel rgyas gsar pa'ang byung yod/ dper na tshul 'chal smra ba'i 17

zlos gar gyis chag grum gyi gar stegs gzugs brnyan dang / zur za'i ri mo can gyi sgro 'dogs kyi 'bri thabs/ 'khrab chas kyi nus par mthong che byed pa sogs gar stegs kyi mtshon thabs gsar pa bkol spyod byas pa dang /brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra bas kyang thabs rtsal thad rgyun chad med par srol gsar lugs gzhan btod pa dper na/ dbyin ji'i yu'e han zhun gyi 〈〈stabs ma legs pa'i mi 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos de 'tshem sgrig ma byas par khag so so byas nas sgam chung nang blug yod la/ khag dang po dang mtha' ma gnyis phud de byings tshang ma rang dgar gong 'og bsnor chog pa dang / klog pa pos rang 'dod ltar go rim sgrig chog pa lta bu dang / da dung brtsams sgrung gsar pa 'ga' zhig ni yongs su yi ge'i rol rtsed cig red/6 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig de'i dar 'go dus gang nas rtsi dgos sam/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig 'go tshugs pa'i lo dus gang la ngos 'dzin dgos pa de ni da phan lo mang ring rgyal khab phyi nang gi dpyad gtam pa mang pos rtsod mtshams ma bzhag pa'i gnad don zhig yin te/a ri'i snyan ngag pa bu phang tes gtso byas pa'i mi kha cig gis/ dus rabs bar ma'i rjes kyi lo lnga brgya drug brgya'i ring gi rtsom rig tshang ma deng rabs smra bar brtsi chog pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa dang / a ri'i rig rtsal skyon yon brjod pa po a'e te meng wer zhun gyi grags pa che ba'i brtsams deb 〈ar kho sa re er gyi mkhar rdzong 〉〉zhes pa'i nang / deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig 'go tshugs pa'i dus tshod de /870lor brtsis yod/de bzhin a ri'i rig rtsal skyon yon brjod pa po zhi lir khang nu'o li /8

sogs kyis /880lor deng rabs smra ba 'go tshugs pa'i ngos 'dzin byas/〈〈deng rabs srol rgyun 〉gyi rtsom sgrig pa po dang cha'o dbyi si dang ye krir zhib 'jug byed mkhan ched rams pa li a'e er man dang / hphe ter zhun gyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig thog mar byung ba'i dus tshod de /900lor gtan 'khel byas na de bas 'os 'tshams yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa sogs lta bu'o/'on kyang rgyal khab phyi nang gi nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la zhib 'jug byed mkhan mkhas pa mang che bas ten mag gi grags can rig rtsal skyon yon brjod pa po po lan kho si'i lta bar rgyab skyor gyis/ /890lor da gzod deng rabs ring lugs dngos su 'go chugs pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/ rang rgyal gyi rgyal phyi'i rtsom rig zhib 'jug mkhas pa grags can yon kho ca yis/ 6‘nga'i bsam par kho tshor bltos te bshad na bar 'dum gyi dus tshod cig bdams te /890lo de deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig 'go tshugs pa'i dus tshod du brtsis na legs pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod mi ces bshad/nga tsho'i ngos 'dzin la/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig dngos su 'go tshugs pa'i dus tshod de /857lo ste/ thengs dang po'i cung dpe mtshon ldan pa'i mtshon rtasas ring lugs pa po te la'e er gyi thengs dang po'i dpe mtshon du gyur pa'i mtshon rtags ring lugs pa'i snyan tshig 〈mi dge me tog 〉〉ces pa thon pa'i lo de yin zhing / nga tshos 'di ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/dang po/ 〈〈mi dge me tog 〉ni dpe mtshon gyi mtshon rtags ring lugs pa'i brtsams chos dang po de yin la/ phyogs yongs nas srol rgyun snyan tshig gi sgyu rtsal gtor te lam bu gsar pa btod pa'i brtsams chos dang po de'ang yin pas/ des mtshon rtags ring lugs dar 'phel dang deng rabs smra ba'i /9

rtsom rig dngos su 'go tshugs pa mtshon yod/gnyis pa/ 〈mi dge me tog 〉ni de rjes kyi lo brgya lhag tsam ring thon pa'i deng rabs smra ba'i grub mtha' sna tshogs dang brtsams deb kyi spyi'i 'byung rtsa yin la/ deng rabs smra ba'i brtsams chos mang che ba'i nang de'i shugs rkyen dang rjes shul mthong rgyu yod/ gsum pa/ 〈mi dge me tog 〉la deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos ldan yod la/ de rang nyid kyang dpe mtshon gyi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig brtsams chos shig red/ brjod bya'i thad/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gis rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'jig rten sngog spel bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod de/ 〈mi dge me tog 〉gis thengs dang por rtsom tshul gyi 'pho 'gyur chen po don thog tu 'khyol ba byas te/ snyan ngag pa'i sems gting du zab 'jug dang 'brel spyi tshogs mi gshis ngan pa'i rigs sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa'i yul du bzhag nas 'bri 'god byas pa dang / sgyu rtsal kyi thabs rtsal thad/ shugs bstan dang / mngon mtshon/ gzhogs spros mdzes rgyan/ dpyad sdur/ blo khams sogs kyi 'bri thabs spyi khyab ngang bkol spyod byas te/ mi sna'i sems nang gi gsang ba phyir 'don byas pa de ni/ 〈mi dge me tog 〉〉gi sgyu rtsal khyad chos gtso bo zhig red/ snyan ngag pa po te la'e er gyis ru'e ten lkog gyur ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba hri teng pa'o yi 66do tshab smra ba mi’'phel rgyas su btang zhing / ri chu rtswa shing rnams mi tshor 'phrin brda gtong mkhan 6tsamatshon byed kyi nags tshal nya’du brtsis nas/ phyi'i dngos po dang mi'i bsam pa'i 'jig rten dbar phan tshun tshur snang dang mthun 'phrod byed thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byed la/ snyan ngag pas sgra yod mdog ldan gyi dngos khams spyad de bsam pa'i 'jig rten phra mo shugs bstan 20

byed dgos par 'dod/ dngos tshor yod pa'i gzugs brnyan spyad de shugs bstan dang / gzhogs spros mdzes rgyan/ dpyad sdur/ sgro 'dogs/ 'brel dran sogs kyi lam bu brgyud mtshon thabs bya dgos rgyur nan bshad byas pa de/ rjes su mtshon rtags smra ba'i snyan tshig sogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig khyon yongs kyi gzhi rtsa'i 'bri thabs shig tu gyur yod/ bzhi pa/ po te la'e er gyi 〈mi dge me tog 〉gi rjes su /890lo'i sngon du wer lun gyi 〈snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal 〉(/884)dang / lan po yi 〈myos gru/〉(187/) ma la me yi 〈'brog lha'i phyi dro 〉〉(/876)sogs skad grags ldan pa'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag thon yod pa ma zad/ kho tshos lte ba byas pa'i snga dar mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi grub mtha' yang byung yod/ 1898lo'i sngon du snyan ngag pa 'di rnams snga rjes su grongs par brten/ /890lo ni snga dar mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi dus mjug yin pa las dus 'go ma yin/ gong smras don dngos kyi thog nas /857lo nas /898lo'i bar ni snga dar mtshon rtags ring lugs dar rgud kyi brgyud rim cha tshang zhig yin pa nga tshos gsal bar rtogs thub/ lo ngo bzhi bcu'i lo rgyus 'di ni nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig hril po'i khyon yongs kyi 'byung rtsa lta bu yin pas/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig lo rgyus kyi snga tshad de /857lor gtan 'khel byas na shin tu don thog la gnas pa zhig red snyam/7 deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi phyi tshad ji tsam la ngos 'dzin byed dgos sam/phyi nang gi dpyad gtam pa mi nyung bas nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig de /970lo'i yas mas su mjug sgril bar brten de'i phyi tshad kyang 2/

970lor gtan 'khel byed dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/gnad don 'di'i thad la'ang nga tshor lta stangs mi gcig pa yod de/ hpha ran si'i gzhi grub ring lugs de /980lor sa the grongs rjes rtsa ba'i char gnas med mod/ sa the grongs rjes a rir kho pa'i shugs rkyen sngar bzhim bsdad yod pa ma zad da dung yo rob dang / a me ri kha gling / la ting a me ri kha gling sogs su byung ba'i deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig mang po'i khrod du'ang de'i shugs rkyen sim thim byung yod pa ni smos ma dgos/ brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra ba'i gtso 'dzin lu'o pu'u —ko li yis da lta'i bar da dung gsar rtsom dang kho pa'i lta ba dril bsgrags byed mus ma zad brtsams sgrung gsar pa'i slob dpon chen po kho lu'o te zhi meng la /985lor no per rtsom rig bya dga' thob par brten/ hpha ran sir 46brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra ba'i tsha rlabs ’ shig bskyar du 'phyur yod/ yo rob dang a me ri kha gling gi deng rabs smra ba'i grub cha nyams len gyis grub pa'i la ting a me ri kha gling gi deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig dper na/ sgyu 'phrul dngos yod ring lugs sogs nyams med dar 'phel gyi skabs yin la/ sgyu 'phrul dngos yod ring lugs kyi mtshon byed rang bzhin gyi mi sna ca zhi ya mar kho sir yang /982lor no per rtsom rig bya dga' thob pa bcas red/de ltar bltas na/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig de lo rabs lnga bcu dang drug cu'i skabs ltar shin tu dar so che ba zhig ma yin mod/ de'i shugs rkyen sngar bzhin che ba ma zad da dung mtho rlabs gsar pa zhig thon mi thon shod dka' bas/ de'i phyi tshad kyi dus tshod da lta shod thabs bral ba zhig red/

8 dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs nyi shu sum cu'i nang rang rgyal la nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi shugs rkyen phog pa'i rtsom pa po ji 'dra yod dam/lo rabs nyi shu'i snga dus nas hpha ran sir slob sbyong byed pa'i li cin hpha la mtshon rtags ring lugs rtsom rig gi shugs rkyen phog yod pa dang / kho pas mtshon rtags smra ba'i snyan ngag pa'i snyan rtsom mang po bklags myong ba ma zad/ po te la'e er dang wer lan sogs la ‘‘nga'i mtshan 'dzin dge rgan nya’zhes 'bod kyi yod/ /925lo'i zla 2tshes /6nyin 〈yus si 〉( kāsbyotshozhes rtsom lugs sna tshogs kyi dus deb cig )zhes pa'i thog kho pa'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan tshig dang po 〈〈zas 'dun can ṣṭhatso〉zhes pa de 'grem spel byas shing / de lo'i zla / /par kho pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsdus 〈char zim/ 〉〉'grem spel byas pa dang / yang de rjes kyi lo gnyis gsum nang 〈'khor mgron dang lo ngan/〉 〈bde skyid kyi ched du glu len 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig phyogs bsdus snga rjes su 'grem spel byas pa red/ rang lugs gsar gtod kyi snyan tshig de tshor bstod smad mi gcig pa'i dpyad brjod byas yod rung / kun gyis mgrin gcig tu kho par ‘ snyan ngag pa mtshar po ’’zhes 'bod kyi yod/ de min gleng na'o khra'o dang / wang tu'u ching / mu'u mu'u then/ hu'u ye phin sogs snyan ngag pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang mtshon rtags smra ba'i snyan tshig gi gsar rtsom bya bar zhugs te/ wang tu'u ching gis 〈grong khyer we nyi 〉dang 〈'phags mi'i snang brnyan gyi mdun du 〉zhes pa sogs kyi snyan tshig phyogs bsdus par skrun byas pa dang / mu'u mu'u then dang gleng na'e khra'o yis rim pa bzhin 〈'grul bzhud kyi sems pa 〉dang 〈seng sgron dmar po 〉zhes pa gsar du 23

bskrun pa bcas/ na gzhon snyan ngag pa 'di rnams ni rang rgyal gyi ches snga ba'i mtshon rtags ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag smra ba yin/ lo rabs sum cu par mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan tshig dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rnam pa thon yod/ /932lor hre kri tshun dang / tu'u heng / ta'e wang hru bcas kyis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i 〈deng rabs 〉zhes pa'i zla re'i dus deb dang / de rjes ta'e wang hru yis gsar du btod pa'i 〈snyan tshig gsar pa 〉zhes pa'i zla re'i dus deb bcas kyis deng rabs smra ba'i snyan tshig krung gor 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur de bas skul 'ded btang yod/ skabs der rang rgyal du snyan ngag pa mi nyung ba zhig la tshad gzhi 'dra min gyi sgo nas deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi shugs rkyen phog pa dper na/ ta'e wang hru yi 〈nub kha'i nyi ma 〉〉dang 〈yig 'phreng bcu bzhi pa 〉〉sogs kyi snyan tshig la mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi bag chags mngon gsal dod po yod la/ zhus kri mo yis lo rabs nyi shu par po ti la'e er gyi 〈mi dge me tog 〉khrod kyi 〈shi ro 〉zhes pa rgya yig tu phab sgyur byas pa ma zad/ snyan tshig de ni ‘‘〈mi dge me tog 〉ces pa'i snyan tshig phyogs bsdus khrod kyi ches mi dge zhing yang ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yal med kyi me tog cig yin ’’pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/ po te la'e er gyi shugs rkyen 'og zhus kri mo yi snyan tshig nang du'ang mi sdug skyug bro ba'i blo khams 'bri 'god byas yod de/ dkon mchog gis bskyar du mi gsar skrun byas pa'i skor gyi 〈tshod lta bskyar ma gcig 〉ces pa'i snyan tshig khrod du lha'i pho nya'i gzugs brnyan bkod pa de'ang shin tu skyug bro ba zhig yin te/ 4‘da ni rgas po nga g.yo 'og tu mi tshud/ dwangs gtsang ni btsog par 'gyur ba mthong / tshul 'dir ji ltar khro bar mi 'gyur/lus la sha 'bu 'byar med pa'i lha pho nya pa su zhig yod/nyanya ces pa lta 24

bu'o/ gleng krir mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa lir kho'i shugs rkyen gting zab phog yod/ lo rabs sum cu pa'i nang kho pas lir kho'i 〈〈na gzhon snyan ngag pa gcig la springs pa'i yi ge bcu 〉zhes pa phab sgyur byas/lir kho ni snyan tshig thad rang mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan brgyud de 'jig rten khams dang mi che'i skor gyi gnas lugs zab mo gsal 'don byed mkhas pa zhig yin/ dper na kho pa'i 〈gzig 〉ces pa'i grags can snyan tshig de ni ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod mi dang spyi tshogs dbar gyi 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi dngos bris shig yin pa red/ hpheng krir yang lir kho'i shugs rkyen phog ste kho pas rtswa phran dang / lam chung / ljon shing sogs kyi gzugs brnyan spyad de rang gis ji ltar go ba blangs pa'i spyi mtshan gyi gnas lugs mtshon pa byed kyi yod/ ho chi hphang gis /93/lor 'grems spel byas pa'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag 〈lung bstan 〉zhes pa der hpha ran si'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa wa la'e li'i shugs rkyen mngon gsal dod po thebs yod/ kho pa rang nyid kyis kyang skabs der ‘phe ran si'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa 'ga' zhig gam tha na snyan ngag pa chen po 'ga' zhig la dga' zhen byed kyi yod/’’ 6‘pho ran si'i mtshon rtags ring lugs rtsom rig gis yid dbang 'phrog gi yod ri ces bshad yod/ kho pas hpha ran si'i mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi rtsom rig 'bor chen bklags pa ma zad/ a'e lu'e the yi 〈'brog stong 〉sogs snyan tshig la zhib 'jug gis de tsho'i shugs rkyen yang phog yod/ 1934—/935lo'i bar/ kho pas 〈nad tsha'i khrod du )〉zhes pa dang / 〈glu thung le'u gnyis/〉 〈〈gna' grong /〉 〈mtshan ljongs/〉 〈gnyid chag pa'i mtshan mo/〉 〈bye rlung gi nyin mo 〉〉sogs kyi snyan tshig bris pa de rnams a'e lu'e the'i snyan tshig gi nyams 'gyur dang 'dra ba'i 25

phyogs yod pa la/ rtsom nyams thad snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pas/ 'brog stong du lus pa'i mis 'u thug re zad kyi 'o dod 'bod pa lta bu yod pa red/lo rabs nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar krung go'i brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom la'ang deng rabs smra ba'i shugs rkyen phog yod/ hre kri tshun gyis dus skabs de'i ring rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung mi nyung ba zhig bris yod la/ lo rabs nyi shu'i dus mjug tu 'grems spel byas pa'i 〈sos char 'bab pa'i dgong dro 〉zhes pa der rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang rtog pa rang yan pa'i skor bris yod/ rtsom de'i nang rgyun gtan gyi dus tshod dbye mtshams gtor te 'das ma 'ong da lta gsum mnyam bsres byas yod la/ don rkyen gsal la ma gsa' dang / mi sna sne mang 'dres 'dzing bcas yod pa red/ lam 'gram tshong g.yog bu mo'i mig gi rnam 'gyur de ha lam rang gi bza' zla'i yid skyo'i mig zung 'dra la/ char chu'i khrod kyi bu mo ni thog ma'i mdza' gcugs la rol ba'i na gzhon ma dang shin tu mtshungs so/9 su'u ko la ti'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba gtso bo gang yin nam/su'u ko la ti ni (spyi lo'i sngon lo 469——spyi lo'i sngon lo 399)gna' bo'i ke ri si'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig dang / skabs der ke ri si'i sku drag gis dmangs gtso'i shog khar ngo rgol byed pa'i bsam pa'i gtso 'dzin zhig red/ kho pas bran g.yog bdag po'i sku drag gi chab srid la brtsi bkur dang / skabs der bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso shog kha dang 'brel ba yod cing yar thon gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i mkhas pa'i shog khar ngo rgol byed kyi yod/ kho par tshe gang ring brtsams deb med cing / 26

kho pa'i bsam blo dang gtam brjod rnams kho pa'i dge phrug se nu'o spun gyi 〈dran tho 〉〉dang / po la thu'u yi 〈gleng mol phyogs bsdus 〉sogs kyi brtsams deb brgyud nyar tshags byas yod/ kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba gtso bo ni/gcig mtshan nyid rig pa'i dmigs yul ni rang byung khams shes rtogs bya rgyu ma yin par rang nyid shes rtogs bya rgyu'i ched du yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ kho pas phya‘rang nyid shes rmongs yin pa rang gis rtogs/’ zhes pa bton te/ kho pa rang nyid mkhas pa ma yin par mkhas par dga' zhen byed mkhan zhig yin pa 'ud sgrog byed pa dang / kho pas rang byung khams kyi phyi don chos nyid kyi rang bzhin khas mi len zhing rang byung tshan rig gi gnas bab mar phab ste/ tshan rig gi sgo nas rang byung khams shes rtogs bya rgyu de dgos pa med pa dang lha la phog thug btang ba zhig yin pa/ lha ni 'jig rten gyi ches mtho'i bdag po dang / lha kho na gzhi nas spyang grung ldan pa zhig yin pas/ spyan zung g.yos ma thag 'jig rten gyi bya dngos kun gzigs thub la/ thos kyang thub pas lha med pa'i sa phyogs med la/ lhas dus gcig tu bya dngos thams cad la lta rtogs byed thub kyi yod pa/ 'on kyang mi'i blo gros ni rin thang ci yang med pa dang / lha'i 'dun pa dang blo gros de bya dngos kyi dmigs yul khrod nas mtshon thub la/ 'jig rten gyi bya dngos yod tshad ni lhas dmigs yul dang dgos pa du ma'i slad gsar gtod gnang ba yin pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed pa dang dus mtshungs/ mtshan nyid rig pas bya dngos kyi dmigs yul tsam la zhib 'jug bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyin yod/ kho pas bton pa'i dmigs yul smra ba de ni te mo kho li the'i dngos gtso ring lugs kyi gtan 'khel smra bar kha gtad gcog ched yin 27

la/ kho pa rang nyid ni lhas rgyal khab 'dir gnang ba'i legs skyes yin par 'ud sgrog byed pa dang / kho pa'i sems nang du skad sgra zhig yod pa des kho pa the tshom gyi gnas su gyar skabs rtag tu ji 'dra bya dgos kyi bslab bya rgyag lugs brjod kyi yod pa der kho pas 8‘mgon lha ’’zhes 'bod kyi yod/rjes su bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso shog khas kho pa log lta dril bsgrags dang / gzhon nur bslad skyon btang ste/ dmangs gtsor ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi nyes gsog par zhu gtug brgyab pas/ khrims khang nas srog thog gi 'khrun thag bcad pa red/gnyis/ 4‘spyod bzang ni shes bya yin zhes pa bton pa/ shes bya'i yul ni ‘‘bzang po mi’yin la/ ches mtho'i shes bya ni ji srid yongs khyab dang bltos med 'gyur med kyi 64bzang po ri zhes pa'i tha snyad de shes rtogs bya rgyu de yin zhing / kun spyod dang bya spyod ni nges par du shes byas rmang gzhi byed pa dang shes bya las thon pa zhig yin pas/ shes bya de kun spyod kyi gtso bo'i gnas su bzhag nas/ blang dor de kun spyod dang bya spyod 'jug ldog gi tshad gzhir brtsis yod/ kho pa ni shes bya dang bya spyod 'brel ba yod pa'i skor nan bshad byed po snga shos de red/ 'on kyang gang 'dra zhig la 64bzang po nya zer ba'i thad kho pa'i shod stangs mi gcig te/ skabs rer (bzang po )ni mi la phan thogs yod pa'i bde thang dang rgyu nor sogs la zer ba dang / yang skabs re tshod 'dzin dang / drang bden/ rtul phod/ tshor skyen/ rig rgod/bag yangs sogs ni ‘‘rnam shes kyi bzang po ’red zer/ bya spyod de rigs skabs re dge mtshan ldan la yang skabs re gnod skyon ldan pa zhig red/ blo gros ldan pa'i rnam shes kyi yang dag pa'i mdzub khrid 'og dge mtshan ldan par 'gyur thub la/ blun rmongs kyi rnam par shes pa'i nor 'khrul gyi mdzub 28

khrid 'og gnod skyon 'byung gi yod/ kho pas slob gso'i nus pa khas len byed mod/ 'on kyang shes bya dang kun spyod bzang po ni phyi don rang byung khams las byung ba ma yin par/ mi rang gi sems su dang thog nas yod par ngos 'dzin/gsum/ gtan tshigs rig pa'i thad phyogs bsdus rigs dbye dang mtshan nyid 'jog pa'i bya thabs 'don mkhan kho pa snga shos yin zhing / kho pas mi gzhan dang mi chos kyi gnad don skor gleng mo byed skabs/ rtag tu dri ba dris lan gyi bya thabs spyad de dri ba mang po bstud mar bton nas pha rol po ni gang yang mi shes pa'i blun po zhig yin pa khas mi len mthu med bzos rjes kho'i blo sne khrid de dngos 'brel gyi spyod bzang shes rtogs byed du 'jug gin yod/ kho pas sems skyed kyi rogs ram bya thabs de la ‘ skye rogs bya thabs ’nyazhes zer gyi yod/ go thos la de ni kho'i a ma'i (phru gu skye rogs pa )sa nas blo sgo 'byed nas rtogs pa red zer/ dngos yod don rkyen gyi khrod nas yongs khyab kyi rtsa don 'phros thabs byed pa de rigs ni phyogs bsdus bya thabs zhes pa de yin la/ phyogs bsdus byas pa brgyud tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid 'tshol zhib kyis mthar yongs khyab kyi don spyir 'gyur ba yin par 'dod/bzhi/ mdzes rig gi bsam blo'i thad/ mdzes pa ni tan tan spyod go chod pa zhig yin dgos shing / mdzes mi mdzes dpyod pa'i tshad gzhi ni phan nus yin la/ spyod go chod na mdzes pa dang gnod 'tshe yod na btsog pa'am mi sdug pa yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ kho pas mdzes pa dang bzang ba ni gcig gyur yin pas mdzes pa'i dngos po zhig yin phyin lta phyogs gcig nas blta ba ste/ spyod go chod pa gzhir bzung nas bltas na'ang bzang ba yin zhing / dngos po ji 'dra zhig yin rung de'i dmigs yul la zhabs 'dregs 29

legs po zhu thub na de ni bzang ba dang mdzes pa yin la/ zhabs 'degs legs po zhu mi thub na de ni ngan pa dang mi sdug pa red ces bton yod/ kho pas phan nus gzhi rtsar bzung nas mdzes pa'i bltos bcas kyi rang bzhin bstan yod de/ ‘‘'gog srung la bltos te phub mdzes pa dang / 'phen gtor byed bde dang de'i stobs shugs la bltos te mdung mdzes pa nyanyalta bu red/kho pas mdzes rig dang spyi tshogs tshan rig gnyis 'brel ba byas te brjod pa ni ke ri si'i mdzes rig bsam blo'i 'pho 'gyur zhig yin pa mtshon thub/ kho pas da dung sgyu rtsal gyis phyi rol gyi zhib phra'i gnas tshul rkyang par do snang byed pa ma yin par/ 8tshe srog mtshon dgos pa nyadang 8‘bsam pa'i gnas stangs mtshon dgos mi’pa'i ngos 'dzin byed// 0 po la thu'u la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs ji 'dra yod dam/ po la thu'u (spyi lo'i sngon lo 427—spyi lo'i sngon lo 347)ni gna' bo'i ke ri si'i phyi don sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig ba ba zhig red/ kho ni su'u ko la ti yi slob ma dang / ya li si tu'o te'i dge rgan bcas yin zhing /〈phugs bsam rgyal khab 〉dang / 〈bca' khrims thor bu/〉〉 〈〈gle tu'o yi rnam thar thor bu 〉sogs brtsams deb tu kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang / mi chos kyi kun spyod/ chab srid dang mdzes rig gi rig gzhung bcas rgyas bshad byas yod/gcig lkog gyur gyi rtog bcas smra ba/ rtog bcas ni bya dngos bye brag pa dang mi'i rigs kyi 'du shes las rang tshugs su gnas pa'i dngos gzugs dang dngos po kun gyi 'byung rtsa yin pa dang / rtog bcas kyi 'jig rten ni 30

ang dang po dang bden pa'i 'jig rten nyag cig yin la/ tshor shes thub pa'i dngos po'i 'jig rten ni ang gnyis pa dang de las mched pa'i rjes grub dang 'phrul snang gi 'jig rten bcas yin par 'dod/ ji srid 'gyur med dang cha tshang ba'i rtog bcas ni bya dngos bye brag pa'i 6‘dpe dbyibs dang / brtan med 'gyur ldog tu 'gro ba'i dngos yod bya dngos ni rtog bcas kyi cha mi tshang ba'i 6 grib ma mi dang 4‘'dra bshus dpe deb ’nyayin pa/dngos yod kyi bya dngos gnas pa ni kho tshor rtog bcas 88bgos skal mi du yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin la/ 'jig rten gyi thog ma'i 'gul shugs ni 6‘mkhas dbang chen po ri (bzo bo chen mo )yin pa dang / 4‘mkhas dbang chen pos ri gdod ma'i nyag nyog gi dngos po'i thog rtog bcas zhes pa bsnan stabs da gzod go rim ldan pa'i 'jig rten zhig grub par 'dod/ tshor ba'i yul ni dngos yod kyi bya dngos yin pas de ni shes bya ngo ma'i 'byung rtsa yin thabs bral/ shes bya ngo ma thams cad ni nyams med rnam shes kyis rtog bcas la byas pa'i 88dran gso ’’tsam zhig yin par 'dod/ rtsod sgrub rig pa ni rnam shes bskul nas rtog bcas dran gso byed pa'i thabs shes shig yin/ kho pas mi tsho'i lag len khrod kyi 'tsho ba de mun nag gi grib khung du btsud cing rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa'i btson pa lta bu rgyab sa phug gi sgo la bstan na nang gyang ldebs su grib ma nag yor tsam las ci yang mthong rgyu med pa der dpe bzhag yod/ po la thu'u yi mtshad nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyis nub gling gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo 'phel rgyas 'gro bar shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs yod pa red/ le nyin gyis sems gtso ring lugs kyi lam phyogs de 66po la thu'u yi lam phyogs risu gsungs myong ba ma zad/ po la thu'u yi sems gtso ring lugs ni 44khungs lung gtan nas med pa'i rtog 3/

bcas kyi lkog gyur ring lugs mi red ces ther 'don yang gnang yod/gnyis/ rnam shes smra ba gzhir 'dzin pa'i mi chos kyi lta tshul/ kho pas bzang ba ni ches mtho'i rtog bcas dang 'jig rten gyi ches mtho zhing ches mthar thug gi dmigs yul yin pa dang / mi'i don dam gyi bde skyid ni dngos po'i 'dod pa skong rgyu ma yin par bzang bar slebs thub pa bya rgyu de red/ mi'i rnam shes mi nub la skye ba 'pho len bya rgyu yod pa dang / mi lus ma lon gong nas kun spyod bzang po yod pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed la/ rnam shes de'ang khag gsum du phye yod de/ blang dor dang / 'dun pa/ brtse dung (sred pa )bcas yin gshis/ de gsum dang bltos zlar gyur pa'i spyod bzang gsum ni blo gros dang / rtul phod/ tshod 'dzin bcas yin pa dang /phugs bsam ni ches mtho'i spyod bzang ste blo gros kyi rmang gzhi yin la/'dun pa ni rtul phod spyod bzang gi rmang gzhi dang / 'dod sred bzod sgom bya rgyu ni tshod 'dzin spyod bzang gi rmang gzhi bcas yin pa/ de bzhin rgyal rigs dbang sgyur par blo gros ldan pa dang / rje rigs dpa' rgod la rtul phod ldan pa/ dmangs rigs mi ser la tshod 'dzin dang brtsi bkur bya rgyu kho na las med/ spyod bzang de gsum po mthun 'brel byed thub na spyod bzang ang bzhi pa ste 6‘bden don 'grub thub pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed/ po la thu'u yi mi chos kyi lta tshul de ni kho pa'i rgyal khab kyi rnam bshad ces pa dang 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/ thad ldir bran g.yog bdag po'i sku drag gi sger gcod dbang sgyur ched du rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gzhi 'dzin pa mkho 'don byed pa zhig red/gsum/ rim pa btsan pa'i ‘‘phugs bsam rgyal khab/ ri kho pas rgyal khab cig la mtshon na rim pa gsum du 'byed dgos pa ste/ rgyal rigs 32

dbang sgyur pa dang / rje rigs dpa' rgod/ dmangs rigs ngal rtsol pa bcas so/ dbang sgyur pas rgyal khab bdag skyong bya dgos pa dang / 8 mtshan nyid kyi rgyal po ’ ni rtsol med skyes pa nas thob pa'i dbang sgyur pa dang khrims 'dzugs pa yin pa/ dpa' rgod kyis rgyal khab srung skyob dang sgrig srol skyong dgos pa/ ngal rtsol pas thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi las la gzhol dgos pa bcas dang / rim pa 'di gsum gyi mi rnams ni gong ma lha yis lcags rigs mi 'dra ba las bskrun pa zhig ste/ dbang sgyur pa ni lhas gser las bskrun pa yin pas ches mchog tu gyur pa dang / dpa' rgod ni dngul las bskrun pa yin pas dbang sgyur pa'i las rogs su 'os pa/ ngal rtsol pa ni zangs dang lcags las bskrun pa yin pas ches tha shal du gtogs/ rim pa gsum po'i las bgos ni ‘6rang bzhin ’’gyis byung ba dang ‘ 'gyur med ’ cig yin pas nges par ji srid bar sra brtan du gnas dgos pa las phan tshun the jus dang brje res bya mi rung ba/ gal te de las ldog na 4rgyal khab kyi god chag tshabs che yin pa ’ bcas kyi 'dod tshul 'dzin gyin yod/ kho pas dbyi tha li'i lho phyogs su snga rjes thengs gsum bskyod de zhi la rgyal phran gyi gtso bdag gi bsam blor g.yo 'gul btang ste kho pa'i 'dod blor yod pa'i chab srid kyi lam lugs spel rgyu'i re ngan bcangs mod/ 'on kyang mtha' ma pham kha nyos nas phyir log bya dgos byung / mar khe sis 46kho pa'i phugs bsam rgyal khab ni e cib kyi rigs rus lam lugs de a rten sir phugs bsam can du 'gyur ba byed pa mi’de red ces gsungs so/bzhi/ mdzes rig thad/ dngos yod kyi bya dngos bye brag pa ni rtog bcas kyi cha mi tshang ba'i lad mo yin la/ yang sgyu rtsal ni dngos yod kyi bya dngos bye brag par lad mo byas pa zhig yin stabs sgyu rtsal ni ‘‘'dra dpe'i 33

'dra dpe ’ dang ‘6grib ma'i grib ma ’ yin la/ rtog bcas ni mdzes pa'i ches mtho zhing ches mtha' ma'i 'byung rtsa yin pa dang / mdzes pa ni bden pa yin la bzang ba'ang yin pa/ rnam par dag pa'i mdzes pa ni rtog bcas yin pas sgyu rtsal gyis mtshon thabs gtan nas med pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed/1 / ya li si tu'o te'i mdzes rig gi bsam blo gang red dam/ya li si tu'o te (spyi lo'i sngon lo 384——spyi lo'i sngon lo 322)ni po la thu'u yi phul byung slob ma red la gna' bo'i ke ri si'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi mdzes rig dang rig rtsal gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dge mtshan phyogs bsdus byed po zhig kyang red/ kho pas rang gi mi che'i ring 〈〈snyan ngag rig pa 〉〉dang / 〈tshig rgyan rig pa/〉〉 zhes pa'i brgyud rim ldan pa'i mdzes rig gi ched rtsom gnyis bris nas cha tshang ba'i mdzes rig gi ma lag cig btsugs pa phud/ de min 〈gzugs 'das rig pa 〉dang / 〈dngos khams rig pa/〉〈mi chos rig pa/〉 〈srid don rig pa 〉sogs brtsams chos su'ang gal 'gangs che ba'i mdzes rig gi gnad don gleng yod/dang thog ya li si tu'o tes sgyu rtsal ni dngos yod kyi lad mo yin pa gtan 'khel byas pa dang / dngos yod 'jig rten gyi bden grub rang bzhin khas len byas par brten der lad mo byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi bden grub rang bzhin yang khas len byung yod pa de'i thog nas phyi don dngos yod 'jig rten ni mdzes pa'i 'byung khungs yin pa'ang khas len byas pa 'di ni po la thu'u yi phyi don sems gtso ring lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs las gom pa che thag chod cig mdun du spos yod pa smos ci/ po la thu'u yi ngos 34

'dzin ltar na mdzes pa ni rtog bcas kyi khrod du gnas gshis/ dngos yod ni rtog bcas la lad mo dang sgyu rtsal ni dngos yod la lad mo byas pa zhig yin pas/ sgyu rtsal dang dngos yod dbar bang rim gsum gyis chod stabs sgyu rtsal mdzes pa ni bden par ma grub pa de red/ 'on kyang ya li si tu'o tes po la thu'u yi ‘‘rtog bcas ’’dor te mdzes pa dang phyi don dngos yod gnyis thad kur 'brel ba byas yod/ de bas brjod rin yod pa zhig ni kho pas sgyu rtsal gyi bden grub rang bzhin khas len byas pa ma zad/ sgyu rtsal ni dngos yod 'jig rten las kyang bden grub tu gyur stabs sgyu rtsal mdzes pa ni dngos yod mdzes pa las kyang tan tan lhag pa zhig tu brjod yod/ 'di ni mdzes rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thog gi 'phur mchong che thag chod cig yin pas da bar de'i shugs rkyen zab mo sngar bzhin gnas yod/ ya li si tu'o tes ngos 'dzin byas pa ltar na dngos yod 'jig rten ni bden par grub pa zhig yin stabs dngos yod la lad mo byed pa'i snyan tshig kyang bden grub tu yod pa shod mi dgos pa dang / snyan ngag la ches mtho'i bden grub kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan ni de dngos yod bden grub kyi lad mo zhig tu ma zad las snon dang gdam gses/ gcig bsdus dang snying bsdus bcas byas pa brgyud/ dngos yod bden grub las de bas lhag pa dang rnam par dag pa zhig tu gyur yod pas red/ kho pas 〈snyan ngag rig pa'i 〉le'u dgu pa'i nang 6‘snyan ngag pa'i 'gan 'khri ni byung zin pa'i gnas tshul 'god rgyu min par 'byung srid pa'i gnas tshul 'god rgyu ste 'byung srid kyi chos nyid dam ldog med kyi chos nyid ltar na thon srid pa de 'bri 'god bya dgos/mi zhes bris yod/ de las sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi dmigs bsal chos nyid bstan pa dang 'tsho bar sgyu rtsal gyi las snon dang gdam gses byed pa'i gal 35

che'i nus pa nan bshad byas pa zhig red/ kho pas da dung snyan ngag dang lo rgyus gnyis dpyad sdur byas pa'i thog nas snyan ngag gis glo bur gyi snang tshul rkyang pa 'god 'bri bya rgyu med par snang tshul gyi rgyab tu gnas pa'i ngo bo dang chos nyid 'bri 'god kyis dmigs bsal nas yongs khyab dang / bye brag nas spyi yongs mngon thub pa bya dgos rgyu'i gsal bshad byas yod/ lta ba 'dis sgyu rtsal pas dpe mtshon gsar bzo bya rgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gzhi 'dzin sa bton pa bcas/ mdor na sgyu rtsal gyi bden grub ni dngos yod kyi bden grub las byung ba dang sgyu rtsal gyi bden grub ni dngos yod kyi bden grub las lhag par nan bshad byed pa'i bsam blo de ni 〈〈snyan ngag rig pa'i 〉rnam shes dang srog shing lta bur grub yod/de min ya li si tu'o tes thengs dang por mdzes pa ni nang don dang rnam pa'i gcig gyur gyi ma lag khrod nas mtshon dgos zhes pa'i dkyus gcig gong bur 'gril ba'i lta ba bton pa red/kho pas rnam pa'i thog gi dkyus gcig gong bur 'gril ba ni nang don thog gi nang gnas chos nyid 'phel rgyas song ba'i phyi gnas kyi mngon mtshon zhig yin pa dang / cha shas ji ltar mnyam sgrig bya rgyu'i thad nges par du khyon yongs kyi nang gnas gtan tshigs la bstun dgos zhes bstan yod pa red/〈srid don rig pa'i 〉nang ‘‘mdzes pa dang mi mdzes pa/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos dang dngos yod bya dngos bcas bar gyi khyad par ni/ de snga kha thor du gnas pa'i grub cha rnams mdzes pa'i dngos po dang sgyu rtsal brtsams chos khrod du zung 'brel gyis gcig gzugs su grub yod pa de red ’’ces bstan pa'i mdzes pa ni tshogs spyir 'dod pa'i lta ba de ni kho pa'i mdzes rig gi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don gyi gras shig red/ kho pas skyo gar ni ke ri si'i sgyu rtsal gyi ches mtho'i 36

rnam par gtan 'khel byas pa ni skyo gar gyi grub cha de lo rgyus kyi snyan ngag las shin tu tshags dam zhing cha tshang ba zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis dang / rmang gzhi de'i thog kho pas rnam pa mdzes pa'i tshad gzhi ni ‘ mthun sbyor ’’la rag las pa ste/ ches 'os 'tsham gyi rnam pa spyad de ches 'thus tshang gi sgo nas nang don mtshon dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung ba bcas/ mdor na ya li si tu'o te'i mdzes rig gi rig gzhung gzhi rtsa'i cha nas dngos gtsor gtogs shing / des de rjes kyi yo rob dngos yod ring lugs kyi mdzes rig dang rig rtsal gyi rig gzhung la rmang gzhi brtan po btsugs yod//2 hru pun ha yi 'dun pa kho na smra bar nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs ni brtse dung gi 'dun pa'i ngo bor 'khyog bshad kyis de'i nus pa tshad med rgya cher gtong ba'i sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa zhig yin zhing / des brtse dung gi 'dun pa bla med kyi gnas su btegs te dngos po kun gyi 'byung rtsar brtsis stabs/ 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs zhes pa'i ming de thogs pa red/ 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs de thog mar 'jar man du dar zhing dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug dang nyi shu'i dus 'gor yo rob dang a me ri kha gling sogs su rgya khyab tu dar 'phel byung yod/ gtso bo'i tshab byed mi snar 'jar man gyi hru pun hwa dang / nyi tsha'o/ ten mag gi khor kha'e kor sogs yod pa red/hru pun hwa (/788—/866)ni 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs gsar gtod byed mkhan pa'i gras shig red la/ /848lo'i yo rob gsar brje chen po langs kha'i 'jar man 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mgrin tshab pa zhig kyang 37

red/ kho pa'i brtsams deb gtso bor 〈'jig rten ni 'dun pa dang snang tshul yin pa/〉〉(/8/9) 〈rang byung 'dun pa'i rnam bshad/〉 (/836) 〈mi chos rig pa'i rtsa ba'i gnad don gnyis 〉(/84/)sogs yod pa red/ brtsams deb de dag gi khrod du kho pas he kor gyi mtshan nyid rig par sun 'byin gyi dar cha bsgrengs te rang snang sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa smra ba bton pa de ni 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs kyi gal che'i yan lag cig yin pa der gsham gsal gyi gtso bo'i nang don tshud yod/gcig 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa ni 'jig rten gyi rmang gzhi dang bya dngos yod do cog gi 'gul shugs yin par 'dod/ hru pun hwa yis rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thad khang te'i rjes shul bzung ste 'jig rten de khag gnyis su 'byed pa ste/ cho ye gnas dngos po'i (khye4 nga༈1) 'jig rten dang sna‘snang tshul ’ gyi 'jig rten gnyis su phye ste de'i dang po ni 'dun par zer ye gnas dngos po'i 'dun pa zer ba de ni phyi don dngos po'i 'jig rten dgrar bzung ba'i lkog gyur gyi 'tsho ba'i nus stobs shig dang (mun 'thom dang 'gog thabs med pa'i ngar shugs 〉’shig yin la/ 'dun pa 'dis ‘ 'jig rten gyi nang gnas nang don dang ngo bo ’ grub pa ste 'jig rten bya dngos kun gyi 'byung rtsa grub par 'dod/ der brten/ 44'jig rten steng gi bya dngos yod do cog tshang ma ni 'dun pa de'i mngon tshul zhig dang phyi don can du 'gyur ba zhig yin pas/ 'jig rten ni 'dun pa'i me long tsam zhig yin/’ phyogs gzhan zhig nas yang ‘6le gnas dngos po'i ’’'dun pa de rigs ni 'du shes (rtog pa )med pa dang / mi'i shes rig gis tshod 'dzin bya thabs med pa zhig red/ de'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos ni 'tsho gnas brtson len byed pa zhig yin stabs ‘4'tsho gnas kyi 'dun pa ’’dang yang na 6‘'tsho 38

ba'i 'dun pa ’’zhes kyang zer gyi yod/ hru pun hwa yis skye dngos kyi rang gshis gal che shos ni tshe srog yin pas tshe srog gi rgyun bskyang rgyu ni bya dngos thams cad gnas pa'i dmigs yul du ngos 'dzin byed la/ 'tsho gnas kyi ldog phyogs su gyur pa ni 'chi ba yin pas/ de las thar ched nges par du mi rabs rjes ma skyed sring bya dgos par brten/ cis kyang 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa dang skye 'phel 'dun pa gnyis zung du 'brel dgos pa dang / mi sger gyi 'tsho gnas dang skye 'phel de rigs rigs rgyud spyi 'tsho gnas dang skye 'phel gyi yo byad du 'dod pa bcas/ mdor na 'dun pa ni 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa dang skye 'phel gyi 'dun par brtsi ba de ni hru pun hwa yi 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs kyi ches ngo bor gyur cing gal 'gangs che ba'i khyad chos su grub yod/gnyis/ blang dor ring lugs la sun 'byin dang dgrar 'dzin gyis 'dun pa nan bshad bya dgos rgyur 'ud sgrog byed pa 'di ni he kor gyi blang dor ring lugs la phar rgol byed pa zhig yin pa gsal po red/ hru pun hwa yis 'dun pa ni blang dor las mtho zhing blang dor gyis kha lo bsgyur mi thub pa zhig yin pa gsal bar bstan yod la/ ‘4mi'i blang dor gyi bsam blo dang shes bya de'i 'byung rtsa bcas ngo bo'i thog nas bshad na yongs su 'dun par brtsi bkur zhu ba zhig red nya zer/ mi'i sems khams 'du shes kyi snang tshul thams cad 'dun pas gtan 'khel byed pa dang tha na mi'i sha rus gdos bcas kyi phung po'ang 'dun pa'i thon dngos te/ 66gzugs kyi 'gul skyod ni phyi don can du gyur pa'i 'dun pa'i 'gul skyod las ma 'das pa ’’yin pas/'dun pas mi'i ngo bo yang grub la 'dun pa kho nas da gzod mi gnas pa de 'grel bshad kyang bya thub par 'dod/ gnad don 'dir nan bshad bya ched hru pun hwa yis mi rnams mi'i mngal du yod skabs nas 'dun pa'i thon 39

dngos shig tu grub zin par 'dod pa dang / kho pas mngal gnas phru gur klad pa yod pa ni kho par bsam blo'i 'dun pa yod pa'i rkyen gyis dang / kha dang pho ba rgyu ma sogs yod pa ni zas za 'dod pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i rkyen gyis red ces brjod kyi yod/gsum/ 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa de gcig nas 'jig rten gyi 'dun pa red la yang mi'i 'dun pa'ang yin pa nan bshad byed/ rim pa mi 'dra ba'i rtog bcas (1tsho༅)brgyud 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa de phyi don can gyi 'jig rten gyi dngos po sna tshogs su gyur pa dang / rtog bcas de 'dun pa'i 88'os 'tshams gyi phyi don can rinyadu gyur yod/ rim pa mtho shos kyi rtog bcas ni mi'i rtog bcas yin la bdag nyid ni mi'i rtog bcas kyi ches mtho'i mngon tshul zhig yin stabs/ bdag nyid dang 'jig rten ni kha bral thabs med pa'i rigs gcig dang / 8 bdag nyid ’ni 'jig rten gyi lte bar gyur pas/‘6bdag nyid mi kyi 'dun pa de'ang 'jig rten gyi 'dun pa dang rigs gcig tu mnyam bsres byung bar 'dod/ kho pas da dung snang tshul gyi 'jig rten ni nang gzugs kyis gtan 'khel byas pa dang / 'dun pa'i 'jig rten ni ‘bdag nyid nya kyi 'jig rten yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te ‘‘'jig rten ni bdag nyid kyi snang tshul ’yin zhes brjod kyi yod pas/ snang tshul gyi 'jig rten hril po 6‘bdag nyid nya kyi nang gzugs 'dun pa'i thon dngos su gyur te sems gtso ring lugs de thal drags pa'i phyogs su phud pa red//3 khang te'i sngon rtogs sems gco ring lugs gang red dam/khang te (/724—/804)ni 'jar man blo 'byed ring lugs dus skabs 40
