kyi grags can mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig red/ kho pas srol rgyun gyi lta ba rnying pa tshang mar sun 'byin drag po byed pa ma zad the tshom mam mtha' dpyod kyi lta stangs thog nas mi'i rigs kyi de snga'i shes bya tshang mar zhib lta byed par brten kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa de la mtha' dpyod mtshan nyid rig pa zhes 'bod kyi yod/ 770lo nas 'go btsugs te kho pas cha tshang ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag cig gsar gtod byas pa'i nang sngon rtogs sems gtso ring lugs dang / rgyu gnyis smra ba/ rtogs thabs med par smra ba bcas kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba tshud yod/ brtsams deb gtso bor 〈〈tshor snang gi yul khams dang bsam pa'i yul khams kyi rnam pa dang rtsa ba'i rigs pa/〉(/770)〈blang dor rnal ma mtha' dpyod/(tram̐rku༈snyi1tsho tsho༈khu ram̐//)〉(/78/) 〈lag len blang dor mtha' dpyod/(༅khrirmi1tsho tshoska6ram̐/1)〉(/788)dang 〈brdar sha gcod pa'i nus pa'i mtha' dpyod/(sko//o7༈ltaro/1)〉〉 sogs yod pa dang / mtha' dpyod de gsum pos kho pa'i cha tshang ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag grub yod/ khang te ni shes bya yon tan la thogs pa med cing legs skyes kyi rjes 'bras 'bur du thon pa'i 'jar man nye rabs sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan zhig red/ en ke sis 〈skam sa chen po'i spyi tshogs sgyur bcos las 'gul gyi 'phel tshad 〉ces pa'i nang ‘‘pho ran sir srid don gyi gsar brje langs pa dang dus mtshungs su 'jar man la mtshan nyid rig pa'i gsar brje langs pa de ni khang te nas 'go tshugs pa zhig med/nya ces gsungs yod/khang te'i sngon rtogs sems gtso ring 'u gas kyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i khyad chos ni/ dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs gnyis dbar gyi 'gal ba gzhi mthun yong thabs byas te bar 'dum ring lugs spel 4/

ba de red/ le nyin gyis 〈dngos gtso ring lugs dang nyams myong mtha' dpyod ring lugs 〉zhes pa'i nang lha‘khang te'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos ni dngos gtso ring lugs dang sems gtso ring lugs gzhi mthun yong thabs kyis de gnyis 'os med stun thabs yong thabs byas thog phan tshun kha gtad du langs pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs ma lag gcig gi nang du mnyam sgrig yong thabs byed pa de red ’ ces rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyis gsal ston mdzad yod/ gzhi mthun dang bar 'dum des rkyen pas kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta ba de ni rdzab tshal blug pa'i khro chen lta bu 'gal ba sna tshogs kyi phung por gyur yod pa de'i zhib phra'i nang don gsham gsal phyogs 'ga' zhig yod de/dang thog khang te'i sngon rtogs sems gtso ring lugs kyis de snga'i po la thu'u dang ti khar sogs kyi sngon rtogs smra ba'i lta ba rgyun 'dzin byas pa ma zad de bas cha tshang ba'i gzugs 'das rig pa'i sngon rtogs smra ba'i ma lag cig chags su bcug pa red/ kho pas shes yon ni lhan skyes shig dang skyes ma thag pa nas yod pa yin pa'i 'dod tshul gyi thog nas dngos gtso smra ba'i tshur snang smra bar sun 'byin byed kyi yod/ tshur snang smra bas phyi don dngos po ni mi rnams kyi 'dod blo ltar mi 'gyur ba'i phyi rol yul gyi don dngos shig yin pa dang / mi tsho'i shes rtogs kyi brgyud rim ni phyi ba/nas kyi don dngos dang mi rnams kyi nang gnas rang snang gi 'du shes gnyis rgyun chad med par zung 'brel byed pa'i brgyud rim zhig yin par brten/ bsam blo'i khyab khongs dang go don ni mi tsho'i lag len gyi bya ba'i snying bcud dang / mi rnams kyis phyi yul shes rtogs dang tshur snang byas pa'i thon dngos shig yin pa nan bshad byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang khang tes de dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du phyogs 42

gcig nas phyi gnas dngos pos tshor byed dbang por shugs rkyen sprad de bag chags dang 'du shes 'byung ba khas len byed mod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas khyab khongs dang phyi yul dngos po gnyis kha 'phral te khyab khongs ni sngon rtogs dang / mi'i klad pa'i nang gzhi ma nas grub pa zhig yin nga/ra brjod de de ni phyi gnas dngos po'i tshur snang yin pa khas mi len pas/ khyab khongs shes rtogs bya rgyur phyi don gyi rmang gzhi med pa bzos pa red/ 'di ltar kho pas shes rtogs brgyud rim khrod kyi rang stobs kyi nus par sgro btags shing phyi rol yul gyis rang snang yul can gyi thag gcod kyi nus par skur ba btab pas sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'dam dong du zags pa red/khang tes shes rtogs brgyud rim gyi lha‘mthar thug smra ba ri 'ud sgrog shugs chen byed pa dang / shes rtogs dang lag len dbar gyi sha rus kyi 'brel ba khyad gsod byed gang thub kyis lag len brgyud shes yon tshad med 'phel rgyas gtong thub pa'i rang bzhin rtsis med btang / kho pas mi'i shes rtogs kyi bya ba ni tshad yod pa dang 64dngos gzugs ri’ni shes rtogs kyi bya ba'i thu‘mthar thug go don ’’cig tu 'dod pa bcas/ 'di ltar mi rnams kyis lag len brgyud tshad med kyi sgo nas phyi don 'jig rten shes rtogs thub pa khas len byas med stabs kho pa'i 'dod tshul de ni rtogs thabs med pa smra bar gyur pa yin no/gzhan yang khang tes gzugs 'das rig pa'i shes rtogs smra ba 'ud sgrog gis shes rtogs ni 'gal bas khengs pa'i rtsod sgrub 'phel rgyas kyi brgyud rim zhig yin pa khas len byas med pa red/ kho pas ra‘ye gnas dngos po mi dang sna snang tshul gyi yul khams minyakha 'phral ba dang / nang gzugs dang phyi gzugs de bzhin lag len dang rig gzhung kha 'phral ba/ mngon sum shes 43

rtogs dang blang dor shes rtogs kha 'phral ba bcas/ de dag ni kher rkyang dang / 'gul med/ phan tshun 'brel med cig tu brtsis te gzugs 'das rig pa'i sgo nas de tsho lhu sgrig cha sbyor byas pa tsam du 'dod pa ni dpe med kyi 'chal gtam du 'khums so//4 nyi tsho'e yi 'phags mi'i mtshan nyid rig par nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/nyi tsha'i ( /87/4—/900)ni 'jar man gyi 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs kyi dge mtshan phyogs bsdus byed po dang sger sdem ma rtsa ring lugs kyi log spyod mgrin tshab pa zhig red/ kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang don gtso bo ni dbang shugs kyi 'dun pa smra ba (༈smo7zlolhu 1྅)dang 'phags mi'i mtshan nyid rig pa (polospostsa)yin/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos ni shin tu thal drags pa'i sgo nas rang ngos kyi 'dun pa nan bshad byed cing / rang gi blang bya dang re 'dod ji yod tshad gzhi mtho shos kyi sgo nas 'don spel bya rgyu de red/ kho pas mngon sum 'dzem med dang g.yo thabs ji yod kyi thog nas dbang cha 'phrog len dang / tha shal gyi bya thabs yod rgu spyod rgyur ji mi snyam par rang nyid kyi dmigs yul sgrub dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin par ma zad/ru‘kho bo ni kun spyod mkho med smra ba dang po de yin ’zhes 'ud sgrog byed pa dang /kho pas da dung mi dmangs mang tshogs la ches gdug rtsub che ba'i drag gnon dang / nyams zhan mi rigs la sgo kun nas btsan 'dzul rgya bskyed byed dgos zhes skad cor drag po rgyag gi yod/ nyi tsha'o yi mtshan nyid rig pas sger sdom ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tshad med rgya skyed kyi ham sems dang / ji srid ngom med kyi za rngam/ 'dzam gling hril po btsan bdag bya rgyu'i ham sems/ 44

srog chags las 'das pa zhig yin/ mtho rim mi ni mi ma yin pa dang mi las 'das pa zhig yin/’1 ‘‘spra de mir bltos nas bshad na ji 'dra red dam/bshad gad slong byed dang ngo tsha nyo mkhan zhig yin pa ji bzhin 'phags mir bltos nas bshad na'ang mi ni bzhad gad slong byed dang ngo tsha nyo mkhan zhig red ’’ces bkod yod/ nyi tshale yi ngos 'dzin ltar na/ mi'i rigs deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs su bskyod rjes bab zhan gnyod chung gi gnas bab tu zhan 'gyur byas yong gi red/ 'on kyang 'phags mis mi'i rigs las brgal thub pa dang mi'i rigs la 'go khrid byed thub pa/ rin thang yod tshad bskyar du gtan 'bebs dang gsar bskrun byed thub kyi yod/ 'phags mi ni rang byung dang spyi tshogs kyi khrims 'dzugs pa zhig kyang yin pas/ bca' khrims gtan 'bebs dang spyi tshogs dang rgyal khab kyi rtsa 'dzugs thag gcod byed kyi yod/'phags mis khrims bzo skabs phyi yul chos nyid kyi tshod bkag mi thebs la kun spyod goms srol gyi 'ching rgyar de bas mi tshud/ 'phags mi ni spyi tshogs kyi khrims srol yod tshad kyi steng du mthon por gnas yod pas/ rang 'dod ltar bden don bzo chog la mi'i rigs kyi bya spyod kyi tshad gzhi yod tshad gtan la 'bebs chog pa bcas yin par 'dod do/'phags mi'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i phyogs gzhan zhig ni ngal rtsol mang tshogs la mthong chung mthar son pa byed pa de red/ nyi tshale'i brtsams deb khrod du brjod tshig ngan rigs spyad nas mngon sum 'dzem med kyis mi dmangs mang tshogs la 'phya smod dang / mi dmangs ni byol song dang /zhabs 'dren pa/ khrom srang gi sbrang ma/ sa lud sogs su ngan smras shugs chen byed pa'i brjod tshig khro gtum che la tshig sbyor drag rtsub ldan pa dang /'khon 'dzin zab mo bcangs pa bcas ni ngan mthar son pa'i dmod tshig 46

med na ma gtogs yod tshad bed spyod btang 'dug ces brjod na chog kho pas da dung mi dmangs kyis 'phags mi'i bkol spyod la srung rtsi dang / 'phags mi'i bka' la nyan 'jog byed pa las 'phags mir bka' gyen log sogs bya mi rung zhing / bran g.yog gis 'phags mi'i bka' gsung ci sgrub bgyis na da gzod mi dmangs rnams skyob thub par 'dod pa sogs/ mdor na 'phags mi'i mtshan nyid rig pas sger sdem 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bsam pa'i 'du shes gcig bsdus thog mtshon yod/nyi tshale yi brtsams 'bras gtso bor 〈skyo gar gyi 'byung rtsa 〉dang / 〈kra la thu'u hri thes 'di skad brjod/〉 〈〈bzang ngan gyi pha mtha'/〉 〈kun spyod ma lag rnam bshad 〉dang phyogs sdom rang bzhin gyi brtsams deb 〈dbang shugs kyi 'dun pa 〉〉bcas yod//5 po ko sen ni ji lta bu'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig red dam/po ko sen (/859—194/)ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus phyed stod mar nub phyogs su grags pa che shos kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i gras shig dang /hpha ran si'i blang dor sun 'byin ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun khrod kyi dge mtshan phyogs bsdus byed po zhig red/ kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag khrod kyi gzhi rtsa'i srog gi ka gnyis ste thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs dang tshe srog mtshan nyid rig pa ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i khyab khongs su rang lugs gsar gtod kyi thun mong ma yin zhig yin par ma zad/ deng rabs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la bag chags shin tu zab mo ldan pa zhig yin pas nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi gal che'i rig gzhung 47

rmang gzhi chags yod pa red/hong li po ko sen ni pha ri si'i mtho rim shes yon can gyi khyim tshang zhig tu skyes pa dang pha ma gnyis po yi'u tha'e ba red/ kho pa lo na chung dus slob grwa chen mo'i ched las gra sgrig slob grwar slob sbyong byed skabs nas gna' bo'i rtsom rig dang rang byung tshan rig la dang zhen yod pa dang / mtho rim dge 'os slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod rjes kho pa'i rtsom rig dang rtsis rig thad kyi khyad yon de bas mngon thub pa byung yod/ /88/lor slob grwa thon rjes snga phyi bar gsum du pha ri si'i slob 'bring 'ga' zhig la slob khrid byas nas bsdad//89/lor kho pas lo na bcu dgu son pa'i gzhon nu ma lu'u dbyi si nyi pir ci dang gnyen sgrig byas/ /897lor bskyar du mtho rim slob grwar phyir log gis hpha ran si slob grwa chen mor 'chad 'khrid dge rgan gyi 'gan 'khur te sems khams rig pa'i slob khrid dang / /900lor hpha ran si slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i dge rgan che mo'i 'gan 'khur dang len gyis gna' bo'i ke ri si'i ro ma'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob khrid byas/ dus skabs 'di'i ring kho pas gal 'gangs che ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brtsams deb khag gcig 'grem spel byas pa dang / dbyin ji dang a me ri kha'i slob grwa che khag la slob khrid byed par thengs mang bskyod de slob ma phon che gso skyong byas pa ma zad/ thog ma'i char rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag cig btod pa red/ /923lor rgyal spyi'i mna' 'brel shes rig mnyam las rgyal spyi u yon lhan khang gis kho pa skabs dang po'i u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhir 'dems bsko byas pa dang / /928lor kho pa lo na drug cu re dgur son skabs kho pa'i rtsom rigs la 6 phun sum tshogs shing skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i bsam blo dang rmad du byung ba'i mtshon byed kyi thabs rtsal ldan pa'i nyanyargyu 48

mtshan gyi thog nas no per rtsom rig bya dga' thob/ /937lor kho pas nad mnar gyi khrod du kha chems yi ge bzhag ste rang nyid la tshe gang ring 'phrad pa'i gegs bar dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i thad kyi grub 'bras bcas khyon yongs nas phyogs sdom byas yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa 'go tshugs rjes kho pas hpha shi si'i stobs shugs kyis yi'u tha'e bar gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i bya spyod la 'gog rgol drag po byas pa ma zad rig gzhung las rigs khrod kyi rang gi shugs rkyen la brten nas ye'u tha'e bar lugs mthun drang bzhag gi thob thang sprod dgos rgyu'i re 'bod kyang byas pa red/ kho pas thog mtha' bar gsum du hpha ran sir bca' sdod byed pa'i 'jar man gyi btsan bzung dmag 7 dpung dang mnyam las bya rgyu khas len gtan nas ma byas pa sogs gzhung srong drang bden gyi shes yon can zhig gi nyams 'gyur mngon par mtshon pa red/ 1941lo'i zla /tshes 4nyin kho pa nad gzhis rkyen pas pha ri sir 'das grongs gyur rjes khar zhi'u zhes pa'i spyi'i bang so khang du sbas pa red/ mkhas pa 'di nyid la dran gso bya ched ri ne wa'i si ci la dpe tshong khang nas /946lor 〈〈po ko sen gyi gsung 'bum 〉bam po drug par du bskrun pa dang / hpha ran si'i slob grwa chen mos kyang 〈po ko sen gyi gsung 'bum 〉bton te mkhas mchog de nyid 'khrungs nas lo brgya 'khor bar dran gso zhus/(/959)deng rabs ring lugs kyi rtsom rig la po ko sen gyi gzhung lugs kyi shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs yod/ kho pa'i sems khams kyi dus tshod dang / bdag nyid kyi 'dun pa/ de bzhin thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs sogs kyis thad kur rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya bar sgyur bcos byung ba dper na/ bang rim mang ba dang bar chod mang ba zur tshad mang ba bcas kyi 'bur gzugs can gyi grub cha dang / yu/la dus 'khrugs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 49

thabs rtsal/ de bzhin mi'i thad rtogs kyi rang nus dang bdag nyid kyi 'dun pa'i gting zab kyi sngog 'don sogs lta bu red/po ko sen ni blang dor sun 'byin ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyi gal che'i tshab mtshon pa zhig yin zhing / kho pa'i gzhung lugs ni tshan rig kho na smra ba'i ring lugs dang bden sgrub ring lugs (༅/khrochazo)la mtha' dpyod byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod du 'phel rgyas byung yod/ kho pa rtsom 'bri'i las la shin tu mkhas pas/ rtsom yig rnams rjod tshig bde la yid dbang 'phrog pa dang / brjod don tshags dam pa/rtsom nyams rang dbang dang ldan pa bcas kyis rtag tu gson nyams ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi dper brten te dpog dka' ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i legs bshad kyi nang don gsal bshad byed thub/ kho pa'i rig gzhung gi brtsams 'bras de deng rabs yo rob 'bol rtsom gyi tshad ldan dpe gzhir 'dzin gyi yod/ po ko sen gyi gtso bo'i brtsams chos su 〈〈dus tshod dang rang dbang gi 'dun pa 〉(/889)dang / 〈dngos po dang dran shes/〉〉(/902)〈gzugs 'das rig pa mdor bstan/〉〉(/903) 〈gsar gtod 'phel 'gyur rnam bshad/〉(/907) 〈〈kun spyod dang chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs gnyis 〉1(/932)sogs yod do//6 po ko sen gyi thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs la nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs ni po ko sen gyi sems gtso ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i ma lag gi gal che'i grub cha zhig red/ de dang blang dor sun 'byin ring lugs kyi bsam blo gnyis ni phan tshun phyi nang du grub pa zhig 50

red/ de ni po ko sen gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i shes rtogs smra ba'i ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i khyad chos dang kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brtag thabs smra ba'i rmang gzhi red/ de bo'i thog nas bshad na/ thad rtogs smra ba'i ring lugs ni thal drags pa'i 'dun pa kho na smra ba'i ring lugs shig yin pa de'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos gsham gsal phyogs 'ga' zhig yod/gcig mngon gsal dod pazhi sgo nas mi'i blang dor gyi shes pas 'jig rten dang bden don shes rtogs byed mi thub par 'dod pa/ kho pas tshor ba dang / don spyi/ brdar sha gcod pa sogs tshud pa'i blo rig gi rnam pas bden don mtshon mi thub par 'dod la/ dbye zhib dang / mnyam bsres/ spyi mtshan/ snying bsdus/ rnam 'byed// phyogs bsdus sogs tshud pa'i blo rig gi thabs shes kyis kyang bden don shes rtogs dang gsal ston byed mi thub par 'dod/ kho pa'i ngos 'dzin la blang dor shes rtogs rnam pa yod do cog gis bltos med rengs gyur dang 'gul med 'gyur med kyi lta ba spyad de bya dngos shes rtogs byed kyi yod pas/ 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog 'gro ba'i tshe srog gi ngar shugs shes rtogs bya thabs gtan nas med pa dang dus mtshungs/ tshor ba dang / don spyi/ brdar sha gcod pa sogs tshang ma ni lho mis bzos pa'i ’nyabarda rtags tsam du zad na/ de tshos 8‘dngos gnas kyi grib ma ’ tsam las dngos gnas kyi gzugs brnyan ngo ma de ston mi thub par 'dod/gnyis/ rtog pa las 'das pa'i thad rtogs ni mi rnams kyis 'jig rten shes rtogs dang bden don khong du chud thabs nyag cig yin pa nan bshad byed/ kho pas shod pa'i thad rtogs ni mi'i rigs kyi blo rig las 'das pa dang / phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten hril po las 'das pa'i bsam 5/

pa'i nyams len la zer/ 'di lta bu'i nyams len gyi khrod du nang gzugs dang phyi gzugs kyi yul yongs su gcig gzugs su 'dres yod stabs/ thad rtogs kyi bsam blo gtong yul de'ang nang gzugs dang phyi gzugs gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbyer med kyi bsam blo gtong yul zhig tu gyur yod/ kho pas 〈gzugs 'das rig pa mdor bstan 〉zhes pa'i nang thad rtogs kyi mtshan nyid skor la ‘6thad rtogs nya’ces pa de ni blo rig gi 'phro 'du zhig yin zhing des mi rang nyid yul gyi khongs su bzhag ste de'i khrod kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos kyi rkyen pas mtshon thabs med pa'i dngos po dang phan tshun mthun bde yong ba byed pa zhig red ces bkod pa de'i thog nas thad rtogs kyang lkog gyur dang / rgyus mnga' lon thabs med pa'i go don cig tu gyur pa red/gsum/ thad rtogs kyi gnas bab mthor 'degs kyis thad rtogs la brtag thabs smra ba'i don snying ldan pa yong phyir po ko sen gyis rtsa ba'i khyad chos gsum rgyas bshad byas yod de/ dang thog thad rtogs kyis shes rtogs bya yul gyi thog nas bltas na/ blang dor ltar bya dngos kyi phyi tshul dang / cha shas/ mtha' skor ram yang na bltos bcas kyi khyab khongs tsam du 'jug pa dang mi mtshungs par 6‘bltos med kyi khyab khongs ’ su 'jug thub pa ste/ rgyun chad med par rang shugs bskyed thub pa dang / rgyun chad med par 'gyur ldog dang 'gul skyod byed thub pa dang rgyun 'byams su gnas pa bcas kyi khyab khongs su 'jug thub/ thad rtogs kyis tsa‘bya dngos kyi nang gnas tshe srog gi 'gul skyod ngo mar kha phyogs thub nga/ dang / tshe srog gi nang gnas ngo bo 'grel bshad/ 'jig rten dngos po kun gyi gsang ba rtog dpyod bcas byed thub pa de'o/ de'i nas ji ltar 'jug tshul gyi thog nas bltas na/ blang dor ltar tshor ba'i bsam gzhigs dang lag len la brten pa zhig ma yin par 52 —

thad rtogs ni dang thog 'dun pa'i 'bad brtson la brten nas mi'i bsam blo de ra rang nyid la rgyab 'gal dang nges par du rgyun gtan bsam blo gtong skabs goms gshis su gyur pa'i kha phyogs dang ltag sprod du bskyod dgos ri zhig dang / thad rtogs kyi brgyud rim ni rtog shes dang blang dor 'jug ldog lag len gyi brgyud rim las 'das pa zhig yin pas/ ‘ skyes thob kyi stobs shugs la brten dgos pa 'ba' zhig yin ’ na/ thad rtogs de'ang skyes stobs ldan pa'i mi kho nar ldan pa'i khyad chos shig tu gyur pa de 'dra red/mtha' ma thad rtogs kyi dmigs yul thog nas bltas na/ blang dor gyis lag len la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dmigs yul dang mi mtshungs par thad rtogs kyis dngos yod khe phan ldan pa'i dmigs yul yod tshad dor te thad rtogs kyi ched du thad rtogs byed pa zhig tsam yin na/ de ni snying po til 'bru tsam yang ma mchis pa'i dngos po zhig red/ deng rabs kyi brtsams sgrung khrod du rtag tu mi sna'i nus pa bud sgrog dang ‘6tshor byed dbang po drug pa mi zhes pa 'bri 'god shugs che byed pa de ni tag tag thad rtogs ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen yin pa mtshon yongad//7 po ko sen gyi ‘8bdag nyid kyi lta ba ’’zhes pa de gang red dam/po ko sen gyis kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i brtsams deb 〈dus tshod dang rang dbang 'dun pa 〉zhes pa'i nang tshe srog mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta tshul gleng yod/ kho pas rgyun 'byams (sbyoskoḥ)dang / ‘ gzhi rtsa'i bdag nyid/ 4‘bden grub kyi dus tshod/nya’ ‘4tshe srog gi ngar shugs ’sogs kyi rgyu rkyen las 'jig rten gyi rmang gzhi dang ngo bo grub pa nan bshad byed kyi yod/ ming tshig 53

de dag ni po ko sen gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i khrod kyi ches gzhi rtsar gyur pa'i tha snyad yin la/ kho pa'i sems gtso ring lugs de'ang ches gcig bsdus kyi thog nas kho pas ming tshig de dag la 'grel bshad rgyag pa'i khrod nas mtshon gyi yod/〈dus tshod dang rang dbang 'dun pa 〉zhes pa'i nang rtsom pa pos/ra bdag nyid ’ zhes pa'i go don dang gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos rnams rgyas bshad zhib phra byas yod la/ kho pas bdag nyid kyi mtshan nyid skor la bdag nyid ni ‘‘nga tshos rang nongs bsam zhib gting zab byas pa brgyud nya sgrub thub pa dang / ‘‘rang skyon rang zhib 'di rigs kyis nga tshos nga tsho rang gi bsam pa'i gnas stangs sna tshogs stangs 'dzin thub pa ma zad nga tshos de tsho ni mngon sum gson rjen dang / rtag tu 'gyur ldog 'gro ba'i dngos po 'ig tu brtsi thub ’ ces brjod yod/ gzhi rtsa'i bdag nyid phud pa'i dngos po ste mi rnams kyi rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i khrod du 'phrad pa'i phyi don 'jig rten ni nga tsho 66rang nyid kyi grib ma mi tsam dang / 66rgyun 'byams rnal mas stong pa'i khams su 'phangs pa'i sgra med dri med kyi grib ma ’nyatsam du 'dod pa 'dis/ bdag nyid ces pa 'jig rten gyi 'byung rtsar sgrub pa dang dus mtshungs/ yang rgyun 'byams de bdag nyid dang 'dra mnyam du brtsis te bdag nyid dang / rgyun 'byams ni ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i gzhi grub yin pa nan bshad byas yod/po ko sen gyi ra bdag nyid ’ kyi go don gsal rtogs byung rjes nga tshos kho pa'i bdag nyid kyi lta ba zhes pa gang la zer min shes rtogs byed rgyu khag po med/ bdag nyid kyi lta ba'i gzhi rtsa'i gnad 'gag ni/ dang po/ kho pas de snga'i rang snang sems gtso ring lugs pas bdag nyid ces pa de bsam pa'i dngos gzugs shig tu brtsi ba khas mi len par bdag nyid ni ‘6sems shugs 54

rang bzhin rnal ma tsam gyi sems khams gnas stangs ’’shig dang / bdag nyid ni 6‘sems khams nyams len gyi 'gyur ldog 'gul skyod de rang yin pa dang rgyun 'byams de rang yin mi zhes bstan yod/ gnyis pa/ kho pas bdag nyid kyi 'gul skyod de nges par du gtan tshigs kyi chos nyid nges can gzhir 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyun srol gyi lta ba rtsis med btang ste/ bdag nyid ni bltos med kyi rang dbang dang bdag nyid dang ldog med gnyis ni phan tshun phyir 'bud byed pa me chu gnyis lta bu gzhi mthun mi srid pas de bas zung 'brel bya thabs med pa dang / gal te bdag nyid kyis blang dor gyi gtan tshigs chos nyid la srung brtsi bya dgos rgyur btsan shed byas na/ bdag nyid kyi rang dbang med pa bzo gi red ces u tshugs mthar skyel byed kyi yod/gsum pa/ bdag nyid la bltos med kyi rang dbang dgos rgyu'i re ba byed kyi yod na kho par chos nyid kyi rang bzhin zhes pa gleng rgyu phra mo tsam med cing /bdag nyid dang bdag nyid gnas pa'i thabs shes rgyun 'byams de'ang shes rtogs bya thabs med pa dang dpog par dka' ba'i dngos por gyur yod/bzhi pa/ bdag nyid dang rgyun 'byams rnal ma spus tshad rnal ma yin zhing grangs tshad kyi khyad nus med pas grangs tshad kyi dbye zhib bya thabs bral ba dang / de ni mtshon rtags kho na brgyud gzhi nas mngon thub pa zhig red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas bdag nyid dang rgyun 'byams nang khul bar du mi chod pa dang so sor 'phral ba'ang min zhing / de ni smra brjod la brten nas mtshon thabs med pas bsam shes don rtogs bya rgyu tsam red/ gal te su zhig gis smra brjod la brten nas bdag nyid mtshon thabs byas na/ sems khams nyams len gyi rgyun de rengs gyur dngos po zhig tu 'gyur 'gro bas/ bdag nyid kyang 'khyog bshad du 'gro'o/55

/8 po ko sen gyi tsa yul dus kyi lta ba ’ gang red dam/po ko sen gyi yul dus kyi lta ba ni rang snang sems gtso ring lugs kyi yul dus kyi lta ba zhig yin pa de'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos ni 'gul skyod dang dngos po kha 'phral te 'gul skyod ni rang ngos bsam pa'i 'gul skyod du brtsi ba de red/dngos gtso rtsod sgrub rig pas 'gul skyod ni phyi rol dngos po'i 'gul skyod cig yin pa dang / 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog 'gro ba ni dngos po'i gnas pa'i rnam pa zhig yin stabs/ dngos po dang 'gul skyod gnyis kha bral thabs gtan nas med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ yul dang dus ni 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa'i dngos po'i gnas pa'i rnam pa zhig yin zhing / yul ni 'gul skyod byed bzhin pa'i dngos po'i rgya skyed kyi rang bzhin dang cher skyed kyi rang bzhin zhig yin la/ yul gyi khyad chos ni dkyus zheng dpangs bcas rgyu gsum gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bar stong de red/ dus ni dngos po 'gul skyod kyi go rim rang bzhin dang/ bar mtshams rang bzhin/ rgyun mthud rang bzhin bcas yin pa de'i khyad chos ni rgyu gcig gi rang bzhin ldan pa ste ldog tu mi rung ba'i rang bzhin de red/ dngos po'i 'jig rten ni phyi rol yul du gnas pa'i don dngos shig dang tshad bkag med pa zhig yin la/ dngos po'i gzhi grub kyi rnam par grub pa'i yul dus kyang phyi rol yul gyi don dngos shig dang tshad bkag med pa zhig red/ 'jig rten gyi don dam par grub pa'i gcig gyur ni de'i dngos po'i rang bzhin de yin pa bcas ni dngos gtso ring lugs kyi yul dus lta ba red/'on kyang po ko sen ni de las ldog ste phyogs gcig nas 'gul skyod dang 56

'gyur ldog 'gro ba de kho pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don du brtsis nas 'gyur med smra bar sun 'byin byed po zhig tu 'ud sgrog byas stabs/ kho pa'i rig gzhung der sna‘'gyur ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa ’’zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas kho pas dngos po dang 'gul skyod kha 'phral bas sems gtso ring lugs kyi 'dam dong du tshud yod/ po ko sen gyi 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog ces pa ni ‘‘dngos gnas kyi rgyun 'byams ’ sam ‘‘tshe srog gi ngar shugs ’’zhes pa de rang la brjod kyi yod/ kho pa ‘4rang gi phyi rol du gang yang med/ 6'gul skyod byed bzhin yod pa————de rang gis 'thus ’’zhes zer gyi yod pas/ dngos gnas rgyun 'byams de'ang dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi nang don mi ldan pa'i 'gul skyod rang nyid tsam du gyur pa dang / de ni dngos gzugs kyi gzhi grub ma yin par phyogs lhung gi rigs shig dang / 'gul skyod rang bzhin gyi rigs shig 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin ldan pa bcas red/ po ko sen gyis 〈gzugs 'das rig pa mdor bstan 〉zhes pa'i nang ‘‘dngos gnas ni 'gul skyod thub pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang / da lta skrun bzhin pa'i dngos po las bskrun zin pa'i dngos po med pa dang / 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin pa'i rnam pa las ma 'gyur so na gnas pa'i bdag nyid kyi rnam pa med/’ ‘ gal te nga tshos phyogs lhung de da lta 'go tshugs pa'i kha phyogs kyi 'gyur ldog cig yin par mos mthun byas na dngos gnas thams cad ni phyogs lhung yin pa de red ’ ces phyogs sdom gyi tshul du bshad yod/ de ltar na/ 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog la nang gzugs med par gyur pa dang dus mtshungs kho pas phyi rol yul gyi dngos po tshang ma 6‘sgyid lug ldan pa'i dngos po mi’zhig tu brtsis pas 'gul skyod dang 'gyur ldog 'gro thabs med pa zhig red/ der brten nga tshos 'di ltar gtan 'khel byed 57

chog pa ste/ po ko sen gyis 'gul skyod ni dngos po'i ngo bo yin pa khas mi len pa de ni don dngos thog 'gul skyod de bsam pa'i ngo bo yin par ngos 'dzin pa dang / kho pas shod pa'i rgyun 'byams dang tshe srog gi ngar shugs zhes pa de don dngos thog sems khams kyi bsam pa'i 'gul skyod la zer ba yin no/po ko sen gyi dngos po dang 'gul skyod kha 'phral ba dang sbrags yul dus kyang kha 'phral ba red/ kho pas 〈dus tshod dang rang dbang gi 'dun pa 〉zhes pa'i nang 'gul skyod ni dus tshod kyi rgyun 'byams shig yin pa dang / ‘‘'gul skyod ni bsam pa'i phyogs bsdus shig dang / bsam pa'i rigs su gtogs pas yul mi 'dzin pa'i brgyud rim zhig yin pa ’ dang / ‘‘'gul skyod ni rgyun 'byams yin pa las rgya che tshad ma yin pa dang / spus tshad yin pa las grangs tshad ma yin stabs/ yul 'dzin thabs med pa red/’’ ces nan bshad byas yod/po ko sen gyi skad cha de rnams ni khungs med kyi 'chal gtam rang red/kho pas 'gul skyod dang dngos po'i gcig gyur kha 'phral ba ma zad yul dus kyi gcig gyur yang kha 'phral yod pa red/ kho pas 'gyur med smra ba'i lta ba 'khrul med kyi thog nas yul la 'grel bshad byed pa ma zad/ yang bltos bcas ring lugs 'khrul med kyi lta ba'i thog nas dus tshod la 'grel bshad rgyag gi yod/ kho pas rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gcig rang la bltos 'jog mi gcig pa'i thog nas 'grel bshad byas te phar 'gyur tshur 'gyur mang po byas stabs rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thog zang zing thon rgyu ni ldog tu med pa zhig red/ kho pas brjod pa'i 'gul skyod de sems khams kyi 'gul skyod yin par brten deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos rtag tu kho pa'i yul dus kyi lta 58

ba spyad de dus tshod kyi go rim go ldog dang / yul dus 'khrugs pa sogs kyi thabs rtsal gyi thog nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed kyi yod pa red//9 po ko sen gyi mdzes rig gi lta ba gang red dam/po ko sen ni deng rabs grags pa che shos kyi 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba'i gras shig red/ kho pas cha tshang la ma lag ldan pa'i mdzes rig gi brtsams deb bris med par gtso bo rang gi mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta bar brten te deng rabs nub phyogs rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur la bag chags sprad yod/ kho pa'i mdzes rig gi lta ba de kho pa rang nyid kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i brtsams chos 'ga' zhig gi khrod du kha thor du mthong rgyu yod pa tsam las cha tshang ba'i mdzes rig ma lag grub med/po ko sen gyi mdzes rig gi lta ba gtso bor gsham gsal 'ga' zhig tshud yod/dang thog mdzes dpyod kyi 'du shes dang mdzes dpyod kyi yul gyi 'brel ba'i thad la kho pas thad rtogs nan bshad byed pa dang / thad rtogs kho nas da gzod mdzes pa sngog 'don dang / mdzes pa shes rtogs/ mdzes pa 'dzin thub pa/ thad rtogs ni mdzes dpyod kyi 'du shes dang mdzes dpyod kyi yul gnyis zung 'brel byed pa'i sbrel thag 'ba' zhig tu 'dod/kho pas bltas na/ 'du shes kyi snang tshul dang tshe srog gi snang tshul thad kur 'dzin mkhan ni mi'i thad rtogs yin la/ thad rtogs kyis dbye zhib dang mnyam bsres/ rnam 'byed dang phyogs bsdus bcas dor te rang stobs dang thad ma'i sgo nas bsam pa'i ngo bo bzung ste mdzes dpyod 'du shes kyi gting mar 'jug thub pa yin la/ rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung khrod du bskrun pa'i mi 59

sna'i rang gshis de mi de dang yug gcig tu 'dres skabs kyi skad cig tsam gyi dus tshod nang byung ba'i tshor snang dang tshad bsdur bya mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang / skad cig tsam gyi dus tshod nang byung ba'i tshor snang ni thad rtogs yin/'bri 'god byed skabs mi rnams kyis bltos bcas kyi dngos po'i khrod kho nar 'jog dgos la/ mtshon par byed skabs kyang gzugs brnyan gzhan dang tshad sdur byed pa 'ba' zhig brgyud de mi sna zhig gi rang gshis bskrun dgos pa yin na/ bltos med kyi dngos po ni lag tu len thabs med pa zhig red/gal te bltos med cig thob 'dod na thad rtogs kho nar brten dgos shing /thad rtogs kyis mi rnams yul gyi nang khul du zab 'jug byed thub pa dang yul gyi ngo bo 'dzin thub kyi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ thad rtogs la brten pa'i mdzes 'dzin gyi lta ba des rjes rabs rtsom pa por shugs rkyen zab mo sprad yod stabs/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos mi'i thad rtogs shugs chen 'bri ba dang mi'i lhan skyes kyi 'du shes mtshon thabs la 'bad pa byed kyi yod pa red/gnyis pa/ mdzes pa'i ngo bo'i gnad don thad/ kho pas mdzes pa'i phyi yul spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo khas mi len par bdag nyid dang rgyun 'byams/ tshe srog gi ngar shugs bcas ni 'jig rten dngos po kun gyi 'byung rtsa yin la/bang rim mtho shos kyi mdzes pa'ang de'i thog nas mtshon thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byed par brten/ bdag nyid mtshon thabs bya rgyu dang / tshe srog gi ngar shugs mtshon thabs bya rgyu de'ang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i nang don du gyur yod/ lta ba 'dis rtsom pa po rnams kyis srol rgyun gyi tshur snang smra ba las brgal te drang bden gyi sgo nas phyi don gzhi grub kyi snang tshul mtshon par byed pa de mi'i rang snang bsam pa'i 'jig rten gyi phyogs su bsgyur te gcig 60

bsdus kyi thog nas rnyog 'dzing che ba'i bdag nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'jig rten mtshon par byed pa dang / hur brtson chen pos bdag nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'phel rim sngog 'don bya rgyur 'khrid ston byas yod pa red/ kho pas tshe srog mtshon dgos pa dang / bdag nyid mtshon dgos pa dar spel shugs che btang bar brten/ mi rnams kyis rtag tu kho pa'i mdzes rig gi bsam blo der 4‘tshe srog gi mdzes rig ’ ces 'bod kyi yod/ po ko sen gyi mdzes rig lta ba'i mdzub khrid 'og nub phyogs deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos rtag tu bdag nyid kyi bang rim mang ba'i sems khams kyi grub cha dang / bdag nyid ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i god chag gi tshor ba dang / yul po'i tshor ba/ 'jigs snang gi tshor ba/ rtsa brlag gi tshor ba sogs mtshon pa bya rgyu de rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi nang don lte bar brtsi gi yod/ kho pa tshos mi'i bsam pa'i ('du shes )'dzin rgyur do snang dang / gdod ma'i tshe srog gi rgyun las 'phros pa'i mi sna'i sems nang gi rdeb rdung dang / 'gal thugagayo 'khyom/ mched 'phyur/ ldog 'gyur sogs mtshon pa byed pa ma zad/phra zhing zhib la spro snang bag phebs ldan pa'i rtsom stangs spyad de nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs po'i sgo nas sems khams kyi brgyud rim de'i 'khor skyod kyi rang bzhin dang / 'gyur rung gi rang bzhin/ 'gal ba'i rang bzhin bcas 'bri 'god byed kyi yod/ 'phel phyogs des mi'i sems khams 'bri 'god kyi zab tshad shugs cher btang ba ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na gsar rtsom gyi kha phyogs 'di'i dbang gis rtsom pa po spyi tshogs kyi dngos don dang kha bral nas sems gtso ring lugs su lhung nges yin pa ni ldog tu med pa zhig yin par brten 'gal rkyen gyi rjes 'bras kyang ha cang chen po yod pa bcas/ mdor na mi rnams kyis po ko sen 6/

ni deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' mang po'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i slob dpon du bkur ba de'i thog nas kho pa'i shugs rkyen ji ltar che ba mthong thub nges lags/20 po ko sen gyi tshe srog mtshan nyid rig pa gang red rngadasbub/ngo/ ko sen gyi tshe srog mtshan nyid rig pa ni rang snang sems gtso ring lugs kyi rig gzhung 'khrul med cig red/ kho pas tshe srog ni bsam pa'i rtog pa'i (zlo 1shā)'gul skyod tsam du 'dod pa dang / ‘6tshe srog ni sems khams kyi dngos po zhig yin pa rinyadang ‘‘rtog pa'am yang na rtog pa las 'das pa zhes brjod na yag shos yin pa de ni tshe srog gi rgyun zhig red ’ ces shod kyi yod/ kho pas 〈rgyun 'byams dang dus mtshungs kyi rang bzhin 〉zhes pa'i nang 64rgyun 'byams ni rtog pa'i don zhig yin pa dang / rang res rgyun 'byams kyi dus tshod thog nas bya dngos mtshon gyi yod stabs nga tshos bya dngos kyi gting du rtog pa'i grub cha 'ga' zhig bsnan yod pa red ’’ces gsal por bstan yod/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig gi thog nas kho pas rtag tu rgyun 'byams dang tshe srog gi ngar shugs de rtog pa'i 'gul skyod kyi nang gzugs bdag nyid yin pa gcig mtshungs su 'dzin par byed pas/ rgyun 'byams kyang bdag nyid kyi rgyun 'byams dang / tshe srog gi ngar shugs kyang bdag nyid kyi ngar shugs su gyur pa red/ kho pas 4‘dngos gnas de rigs ni dus tshod kyi khrod du 'khor skyod byed pa'i nga tsho'i mi gshis yin te/ rgyun 'byams kyi bdag nyid de red/nya’ ces bshad myong yod/rgyun 'byams dang bdag nyid kyi rmang gzhi'i thog kho pas/ bdag nyid 62

dang rgyun 'byams las tshe srog 'byung ba dang / tshe srog gi ngar shugs las 'jig rten gyi dngos po kun mched pa yin pa'i yongs khyab kyi spyi 'grel btod pa red/ tshe srog gi ngar shugs de mi rang gi 'gul skyod cig tu brtsi ba dang / yang gom gang mdun spos kyis tshe srog gi ngar shugs de phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten gyi rmang gzhi dang ngo bor brtsi gi yod/ 'on kyang lta ba der kho pas rigs sgrub khungs skyel gsal po byas med par 'dra dpe rgyas 'gebs kyi rigs sdur bya thabs thog nas bzhag pa'i chod sdom tsam red/gzhan yang kho pas mi ni 'jig rten gyi cha shas shig yin pa dang / skye dngos 'phel 'gyur gyi nus tshad che shos ldan pa'i thon dngos shig yin gyur na/mi'i ngo bo de 'jig rten gyi ngo bor grub pa yin pa dang / mi'i ngo bo de tshe srog gi ngar shugs yin gyur na/ mi gnas sdod kyi khor yug 'jig rten gyi nang gnas rnam pa de'ang de dang 'dra bar tshe srog gi ngar shugs yin snyam gyi yod/ de ltar na tshe srog gi ngar shugs de dngos po kun bskyed par byed cing yongs khyab tu gnas pa'i lkog gyur gyi stobs shugs shig tu grub yod/ lkog gyur gyi brgyud rim de'i rtsa ba'i rigs pa ji 'dra yin min la kho pas mi brjod par 'dra dpe rgyas 'gebs kyi gnad don du ma drangs te gsal bshad byas pa tsam red/tshe srog las dngos po kun ji ltar mched pa'i tshul la thabs shes mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa'i khrod du gzhi rtsa'i char rigs dang phyogs lhung mi 'dra ba khag gnyis su 'byed chog ste/ rigs gcig ni tshe srog ngar shugs kyi rang byung 'gul skyod de tshe srog gi ngar shugs thad kur yar 'phyur nas tshe srog gi rnam pa yod tshad thon gyi yod/ rigs gzhan zhig ni tshe srog gi ngar shugs zhes pa rang byung 'gul skyod 'di'i ldog 'gyur ni mar zag pa de red/ de 63

nas srog med kyi dngos po yod tshad thon pa de red/ phyogs lhung de gnyis phan tshun kha gtad dang / phan tshun nang thim/ phan tshun tshod 'dzin byed pa bcas las nyams 'gyur 'dra min sna tshogs dang 'gyur ba khri stong can gyi 'jig rten gyi dngos po kun grub pa dang / rmang gzhi de'i thog kho pas 'jig rten hril po tshe srog ngar shugs kyi khyab khongs su bzhag nas mtho ba mi'i brtse dung 'du shes kyi 'gul skyod dang / dma' ba skye med dngos rdzas bcas tshud pa tshang ma tshe srog ngar shugs kyi thon dngos yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ dus mtshungs kho pas da dung tshe srog ngar shugs kyi brgyud rim ni rang 'gul gsar gtod kyi brgyud rim zhig yin pas/ rang byung gi chos nyid dam blang dor gyi chos nyid sogs gang la'ang bltos pa med ces nan bshad yang se byed pa de'i thog nas tshe srog gi ngar shugs de gang dran dran dang / stes dbang / mun 'thom gyi khyad chos chen po gsum dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur pa las thams cad mched par 'dod pa'i lta ba de ni sems gtso ring lugs yin pa smos ci dgos la/ der shugs drag che ba'i 'dun pa kho na'i ring lugs dang / bltos bcas ring lugs/ lkog gyur ring lugs bcas kyi phyogs lhung yang ldan yod/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa pos lhag tu tshe srog ngar shugs kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa de rtsom rig gsar rtsom du bed spyad de bdag nyid la bstod glu len pa dang bdag nyid de rtsom rig gi bri bya'i lte gnad du 'dzin gyi yod la/yang kho pa tshos tshe srog gi gdod ma'i dngangs 'dar shugs chen 'bri ba dang /mi'i rigs kyi ches gdod ma dang ches rtsing spyod kyi 'dod sred de mdzes mtshon gyi yul du brtsi gi yod pa bcas red/ 64

2/ thu lu'o dbyi te ni mkhas pa ji 'dra zhig red dam/hphu lu'o dbyi te ni yo rob tu skad grags yod pa'i sems khams rig pa dang dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi nad kyi sman pa/ yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa'i srol gtod pa bcas red/ /856lor o si khru yi mo la we yar skyes/ kho pa'i pha ma gnyis po yi'u tha'e ba red/ kho pa lo bzhir son skabs we ye nar gnas spo byas pa dang de rjes yun ring sa cha de rang la bsdad/ byis pa'i dus su khyim du pha rgan gyis yi ge bslabs nas bsdad/ de skabs nas kho par skyes thob kyi shes rab dang rnam 'byed kyi nus pa shugs che ldan pa mngon yod//873lor kho pa we ye na slob grwa chen mor zhugs nas gso rig zhib 'jug gi las ka byas/ /876lor kho pas dge rgan che mo ba pu'u lu'i kho'i las rogs zhib 'jug pa byas pa dang / /88/lor gso rig gi po hre ste 'bum rams pa'i ming btags blangs/ hphu lu'o dbyi te'i grogs po dge rgan chen mo ba pu'u lu'o dbyir gyis /880lo nas bzung an na zhes pa'i bud med gcig la smyo nad sman bcos byed skabs gnyid 'gug bcos thabs la brten nas kho mo drag tu bcug pa red/ 882lor pu'u lu'o dbyir gyis sman bcos kyi grub 'bras de hphu lu'o dbyi ter bshad rjes kho pas mu mthud smyo nad kyi nad gzhi bcos thabs thad zab 'jug rtog dpyod byas shing / gnyid 'gug bcos thabs la zhib 'jug bya ched da dung /889lor hpha ran si'i nan zhir bskyod de hpha ran si'i sman pa dge rgan du bsten pa dang / hpha ran si'i sman pa phun han zhes pas nad par gnyid 'gug bcos thabs spyad pa de mthong rjes phan nus ldan pa'i sman bcos kyi bya thabs des kho pa'i blo sgo 'byed pa yod/ kho pas mi'i rigs kyi 65

'du shes (rtog pa )kyi rgyab tu phal cher da dung gsang stabs su shugs che ba'i yid shes kyi brgyud rim zhig yib nas sdod pa shes rtogs byung zhing / hpha ran si'i gso rig gi shugs rkyen dang nad thog lag len bcas brgyud smyon nad kyi 'byung rtsa rtsad zhib byed skabs kho pa rim bzhin skye khams kyi nad rtsa smra ba nas sems khams kyi nad rtsa smra ba'i phyogs su bskyod pa red/ kho pas mi'i rtog pa de bang rim gsum du 'byed chog pa ste rtog pa (hrū1shā)dang / rtog pa sngon ma(cho //hrū1shā)/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu (༈sproṣṭha1shā)bcas yin pa dang / smyon nad bcos dgos na nges par du nad pa'i rang mos 'brel dran brgyud rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khyab khongs su gnas pa'i kun slong dang 'dod sred (gtso bo chags spyod kyi ngar shugs dang 'dod sred )'tshol zhib bya rgyu de ni nya mo skam sar 'don pa lta bu'i rtsa bcos kyi bya thabs shig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed//895lor hphu lu'o dbyi te dang pu'u lu'o dbyir gnyis kyis 〈skyon 'bogs zhib 'jug 〉ces pa dpe skrun byas shing / des hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed rig pa'i rigs gzhung gi rmang gzhi bting ba red//896lo nas /897lo bar hphu lu'o dbyi tes yang skor bskyar skor dang gting zab kyi sgo nas kho pa rang nyid la dbye zhib byed pa'i khrod nas rang nyid byis pa'i dus su rang gi a mar bral mi phod par dung sems skyes pa dang dus mtshungs rang gi pha la phrag dog dang dgrar 'dzin byed pa de shes rtogs byung bar brten 8 e ti phu'u si'i 'khreng mdud (༈waṃ rto1(khyelo phretram̐) nyazhes pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gsar btod byas pa red/ pu'u lu'o dbyir gyis kho pa'i chags sred kyi lta bar mos mthun ma byas skabs kho pas mkhas pa gzhan zhig ste hphu li si dang phan tshun 'phrin gtong gi rnam pa'i thog nas gnad don la zhib 'jug byas yod/ lo rabs dgu bcu'i dus mjug tu u ru su dang pho 66

lan la log spyod shog khas gdug rtsub chen pos yi'u tha'e bar gnod 'tshe gtong ba de'i shugs rkyen yo rob hril por khyab pas/ hphu lu'o dbyi ter yang rigs rgyud ring lugs pa'i phyir 'bud dang rdung rdeg phog pa red/ 'on kyang dka' tshegs che ba'i khor yug gi khrod du kho pas sngar bzhin sems khams rig pa'i gnad don skor zhib 'jug byas yod la/ /900lor 〈rmi lam zhib 'grel 〉zhes pa'i deb gcig par du bskrun pa de ni kho pa'i yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos shig red/ skabs der deb grangs drug brgya las par du btab med rung spyi tshogs thog der yid ma rang ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan stabs lo brgyad nang gzhi nas btsong tshar/ de ltar na'ang dus rabs nyi shu'i dus stod du hphu lu'o dbyi te ni rgyal khab phyi nang du skad grags yod pa'i rang lugs gsar gtod byed mkhan sems khams rig pa ba zhig chags pas/ /909lor kho pa a ri'i kho la kho slob grwa chen mo'i slob spyi'i gdan zhu ltar slob grwa de btsugs nas lo nyi shu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel gyi dus ston du zhugs pa ma zad mtshan 'dzin 'bum rams pa'i ming btags kyang thob pa red/ rjes su kho pa'i rig gzhung la do snang je cher song ste 'dzam gling gi khyon du yongs khyab ngang bag chags byung yod//923lor kho par kha skran gyi nad gzhi phog kyang sngar bzhin brtson pa ma btang bar las don sgrub kyi yod/ lo rabs sum cu'i nang 'jar man he the les gtso bo byed pa'i hpha shi si'i stobs shugs nyin bzhin smyo ham je cher song ste 'dzem bag spu tsam med par yi'u tha'e bar gnod 'tshe gtong gi yod pa dang / /938lor hpha shi si'i dmag dpung o si khrur nang 'dzul byas stabs kho pa phyi rgyal du mi bros ka med byung zhing / /939lo'i zla 9tshes 2/nyin dbyin jir grongs/ 67

hphu lu'o dbyi tes rang lugs gsar gtod dang grub mtha' rang chags kyi sgo nas sems khams rig pa'i zhib 'jug la gzengs su thon pa'i legs skyes phul yod/ kho pa'i yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa'i zhan cha ni/ gcigaphyogs re ba'i sgo nas rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i nus par sgro 'dogs kyis rtog pa'i nus pa nyams smad du btang bas blang dor mkho med smra ba'i lta bar lhungs pa ni ldog tu med pa zhig yin pa/gnyis/ thal drags pa'i sgo nas 'dod chags kyi rang stobs nus pa nan bshad byed pa de ni don dngos thog mi dang srog chags gcig mtshungs su brtsis te mi srog chags su mar phab pa de red/hphu lu'o dbyi te'i gtso bo'i brtsams chos su 〈〈rmi lam zhib 'grel 〉dang /〈yid rnam 'byed kyi mdor bshad/〉 〈〈yid rnam 'byed kyi mdor bshad gsar sgrig 〉sogs yod do/22 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa zhes pa gang red dam/hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed kyi thabs shes de ni mi'i sems khams kyi snang tshul la zhib 'jug byas pa brgyud sems gting du sbas pa'i bsam blo'i brtse dung gsal ston bya rgyu de red/ 'di'i thad kho par cha tshang ba'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig yod de/ dang po/ kho pas/ 46bsam pa'i brgyud rim de rang ni tshang ma rtog pa med pa de red/ rtog pa dang bcas pa'i bsam pa'i brgyud rim de tsho ni kher rkyang du gnas pa'i 'gul skyod 'ga' zhig tsam dang bsam pa'i 'tsho ba hril po'i cha shas tsam yin pa gtan 'khel byas yod/’ rtog pa med pa zhes pa ni rtog pa 'og 'gyu la zer/ kho 68

pas rtog pa 'og 'gyu nan bshad byas te de ni bsam pa'i byed sgo'i phyogs gtso bo yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ bsam pa'i byed sgo ni 'khyags ri zhig dang 'dra ba dang / chu'i 'og tu bsnubs pa ni 'khyags ri'i cha shas mang che ba yin pa de ni rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khongs su gtogs/ 'on kyang chu'i steng du yod pa'i rtog pa'i khyab khongs kyis 'khyags ri'i cha shas ha cang chung ngu tsam las bzung med pa red/ rtog pa ni mis rang nyid shes rtogs dang khor yug shes rtogs byed pa'i sems khams kyi phyogs de yin pa dang / rtog pa 'og 'gyu ni mi tshos tshor shes ma byung ba'i sems gting gi mngon chung dang gting zab tu thim pa'i phyogs de yin par 'dod/ gnyis pa/ kho pas 'dod chags kyi rang nus ngar shugs kyis dbang rtsa dang sems khams kyi nad gzhi'i 'byung rkyen khrod du nus pa shin tu chen po thon gyi yod pa ma zad/ 'dod chags kyi ngar shugs 'di tshos ‘ mi'i rigs kyi bsam pa'i ches mtho'i rig gnas dang / sgyu rtsal/ spyi tshogs kyi grub 'bras sogs kyi thad de'i rin thang phal cher tshod dpag mtho drags pa byed mi srid pa'i legs skyes phul yod pa nya’dang / rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khyab khongs de spyir na 'dod chags kyi rang nus dang 'brel ba yod pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ kho pas rtog pa 'og 'gyu ni dmigs bsal gyi bsam blo'i rnam pa zhig dang / dmigs bsal gyi sems khams brgyud rim zhig yin pa/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khyab khongs nang gi bsam pa'i byed sgo ni rtog pa dang bcas pa'i bsam blo'i rnam pa las de bas rnyog 'dzing che la dpog dka' ba zhig yin pa yang nas yang du rigs sgrub khungs skyel byas yod/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang rtog pa'i dbar gyi 'brel ba ji 'dra zhig yin nam snyam na/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes ‘6nga tshos dpe zhig bzhag na sems khams kyi brgyud rim tshang ma dang thog rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i rnam 69

pa'am dus la yod pa dang rjes su dus de kho na nas da gzod rtog pa dang bcas pa'i dus la bar brgal byed kyi yod pa de ni par zhig la cha mtshon na dang thog tshang ma spyin shog nag po sha stag yin pa nas rjes su 'khrud bzo byas rjes gzhi nas par du 'gyur thub pa dang shin tu 'dra po yod pa red/ 'on kyang spyin shog nag po yod tshad par du 'gyur ba'i nges pa ye nag med pa ji bzhin rtog pa 'os 'gyu'i sems khams brgyud rim re re bzhin tshang ma cis/ kyang rtog pa dang bcas pa'i sems khams brgyud rim zhig tu 'gyur dgos pa'i nges pa'ang ma mchis mi’zhes bshad/ mi'i gdod ma dang / kun spyod dang bca' khrims las brgal ba'i re 'dod sna tshogs spyi tshogs cha rkyen gyi tshod 'dzin 'og 'dod pa khengs pa zhig ma byung ba'i skabs de dag rtog pa med pa'i khrod du non nas mi tshos de tsho rtog tshor yong gi med mod/ 'on kyang de dag ni rtog pa med pa'i khyab khongs su 'gul skyod byed kyi yod/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes rtog pa med pa'i khyab khongs de mdun khang chen po zhig tu dpe bzhag pa dang / mi'i sba gsang du gnas pa'i bsam pa'i ngar shugs sna tshogs mdun khang chen po de'i nang 'tshang kha shig shig ngang bsdad yod pas/ mdun khang chen po de nas mgron bsu khang lta bu'i khang pa chung ngu zhig tu 'gro sa yod pa de'i nang rtog pa gnas yod/ khang pa de gnyis po'i sgo them gyi 'gram du srung bya mi zhig langs nas bsdad yod pa de'i mos mthun ma thob tshe rtog pa med pa'i ngar shugs de mgron bsu khang du 'gro mi thub/ sgo them brgal te mgron bsu khang du 'dzul mkhan ngar shugs der rtog pa sngon ma zer ba dang / rtog pa bkug ste rtog pa'i khyab khongs su 'dzul rjes da gzod rtog pa zhes 'bod kyi yod/ rtog pa ji 'dra zhig yin rung dang thog tshang ma rtog pa med pa yin pas rtog pa med pa ni rtsa ba ste ngo bo dang po dang / rtog pa ni ngo bo gnyis pa 70

red/ sngon ma de rjes ma las shin tu rnyog dra che la/ rtog pa dang bcas pa'i sems khams kyi snang tshul ni rtag tu bden par ma grub pa dang / mtshon rtags kyi rang bzhin zhig yin na/ de'i gdong ris ngo ma dang kun slong ngo ma ji 'dra yin min rtog dpyod byed par nges par du yid rnam 'byed brgyud rtog pa med pa'i khyab khongs su mthil brtol 'tshol zhib byed dgos kyi red ces brjod yod/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes rtog pa ni mi'i sems khams 'gul skyod kyi ches mtho'i rnam pa zhig yin pas des rtog pa 'og 'gyur tshod 'dzin byas te de nyid ches dma' rim du 'jog par byed pa dang / rnyog 'dzing che la 'tshub sha dod pa dang / grung sha ldan pa'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu thengs gcig min gnyis min phyir thon yong yang sgo srung ba des slar thengs gcig min gnyis min nang du 'jug gi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/23 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i 6‘mi gshis kyi grub cha khag gsum ’ zhes pa de gang red dam/hphu lu'o dbyi tes gzhi rtsa'i bdag dang / bdag rang / bdag las 'das pa dang bcas gsum ni ra mi gshis kyi grub cha khag gsum 〉〉(ngasgo'i༈lhosgrotsu khri)yin par 'dod/gcig ‘‘gzhi rtsa'i bdag ’’(sayo)ni mi'i lhan skyes kyi nus pa ste 'tsho ba'i rang nus dang 'chi ba'i rang nus la zer zhing / 'di ni skye dngos kyi ngar shugs dang mi'i gdod ma'i nus shugs kyi 'byung rtsa yin pa de rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khongs su gtogs pa dang / bde tshor nyams su myong ba'i rtsa don gzhir bzung der gdod ma'i rang nus kyi dgos mkho skong dgos pa'i blang bya 'don/ 7/

hphu lu'o dbyi tes kher gzugs dang rigs rgyud tshe srog gi rang nus rgyun mthud byed pa de ni 6 'tsho ba'i rang nus ’’sam yang na li pi tu'u (tshoti6ṭwāṃkhu)zhes 'bod pa de yin pa dang / mi'i rigs la 6 'tsho ba'i rang nus ’ phud da dung 4‘'chi ba'i rang nus ’’shig kyang yod pa der/ 46rang nyid rang gis brlags pa ri’dang / gtor bshig gi rang bzhin/ btsan 'dzul gyi rang bzhin sogs kyi ngar shugs ldan yod/ gzhi rtsa'i bdag la mi'i 'tsho ba'i rang nus dang 'chi ba'i rang nus bcas khag gnyis ldan yod pa dang / rgya yig tu bsgyur ming mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis der 6‘dbyi te ’’(ṣāḥ)zhes kyang 'bod kyi yod/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khongs su gtogs pas blang dor dang / kun spyod/bca' khrims/ de bzhin spyi tshogs goms srol sna tshogs pa bcas kyi 'ching sdom mi 'khel stabs/ gal te de nyid rang dgar rgya yan du btang na spyi tshogs dang mi sger la gnod 'tshe tshabs che bzo srid ba'i ngos 'dzin byed/gnyis/‘‘bdag rang ’ (khyem)zhes pa ni mi gshis kyi grub cha'i phyi'i bang rim zhig yin pa de ni don dngos can du gyur pa'i rang nus shig red/ phru gu dmar 'byar la dang thog 66gzhi rtsa'i bdag nyatsam las med/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs khor yug gi shugs rkyen las rim bzhin cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og gzhi nas bde blag ngang ‘‘gzhi rtsa'i bdag ’gi re 'dun skong thub pa de shes rtogs byung ste 46bdag rang mi’zhes pa de grub pa red/ rang nus kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du dga' skyid brtson len byed pa'i dmigs yul sgrub thabs byed mod/ 'on kyang de'i dge rgan te ldog med rang bzhin gyi slob gso'i 'og kho pas don dngos kyi rtsa don dang len byas yod/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes 8 mthar gtugs nas bshad na rtsa don de'ang dga' skyid dmigs yul du bzung ba zhig red/ 'on kyang don dngos la bsam gzhigs byas rkyen de ni 72

nar 'gyangs dang shugs zhan du btang ba'i dga' skyid cig yin pa ri red ces brjod yod/ 4‘bdag rang :ni mi sger gyi bsam pa'i snyoms sgrig la srung skyob byed pa'i rgyu rkyen nam grub cha zhig yin pa des/ smyo gzhi rtsa'i bdag ’’la tshod 'dzin byas te de nyid kyis 'dzem bag med par spyi tshogs dang mi sger la gnod 'tshe gtong rgyur bkag 'gog byed kyi yod/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes 66gzhi rtsa'i bdag ri’gis non thabs bral ba'i 'dod sred mtshon pa dang / 46bdag rang ’ gis blo rig dang jus zab phugs ring mtshon gyi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/gsum/ ‘ bdag las 'das pa ’ (mam)ni kun spyod can du gyur pa'i ‘6bdag rang ’’yin zhing de ni mi gshis kyi grub cha'i cha shas shig yin pa red/44gzhi rtsa'i bdag ’ gis srung rtsi zhu ba ni bde tshor nyams su myong ba'i rtsa don yin pa dang / 'on kyang 64bdag las 'das pas mi’srung brtsi zhu ba ni kun spyod kyi rtsa don de nyid red/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes nad pa'i sems par dbye zhib byed skabs nad pa mang po zhig ni rang gi spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod las 'gal ba'i 'thus shor la sems gting nas 'gyod pa drag po byed pa dang tha na nyes pa zhig bsags pa lta bu'i tshor snang yong gi yod pa shes rtogs byung ba de ni kho pa cho3re mi gshis kyi grub cha'i nang 64bdag las 'das pa'i ’’cha shas de yin par brjod/ 'di ni mi dang srog chags dbar mi 'dra ba'i cha de red/ srog chags la'ang rang nus yod pas khor yug dang 'dris 'dres byung ba'i khrod du mang nyung la mi bltos par/ ‘4bdag rang ’’'phel rgyas su btang mod/ 'on kyang phu bdag las 'das pa mi 'di ni mi'i rigs kho nar yod pa'i khyad chos su zad/ ‘ bdag las 'das pa mi’'dir phyogs gnyis kyi nang don tshud yod de/gcig ni rgyun du shod pa'i 4‘sems bzang 〉zer ba de yin pa dang / gzhan 73

zhig ni sna bdag rang gi phugs bsam ’ zhes pa de red/ byis pa rnams spyi tshogs khor yug gi bag chags dang lhag par du pha ma'i bag chags 'og 8‘bdag rang rinya'aphel rgyas su song ba ma zad rim bzhin yin min gsal 'byed kyi kun spyod lta ba zhig chags kyi yod pa red/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes yun ring ba'i byis pa'i dus su/ 'tshar longs yong bzhin pa'i mi rnams ni rang gi pha ma po /nyis la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod kyang kho pa'i sems nang du dim dngos shig lus yod pa dang / dim dngos de bdag rang zhes pa'i nang gi dmigs bsal sgrig gzhi zhig tu grub nas pha ma'i bag chags de yun ring nyar 'jog byed kyi yod/ byis pa'i sems gting si/ dim dngos de ni pha ma'i mi gshis dang mi rabs nas mi rabs bar brgyud pa'i spyi tshogs kun spyod de yin la/ kun spyod dang / sems bzang / phugs bsam 'di rigs kyis mi chos nang gi ‘‘bdag las 'das pa ’ zhes pa de grub pa yin pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed/8‘bdag rang nya gis mi tsho'i lus thog tu snyoms sgrig gi nus pa yag po zhig thon gyi yod de/ sna‘gzhi rtsa'i bdag nya gi re 'dod skong bar ma zad/ da yod khor yug gi cha rkyen 'og sgrub thub min la bsam gzhigs yang byed pa/da dung 8‘bdag las 'das pa ’nyade tshad gzhi lon pa zhig yin min te spyi tshogs/ kyi kun spyod dang 'tshams min la bsam gahu/gas bcas byed pas/ mi gshis khrod kyi ‘‘gzhi rtsa'i bdag nya dang ‘4bdag rang /mi 8‘bdag las 'das pa nyabacas dbar gyi 'brel ba ni shin tu zab mo zhig yin par 'dod do/

24 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i 〈rmi lam zhib 'grel 〉gyi nang don gtso bo gang red dam/〈rmi lam zhib 'grel 〉ni hphu lu'o dbyi te'i skad gras/sa che ba'i brtsams chos shig yin pa de /900lor 'grem spel byas/ deb de'i nang rtsom pa pos rmi lam 'bor che dngos dper drangs te rmi lam gyi gnad don skor la phyogs gang sa nas nan tan zhib dpyod byas te gsham gsal lta tshul 'ga' zhig bton yod pa red/gcig rmi lam ni bsam pa'i 'gul skyod cig yin pa dang 66de'i kun slong ni ga dus yin rung re 'dod blo yid tshim pa zhig 'tshol zhib bya rgyu de yin/’’ rmi lam ni re 'dod las byung zhing de'i nang don ni 44re 'dod tshim par byed pa de red/’ rmi lam gyis bsam pa mtshon par byed pa'i go skabs shig 'byung ba byas par ma zad 'khrul snang nyams myong gi bya thabs la brten nas blo yid tshim pa'i re 'dod cig mtshon gyi yod/ rmi lam ni 46re 'dod tshim par byed pa mi zhig yin pa'i skor la rtsom pa pos dngos dpe mang po drangs yod pa'i nang gi gcig ni kho pa'i lo na lngar son pa'i phru gu de'i skor red/ thengs gcig kho tshang gi bza' mi tshang ma ta ho ri bo'i ri 'dabs su rtsed mo rtse bar bskyod pa dang / kho pa'i phru gu chung chung des rtag tu rgyang shel la brten nas ri rtse'i zhi meng nyi khang chung (yotsho༅71doṣṭha)mthong gi yod stabs ri gsham du rtsed mo brtsis nas sdod rgyu tsam gyis blo yid tshim gyi med/'on kyang pha ma gnyis pos kho pa ri rtser ma khrid pas skabs der kho pa ha cang ma dga'/ rtsom pa pos ‘6nyin gnyis pa'i zhogs par kho par spro snang brtas bzhin par mdun du rgyugs yong ste/ ‘mdang nub nga la nged tsho zhi meng nyi 75

khang chung du bskyod pa'i rmi lam btang byung 〉zer gyi 'dug ngas da lta gzhi nas shes rtogs byung bar skabs der ngas ta ho ri bor 'gro rgyu'i skor shod skabs kho pas tan tan hor si tha the nas la brgyab lung brgal byas te kho pas nyin ltar rgyang shel gyi thog nas mthong ba'i yid smon gyi sa cha zhi meng nyi khang chung du slebs shag byas pa red/ 'on kyang kho pas kho tsho 'gro sa ni ri 'dabs kyi rbab chu yod sa de tsam yin pa shes ma thag kho pa shin tu re ba zad pa dang shin tu 'dod blo mi khengs pa zhig byung yod kyang / rmi lam gyis kho pa'i re 'dod skong thub pa byung ba red ’ ces zer/gnyis/ rmi lam ni rtog pa 'og 'gyus rang nyid mtshon par byed pa zhig red/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu de mi sems kyi gting ring shos su mnan yod mod/'on kyang de shin tu grung sha dod pa zhig yin pas thabs brgya jus stong gi sgo nas rtog pa sngon ma'i khyab khongs las brgal te phyir don yong gi yod/ ‘‘bdag rang ’ngal gso'i dus sam yang na ngal gso legs po zhig ma byung ba ste rig pa za zir gyi rnam par gnas te dogs zon shor ba'i skabs su rtog pa 'og 'gyus bya spyod spel 'go 'dzugs kyi yod/ der brten rmi lam byung ba red/ rmi lam gtong mi'i re 'dod mi nyung ba zhig ni kun spyod dang 'gal ba zhig song tsang rtogo pa 'og 'gyus phyi'i gdong ris bsgyur pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas don yong gi yod/ rmi lam ni ya mtshan che zhing go ba len thabs med pa zhig yin pa de ni rmi lam gyis mdzes rgyan spras pa las byung ba zhig red/ rmi lam gyis mdzes rgyan thengs mang spras nas don yong ba de nges par du yid rnam 'byed kyi bya thabs brgyud gzhi nas 'grel bshad rgyag thub/gsum/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes rmi lam dang smyo nad dbar phan tshun 'dra ba'i phyogs yod pa dang / lha rmi lam nang stabs bde'i dogs pa tsha ba'i nad skor 76

gyi sems khams rig pa tshud yod mi’pa'i ngos 'dzin byed pa de ni/ rmi lam dang dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi nad skor 'grel bshad byed skabs tshang ma rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgyab rten bcol ba'i rkyen gyis red/kho pas rmi lam dang smyo nad tshang ma rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i 'gul skyod chos nyid dang 'tshams pa'i skor phyogs sdom bgyis pa'i sdom tshig ni 6‘rtog pa 'og 'gyus rtog pa sngon ma'i khrod du do snang mi byed pa dang / snang chung byed pa'am yang na thab zur du phud ma thag pa'i (phyir 'bud phog pa )don spyi de dag dang 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyur cung dga' po yod/’’ ces pa de yin zhing/bya thabs de rigs la brten nas g.yo rgyu che ba'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu gsang stabs ngang rtog pa'i khyab khongs su bskyod kyi yod pa red/hphu lu'o dbyi tes de snga mi rnams kyi rmi lam ni rang byung las 'das pa'i lha 'dres blo sgo 'byed pa'i skor gyi shod srol rtsis med du btang ste/ rmi lam ni mi'i sems khams 'gul skyod kyi cha shas shig dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu las byung ba zhig yin pa nan bshad dang / rmi lam ni gsal bar mngon pa'i rnam shes ma yin la/ dkon cog gis blo sgo 'byed bcug pa zhig kyang ma yin par/mi'i rigs gzhon nu'i skabs bya ba'i lag len gyi mkho 'jog snyigs dor zhig dang dim dngos shig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/25 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i gzhung lugs kyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la shugs rkyen ga re sprad yod dam/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa po tshang mas hphu lu'o dbyi ter gong bkur byed pa ma zad mang nyung la mi bltos par kho pa tshor sems khams rig pa ba de'i shugs rkyen phog yod pa red/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes mi'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang 77

'dod chags kyi rang nus nan bshad kyis de ni mi'i rigs kyi sems khams 'gul skyod kyi gzhi rtsa'i 'gul shugs yin zer/ kho pas mi'i sems pa'i nang rkyen dang mi gshis kyi grub cha de bang rim gsum du phye yod pa ste/ rtog pa dang / rtog pa sngon ma/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu bcas yin zhing / kho pas mi'i tshul ldog sems khams dang rmi lam la yun ring du zhib 'jug nan tan byas pa yod pa red/ kho pa'i lta tshul ltar na rmi lam ni re 'dod tshim par byed pa de yin la/ re 'dod dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu gnyis 'brel ba dam zab yod pa zhig red/ dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi nad gzhi'i 'byung rkyen yang rtog pa 'og 'gyu khrod kyi 'dod chags kyi rang nus la 'gog gnon phog ste stong bsam yul khams su lhung ba'i rkyen gyis yin par 'dod/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang 'dod chags kyi rang nus de'ang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i 'gul shugs yin la/ rtsom pa pos gsar rtsom byas pa brgyud rang nus dang re 'dod kyi sems nad shod thub pa zhig kyang yong gi yod/ kho pas da dung rmi lam yod tshad ni bdag nyid lte bar byed pa zhig dang / rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom ni nyin mo'i rmi lam zhig yin na/ kho jo'i gsar rtsom gyi khrod du'ang bdag nyid lte bar byed pa'i khyad chos de mtshon gyi yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/kho pa'i lta ba de dag gis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi nang don dang rnam pa gang gi thad la'ang shugs rkyen chen po sprad yod pa red/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi nang don khyad chos ni gtso bor bdag nyid mtshon thabs byed pa de yin te/ rang snang yul can gyi 'jig rten mtshon dgos pa nan bshad byed kyi yod/ deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa po'i smyug rtse las thon pa'i mi sna rnams ni tshul lugs las ldog cing rgyun gtan ma yin pa'i bu'am bu mo sha stag yin pa dper na/ 'ga' zhig ni smyon pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni gza' ro/ 78

da dung 'ga' zhig ni smyo ham chen tres sdug spyod gtong mkhan nam yang na sdug spyod myong mkhan yin pa red/ kho pa tshos rtag tu 'dod chags kyi rang nus 'bri ba dang / mi'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu la lhag par dga' snang byed pa ste/mi'i rigs kyi sems nyid kyi gsang ba 'bri 'god byed pa sogs sems khams 'bri 'god kyi thad la rtog 'jug shin tu zab mo byas yod/ kho pa tshos mi sna gtso bo'i rmi lam 'dres non dang / 'khrul snang / (stong bsam yang zer)rtogs pa rang yan pa/ shugs bstan/ mtshon rtags/ rang mos 'brel dran sogs 'bri 'god bya rgyur shin tu dga' po byed pa dper na/ dbyin ji'i deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa po grags can cha'o dbyi si'i rtog pa rang yan pa'i tshab mtshon brtsams sgrung 〈yi'u li zhi si 〉zhes pa'i nang mi sna'i 'dod chags kyi rang nus dang tshul ldog gi sems khams dmar dmar rjen rjen ngang 'bri 'god byas yod/ de'i nang gi bud med mi sna gtso bo ma'o la'e ni blo rig gis rang tshod zin pa'i nus pa zhan zhing gdod ma'i rang nus dang ngar shugs tsam las med pa zhig yin pa dang / rtsom de'i mjug bsdu'i mtshams su kho mo gnyid ma sad skabs kyi rmi lam 'khrul snang dang rtog pa rang yan pa'i skor bris yod/ mchong skyod can gyi sems nyid chig lab de rigs kho nar shog grangs bzhi bcu lhag zin pa ma zad bar mtshams su brda rtags tsheg shad kyang med pa red/ de'i khrod kyi chig lab khag gcig la cha mtshon na/46skar ma bco lnga'i rjes shin tu snga po yin pa'i dus 'dir krung go ba rnams ni yar langs nas ral par skra shad rgyag pa dang ring min ye shu'i chos kyi dge ma tshos zhogs tshogs smon lam gyi cong brdung grabs yod cing kho mo tsho'i gnyid dkrogs mkhan med dgong mor da dung smon lam 'debs mkhan gyi ye shu'i chos 'chad pa ya mtshan can gcig gnyis kyi khar khyim mtshes kyi dril ldan chu 79

tshod bya pho'i gzugs can des skad cor brgyab ma thag lam seng zing cha langs yong ba phud mi’ces bris yod pa 'dir yongs su mi sna'i ya mtshan che ba'i snang ba ban bun gyi sems khams kyi rnam pa mtshon gyi yod phyir hphu lu'o dbyi te'i shugs rkyen phog pa ni mngon gsal shin tu dod po red/ hpha ran si'i rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi tshab mtshon rtsom pa pos bris pa'i 〈chu 'gros lang tsho'i dran gso 〉zhes par yig 'bru sa ya gsum lon pa tshang ma mi sna gtso bo'i dran gso lu gu rgyud du bkod nas mi sna'i rtog pa sngon ma dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu gsal ston byas yod la/ 'go mjug bar gsum tshang ma rmi lam 'khrul snang dang rtog pa rang yan pa sha stag red/deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig khrod kyi mtshon rtags ring lugs dang /dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs/ brtsams sgrung gsar pa smra ba/mngon mtshon ring lugs/ tshul 'chal smra ba sogs tshang mar hphu lu'o dbyi te'i gzhung lugs kyi shugs rkyen phog ste/ rang nyid mtshon dgos pa nan bshad byed pa ma zad rtag tu mtshon rtags dang / rmi lam 'khrul snang /shugs bstan sogs sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal spyod kyi yod/ mtshon rtags ring lugs kyis sgyu rtsal ni phyi yul 'jig rten mtshon dgos pa zhig ma yin par rmi lam 'khrul snang gi 'char yan rnam pa'i thog nas rang snang 'jig rten mtshon dgos pa dang / rtsom pa po'i sems gting gi gsang ba 'bri dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ kho pa tshos rtsom pa po'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab ni gting zab tu gnas pa'i rmi lam gyi yul khams yin par 'dod pa dang / kho pa cho'i gsar rtsom dang hphu lu'o dbyi te'i yid rnam 'byed kyi rig pa'i dbar 'brel ba dam zab yod pa bcas red/hphu lu'o dbyi te'i gzhung lugs kyis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom pa por khrid 80

ston byas te mi'i sems nyid kyi 'jig rten gting zab sngog 'don dang /bang rim mi 'dra ba'i sems khams 'bri 'god byed pa sogs kyis rtsom rig gi mtshon bya'i khyab khongs rgya cher song yod/ 'on kyang phyogs gzhan zhig nas hphu lu'o dbyi tes phyogs re ba'i sgo nas rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang 'dod chags kyi rang nus ni rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i 'gul shugs yin pa dang / rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa ni bdag nyid mtshon thabs shig yin pa nan bshad byed par brten/ gzhung lugs de dag gis deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig la 'gal rkyen gyi nus pa thon yod pa'ang smos mi dgos so/26 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i rig rtsal gyi lta ba gang red dam/hphu lu'o dbyi tes rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang 'dod chags kyi rang nus ni rig rtsal gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i 'gul shugs dang rang nus ngar shugs rnam sbyangs dang mngon 'phar (yo༅)byas par 'dod/ kho pas su'o hphu kho le si'i 〈ye ti phu'u si rgyal po 〉dang shig si sbi ya'i 〈(ha mu'u la'e the 〉〉gnyis dper drangs nas gnad don de gsal bshad byas yod de/ mi rnams byis pa'i dus su 'dod chags kyi ngar shugs skye yul dang po de rang gi a ma yin pa dang / rang gi a mar dga' po yod pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi pha la phrag dog dang 'khon 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 〈ma ti phu'u si rgyal po 〉zhes pa'i nang e ti phu'u si rgyal pos pha bsad de ma bag mar blangs pa ni re 'dod tshim par byed pa zhig ste mi rnams byis pa'i dus kyi re 'dod tshim par byed pa de red/ re 'dod 'di rigs gzhi rkang snga sa nas rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khrod du 'gog gnon phog nas yod la/ rtsom rig mkhas pas 6 mi gshis la rtog dpyod byas pa brgyud mi nam zhig e ti phu'u si rgyal po'i sdig nyes ther 'don 'byung skabs/8/

8‘kho pa'i spyod tshul de las nga tshos nang gnas kyi bdag nyid mthong thub/ de tshor shes yong rgyur 'gog gnon phog bzhin yod mod/ 'on te re 'dod 'di rnams ni sngar bzhin sems gting du gnas par byed/nya’ skyo gar de'i khrod kyi las dbang la de lta bu'i mi sems 'gul ba'i stobs shugs ldan pa de ni tan tan nga rang tsho'i sems kyi gting du'ang de dang rigs 'dra ba'i 'bod sgra zhig gnas pa'i rkyen gyis da gzod nga tshos mos pa gcig mthun gyi mgo lcog ldem ldem byed par ngos 'dzin byed/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes bu tshang mas ma la dga' zhing pha la phrag dog byed par 'dod la/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khrod du 'bog gnon phog pa'i brtse dung 'dir 4‘e ti phu'u si'i 'khreng mdud rices 'bod kyi yod/ ha mu'u la'e the'i gzugs brnyan la dbye zhib byed skabs yang kho pas 46ha mu'u la'e thes sgrub mi thub pa'i bya ba med/ 'on kyang rang gi pha bsad/ rgyal po'i dbang cha 'phrogs/ yum chen bag mar blangs pa'i mi zhig la ci bya gtol med du gyur pa ni/ mi des ji ltar byas pa de ni kho pa rang nyid kyis yun ring khong du sbas pa'i byis pa'i dus kyi re 'dod de yin pas red/ der brten rang nongs 'gyod sems kyi bsam pas dgra bor bcangs pa'i 'khon 'gras kyi tshab tu zhugs te gnong 'gyod dang bcas don dngos thog kho pa rang nyid ni rang gi pha bsad de ma bag mar blangs pa'i lag dmar ba 'di las cher mi dga' snyam pa red ’’ces zer/ kho pas ha mu'u le'e the'i lus thog tu'ang de dang 'dra bar 6‘e ti phu'u si'i 'khreng mdud nyanyaganas yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ de dang phyogs mtshungs bu mo tshang mas ni pha la dga' zhing ma la phrag dog byed par 'dod la/ 'gog gnon 'og gnas pa'i brtse dung 'dir 66a'e le kho the la'i 'khreng mdud mi (1lkornyonyatho༈ho12 3/ntaphrezlo)ces 'bod kyi yod/ de ni a'e le kho the la yis gcen por ngan skul 82

gyis rang gi ma bsad de pha'i ched du dgra sha len pa'i ke ri si'i lha sgrung zhig yod pa de gzhir bzung nas btags pa'i ming zhig red/ mdor na kho pas rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yod do cog ni rtsom pa po'i sems nang gi rtog pa 'og 'gyu mtshon thabs shig dang / rnam pa mi 'dra ba dang tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i thog nas ‘ e ti phu'u si'i 'khreng mdud ’ dang 64a'e le kho the la'i 'khreng mdud ’ mtshon pa zhig yin pa nan bshad byed/hphu lu'o dbyi tes rig rtsal ni rtsom pa po'i yid mi tshim pa'i re 'dod mtshon thabs byed pa zhig yin pa dang / de ni sgyu rtsal gyi rnam par brten te 'gog gnon phog pa'i rang nus kyi 'dun pa'i sems nad shod pa zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ kho pas ‘‘sgyu rtsal ni nyin mo'i rmi lam dang gnyis su med ri’ces dang / rmi lam dang stong bsam gnyis zung du 'brel ba zhig yin pa ni/4‘dgong mor nga tshos rmis pa'i rmi lam de stong bsam rang yin pa las gzhan gang yang ma yin 1 pa'i rkyen gyis dang / rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khrod kyi kha tsha dgos gartegs kyi re 'dod sna tshogs la 'gog gnon phog ste 'dod blo tshim pa zhig mi yong ba de rmi lam gyi khrod du stong bsam gyi rnam pa'i thog nas blo yid tshim pa zhig yong thub kyi yod ces zer/ sgyu rtsal ni nyin mo'i rmi lam red la rtsom pa po'i re 'dod skong ba zhig dang 'gog mnon phog pa'i brtse dung dang rang nus kyi 'dun pa'i sems nad shod pa zhig kyang yin pa 'di'i thad hphu lu'o dbyi tes 〈rmi lam zhib 'grel 〉zhes pa'i nang / ko te dang hu'o er mu'u hu'o tsi sogs rtsom pa po dper drangs nas gsal bshad byas yod de/ ko te gzhon nu'i dus rtag tu khrims dpon pu'u hphu'i khyim du bskyod kyi yod pa dang pu'u hphu'i bu mor kho pa sems chags/ nyin zhig gzhon nu ma de dang mi gzhan zhig gnyen gan bzhag pa shes rtogs byung rjes kho'i sems nang brjod 83

kyis mi langs pa'i gdung ba byung / rjes su ko te'i grogs mchog ye hra la'e zhes pas kyang kho pa'i gong rim dpon gyi chung mar sems pa chags/ 'on kyang 'dod don sgrub thabs med par yid chad re zad kyi khrod du rang srog bcad pa'i gnas tshul go thos byung rjes/ kho pa'i yid sngar med du g.yos shing rmi lam lta bu'i gnas tshul der gzhigs te skad grags che ba'i brtsams chos 〈gzhon nu we thi'i yid mug 〉ces pa de ji ltar 'bri rgyu'i bsam gzhigs byung ba dang / kho pa'i sems nang 'gog gnon phog pa'i 'dod chags kyi me lce'am yang na dga' ba'i rang nus de btso sbyang byas pa brgyud rlabs chen gyi sgyu rtsal brtsams chos shig tu gyur pa red zer/ hphu lu'o dbyi tis sgyu rtsal mkhas pas rang gi re 'dod ma tshim pa'i skabs da gzod gsar rtsom du zhugs pa dang /khos 4 dngos yod las byol te rang gi dga' snang yod tshad dang / rang nus kyi ngar shugs yod tshad rang gis re ba byed pa'i stong bsam 'tsho ba'i gsar rtsom gyi phyogs su bsgyur gyi yod ri pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/hphu lu'o dbyi tes rtsom rig gi brtsams chos ni rtag tu rtsom pa pos ‘‘rang nyid gsal ston ’’byed pa zhig dang / 6‘bdag nyid lte bar byed pa ’ zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ kho pas 44nga tshos rang che rang rlom byed mkhan ma yin yang gzhan dang 'dra bar rgya che'i bu dang bu mo yod pa'i 'char yan brtsams sgrung gi rtsom pa po dang / brtsams sgrung ring gras dang thung gras kyi rtsom pa po bdams nas go bsdur zhig bgyis na/ rtsom pa po de dag gi brtsams chos tshang mar do snang bya yul gyi lte gnas su gyur pa'i mi sna gtso bo yod la/ rtsom pa pos thabs rtsal yod rgu spyad de nga tshos mi sna gtso bo de dang gdung sems mnyam skyes yong ba byed pa dang mi sna gtso bo de kho pa tshos dmigs bsal gces srung bya yul zhig tu 'jog pa/ le tshan gcig gi 84

4mjug bsdu'i mtshams su mi sna gtso bo de gal te mas skyon drag pos rkyen pas khrag rgyun mi chod pa dang dran med du brgyal ba zhig yin na/ le tshan rjes ma 'go tshugs skabs kho par gnyer skyong gang yag yag byas te rim bzhin nad gzhi sangs drag byung ba de ngas tan tan mthong thub/ ngas mi sna gtso bo de dang mnyam du dka' tshegs che la nyen kha ldan pa'i lam bu zhig brgyud mod kyang bde 'jags kyi tshor snang zhig yod 'dug 'on kyang ngas bltas na/ 'di 'dra'i gnod 'tshe mi phog pa'i khyad chos chen po des gsal zhing phra ba'i sgo nas ‘8bdag nyid minyachen po mchog ste/ nyin mo'i rmi lam thams cad dang brtsams sgrung gi mi sna gtso bo gsal ston byas yod pa red/’’ ces dang / kho pas bdag nyid ni sna nyin mo'i rmi lam yod tshad dang sgrung gtam ji yod kyi mi sna gtso bo ’nyayin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/hphu lu'o dbyi tes sgyu rtsal pa dang dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi smyo nad yod pa'i mi'i dbar 'dra ba'i phyogs yod pa dang / dbang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi smyo nad yod pa'i mis dngos yod la yī rangs pas dngos yod las bral te stong bsam 'jig rten gyi phyogs su bskyod par byed/ sgyu rtsal pas kyang kho pa yid mi rangs pa'i dngos yod kyi khrod nas phyir bshol byas te rang gi bsam pa'i bkod shugs kyis btod pa'i 'jig rten de'i khrod du 'dzul gyi yod/ de gnyis mi 'dra sa ni sgyu rtsal par sngar bzhin rig pa dwangs gsal gyi rtog pa yod pas phyir log gi 'gro lam ji ltar 'tshol dgos pa rtogs pa ma zad bskyar du dngos yod tshod 'dzin la gzhol ba zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/hphu lu'o dbyi tes ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar na/ sgyu rtsal pas gsar rtsom la brten nas rang gi re 'dod bsam tshod ngang tshim thabs byed pa ma zad/klog pa po'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i re 'dod kyang tshim thabs byed kyi yod/ 85

phyogs mtshungs sgyu rtsal pas rnam pa mdzes pa'i skyid snang gi tshor ldan bya thabs spyad de klog pa po'i mdzes dpyod kyi spro snang 'phel thabs kyang byed kyi yod/ kho pas rtsom rig gi rnam pa mdzes par shin tu mthong che byed pa dang /rtsom rig gi rnam par nges par du zlos gar gyi rang bzhin dang / stong bsam rtog bzo/ gson nyams ldan la zhib cing phra ba bcas kyi khyad chos ldan dgos pa/ rtsom pa po dang sgyu rtsal pas gsar rtsom gyi bya bar 'jug skabs rmi lam rmis pa ltar bsdu bstungs dang / bcos sgrig spo sgyur/ snor 'josagaces bsdus sogs kyi thabs rtsal spyad de brtsams chos de nyid 'char yan gyi rang bzhin ldan la zlos gar gyi rang bzhin ldan pa dang / dpe mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan la/ mtshon rtags kyi rang bzhin bcas dang ldan pa zhig yong dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ hphu lu'o dbyi te'i rig rtsal gyi lta bar phyogs re ba dang phyogs zhen gyi lta stangs mi nyung ba zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang kho pas deng rabs kyi sems khams rig pa'i thog nas rig rtsal la zhib 'jug byed pa der legs cha nges can zhig yod pa ni smos med red/27 hphu lu'o dbyi te'i 〈gsar rtsom pa dang nyin mo'i rmi lam 〉〉zhes pa der nang don ji 'dra tshud yod dam/hphu lu'o dbyi tes 〈gsar rtsom pa dang nyin mo'i rmi lam 〉zhes pa'i nang rtsom 'go btsugs ma thag (rgyus med pa nga tshos sngar nas ya mtshan gyi sems pa shugs che mo bcangs te—a li a'o si thor gcig mtshungs kyi gnad don 'don mkhan chos dpon gtso bo de ji bzhin—mtshar mi (gsar rtsom pa )de rigs kyi thog ma'i dpyad gzhi rnams gang nas byung ba dang / kho pa tshos yang 86

gang 'dra byas nas dpyad gzhi de dag spyad de nged tshor de lta bu'i bag chags zab mo bzhag pa ma zad/ nga tsho'i brtse dung yang skul spel byung ba'i skor shes rtogs byed 'dod byung / sdong tshor brtse dung 'di 'dra byung ba ha lam nga tshos sngar nas kyang bsam blo 'khor ma byung / gal te nged tshos 'di'i thad rtsom pa por bka' 'dri zhig zhus na/ rtsom pa po rang gis nged tshor 'grel bshad mi gnang ba'am yang na 'dod blo khengs pa'i 'grel bshad cig gnang gi ma red/ tag tag dngos don 'di rang gis nga tsho de bas gnad don der do snang byed pa'i spro ba bsrings song / gal te nga tshos khong gis thog ma'i dpyad gzhi de ltar bdams pa'i thag gcod kyi rgyu rkyen gang yin gsal zhing phra ba zhig shes rtogs byung ba dang / gsar rtsom des gzugs brnyan rtog bzo byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi ngo bo gang yin gsal rtogs byung ba'i dbang du btang rung / nga tsho gsar rtsom pa zhig tu 'gyur rgyur sngar bzhin rogs ram gang yang byed mi thub/’’ ces bkod yod/hphu lu'o dbyi te'i ngos 'dzin ltar na/ 'di'i thad kyi gnad don rtog 'jug bya dgos tshe byis pa'i dus skabs su phyir log gis bsam bkod 'gul skyod kyi thog ma'i rjes snyeg pa las 'os med pa de red/ byis pa tshos dga' shos dang sems rtsa 'phel shos byed pa ni kho pa tshos rtse bar spro ba'i rol rtsed las ma 'das/ rol rtsed du 'jug skabs kho pa tshos kho tsho rang nyid la dbang ba'i 'jig rten zhig gsar gtod byas te bya thabs gsar pa zhig la brten nas kho tsho'i 'jig rten gyi bya dngos bskyar du bkod sgrig byed pa'i thog nas rang nyid kyi 'dod blo tshims thabs byed kyi yod/ gsar rtsom pas bgyis pa ni rol rtsed khrod kyi byis pa ltar shin tu nan tan gyi rnam 'gyur thog nas stong bsam gyi 'jig rten zhig btod pa dang dus mtshungs/ yang de dang dngos 87

yod kyi 'jig rten gnyis dbye ba gsal po phye ba dang / skad yig gi khrod du byis pa'i rol rtsed dang snyan ngag gsar rtsom dbar gyi 'brel ba de rigs sor 'jog byas yod pa bcas red/hphu lu'o dbyi tes yang 'di ltar bshad yod de/ mi rnams 'tshar longs byung ba'i rjes su rol rtsed kyi khrod nas thob pa'i spro snang de phal cher dor ba 'dra rung / mi'i rigs kyi sems khams rtogs mi tshang mas shes pa ni/ mi zhig la de snga rang gis brgyud myong ba'i spro snang dor dgos pa'i blang bya bton na gang 'dra zhig las kyang dka' tshegs che ba ni smos ci/ mi rgan pa rnams ni phru gu'i ra rol rtsed mi de 64stong bsam ’nyal bsgyur pa tsam yin la/ stong pa'i khams su mkhar rdzong bskrun te nga tshos 8‘nyin mo'i rmi lam nya’zhes 'bod pa'i dngos po rnams gsar gtod byed kyi yod/ mi rgan gyi 'gul skyod de byis pa'i rol rtsed ltar gzhan gyi rtogs sla ba zhig min la/ na so dar la bab pa rnams kyis ni rtag tu rang nyid kyi stong bsam de ngo tsha'i rgyur brtsis nas khong du sbed cing rang gi bsam pa'i gting ring shos su gnas pa'i bdag dngos shig tu rtsi bar byed/hphu lu'o dbyi te'i ngos 'dzin la/ stong bsam gyi 'gul shugs ni ma tshims pa'i 'dod blo yin la/ thengs re'i stong bsam ni re 'dod re sgrub pa de yin stabs/ re 'dod ma tshims pa'i mi 'ba' zhig la da gzod stong bsam yod pa las bde skyid dang ldan pa'i mi la stong bsam nam yang med/stong bsam de'ang rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis su 'byed chog ste/ gcig ni ham sems kyi re 'dod dang / gzhan zhig ni 'dod chags kyi re 'dod red/gal te stong bsam tshad las brgal ba mang drags pa dang shugs che drags pa yin na/ dbang rtsa'i nus pa nyams pa'i nad dang smyo nad langs pa'i cha rkyen 88

'grub kyi yod/brtsams chos de'i nang da dung 'di ltar 'khod yod de/ 6‘nga tshos dgong mor rmis pa'i rmi lam de'ang stong bsam red/’’ 6‘skad yig gis 'gran zla bral ba'i blo gros la brten nas rmi lam gyi ngo bo'i gnad don thad la mtshan nyid bzhag yod de/ des stong bsam gyi ngos med 'khrul snang gi gsar gtod la ‘nyin mo'i rmi lam 〉zhes pa'i ming btags yod pa red/’’hphu lu'o dbyi tes bsam pa'i bkod shugs kyis phyug pa'i rtsom pa po ni sna nyi ma kha dkar ngo dkar 'og gi stong bsam pa ’’zhig tu dpe bzhag pa dang /rtsom pa po'i brtsams chos de nyin mo'i rmi lam du dpe bzhag yod/ kho pas rtsom yig gcig ni nyin mo'i rmi lam gcig dang 'dra bar de ni byis pa'i dus rtsed myong ba'i rol rtsed kyi rgyun mthud pa zhig dang de'i tshab dngos shig yin la/ tha na lha sgrung zhig la cha mtshon na de'ang phal cher mi rigs yongs kyi re bcol gyi stong bsam zhig dang mi'i rigs gzhon dus kyi dus yun ring po'i re 'dod 'khyog bshad byas mjug gi shul rjes shig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/kho pas ‘bdag nyid ’ ni nyin mo'i rmi lam re re dang sgrung gtam re re'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo yin la/ sgrung gtam khrod kyi ‘ mi yag pa mi’rnams ni sgrung gtam gyi mi sna gtso bor gyur pa'i ‘‘bdag nyid ’ yin pa dang / 4‘mi ngan ri’rnams ni 4‘bdag nyid mi’kyi dgra bo'am kha gtad du langs pa'i rigs yin pa/sems khams kyi brtsams sgrung khrod du rtsom pa po ni ha lam mi sna gtso bo'i klad pa'i nang 'dzul yod pa 'dra zhing de min gyi mi sna rnams ni phyi rol nas rtog zhib byed pa tsam zhig red/ deng rabs brtsams sgrung gi rtsom pa pos rang nyid la rtog zhib byed pa'i thabs rtsal spyad de kho pa'i ‘6bdag nyid ’’de ‘ cha shas kyi bdag nyid 〉nyamang por phye ste/ kho pa rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'tsho ba'i 89

khrod kyi ngar shugs kyi bsam blo de mi sna gtso bo 'ga' zhig gi lus thog nas mtshon par byed pa dang / bcoms sgrung 'ga' zhig la nga tshos 66ya mtshan can ’’gyi brtsams sgrung zhes 'bod chog pa ste/ de tsho ni nyin mo'i rmi lam gyi rigs dang dmigs bsal kha gtad du grub yod pa bcas kyi ngos 'dzin byed/brtsams chos de'i nang da dung 'di ltar bris 'dug ste/ nyin mo'i rmi lam ba tshos mi gzhan gyi mdun du rang gi stong bsam sba gsang nan po byed pa de ni kho pa'i sems par stong bsam de dag gi rkyen pas ngo tsha dgos pa zhig yin stabs gzhan la shod spobs bral ba de yin zhing / ci ste rang nyid kyi stong bsam de dag mi gzhan la bshad pa'i dbang du byas kyang gzhan la spro snang ster ba'i nges pa mod/ 'on kyang rtsom pa po zhig gis rang nyid kyi gsar rtsom byas pa'i 'khrab gzhung ngam brtsams sgrung rnams nga tsho'i mig mdun du bzhag pa'am yang na nga tshos kho pa rang nyid kyi nyin mo'i rmi lam du rtsi ba de deb thog nas nga tshor shod pa'i skabs/ nga tsho ni dga' snang shin tu chen po skye yi yod/ rtsom pa po'i las 'gan ni gsar rtsom gyi thabs rtsal brgyud de nga tsho'i sems kyi zhen log sel dgos pa dang / bsgyur bkod dang rdzun bzo'i rnam pa'i thog nas kho pa'i rang phan ring lugs pa'i nyin mo'i rmi lam gyi ngo bo je chung du gtong dgos pa ma zad/ kho pa'i stong bsam mtshon pa'i skabs nga tshor rnam pa rnal ma zhig ste mdzes pa'i longs spyod dang spro snang zhig sbyin par byas te nga tsho dbang med du bslu thub pa zhig dgos/ nga tshos spro snang de rigs la ‘‘zugs gzer slong byed ’ dam ‘ sngon rtogs bde tshor ri zhes pa'i ming gis 'bod kyi yod/ nga tshor spro snang 'di 'dra sbyin pa ni phal cher de bas gting ring du gnas pa'i bsam pa'i 'byung khungs kyi de bas che ba'i spro snang zhig thob thub ba'i ched du red/ hphu lu'o dbyi nyes ‘4nga'i ngos 'dzin 90
