bsgyur pa'i ldog phyogs kyi 'bras bur/ mi sna mi nyung ba zhig gi rtog pas gting med kha tsam du g.yeng ba'i tshor byed kyi bag chags dang / spyir btang gi sems shugs spyi mtshan gyi cha ru gtogs pa'i go don tsam mtshon par byed pa las/ srol rgyun rtsom rig gi blang bya'i bsam blo'i rang gshis de 'dra mtshon thub kyi med pa red/ der brten brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna de rnams kyang kho tsho gnas pa'i dus rabs dang 'dra bar mang che ba ni yid mugasems sdug skyo snang bcas dang tshul ldog gi bsam pa ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan sha stag yin no/gsum/ gtam rgyud kyi don rkyen byung rim gyis grub cha mi byed par/ 44sems khams kyi dus tshod 1’de brtsams chos kyi 8‘bsam pa'i mi snar ’ brtsi ba/rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi grub cha de srol rgyun brtsams chos dang shin tu mi 'dra ste/ des rtsom rig gi lo rgyus thog thengs dang por srol rgyun brtsams sgrung gis gzhi rtsa'i thog gtam rgyud kyi snga phyi'i don rkyen byung rim gzhi bzung ba'am yang na byung rim bar gyi gtan tshigs kyi 'brel ba gzhir bzung sna gcig rkyang par thad thig gi sgo nas 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i grub cha yongs su gtor te/ gtam rgyud brjod pa de dus tshod kyi go rim gzhir bzung thad thig tu mdun skyod byed pa ma yin par mi'i rtog 'gyu'i 'gul skyod dang bstun te rang mos 'brel dran gyi sgo nas go sgrig byed kyi yod/de'ang gsal por bshad na/ rtog pa'i bcos min rang bzhin mtshon dgos kyi yod stabs gtam rgyud kyi don rkyen byung rim yang rgyun gtan gyi dus tshod go rim gzhir bzung 'phel rgyas gtong thabs med pa zhig red/ der brten rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung nang gtam rgyud bkod sgrig dang don rkyen gyi byung rim 'brel mthud byed skabs spyir na yul dus gtan tshigs dang rgyu 384

'bras 'brel ba sogs kyi tshod bkag mi thebs shing / rtag tu dus rim bsnor 'jog gis yul dus mchongs skyod dang 'gyur ba mang ba'i snang tshul mngon rgyu yod la/ don rkyen gong 'og bar dus tshod dang sa gnas kyi gtan tshigs 'brel ba dam zab dgos/ pa'i nges pa'ang ma mchis/ dus tshod thad dus gsum phan tshun go ldog dang / phan tshun sim thim/ snol 'dres spel mar spyod chog pa zhig red/ po ko sen gyi ra sems khams dus tshod 〉’dang /we len kran mu'u si'i ‘6tshor snang khrod kyi da lta ri de bzhin dbyi li hra pa'e pa'o wun gyi tsa zlos gar rang bzhin gyi ‘da lta ri1’zhes pa sogs kyis rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gzhi 'dzin sa mkho 'don byas yod/bzhi/ 4‘rang mos 'brel dran 1’dang 6‘nang sems chig lab ri kyi bya thabs spyad de don brjod dang / 'bri 'god/ dpyad brjod mtshams sbyor bcas kyis gtso bo byed pa'i 'bri thabs dor ba/ hphu lu'o dbyi tes rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom bya 'gul ni ‘‘rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i 'gul skyod 1’cig gam yang na ‘6rang mos 'brel dran minyazer ba de yin 'a// (snarang mos 'brel dran mi gyi bya thabs kyis mi'i sba gsang byas ba'i kun slong ste rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i 'gul skyod sngog 'don legs shos byed thub pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung gi dpyod yul ni tag tag mi'i rtog pa'i 'gul skyod de yin la/ lhag don mi'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i 'gul skyod de yin stabs/ rtog pa rang yan pa'i brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po yod do cog gis hphu lu'o dbyi te'i sa nas/ ‘4rang mos 'brel dran ’’gyi gzhung lugs nyams len gyis de nyid rang gi gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i bya thabs shig la bzung ba ni smros mi dgos pa zhig yin no/385

'byung 'gyur ring lugs/130 ji 'dra zhig la 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zer ba dang / de ji ltar thon cing 'phel rgyas song ba yin nam/'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor yo rob tu thon pa'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi grub mtha' gsar pa zhig yin pa de dang thog dbyi tha lir dar 'phel byung ba dang / rjes su u ru sur mgyogs myur dar khyab byung zhing hpha ran si dang / dbyin ji/ 'jar man sogs rgyal khab la'ang shugs rkyen nges can byung yod/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar gtod pa ni dbyi tha li'i snyan ngag pa dang zlos gar ba ma li ne ti zhes pa de red/ khos 909lo'i zla 2tshes 20nyin hpha ran si'i 〈gle ca lu'o tshags par 〉thog 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas pa des 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zer ba'i grub mtha' gsar pa 'go tshugs pa mtshon yod/ /9/0lor khos slar yang 〈〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa spel te 'byung 'gyur ring lugs rtsom rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang gsar rtsom gyi rtsa don dril bsgrags byas/ 19/3lor kho pa dang pha la tse si ci sogs kyis mnyam du 〈la'e tsha'i pa 〉zhes pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dus deb cig rtsom sgrig byas pa dang / lo der ma li ne ti u ru sur bskyod de hur brtson chen pos kho pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba dril bsgrags kyis u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur skul ma btang yod/ 1914lor ci ti sogs kyis grong khyer hpho lu'o lun sa sogs la 386

'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi mtshan tshogs 'tshogs nas grub mtha' gsar pa de'i shugs rkyen rgya cher btang / /915lor ma li ne ti dang sa'e ti me li sogs kyis 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi zlos gar bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas/ /916lo nas /9/8lo'i bar ci ti sogs kyis 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dbyi tha li 〉zhes pa'i dus deb gsar du bton nas hur brtson chen pos zlos gar thad kyi 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba dril bsgrags byas/ de ltar 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos dar spel dang dril bsgrags byas pa brgyud 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas phyin pa dang shugs rkyen yang nyin bzhin je cher song yod/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi tshab mtshon rtsom pa por dbyi tha li'i ma li ne ti dang / pha la tse si ci/ ci ti/ hpha ran si'i a po li ner/ u ru su'i ma ya kho hphu si ci/ pu'u er li'u kho sogs yod pa dang / tshab mtshon brtsams chos kyi gras su ma li ne ti'i 'khrab gzhung 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa dang /ci ti'i 'khrab gzhung 〈ar las 〉dang 〈ser po dang nag po/〉 pha la tse si ci'i 〈nga su red dam/〉 ma ya kho hphu si ci'i 〈mtshan mo 〉dang 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉zhes pa sogs yod pa red/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyis rigs pa'i gzhung lugs thad rtsom rig dang rig gnas kyi srol rgyun rnying pa mtha' dag dor te rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs dgos pa dang / nang don dang rnam pa gnyis thad nas de snga dang mi 'dra ba'i 88'byung 'gyur gyi sgyu rtsal gsar pa ’nyazhig gtod dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ ma li ne tis 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni 68deng rabs kyi snying stobs mi’zhes pa de yin zhes bshad pa 'di'i 387

thog nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs thon pa der dus rabs kyi 'byung rkyen ded khungs ldan pa mthong thub/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor yo rob kyi bzo las dang / tshan rig lag rtsal bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas song nas spyi tshogs kyi rnam par 'gyur ldog shugs che byung ba dang / deng rabs kyi grong khyer chen po dang / 'phrul chas kyi shes rig myur tshad dang 'gran rtsod sogs ni skabs de'i dus rabs kyi khyad chos su grub yod/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos rtsom pa po zhig la cha mtshon na dngos yod kyi gnas tshul gsar pa mtshon dgos pa dang / spro sems rab tu 'phel ba'i sgo nas ra‘yar brtson rang bzhin gyi las 'gul ’dang 4‘'phrul chas kyi shes rig ’ la bstod glu len dgos pa/ grong khyer chen pozhi zang zing gi 'tsho ba dang / 88myur tshad kyi mdzes pa nyanyadang stobs shugs la bsngags brjod byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin/ rtsom pa pos deng rabs 'tsho ba'i 6 las 'gul gyi tshor snang /nyamatshon par byed pa dang / deng rabs grong khyer gyi ‘‘'gul tshul mi’khrod nas mdzes pa 'dzin pa dang snyan ngag gi 'byung rtsa sngog spel byed dgos pa de red/ spyir na kho tsho ni deng rabs grong khyer gyi dngos po'i dpal yon la yid mos brtsi bkur zhu mkhan zhig red/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs/ kyi rtsom pa pos rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis drang bden dang drang bden ma yin pa'i dmag 'khrug tshud pa'i dmag 'khrug la bstod glu len dgos pa'i dril bsgrags byed kyi yod de/ kho tshos rnying pa yod tshad gtor dgos na nges par drag shugs spyod dgos rgyu'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod stabs/ dmag 'khrug dang / drag shugs/ 'jigs skul bcas kyi bya spyod la khas len gyi gdeng 'jog byed kyi yod/ kho tshos dmag 'khrug la 6‘rlabs chen gyi mnyam sgrog rol mo mi dang /'dzam gling gtsang ma bzo byed kyi bya thabs/ 46'dzam gling dwangs gtsang du 388

bcos byed lam bu nyag cig ’’tu 'bod par byed/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gral rim rmang gzhi ni 'byor chung gral rim yin zhing gral rim de'i gnas bab mi brtan pa dang / bsam blo thal che'i phyogs su bskyod rgyur dga' ba bcas ni 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi don stong ring lugs dang srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs kyi 'byung rtsa red/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor dbyi tha li'i thon skyed chung ba byed mkhan gyis legs pa'i gnas bab bzung ba dang / u ru su'i thon skyed chung ba byed mkhan yang pha mtha' mi mngon pa'i rgya mtsho lta bur yod pas/ 'di ni 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig de dbyi tha lir thon pa dang u ru sur dar khyab 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen red/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom pa po'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur tshang mar rang gshis re ldan yod la bsam blo'i chu tshad dang / chab srid kyi rnam 'gyur bcas kyang mi 'dra ba re yod do/ 131 'byung 'gyur ring lugs la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig la gsham gsal gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos ldan yod de/gcig phyi rol don dngos dang mthun par dngos yod 'dra bshu bya rgyur sun 'byin gyis rtsom pa po'i rang ngos kyi myong tshor brgyud sgyu rtsal gyi thog nas rang nyid gson por gnas pa'i sna ngo bo ’’mtshon dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ ma li ne tis zlos gar gyis 4 rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang / dpog par dka' ba'i stobs shugs/ spyi mtshan rnam dag dang bsam bkod rnam 389

dag bcas kyi khrod nas sngog 'don byas pa'i yod tshad ’ mtshon dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rtsom pos rtag tu rang ngos kyi bsam bkod dang 'phrul shes kyi rnam pa'i thog nas bya dngos kyi kha dog dang / sgra gdangs/ bro ba/ 'gul tshul sogs mtshon par byed pa ste/ dper na ma ya kho hphu si cis 1913lor bris pa'i 〈grong khyer dmyal ba chen po 〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag nang snyan tshig 'di 'dra zhig bris yod de/sge'u khung gis grong khyer dmyal ba chen po de/dmyal ba chung chung mang por phral cing /glog 'og 'jib kyin yod/rlangs 'khor ni skra dmar gdon 'dre dang 'dra bar 'tshub mchongs byed la/sgra 'dzin dbang po'i 'gram du/dung chen gyi smyo cor sgrog gin gda'/zhes pa lta bu'o/ 'dir 'god 'bri byas pa'i grong khyer ni kha dog dang / sgra gdangs/ glog 'od bcas kyi g.yo 'gul gyis khengs sa'i grong khyer yin la rlangs 'khor ni sgo skra dmar gdon 'dre mi dang / dmyal bar dpe bzhag ste ‘‘glog 'og 'jib kyin yod pa ’’bcas ni shin tu ya ma tshan che ba'i bsam bkod 'ba' zhig red la/ snyan tshig 'di'i nang gi grong khyer ni rtsom pa po'i 'phrul snang can du gyur pa'i grong khyer yin pa red/ rtsom pa pos rang ngos kyi bsam pa'i bkod pa 'bri rgyur mthong che byed la bsam bkod de rnams kyang rtag tu shin tu ya mtshan can zhig yin par brten/ snyan tshig mang po'i nang don klog pa pos ha cang rtogs dka' ba yod pa red/ 'on kyang snyan tshig legs gras rnams ni rnam pa gsar la phun sum tshogs pa'i nang don gting zab 390

bcas dang ldan pas/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa'i blo rgya chen po'i gsar bcos dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs mngon gyi yod/gsum/ rtsom rig gi rjod byed gsar bcos byed par brten nas rtsom rig gi srol rgyun rnying par sun 'byin byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa/ma li ne ti sogs kyis snyan ngag pas 6‘'ching med rang dbang ldan pa'i tshig phreng ’’rmang gzhir bzung ste snyan ngag rtsom dgos par bstan pa dang / hpha ran si'i rtsom pa po a po li na'e er gyis 88gleng mo'i rtsom lugs kyi snyan tshig ri’'bri dgos pa dang / rjod byed kyi sgra skyed phan nus la mthong che byed dgos pa ma zad zang zing mgo mjug med pa'i kha skad kyi thog nas snyan ngag 'bri dgos zhes bstan yod/ u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pas skad yig rnying pa gtor dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung ste 4‘yo byad du spyod pa'i yi ge gtor dgos/ rang nyid dmigs yul du byed pa dang / rang nyid 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i yi ge khri lor brtan pa shog mi ces pa'i 'bod tshig bton pa dang / kho tshos rjod byed kyi rnam pa'i thad sngar med gsar spros kyis sus kyang mi shes pa'i tha snyad gsar pa 'ga' re bzos pa/ 'ga' zhig gis tha na skad yig gi tshad ldan bkas bcad med pa bzos te rgyan tshig dang / bsnan tshigabarda rtags tshegs shad bcas pa rtsa gtor gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton yod/kho tshos par ris sna tshogs sgrig sbyor dang / dras sbyar/ tha na rtsis rig thad kyi brda rtags dang rol mo'i dbyangs rtags sogs spyad de rang nyid kyi bsam tshul mtshon par byed cing / 'ga' zhig ni rnam pa ring lugs kyi rwa dung nang zhugs nas yongs su tha snyad kyi rol rtsed la gzhol yod/bzhi/ snyan tshig rtsom stangs kyi rnam gzhag thad gsar gtod gang 'tshams byung yod de/ a po li na'e er gyi skas dbyibs can gyi snyan tshig 391

ces pa'i snyan tshig gi rnam pa gsar pa zhig btod pa de ma ya kho hphu si cis 'phel rgyas su btang nas sgyu rtsal gyi phan 'bras gang legs thon yod/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos rnam pa gsar pa don gnyer byed pa der thal drags pa'i zhan cha yod mod/ 'on kyang rtsom rig gi mtshon byed thabs tshul phun sum tshogs su gtong ba'i thad legs skyes phul yod de/dper na ma li ne ti'i 'khrab gzhung nang mi'am srog chags lta bur sgrog tse rkub stegs sogs kyis kyang 'gul skyod byed pa'i rnam pa thon yod la/ rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gi snyan tshig nang 'khrul shes kyi rnam pas khengs te gsal la ma gsal dang bden la ma bden gyi blo khams shig grub yod pa de thams cad kyi ngo mtshar las mi rnams la rnam pa gsar pa'i tshor snang zhig sbyin yod/132 dbyi tha lir khyab khongs ji 'dra'i nang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod dam/'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi 'byung sa dang lte gnad ni dbyi tha li yin pas 'dir 'byung 'gyur smra ba'i las 'gul nang gzhug mkhan mi mang shos dang / zil shugs che shos/ shugs rkyen thebs yul mang shos bcas yin pa red/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de g.yas g.yon gzhogs gnyis su gyes shing dbyi tha lir g.yas gzhogs kyis legs pa'i gnas bab bzung yod la/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar gtod pa ni g.yas gzhogs pa'i gtso 'dzin ma li ne ti yin/dbyi tha lir 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de dang thog rtsom rig nas 'go tshugs pa dang / der gzhug mkhan gyi mi sna'i gras su ma li ne ti phud da dung pha la tse si ci dang / ko a'o nyi/ pha phi nyi/ su'o hphe chi/ pu'u chi/ kha wa cha'o 392

li sogs yod pa red/ rjes su zlos gar dang / ri mo/ rol dbyangs sogs kyi khyab khongs su 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa dang / ci ti/ sa'e ti me li/ kho la/ po cha'o nyi/ pa la sogs ni de'i khrod kyi tshab mtshon mi sna red/33 ma li ne ti ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ma li ne ti (1876—1944)ni dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs rtsom rig gi srol gtod pa zhig red/ /876lor e cib kyi ya li hran ta gru kha'i dbyi tha li pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu skyes/ 1893lor pha ma gnyis dang mnyam du pha ri sir gnas spos pa dang der hpha ran si'i deng rabs smra ba'i rtsom rig gi shugs rkyen thebs/ 1894lor dbyi tha lir phyir log gis pha we ya dang re na ya sogs slob grwa chen mor khrims rig slob sbyong byas shing //899lor slob grwa thon/ /897lo nas bzung mtshon rtags ring lags kyi snyan tshig spel 'go btsugs/ /905lor 〈snyan tshig 〉〉ces pa'i dus deb gsar gnyer gyis de'i nang rgyal khab phyi nang gi deng rabs smra ba'i snyan tshig 'god kyin yod//909lo'i zla 2tshes 20nyin pha ri si'i 〈hphe ca lu'o tshags par 〉〉thog 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉spel/ 1910lor 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig bsgrags gtam 〉spel ba dang / yang brgyud mar 〈〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi zlos gar bsgrags gtam 〉spel/ bsgrags gtam de rnams kyi khrod du 'byung 'gyur ring lugs smra ba'i rig gzhung ma lag rgyas bshad byas yod/ 19/3lor kho pa dang pha la tse si sogs kyis 〈la'e tsha'i nga/ 〉zhes pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dus deb bton/ lo der yang 393

u ru sur bcar 'dri dang der rang gi 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba dril bsgrags byas pas shugs rkyen cung che tsam thebs/ma li ne nyis gsar rtsom gyi lag len khrod du rang gi 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rig gzhung gang thub lag bstar gyis blo rgya chen pos gsar bcos byas yod/ brtsams chos khrod kyi skad yig rnams ga dus yin rung skad cha'i thad brda sprod kyi gzhung dang mi mthun pa'i 'tsho bar lad mo byed pa'i grags sgra dang rtsis rig gi brda rtags spyad pas ya mtshan rtogs dka' ba zhig yod pa red/ kho pa'i brtsams chos kyi gras su 〈ti li po li g.yul 'gyed 〉(/9/ 1)dang / 〈kra—thu'u po—thu'u po/〉〉(1914) 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa ma pher kha/〉〉(1910) 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉〉zer ba sogs yod/ 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa'i 'khrab tshan thung ngu de'i nang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos srol rgyun zlos gar la sun 'byin pa'i khyad chos gang legs mtshon par byas yod de/ 'khrab tshan la mgo 'dzugs pa dang / mtho rlabs dang mjug 'bras sogs med la tha na gtam rgyud kyi byung rim zer ba'ang med/srol rgyun zlos gar la rang gshis kyi khyad rtags mngon gsal che ba'i mi sna'i gzugs brnyan yod la mi sna'i bar gyi gleng mol yang yod mod/ 'on kyang 'khrab gzhung 'di'i nang mi sna'i rang gshis dang mi sna'i bar gyi gleng mol gtan nas med la/ 'khrab gzhung hril por khyon bsdoms 'khrab tshig dum bu gsum dang de min sus kyang mi go ba'i mu cor gyi gtam tshig gcig bcas las med/ 'khrab tshan 'go tshugs skabs gar stegs thog rgyas spros che ba'i mgron khang zhig yod pa dang / g.yog po khyu cig gis sku mgron phebs sgug zhus nas bsdad yod/ skabs der spyi gnyer mgron khang du yong nas 68myur bar gra sgrig gyis shig kho tsho slebs song mi zhes pa'i 'khrab tshig dang po de 394

bshad rjes/ g.yog po tshos spyi gnyer gyi ngag bkod ltar brel 'tshub ngang sgrog rtse rkub stegs sgrig bkod byed/ 'on kyang mtha' ma sku mgron gcig kyang slebs med pa dang / ‘4g.yog po tsho ni gar stegs kyi khug 'khyog cig la 'dar sig sig tu 'khums nas bsdad de yid shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nas bde spro'i khri'u shing dang rkub stegs rnams dal bus mgron khang nas phyir thon bya rgyur sgug nas bsdad/’’ rkub stegs rang nyid kyis 'gul skyod byed pa de 'dra ha cang khungs med kyi ya mtshan dpe gsar zhig yin mod de ni 'phrul shes kyi rnam pa tsam du zad cing / 'khrab gzhung 'di lta bus srol rgyun rnying pa gtor ba los yin 'on kyang 'dir gting zab kyi bsam blo'i don snying zer ba gleng thabs med/chab srid langs phyogs la bltas na/ ma li ne ti ni 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi g.yas gzhogs pa'i tshab mtshon mi sna yin pa dang / /9/4lor 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang hpha shi si ring lugs 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig spel te hpha shi si ring lugs dril bsgrags byas/rjes su hur brtson chen pos hpha shi si'i tang gi bya 'gul nang zhugs te dbyi tha li'i hpha shi si'i 'go gtso mo su'o li nyi'i ched du dar 'phyar dung 'bud kyis kho pa'i ngan rogs su gyur/ hpha shi si'i tang gis srid dbang bzung ba'i rjes su khos tshan rig khang gi yon hri dang dbyi tha li'i rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyi kru'u zhi sogs kyi las khur byed myong ba dang / /942lor dbyi tha li'i btsan 'dzul dmag dang mnyam du u ru sur bskyod de /944lor nad gzhis rkyen pas lnga lam du 'khod/ 395

134 ma li ne ti'i 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa'i nang lta ba ga re bton yod dam/ma li ne tes 〈〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉〉zhes pa'i nang phra zhing gsal ba'i lta ba lnga ste 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snying don rnams bton yod/gcig rig gnas kyi srol rgyun yod tshad dor rgyu/ khos dus rabs ni gong 'phel myur bar 'gro bzhin pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni dus las 'das pa dang rul sungs malo med cig tu gyur zin na nges par du de dang 'brel thag gtsang bcad kyis de thams cad dor dgos par 'dod/gnyis/ mi rnams yar langs nas ngo log gis smyo skar mar 'gran slong ’ byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas/ khos 6 'thab rtsod kyi khrod las gzhan du mdzes pa med la/ byed phod pa dang gtong phod pa'i snying stobs med na phul byung gi brtsams 'bras thon mi srid/ ri’ ‘nga tsho'i snyan tshig khrod du gal 'gangs che shos kyi grub cha ni dpa' ngar dang / blo stobs/ ngo log sa’bcas yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/gsum/ ‘‘'byung 'gyur gyi sgyu rtsal ’ gyis ‘6'gul skyod ’ mtshon rgyu lte bar —'dzin dgos/ khos rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis nus shugs yod rgus ‘ 'gul skyod mi’dang 'brel ba'i myur tshad dang / stobs shugs/ nus tshad/ sgra skyed/'phrul 'khor/ lag rtsal sogs 'a/ bstod glu len dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa dang / ‘‘gsar byung mdzes pa'i rigs shig gis 'jig rten brjid chags 'od stong 'phro ba zhig tu bsgyur yong / 'di 'dra'i mdzes pa ni myur stobs kyi 396

mdzes pa zhig red ’’ces brjod/bzhi/ dmag 'khrug dang / drag shugs/ 'jigs skul bcas ni srol rgyun rnying pa rtsa brlag gtong rgyu dang / 'byung 'gyur gsar pa gtod byed kyi bya thabs shig yin na de tshang mar bsngags brjod byed 'os pa zhig yin/lnga/ sna 'byung 'gyur gyi sgyu rtsal ri’gsar gtod byed dgos pa bcas so/135 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉〉zhes pa de'i nang don gtso bo gang red dam/1909lo'i zla 2tshes 20nyin dbyi tha li'i ma li ne tes 'grems spel byas pa'i 〈〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa de'i nang don gtso bo gsham gsal te/ gcig nga tshos nyen khar dga' zhen byed pa der bstod glu len dgos pa dang / sems shugs kyis phyug pa'i goms gshis la bstod glu len dgos pa/ blo rgya chen po'i snying stobs la bstod glu len dgos/gnyis/ nga tsho'i snyan tshig khrod kyi grub cha gal 'gangs che shos ni dpa' ngar dang / blo stobs/ ngo log bcas red/gsum/ rtsom rig gis sngar nas bzung mno sems la rol ba lta bu'i khu sim dang / bla 'khyam yid myos/ gnyid du yur ba'i ngang tshul bcas la bstod glu len gyi yod mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i bstod glu len yul ni byed phod pa dang gtong phod pa'i las 'gul dang / smyo ba lta bu'i gnyid yer/ myur 'gros kyi gom stabs/ mgo rting slog pa/ 'gram lcag gzhu ba/ khu tshur bsnun pa bcas yin/bzhi/ gsar byung mdzes pa'i rigs shig gis 'jig rten brjid chags 397

'od stong 'phro ba zhig tu bsgyur yong ces nga tshos khyab bsgrags bya rgyu dang /'di 'dra'i mdzes pa ni myur stobs kyi mdzes pa zhig red/ myur bar mdun du bskyod pa'i rlangs 'khor gyi sgrom stegs nang shin tu che ba'i sbu gu blugs yod pa de ni sbrul mang pos thol byung gi 'bar gas lta bu'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa dang 'dra la/ ngar skad sgrog pa'i rlangs 'khor te/ ha lam skar mda' dang 'dra bar mdun du 'phur bgrod byed pa de ni ———sa mo se le si'i rgyal kha las kyang de bas mdzes sdug ldan pa yod/lnga/ nga tshos kha lo sgyur byed lag tu bzung nas sa'i go la'i lam thig ded de drag skyod byed mkhan la bstod glu len rgyu yin zhing kho'i blo la 'thad pa'i lag 'ju des go la'i sa ngos brtol bar 'gyur/drug snyan ngag pas cis kyang smyo ba lta bu dang / spobs nyams ldan pa/'jungs pa med pa bcas kyi ngang tshul ldan pa byas te lhag bsam dag pa'i khrod du gdod ma'i grub cha snon dgos/bdun/ 'thab rtsod kyi khrod phud gzhan mdzes pa med la/ byed phod pa dang gtong phod pa'i snying stobs med na phul byung gi brtsams 'bras thon mi srid/ snyan tshig gis nges par du ma shes pa'i stobs shugs sna tshogs la shugs drag che ba'i rgol rdung byas te de dag gis mi'i rigs kyi mdun du mgo sgur zhu rgyur bka' btsan 'bebs dgos/brgyad/ nga tsho dus rabs mthar zad kyi gle'u'i thog g.yo med 'gying nger langs nas yod/ nga tshos 'dzul mi thub pa'i lkog gyur gyi phug lam nang du ngar 'dzul bya rgyu yin/ skabs 'dir nga tshos da dung phyir lta byed dgos don ci/ yul dang dus tshang ma kha nyin rtsa med song zin/ nga tshos snga sa nas yun ring dang yun gnas kyi myur tshad bskrun zin na/ nga tsho ni bltos med kyi 398

khrod du 'tsho bar rol gyin yod/dgu/ nga tshos 'dzam gling bde thang can du 'gyur ba'i bya thabs nyag cig ste dmag rgyal ring lugs dang / rgyal gces ring lugs/ srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs bcas kyis yod tshad rtsa gtor gtong byed kyi dpung pa lta bu'i dmag 'khrug dang / srog gcod kyi mdzes pa'i bsam blo/ bud med la mthong chung byed pa bcas la bstod glu len snyam/bcu/ nga tshos dngos mang bshams ston khang dang dpe mdzod khang rtsa brlag gtong rgyu dang / kun spyod ring lugs dang / bud med kyi dbang cha'i ring lugs/ de bzhin skabs 'tshol ring lugs dang khe phan ring lugs yod tshad kyi skyug bro ba'i dngos po dang 'thab rtsod byed snyam/bcu gcig nga tshos ngal rtsol dang / dga' mgur/ ngo log bcas kyi spro ba rab 'phel 'og gnas pa'i mi tshogs stug por glu dbyangs len rgyu yin/de ring nga tshos 'dir brten nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gsar gtod byas pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nga tshos dge rgan che mo dang / gna' rdzas rtog zhib pa/ yul skor sne shan pa bcas kyi 'dam myags khrod nas dbyi tha li skyob rgyu'i ched du yin/nga tshos 'dzam gling gi rtse mor langs nas bskyar du skar mar 'gran slong bya rgyu yin/136 ma li ne ti'i 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos kyi nang don gang red dam/〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa de ni ma li ne ti'i 'khrab tshan thung gras shig red/ 'khrab tshan hril po'i nang don ni 'di lta te gtam rgyud ni rgyas spros che 399

ba'i mgron khang gi mtshan mor byung ba'i gnas tshul zhig red/ 'khrab yol phye ma thag mig la gzan pa'i mgron khang gi dpyang zhu'i glog 'od chem chem 'phro/ gar stegs kyi g.yon phyogs me tog ldum rar bskyod pa'i sgo dang sge'u khung gdangs nas yod/ rtsig 'gram du sgrog rtse gru bzhi nar mo chen po zhig yod pa de'i steng sgrog ras bkab yod/ gar stegs kyi g.yas phyogs su'ang sgo zhig yod pa de phye nas yod cing rtsig 'gram du gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bde spro'i khri'u shing zhig brgyab yod pa de'i gzhogs g.yas g.yon so sor rkub stegs bzhi re bzhag yod/ skabs der spyi gnyer dang khug rta'i mjug ma lta bu'i gos gyon pa'i g.yog po gnyis g.yon sgo nas gar stegs su yong ste/spyi gnyer gyis ‘6myur bar gra sgrig gyis shig kho tsho yong gi 'dug mi’ces bshad de phyir bshol/ yud tsam song rjes spyi gnyer bskyar du yong nas 66bka' rgya gsar pa gtong rgyur/ kho tsho ngal dub shin tu chen po byung 'dug mgyogs myur sngas mgo dang rkub bkyag khag gcig gra sgrig gyis shig ’mices bka' bkod gnyis pa btang ste phyir 'then/ de rjes g.yog po tshos brel 'tshub ngang las 'go btsugs te g.yas sgo nas phyir thon cing sngas mgo dang rkub bkyag sogs khur te tshur yong / bde spro'i khri'u shing de mgron khang gi dbus su spos pa dang / de'i gzhogs gnyis so sor rgyab bde spro'i khri'u shing la gtad pa'i rkub stegs bzhi re brgyab/ bde spro'i khri'u shing dang rkub stegs so so'i mdun du slar yang rkub bkyag re brgyab pa bcas byas las brel 'jags mtshams g.yog po tsho sgo 'gram du song nas mi yong min rgyang blta byas shing / kho tshos sngar bzhin ltad mo bar rgyab bslogs nas bsdad/de ltar yun ring sgug sdod byas rjes spyi gnyer slar yang me tog ldum ra nas dbugs hal hal ngang mgron khang du yong ste 66bka' rgya gsar pa gtong rgyur/ 400

kho tsho'i grod pa ltogs 'dug za ma gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig gyis 1’zhes/ pa'i 'khrab tshig gsum pa de bshad de slar yang phyir bshol/ phal cher 44kho tsho ri slebs yod pa 'dra/ 'on kyang / 46kho tsho ri’su yin pa dang gang du bsdad yod pa sus kyang mi shes/ g.yog po tshos slar yang brel ba 'tshub 'tshub ngang sgrog tse gru bzhi nar mo ba de mgron khang gi dbus su bskyal/ sgrog tse'i mtha' skor du rkub stegs brgyad bzhag bde spro'i khri'u shing de gral 'gor brgyab pa bcas byas te brel 'tshub ngang phyir 'then byas/ de rjes slar yang g.yas sgo nas yar 'dzul te za cog bkod sgrig byas/ bzhugs gral dang po'i mdun du me tog bum pa gcig bzhag pa dang / bzhugs gral gnyis pa'i mdun du a rag shel dam brgyad bzhag pa/ de min bzhugs gral gyi mdun du za snod 'thung chas cha re bzhag pa bcas kyi thog nas ‘6kho tsho 1 ni rim pa gsum la 'byed yod pa mthong thub/ gzhan yang rkub stegs gcig za cog la bsnyes te rgyab rkang gnyis yar 'greng nas bzhag pa de ni za khang de 'dra'i nang rgyun du 64sor 'jog 'dug gnas lha kyi mtshon byed lta bur de ltar 'jog srol yod pa lta ra byas/ g.yog po tshos de 'dra'i 'du 'god kyi las mjug bsgril rjes rgyab ltad mo bar phyogs nas sngar bzhin sgo 'gram nas phar lta tshur lta byas/slar yang yun ring sgug sdod byas rjes spyi gnyer brel rgyug ngang yong ste 61100tha༈11757༅057la0zhes pa'i bka' rgya thengs bzhi pa btang ste song /bka' rgya de'i nang don ji 'dra yin min sus kyang mi rtogs pas/ ltad mo bas g.yog po'i 'gul tshul dpag ste bsam gzhigs bya rgyu tsam red/ spyi gnyer phyin pa'i rjes su g.yog po tshos de ma thag gra sgrig byas zin pa'i za cog de sngar gnas su rang 'jags bskyal/ bde spro'i khri'u shing de me tog ldum rar 'gro sa'i sgo'i mdun du 'phred bzhag byas rjes rkub stegs brgyad po'ang 401

de mjug tu bstar ring bsgrigs su bzhag pa de gar stegs brgyud gtad zur thig tu grub yod/ de rjes g.yog po tshos dpyang zhu bsad pas gar stegs nag thing nger gyur/ me tog ldum rar 'gro sa'i sgo'i nang nas gar stegs su zla 'od phog mthong rgyu med pa'i 'od 'du'i glog zhu zhig gis bde spro'i khri'u shing dang rkub stegs brgyad bcas kyi grib ma sa steng du gsal bar gyur to//37 〈〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes par 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi khyad rtags gang dang gang ldan yod dam/〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa'i nang don la bltas na 'di ni sngar med ya mtshan can gyi 'khrab tshan zhig yin pa mthong thub/ ma li ne tis 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉nang / de'i snga'i zlos gar tshang ma ni rnying rul dang / yig rdzob che ba/ 'gyur 'gul med pa bcas kyi yid rnam 'byed kyi zlos gar zhig yin pa de'i tshe srog gi nus pa shor tshar ba red/de'i tshab tu spyod 'os pa ni shin tu tshad yod kyi yul dus dang don rkyen byung rim khrod nas 44kho tsho ji 'dra'i don dngos la rgyab kyis phyogs shing ha las ya mtshan dang zlos gar la ngo log pa zhig yin min la mi bltos par rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i khrod dang / dpog par dka' ba'i stobs shugs/ spyi mtshan rnam dag dang bsam bkod rnam dag bcas kyi khrod nas sngog 'don byas pa'i yod tshad mi mtshon pa bya rgyu de yin zhes bshad yod pa ltar/ 'khrab tshan thung gras 'di ni tag tag kho pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi zlos gar bsam pa lhag bsam rnam dag ngang mtshon pa zhig red/dang po/ de ni yig rdzob che bar sun 'byin byed pa'i rab thung zlos gar zhig red/ zlos gar hril por spyi gnyer gyi bka' rgya bzhi ste khyon 'khrab 4 02

tshig bzhi rang las med de/spyi gnyer na re/ myur bar gra sgrig gyis shig kho tsho yong gi 'dug(phyir log)spyi gnyer na re/ bka' rgya gsar pa gtong rgyur/ kho tsho ngal dub shin tu chen po byung 'dug mgyogs myur sngas mgo dang rkub bkyag gra sgrig gyis shig (phyir log)bka' rgya gsar pa gtong rgyur/ kho tsho grod pa ltogs 'dug za ma gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig gyis/ (phyir log) spyi gnyer na re/ 21100'i 1 357la052la0 (phyir log)zhes pa bcas kyi 'khrab tshig bzhi bshad yod la 'khrab tshig bzhi pa de ni da dung sus kyang mi shes pa'i skad cha dum bu zhig yin zhing / 'khrab tshig so so'i mjug gi byed lugs kyi gsal bshad yi ge bcas bsdoms na'ang khyon bsdoms yig 'bru lnga brgya nas drug brgya'i bar las med la/ 'khrab tshan nang mi sna'i phan tshun gyi gleng mol med pa dang 'gal ba thod gtug sogs srol rgyun zlos gar gyi gnad che'i rgyu rkyen de 'dra de bas kyang med pa red/'on kyang yig 'bru brgya phrag las med pa'i 'khrab tshan thung ngu des mi tsho'i sems la tshod dpag dang bsam gzhigs bya rgyu'i gnad don mi nyung ba zhig bzhag yod pas/ der ldab 'ga' zhig gam tha na ldab bcu phrag 'ga' zhig gi nang don tshud yod la/ dngos 'brel tshad yod kyi yul dus khrod nas sgro 'dogs dang / blang dor dang 'gal ba/ ya mtshan che ba bcas kyi gar stegs kyi gzugs brnyan zhig bskrun yod pa red ces brjod chogaganyis pa/ 'gul tshul nan bshad kyis 'gul med kyi yid rnam 'byed la sun 'byin pa/ zlos gar nang 'khrab tshig gam byed lugs kyi gsal 403

bshad yi ge gang gi nang du'ang 'gu'/ med kyi yid rnam 'byed gtan nas med par 'khrab tshan hril pos mi rnams la ‘‘'gul ’’ba'i tshor snang zhig sbyin yod/ zlos gar nang gi mi sna dang / spyi gnyer/ de bzhin g.yog po gnyis bcas tshang ma thog mtha' bar gsum du brel zing gi tshul du gnas shing / spyi gnyer gyis bka' bsgyur re btang tshar ma thag lam seng phyir 'gro ba las gar stegs thog gtan nas mi sdod la/ gar stegs thog yong ba'i skabs kyang ga dus yin rung brel ba 'tshub 'chub kyi rnam pa ldan pa zhig ste/ thengs sngon ma rnams ni 64dbugs hal hal ngang me tog ldum ra nas yar yong ba ’’dang / mjug mthar ‘8brel rgyug ngang yong ba :zhig red/ g.yog po tsho ni de bas kyang spyi gnyer thengs re gar stegs thog bskyod rjes kho tshos brel zing thengs re rgyag dgos kyi yod pa red/ sdings cha'i thog gtso bo bde spro'i khri'u shing dang / rkub stegs/ sgrog tse gru bzhi nar mo ba/ rkub bkyag la sogs pa'i 'khrab chas yod pa de rnams kyis kyang 'gul skyod byed kyi yod de/ dang thog g.yog po tshos yang yang de tsho 'gul skyod gtong ba nas mtha' ma kho tshos rang 'gul gyis ru star ring po zhig bsgrigs te sdings cha nas phyir 'then byas te 'gro ba de 'dra ni ngo mtshar zhig ma red ces sus brjod nus/gsum pa/ 64'phrul snang nya’gi nus pa spyad pa/ 'di ni ha lam 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa yod tshad kyis spyod par dga' ba'i bya thabs shig yin la/ ma li ne tis 'khrab tshan 'di'i nang de bas bed spyod 'thus legs btang yod pa de ni/ ltad mo/ bas ‘'phrul snang ma gi khrod nas (lkog gyur gyi blo sgo zhig 'byed thub pa ’ dang / dngos— gzugs la'ang 64tshe srog ldan pa ri tshor snang yong du 'jug snyam pa de yin no/ 404

138 ma li ne tes 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes par gsal bshad gang 'dra zhig brgyab yod dam/ma li ne nyis 〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa'i mjug tu gsar rtsom gyi dmigs yul brjod pa'i ‘ gsal bshad mi’cig zhor 'phros su bkod yod pa der blta tsam byas na 'khrab gzhung la rgyus mnga' lon rgyur rogs ram gang legs yong nges red/ khos 88〈kho tsho slebs song 〉zhes pa'i zlos gar nang ngas srog ldan pa'i dngos gzugs kyi 'dres sbyor zhig gsar gtod byed snyam pa de yin/ tshor ba skyen po dang bsam pa'i bkod shugs phun sum tshogs po'i mi tshang mas rang bzhin ngang thengs gcig min gnyis min shes rtogs byung ba ni/ mi med pa'i khang pa'i nang gi sgrog tse rkub stegs dang lhag par bde spro'i khri'u shing dang rkub stegs de dag las mi rnams la bag chags zab mo 'jog pa'i rnam pa zhig mngon gyi yod la/ lkog gyur gyi blo sgo 'byed rgyu yod pa'i gnas tshul gyis khengs nas yod pa de red/ngas lta ba 'di 'dra zhig rmang gzhir bzung nas nga'i 'dres sbyor de gsar gtod byas pa yin/ shin tu che ba'i bde spro'i khri'u shing de dang rkub stegs brgyad kyis phebs sgug zhu yul gyi sku mgron rnams la bsu ba bya ched rgyun chad med par kho tsho'i gnas yul 'pho 'gyur byed pa dang / rim bzhin kho tshor ya mtshan che ba'i 'phrul snang lta bu'i tshe srog ldan par gyur te/ mtha' ma kho tsho'i grib gzugs ring du bsrings pa dang kho tsho sgo 'gram gyi phyogs su 'gul skyod byed pa dang bstun nas ltad mo bas rkub stegs de tshor dngos gnas tshe srog ldan zhing /kho tsho rang nyid kyis 'gul te sgo phyir thon song snyam pa'i tshor snang yong ba de 405

red ’ ces bshad yod/139 pha la ce si ci ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/pha la tse si ci (1885—1)ni dbyi tha la'i deng rabs grags can snyan ngag pa dang brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi srol gtod pa'i gras bcas red/kho pa'i de snga'i ming la ar tu'o ku'u la nyi zer zhing hpho lu'o lun si'i tshong pa zhig gi khyim du skyes/ snga dus tshong las slob grwar slob sbyong byed myong ba dang rjes su dus skabs shig ring zlos gar 'khrab ston pa byas/ /903lor snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs deb dang po 〈rta dkar 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas pa nas bzung rtsom rig las rigs su zhugs/ 1907lor slar yang snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈glog zhu 〉〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas/ kho'i snga dus kyi snyan tshig ni dgod bro bstan bshig tsha ba zhig yin pa dang / grong mi chung ba'i 'phel med tha mal pa'i 'tsho bar zhen log yid mug gi bsam blo mtshon gyi yod/1909lor ma li ne ti dang mnyam du 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi grub mtha' btod de grub mtha' de'i skabs shig ring ming grags che ba'i tshab mtshon snyan ngag pa'i gras su gyur/ khos snga rjes su snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈snyan ngag 〉(1909)ces pa dang / 〈me gtong nyes can 〉(1910)zhes pa 'grems spel byas pa de tshor 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag nyams 'gyur mngon gsal dod po mtshon gyi yod la/ tshig rgyan gyis bcings pa'i yid 'ong nyams dga'i srol rgyun snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur dor te shugs drag che ba'i gsar bcos kyi snying stobs ldan yod/ brtsams chos kyis nus shugs 406

yod rgyas deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi sems khams grub cha'i gnad che'i rgyu rkyen gsum ste/ tshu smyo ba lta bu mi dang / ‘‘yid gdung /’’ 66skyo shas ri’bcas sngog 'don gyis go ldog zang zing gi dngos yod mdun du ci bya gtol med du gyur pa'i mgo rmongs dang smyo ngar 'tshab skyod kyi bsam pa mtshon pa ma zad don stong ring lugs dang 'chi la khad kyi skyo shas kyi rnam pas khengs yod pa red/sgyu rtsal thad/ snyan ngag 'di'i rigs ni zang nge zing nge dang mchong skyod kyi rang bzhin can zhig yin la/ blang dor bsam gzhigs kyi gtan tshigs 'brel ba bcad de ched mngags mi tsho'i rmi lam gyi yul khams dang 'phrul snang gi yul khams/ thad rtogs dang 'khrul shes bcas bris te las 'gul gyi mdzes pa dang 'gul tshul gyi mdzes pa zhes pa don gnyer byas pa zhig red/snyan tshig gi rjod byed ni drag brgal mchong skyod can zhig yin pas/ yongs su srol rgyun gyi tshig grub sbyor stangs dang sdebs sbyor gyi nges srol gtor nas sna rigs 'gre ri dang thu tshur snang mi’ngam yang na mu 'brel gnyid lab can gyi skad sgra mtshon pa'i sgra lta bu rim pa star chags su spyad de snyan ngag pa'i mgo rmongs zang zing gi bsam pa'i myong tshor mtshon pa byas yod/ 'on kyang snyan ngag pas blo khams 'tshol 'dzin dang gdam gses bya rgyur yang shin tu do snang byas te mtshon don gsar la ya mtshan che ba dang / srol rnying gi 'ching rgyar mi tshud pa/ dmigs bsal gyi rtsom lugs gsar pa bton pa bcas kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa 'bur btod dang / bkrag mdangs che ba'i ngo mtshar zam mi chad par thon te sgyu rtsal gyi mtshams tshad gsar rkyang zhig tu slebs thub pa byung bas/ mi rnams la brtse dung zab cing go rgyu cher ldan gyi tshor snang zhig kyang sbyin yod/ pha la tse si ci ni srol rnying dam srung ngam nus chung spobs med kyi snyan ngag pa zhig ma yin par thabs lam gsar gtod 407

dang 'tshol zhib byed pa'i yar brtson pa zhig red/ bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gang gi thad nas dpyad kyang kho'i snyan tshig ni dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag grub mtha'i khrod kyi ches mtho'i grub 'bras ldan pa'i rtser son gyi gras shig yin/pha la tse si ci yis da dung brtsams sgrung mi nyung ba zhig bris yod de/dper na brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈pe la'i khrims gzhung 〉(19//)dang /〈dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i brjod bya/〉( 932) 〈ma rabs can la sprad pa'i bya dga'/〉(1936) 〈nyams rgud du song ba'i btsan rgyal gsum pa 〉dang 〈ro ma 〉(/955)la sogs pa'i brtsams chos yod pa de rnams kyis brjid chags bkrag mdangs che ba'i tshon ris lta bur dngos bden gzhi rgya che ba'i sgo nas dus rabs phyed tsam ring gi dbyi tha li'i zang zing brtan lhing med pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon par byas pa dang / de'i khrod du lte ba'i gnas bab bzung ba ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shes yon can chung 'bring tshos rlung sprin lta bu'i 'gyur ldog che ba'i dus rabs nang myangs pa'i bar chad dka' sdug dang / yid gdung bkra ma shis kyi gnas tshul bkod pa rnams red/chab srid thad kho pa ni 'byor 'bring gral rim gyi zhi 'jam shog kha'i khongs su gtogs shing ma li ne tis tshab byed pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi g.yas gzhogs pa'i stobs shugs bar rno ngar che ba'i 'gal ba gnas yod/khos mi chos ring lugs kyi langs phyogs thog langs te ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi dka' sdug dang bar chad la gdung sems mnyam skye byed pa dang / 'byor chen gral rim gyi sger gcod dbang sgyur la 'khon sems bcangs kyi yod/1914lor mngon sum 'dzem med ngang ma li ne tis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi 408

dmag 'khrug la bcangs pa'i ngo dga' sprel lad kyi rnam 'gyur la ngo rgol gyis khong khro 'bar ba'i ngang nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi grub mtha' nas phyir 'then byas/ lo rabs sum cur slebs skabs dbyi tha li'i hpha shi si'i stobs shugs skabs shig ring smyo ham je cher song bas khos rtsom 'bri'i las khongs nas re zhig phyir bshol gsang yib kyis mo su'o li nyi'i log spyod srid dbang dang 'brel ba gtan nas ma byas par gzhung sems drang bden gyi shes yon can zhig gi khengs rlom spobs che'i ngang tshul mngon par byas/kho'i tshe mjug tu 〈skyo snang skye ba'i 'grul bzhud 〉(1955)dang 〈nga'i bsam pa 〉(1968)zer ba sogs kyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs kyi brtsams chos bris yod pa de tshor grub 'bras snga dus ltar thob med/1 40 pha la ce si ci'i 〈nga su red dam 〉〉zhes pa de ni snyan tshig ji 'dra zhig red dam/〈nga su red dam 〉〉zhes pa de ni pha la tse si ci'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos gang legs mtshon pa'i snyan tshig cig dang kho'i tshab ma/tshon brtsams chos shig red ces brjod chog snyan tshig de ni snyan ngag pas /909lor par du skrun pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈snyan ngag 〉ces pa'i nang bsdus yod cing snyan tshig hril po ni gsham gsal te/nga / snyan ngag pa zhig yin shas che/de 'dra min pa thag gis chod/nga'i sems nang gi smyu gus/ya mtshan gyi yig 'bru 'ba' zhig las mi 'bri ba ste/de yi ming la ‘ ‘smyo ba ’ zhes bya'o/ 409

nga / ri mo ba zhig yin shas che/ de yang min pa thag gis chod te/nga'i sems nang gi 'bri ras thogatshon mdog rigs gcig kho na las mi mngon ste/de yi ming la sna yid gdung ’zhes bya'o/'o na/ nga ni rol mo ba zhig red dam/de'ang min pa rigs mtshungs te/nga'i sems nang gi mtheb bkyag gis/sgra rtags gcig las mi dgrol ste/de yi ming la 8 skyo shas ’ zhes bya'o/ nga / yang snying su red dam/ngas che shel leb mo zhigasems pa'i mdun du 'jogaskye bo tshang mas zhib dpyod mdzod//deng su red dam/nga'i sems pa btsan bskul byed mkhan phra men ma/'di ni dpe mtshon du gyur pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan tshig cig red/ 'on kyang nga tshos de'i ngo bo shes rtogs ma thub na rnam pa'i thog nas sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal thad srol rgyun snyan tshig 'di'i ngo bo ni bdag nyid 410

kyi sems par dbye zhib grang shur shur zhig byas pa brgyud 64sto ba ’’dang / 4‘yid gdung /nyari ‘skyo shas ri’bcas kyi nang sems 'jig rten zhig gsal ston byas pa brgyud snyan ngag pa gang des don stong ring lugs kyi lta ba'i thog nas 'jig rten la lta ba dang / yod tshad khas mi len pa/ nus shugs yod rgus phyi rol don dngos las byol thabs bcas kyis ngos 'dzin gsal po ma thob pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi zang zing la yid smon byed pa las byung ba'i smyo ngar 'tshab skyod kyi sems shugs shig mtshon par byas yod/ der brten snyan ngag pas brjod pa'i ‘ nga su red dam/ nga'i sems pa btsan bskul byed mkhan phra men ma/ri zhes pa'i nga su red dam/ 66nga'i sems pa ’ zhes pa de'ang snyan ngag pa rang 'ba' zhig la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i sems ma yin par de tsho ni 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtsom rig hril po'i bsdus ris shig yin la/skabs der dngos yod la 'dod pa mi rangs shing rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs kyi mdun lam zhig 'tshol 'dod pa'i gzhon nu mi rabs gcig gi bsdus ris red/ kho tshos skabs de shed kyi dngos yod lam srol la yid ma rangs pa dang /srol rgyun gyi stobs shugs dang rig gnas rnying pa'i 'ching rgya gtor nas tham thom ngang dngos yod kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig 'tshol zhib kyis sgyu rtsal gyi nang don dang rnam pa gsar bcos byed snyam pa de red/ 6 smyo ba mi’dang / 6‘yid gdung /ri 64skyo shas mi’bcas ni kho tsho'i rtsa ba'i sems khams kyi gnas stangs shig yin pas kho tshos rnam pa ji 'dra zhig gi thog nas gsar rtsom byas kyang kho tsho'i brtsams chos kyi gzhi rtsa'i nang don ni sems khams 'di 'dra zhig rang mtshon par byed pa tsam du zad/ der brten ngo bo 'di nyid dam bzung byas tshe snyan tshig chung ngu 'di tshab mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi brtsams chos shig yin pa gzhi nas mthong thub bo/ 4 //

141 pha phi nyi ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/pha phi nyi (1881—1956)ni dbyi tha li'i deng rabs grags can snyan ngag pa dang 'bol rtsom pa zhig red/ kho pa dbyi tha li ma rtsa ring lugs btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi phyogs su bgrod pa'i yam yom che ba'i dus rabs nang 'tsho ba bskyal ba dang / tshod dpag byed dka' ba'i chab srid kyi gnas bab dang / rgyun chad med pa'i btsan rgyal rang lugs kyi dmag 'khrug de bzhin mtshan nyid rig pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang thon pa bcas kyi 'gyur ldog mang zhing yam yom che ba'i lo rgyus kyi khor yug gis kho'i gzugs thog la mngon gsal dod po'i rtags tham brgyab yod/kho'i tshe gang ring gi bsam blo'i 'phel rim de ha lam du mtshams gsum la 'byedar chog snga dus kho pa ni dngos spyod ring lugs pa'i bsam pa rnam dag gi rjes 'brangs pa zhig yin pa dang / a ri'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba kran mu'u si dang tu'u we la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bla med gong bkur zhu gi yod/ khos gzugs 'das rig par ngo rgol gyi dar cha bsgrengs te dbyi tha lir ( mthar phyin pa'i nyams myong ring lugs mi zhes pa 'ud sgrog shugs chen byed pa dang / gzhi grub (༅4)kyi dngos po kun nyams myong yin la 'jig rten hril po nyams myong gi grub cha yin pa nan bshad byed pa ma zad ‘nyams myong ni gzhi grub dang mtshungs shing gzhi grub ni phyi rol 'jig rten dang mtshungs ’ pa'i nyams myong ring lugs kyi phung gcig can gyi spyi 'gros bton pa red/ lta ba 'dis mngon gsal dod pos 'byor 'bring gral rim gyi bsam blo dang chab srid kyi khe phan mtshon pa dang / kho tsho'i rang dbang 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa byung yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang 4/2

po'i rjes su pha phi nyir dmag 'khrug gi god chag tshabs che brgyud myong ba'i yo rob nub ma'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa tsho'i yongs khyab kyi dngos yod la yid chad dang mgo rmongs pa'i bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun gyi shugs rkyen zab mo phog pas/ khos kha tshur bskor te chos lugs thad rang gi bsam ma'i skyabs gnas 'tshol phyir gnam bdag chos la dad zhu dang / blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis 〈dam pa'i gsung rab 〉la zhib 'jug byas pa ma zad/ lo gnyis kyi dus yun spyad de 〈ye shu'i rnam thar 〉zhes pa'i deb gcig rtsom 'bri byas nas 'dzem cha med par chos lugs kyi bya btang dben 'grims bsam blo dril bsgrags byas/lo rabs sum cu pa'i dus 'gor slebs skabs dus bab kyi gnas stangs la 'gyur ba byung nas dbyi tha li'i hpha shi si ring lugs de srid byin tshong rgyug pa'i dngos zog lta bur gyur stabs/ khos slar yang chos lugs kyi bsdams bkyigs las phyir phyungs te hpha shi si'i phyogs su kha sgo bsgyur cing / dus skabs de shed du khos rtsom yig 'bor che spel nas mi rigs hra wun ring lugs dang mi rigs rgya bskyed ring lugs dril bsgrags dang / mngon sum 'dzems med ngang dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis 'jar man hphan shi si'i rkang rjes ded nas dmag dpung rgya bskyed dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig gis sa'i go la hril po btsan bdag bya rgyu'i ham sems mngon 'gyur yong ba bya dgos rgyu'i 'bod skul byas pa red/ kho'i dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi dril bsgrags 'dir 'byor ldan gral rim che khag dang hpha shi si ring lugs pas gcigs 'dzin byas pa dang / /939lor kho pa dbyi tha li tshan rig khang gi yon hrir bsko gzhag byas/ lo der kho pas 〈nga'i dbyi tha li 〉zhes pa'i srid don dpyad gtam ring po zhig spel te smyo ba lta bus mo su'o li nyi'i srid dbang gi byas rjes dang bzang cha brjod pa dang / der bstod glu 'bul ba bcas byas te 413

ngan pa'i bag chags ci che bzos pa red/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes su khos mngon chung byas te phyi phyogs dang 'brel ba bcad pa'i thog nas rig gzhung zhib 'jug dang rig rtsal gsar rtsom la gzhol ba las chab srid kyi gtam brjod 'grems spel byas pa shin tu nyung /pha phi nyis dus rabs phyed tsam ring gsar rtsom gyi bya bar zhugs pas dbyi tha li'i rig gzhung las rigs thog gzhi rgya shin tu che ba'i bag chags ldan yod/ 1903lor khos gsar du bton pa'i 〈li'e a'o na tu'o 〉〉zhes pa'i dus deb de rjes su dbyi tha la'i mdzes pa kho na'i ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi 'thab sa gtso bo zhig tu gyur pa dang / kho tsho'i dmigs yul ni sgyu rtsal bla na med pa dril bsgrags dang / sgyu rtsal kho na'i ched du sgyu rtsal shugs cher gnyer ba dang dus mtshungs sems thag chod pos sgyu rtsal gyi shul dngos dang sgyu rtsal gyi srol rgyun yod tshad rtsis med btang ste sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal dang sgyu rtsal gyi bya thabs gsar bcos mthar phyin pa byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ 1912lor khos rang rnam gyi ngo bo gsal po ldan zhing kyag kyog ngang kho pa rang nyid kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gi dka' sdug bzod bsran gyi 'bad 'thab gnas tshul mtshon pa'i 〈re ba med pa'i mi zhig 〉〉ces pa'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos 'grems spel byas pa des/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'go'i 'byor ldan gral rim shes yon can gyi bsam pa'i gdung ba dang mdun lam zad pa'i gnas tshul mtshon pa ma zad kho tshos sgyus rtsal mdzes pa don gnyer byed pa'i gsar bcos kyi blo stobs dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs kyang mtshon par byas yod/ /9/3lor khos ma li ne ti'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba dang len gyis 〈la'e tsha'e pa 〉zhes pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dus deb gsar du bton pa'i las kur zhugs pa'i rjes 414

su kho pa ni thog mtha' bar gsum du grub mtha' de'i rkang 'dzin pa zhig yin la/ kho'i grags can snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈snyan tshig shog brgya ma 〉(19/5)dang / 'bol rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〈gas srubs 〉(1916)zhes pa de gnyis kyis gcig bsdus thog kho'i sgyu rtsal gyi lta ba mtshon pa dper na/ sgyu rtsal srol rgyun yod tshad khas mi len pa dang / rjod byed thad srol gsar lugs gzhan shugs cher btod pa/ de bzhin deng rabs kyi tshan rig dang ‘‘'phrul chas kyi shes rig mi’la bsngags brjod dang / 46myur tshad kyi mdzes par mi bstod glu 'bul ba la sogs pa'i ‘/grong khyer gyi 'gul shugs rig pa'i mi brjod bya gtso bo sogs 'di dang de lta bus 'byung 'gyur ring lugs rtsom rig gi gzhi rtsa'i khyad chos mngon gsal dod pos mtshon gyi yod do/142 ci ti ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/ci ti ni dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zlos gar gyi gal che'i tshab mtshon mi sna'i gras shig dang ma li ne ti'i hur brtson che ba'i rjes 'brangs pa zhig red/ 9/4lo nas bzung hpho lu'o lun sa sogs gnas su 'bad brtson chen pos 'byung 'gyur ring lugs 'ud sgrog dang / ra‘'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi mtshan tshogs mi byed sgo sgrig 'dzugs kyis 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi zlos gar 'khrab ston byas/ 1916lor 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig spel te 'byung 'gyur ring lugs smra ba'i rig gzhung lta ba dril bsgrags byas pa dang / 1916lor nas 1918lo'i bar 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dbyi tha li 〉zhes pa'i dus deb gsar gnyer gyi las gar zhugs shing rtsom yig 'bor che bris nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zlos gar gyi rig gzhung dril bsgrags byas/ 1916lor 〈'byung 'gyur 415

ring lugs kyi glog brnyan 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig spel te 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de glog brnyan gyi khyab khongs su rgya bskyed btang / kho'i 'byung 'gyur lugs zlos gar gyi brtsams chos gtso bor 〈ar las 〉dang 〈ser po dang nag po 〉zhes pa sogs yod/ma li ne tis lhag bsam dag pa'i rjes 'brangs pa 'dir mthong ha cang chen pos 44rnam dag gi sgyu rtsal pa ’ zhes pa'i ming gis 'bod cing kho'i 〈ser po dang nag po 〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos de 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ches phul du byung ba'i 'khrab gzhung du rtsi bar byed/ 〈ser po dang nag po 〉zhes par da dung ‘ nang sems kyi 'jigs snang ’ zhes pa'i kha byang phal pa zhig kyang mchis shing / zlos gar hril po ni mi sna gtso bo yu'e se hphu yi 'jigs snang gi bsam pa'i skor nas 'phros pa zhig ste/ o si khru'i dmag dpung gi 'dzing rags nang yu'e se hphu'i ngo gdong nag po gyur nas sna nga tshor dam du 'khril cing shin tu thag nyer gnas pa'i dngos po de tsho mi’la zhed snang tshad med byed pa dang / 66de ni 'chi ba las kyang 'jigs ’’pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ khos skabs skabs bsam gzhig gtong ba lta bu byed pa dang / skabs re sems 'tshab cing yid mi bde ba lta bu byed pa/ yang skabs re rna ba ma g.yeng bar nye 'khor gyi gnas tshul nyan 'jog byed pa dang / skabs 'gar mig cher gdangs nas mun nag gi khrod du g.yo che'i so khung de 'tshol gyin yod/ mun nag dang 'chi ba'i nyen khar dmigs nas khos dngangs skrag dang 'jigs snang chen pos rgyun gtan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'tshab 'tshub kyi rnam pa zhig ston gyi yod/ mtha' ma khos rang gcun gyi nus pa bral ba lta bur ring mda' yar bkyag ste rang gi dmag mir brgyab nas bsad rjes 4‘nga tsho'i mgo thog tu gdon 'dre'i gshog pa 'dug mgyogs por bros shig tshos gzhi ser nag gnyis kyi 416

dar cha ni mi gsod lag dmar ba o si khru'i rgyal po'i mig gnyis red/ da lta nga tshor ce rer lta bzhin 'dug ’ ces smyo ba lta bus skad cor brgyab pa ma zad/ o si khru'i tshos gzhi ser nag gnyis po'i dar cha dbral te g.yul sa nas wa bros brgyab/ zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zlos gar gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gzhir bzung srol rgyun gyi bya thabs dor cing thad rtogs dang 'phrul snang / bsam bkod dang 'du shes 'og ma bcas res mos kyi sgo nas thon pa'i bya thabs spyad de 'dzam gling dmag chen dang por zhugs pa'i o si khru'i dmag mi'i 'chi ba mngon du phyogs skabs kyi 'jigs snang dang zang zing gi sems khams mtshon par byas yod/ 'jigs snang gi sems khams 'di ni gdon 'dre gdug pa can lta bur mi rnams la dam du 'khril cing mi tshos dpog dkal ba zhig yin pa ma zad mi rnams de'i dbang du song zhing des kha lo bsgyur pa dang / des bskul nas dmag mi bsad cing rgyal dar dbral ba'i bya las la 'jug par byas/brtsams chos khrod du spyad pa'i bya thabs 'di rigs kyis rtogs la ma rtogs dang yod la med pa'i khor yug cig btod par byas pa 'di ni mi'i nang sems kyi gsang ba mtshon pa bya rgyur blo rgya che ba'i myong len zhig yin/ gab dpe'i bya thabs 'di rigs spyad nas dmag 'khrug la ngo rgol byed pa'i dmigs yul sgrub par byed pa 'di ni ha lam mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal thabs rtsal slar yang 'phel rgyas su btang ba zhig red/143 hpha ran si'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur smra ba zhes pa de grub mtha' ji 'dra zhig red dam/ 1909lor/ dbyi tha li'i snyan ngag pa ma li ne nyis hpha ran si'i 〈gle ca 417

lu'o tshags par 〉〉thog 〈('byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉'grems spel byas rjes grub mtha' de mgyogs myur hpha ran sir khyab pa dang / rgyal khongs pho lan yin pa'i hpha ran si'i snyan ngag pa a po li na'e er gyis ma li ne te'i rtsom rig gi lta ba dang len byas te hpha ran si'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyis grub mtha' gsar du btod/ 1913lor a po li na'e er gyis 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi srol rgyun la sun 'byin pa'i skor gleng ba 〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'grems spel byas pa des 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi grub mtha' gsar du btod pa mtshon yod/ grub mtha' 'di'i khyad chos mngon gsal dod shos ni 4‘'bur gzugs smra ba ’’zhes pa'i mdzes rtsal gyi ched las tha snyad de rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi khrod du 'dren spyod byas pa de red/ der brten grub mtha'i ming du'ang 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zhes thogs/ de bas mtho ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa bskrun phyir dang / 66'jig rten gyi dngos yod ri’la bskyod pa'i yul 6‘rten bzhi'i ’’bar snang 'tshol zhib bya phyir/ kho tshos snyan ngag dang / 'jim rko/ri mo bcas kyi sgyu rtsal rnam pa zung du sbrel nas ‘‘ri mo'i snyan ngag ’’tu 'bod pa'i 'bur gzugs snyan ngag gi rnam pa gsar skrun byas shing / kho tshos brda rtags tshegs shad mi spyod pa dang / snyan ngag gi tshig phreng rnams sgyu rtsal gyi rgyan ris sna tshogs su sbyor bzo byas te snyan ngag gi sgra tshigs mdzes pa dang /sdeb sbyor mdzes pa/ sgra nus mdzes pa bcas mngon 'gyur yong ba byed pa dang dus mtshungs snyan tshig gi 'bur gzugs mdzes pa mngon pa byed kyi yod/dper na a po li na'e er gyi 〈zhi bde'i phug ron bsad pa 〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig la cha mtshon na/ snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor rnams phug ron gyi gzugs dbyibs su sbyor 'god kyis de ni mgo yod la nam 'phang gcod 'dod kyi gshog pa ldan pa dang / da dung mjug ma chen po zhig brkyangs nas yod pa 418

bcas zhi bde'i phug ron gsod skabs gshog pa rdeb bzhin 'chi kha'i 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i ya nga ba'i gnas stangs thad kur mngon par byas pa de'i thog nas mi tshos btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug la bcangs pa'i 'khon sems je zab tu gtong ba dang dus mtshungs/ me skyogs kyi mdel gzan du gyur pa'i gzhon nu nyes med can tshor snyan ngag pa gang de'i mya ngan gyi bsam pa mtshon par byas yod/ a po li na'e er gyis gsar gtod byas pa'i 'bur gzugs snyan ngag gi rnam pa gzhan zhig ni 66skas dbyibs can ’’zhes pa de yin te/ snyan ngag tshig phreng rnams sgra tshigs chung ba 'ga' zhig tu phye zhing de nas phreng bgos bang bsgrigs kyi skas dbyibs kyi rnam par sbyor sgrig byas te bsam pa'i brtse dung gi 'gyur 'jags dang snyan tshig gi nang gnas sgra tshigs kyi mchong skyod gnyis tshad mtho'i mthun sbyor yong ba byas yod/skas dbyibs rnam pa'i snyan ngag gi tshig phreng 'di rigs gcig nas klog bde ba dang / gnyis su 'gag gnad rang bzhin gyi tshig sbyor gsal dod byung bas mthong snang bde la sgra dbyangs gsal ba bcas kyi thog nas snyan tshig gi mtshon shugs rgya cher btang yod/'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur smra ba'i khyad chos gnyis pa ni shugs drag chen pos srol rgyun la sun 'byin byed pa de red/ kho tshos gsar gtod dang bsgyur bcos la bla med brtsi bkur byed cing rnying zhen bag 'khums la 'khon 'dzin/ lugs rnying srol ngan la khrel dgod/ gna' gzhung gi nyams 'gyur la sun 'byin bcas byed pa dang / srol rgyun gyi rnam pa dor cing zhi dul gyi nyams 'gyur spang ste shugs tshad dang / rtsub spyod/ smyo ba lta bu'i brtse dung bcas nan bshad byed pa ma zad/ snyan tshig gi rnam pa dpe gsar dang /sus kyang mi shes pa'i tha snyad de 'dra gsar bzo/ rjod tshig rno ngar che la ya mtshan can gyi dpe bkod pa sogs byed la snyan ngag tshig phreng 'ga' zhig ni 419

bsam blo ji ltar btang rung go ba gtan nas len thabs med pa bcas red/'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur smra ba'i khyad chos gsum pa ste/ 'byor ldan gram rim la rno ngar che ba'i zur za dang shugs drag ldan pa'i sun 'byin/ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dbang bsgyur la 'gog rgol byed pa bcas ni kho tsho'i gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i nang don du grub yod/ kho tsho'i sor rtse las byung ba'i brtsams 'bras nang 'byor ldan gral rim ni sgyu rtsal gyi dgra bo dang / mi za mkhan gyi 'dre srin/ mi'i rigs kyi gnod 'tshe bcas yin pa dper na/ar hphu le te ya li'i dgod bro'i zlos gar 〈rgyal po yus pu'u〉〉zhes pa'i nang snyan ngag pas khrel dgod zur za'i nus pa rtsal du bton te zlos gar gyi mi sna gtso bo'i gzugs thog tu za rngam dang / ser sna/ bla 'dar/ g.yo sgyu/ 'ud shob/ gdug rtsub/ sger sems sogs 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srol ngan yod tshad bsdu 'god byas yod la/ rjod tshig ches rno ngar dang gzer po'i sgo nas 'byor ldan pa'i skyug bro la khungs med kyi spyod tshul gsal dod byas yod/a po li na'e er gyi 〈dmar gsod btang ba'i snyan ngas pa 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig thung ngu der/ yid gdung gi rtsom nyams thog nas snyan ngag pa zhig mi ngan gyis rdo rdung dmar gsod btang ba'i ya nga'i gnas tshul 'bri 'god byas pa brgyud ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs nang sgyu rtsal dang shes ldan pa ljar gyis gsod pa'i sdig nyes zhu 'bod byas yod pa red/144 a po li na'e er ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red cadasbub/ a po li na'e er (/880—19/8)ni hpha ran si'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi grags can snyan ngag pa zhig yin/ kho pa nal phrug cig yin pa dang 420

a ma ni pho lan gyi sku drag red/ kho hpha ran sir 'tshar longs byung zhing hpha ran si rgyal khab kyi slob gso thob myong / /895lor pha ri sir 'byor ba dang 'tsho gnas kyi ched du dngul khang gi las byed chung chung dang / dpe tshong khang gi lag g.yog gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan sogs las ka sna tshogs byed myong ba ma zad mi drag 'byor ldan pa'i khyim du phru gur bdag skyong yang byed myong yod/ /914lo ste 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po langs pa'i rjes su dmag mir 'dzul ba ma zad hpha ran si'i rgyal khongs su zhugs pa dang / g.yul 'gyed kyi me lce lang long 'phyur ba'i g.yul sa mdun mar dka' tshegs che ba'i lo zla bskyal/ /9/6lor rmas skyon tshabs che phog nas rgyab phyogs sman khang du sman bcos byed par mngags/ /9/8lor hpha ran si'i bu mo 'ig dang gnyen sgrig byas/ lo de rang la nad gzhis rkyen pas dus min du gyur cing skabs der lo sum cu so brgyad las son med/a po li na'e er gsar rtsom nang zhugs pa'i dus tshod ring po min/'on kyang snyan tshig thad thob pa'i grub 'bras cung che la bag chags kyang rgya che tsam yod/ kho'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs su 〈〈srog chags kyi glu chung ba 〉(19/ /)dang / 〈zhim rag phyogs bsgrigs/〉(/9/3) 〈dmar gsod btang ba'i snyan ngag pa/〉(/916) 〈mdzes pa'i yi ge 〉(/9/8)sogs yod pa red/〈zhim rag phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes pa der snyan tshig gi grub cha'i thad gsar bcos dang / srol rgyun snyan tshig gi tshig sbyor spel stangs gtor te snyan tshig gi nang gnas rnam pa dang dbyangs rta don gnyer byas pas/ hpha ran si'i snyan ngag las rigs la rtsom lugs gsar pa'i snyan ngag 'di'i shugs rkyen cung che tsam thebs yod/ 〈mdzes pa'i yi ge 〉zhes pa de ni 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i g.yul sar bris pa'i snyan tshig thung gras mang po zhig yin zhing /421

rtsom lugs dang tshig sbyor spel stangs thad blo rgya chen pos gsar bcos byas yod pa zhig red/ khos 46snyan tshig gi dbyangs rta dang gdangs 'gros de rang da gzod dngos 'brel gyi tshegs shad yin ’’pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te snyan tshig nang brda rtags tshegs shad sogs gtan nas bed spyod byas med/ khos 'tsho ba'i nang gi mgo yod mjug med lta bu'i zang zing gi skad char lad mo dang sgra'i phan nus gtsigs cher bzung ste te ‘4gling mo'i rtsom lugs kyi snyan tshig ’ 'ga' zhig bris pa dang / da dung snyan tshig dang / ri mo/ rol dbyangs/ yig gzugs sogs zung du sbrel nas 64'bur gzugs snyan ngag ’’gsar gtod bya rgyu'i myong len yang byas yod/ snyan ngag gi tshig phreng bang bsgrigs te me tog dang bya byi'u sogs kyi rgyan ris sna tshogs su sbyor sgrig byas pa de ni 'don klog bya rgyu yod pa tsam ma zad/ phar bltas na bya gcig gam me tog gcig gam yang na gzhan gyi dngos po zhig yin pa red/ 〈zhi bde'i phug ron bsad pa 〉zhes pa de ni snyan ngag gi tshig sgrub las grub pa'i phug ron gyi ri mo yin pa dang de ni skad grags ldan pa'i 'bur gzugs snyan ngag cig red/ snyan ngag gi tshig phreng bkod sgrig thad khos skas dbyibs can gyi snyan ngag gi rtsom lus gsar gtod kyis snyan tshig gi mtshon shugs je cher btang yod/ rjes su ma ya kho hphu si cis snyan tshig gi rtsom lus 'di nyid gong 'phel btang nas dmigs bsal gyi sgyu rtsal nyams 'gyur zhig grub par byas yod/a po li na'e er gyi phul du byung ba'i snyan tshig 〈'dra par 〉zhes pa de ni blo khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong la mtshon don phra zhing gsal ba dang / sgyu rtsal gyi yid 'gug nus pas phyug pa zhig yin pa de'i tshig rkang 'ga' zhig bshus na 'di ltar te/ 422

pho mo'i mdzes sdug ni/'bar ba'i me lce red/'dra par khyed ni me lce 'di yi du ba red/khyod kyi sar/'dra par las/ngal dub che ba'i sgra gdangs kyis/mi sems 'gul ba'i glu dbyangs/rang gdangs su gyer/ zhes pa lta bu'o/'dir snyan ngag pas mdzes sdug ldan pa'i bsam bkod la brten nas snyan tshig dang / ri mo/ rol dbyangs bcas zung du sbrel ba ma zad skas dbyibs can gyi snyan ngag gi tshig phreng spyad pas mi rnams la mthong thos gsar pa'i tshor snang zhig sbyin yod pa bcas/ mdor na a po li na'e er ni snyan tshig rig pa'i khyab khongs kyi blo rgya chen po'i gsar bcos pa zhig yin no/1 15 ya ko pu'u ni snyan ngag pa ji 'dra zhig red dam/ma kho si ya ko pu'u (1876—1944)ni hpha ran si'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa dang zlos gar ba zhig red/ kho pa hpha ran si'i pu'u li'e tha nyi'i sa khul gyi yi'u tha'e ba'i khyim tshang zhig tu skyes shing pha ma gnyis po phu'u lu'u hri'i gnas spos yul mi yin pa red/ snga dus/ khos mdzes rtsal gyi las ka bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad de pha ri sir slebs nas pi ca su'o dang sar ming sogs dang lhan cig 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi mdzes rtsal grub mtha' gsar du btod/ /909lor kho par glo bur du deng rabs kyi sgyu rtsal kyi tshod lta khang byed pa'i kho pa'i khang pa de'i 423

nang ye shus rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i 'phrul snang zhig mig lam du byung bar brten nas rang gi mi tshe'i re ba de chos lugs la bcol zhing 1915lor dngos su gnam bdag chos lugs pa zhig tu gyur/ kho'i bsam blor sa khams dang /rigs rgyud/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes bcas phyogs gsum thad kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod pas/ kho'i brtsams chos kyi phyogs lhung yang rang byung ring lugs dang gnam bdag chos lugs kyi bsam pa'i ya mtshan che ba'i 'dres sbyor phung por grub yod//905lor ya ko pu'u yis 〈theng ma tu'o ler 〉zhes pa'i chos lugs kyi lkog gyur zlos gar 'khrab gzhung zhig 'grems spel byas pa nas bzung rtsom rig gi bya bar zhugs/ lo der yang pu'u li'e tha nyi'i yul skad kyi thog nas bris pa'i 〈mtsho kha 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs shig kyang par du bskrun/ 1917lor 'bol rtsom snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈cho lo dkrugs byed ko phor 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas rjes bstud mar 〈me tog mngon pa'i rtsi shing 〉(1918)zhes pa dang / 〈mi sna sna 'dzoms 〉( 920)zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung dang / snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈lte gnas tshod lta khang 〉(1920)zhes pa bcas 'grems spel byas/ phyi ma 'di ni kho pa'i 'bur gzugs smra ba'i phyogs lhung zab shos kyi snyan rtsom zhig red/1921lor ya ko pu'u grong khyer gyi 'tsho bar zhen log gis lu'u war gtsang po'i 'gram gyi hreng —po nu'u wa grong brdal gyi nye 'gram spyil bu zhig nang lo bdun ring dben par gnas ring phyogs gcig nas gsol 'debs dge sgrub dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas gsar rtsom gyi 'tsho bar rol zhing chos lugs thad kyi gsang ba lkog gyur gyi khyad chos zab mo ldan pa'i brtsams chos rab dang rim pa bris pa'i nang / 〈khang pa nag po 〉(1922)dang / 424

〈pu'u zha par zhes pa'i ra ba/〉〉(1922) 〈gle li pi the'am gser gyi chu tshod 〉〉(1922)zhes pa la sogs pa'i brtsams sgrung dang / chos lugs kyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈dmyal ba'i 'phrul snang 〉zhes pa sogs yod cing / dus skabs 'di'i ring da dung dbyi tha li dang si phen la dus thung 'grul skyod thengs gcig kyang byed myong yod/1929lo'i rjes ni kho pa'i dus mjug gi gsar rtsom bya ba'i dus skabs yin pa dang / dus skabs 'di'i ring snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〈mtsho 'gram 〉(1930)zhes pa dang / 〈dmangs gzhas phyogs bsgrigs 〉(1938)zhes pa'i brtsams chos bris yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa langs rjes 'jar man hpha shi sis hpha ran sir btsan bzung byas gshis/ 1944lor 'jar man gyi gsang ba'i nyen rtog pas kho pa 'dzin bzung byas te ring min glo ba'i nad gzhis rkyen pas te lang zhi gcig bsdus btson rar grongs pa red/ snyan ngag pa gang de lnga lam du 'khod rjes ming grags shugs cher 'phel zhing hpha ran si'i dpe skrun las rigs kyis kho pa'i shul bzhag rtsom yig legs sgrig gis snga rjes su 〈〈gzhon nu snyan ngag pa zhig la springs nga/'i lcag 'debs kyi yi ge 〉(1945)zhes pa dang / 〈mtha' ma'i snyan tshig〉(1945) de bzhin 〈cho lo dkrug byed ko phor phyogs bsgrigs gnyis pa/〉(1953) 〈mno bsam phyogs bsgrigs/〉 〈'phrin yig phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes pa la sogs pa'i brtsams chos par du bskrun/ya ko pu'u'i snyan tshig gi nyams 'gyur gyis 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang tha na hpha ran si'i snyan ngag las rigs hril por shugs rkyen chen po sprad yod/ bsam blo'i nang don thad khos dus rabs bar ma'i snyan tshig gi brjod bya bskyar gson yong ba byas te chos lugs kyi gtam rgyud dang lkog 425

gyur ring lugs kyi nang don bskyar du snyan tshig nang drangs pa dang / gzhi rtsa'i brjod bya gtso bo ni rig pa thol skyes dang ye shu'i chos kyi lkog gyur bar gyi 'gal ba thod gtug skor yin pas de ni deng rabs ring lugs snyan tshig gi ldog phyogs su 'gyur ba zhig red/ snyan tshig rtsom pa'i thabs rtsal thad deng rabs snyan tshig gi rlabs rgyun dang mthun par srol rgyun snyan tshig sdeb sbyor gyi tshod bkag las brgal te rang mos ci dgar spyod pa'i snyan ngag gi rtsom lugs gsar pa btod dgos pa dang / ming tshig gsar bzo dang tshig gi shong tshad 'phar snon rgyag dgos pa bcas kyi 'dod tshul shugs cher bzung ste/ thad rtogs dang 'phrul snang de snyan tshig gsar rtsom byed pa'i thabs rtsal gyi gtso gnad du bzhag pas/ srol rgyun gyi blang dor gyi gnas la dpyad pa de smag rum mun 'khrugs lta bu'i 'od snang med par bzos pa bcas/kho'i gsar bcos 'di rigs kyis dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs kyi 6‘snyan tshig gsar brjer ri’shugs rkyen nges can sbyin yod do/146 le we ti ni snyan ngag pa ji 'dra zhig red dam/phi a'e er le we ti (1889—1960)ni hpha ran si'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gal che'i snyan ngag pa zhig red la/ skad grags che ba'i mi chos rig pa dang brtsams sgrung rtsom pa po zhig kyang red/ khos phyi'i zhing chen gyi grong gseb tu rang gi byis pa'i dus skabs bskyal ba dang / rang byung khams chen po'i char drag rlung 'tshub dang / 'brug grags thog brgyab/chu log me ri sogs kyi gnod 'tshes kho'i col chung byis pa'i sems gting du gnas bzod mi bde ba'i dngangs skrag gi bag chags shig bzhag nar son rjes khos rtag tu gnod 'che'i rang bzhin gyi bya dngos 'di rigs brjod 426

byar byas te rang gi zang zing dngangs skrag che ba'i bsam pa'i gnas stangs mngon pa byed kyi yod/ 1910lor kho pha ri sir gnas spos gtan sdod byas pa dang gang mgyogs ngang pi ca su'o dang / hong ko li/ a po li na'e er sogs ri mo ba dang snyan ngag pa'i bar 'brel lam zab mo btsugs pa ma zad 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gsar gtod kyi bya ba'i nang zhugs/1915lor kho'i 'bur gzugs smra ba'i brtsams chos yang dang po ste 〈'bol rtsom snyan ngag 〉ces pa'i phyogs bsgrigs dpe deb 'grems spel byas/1916lor khos gsar du gnyer ba'i 〈byang —lho 〉zhes pa'i dus deb de ni 'bur gzugs smra ba'i snyan tshig gi gal che'i 'thab sa zhig yin la/ gsar bcos kyi snying stobs dar spel dang blo rgya chen pos snyan ngag gi rtsom lugs gsar pa tshod lta byed pa'i skad grags ldan pa'i dus deb cig kyang red/dus deb de'i steng khos rang gi snyan ngag gi gzugs brnyan gyi mtshan nyid skor rgyas bshad byed pa'i rtsom yig kyang spel te snyan tshig gi gzugs brnyan ni 66rang bzhin gshogs pa rdeb kyin 'phur nas yong ba ’ las 6 mis ched du bzo ba mi’de 'dra ma yin dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung ba dang / rjes su dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa tshos lta ba 'di ‘snarang bzhin rtsom 'bri'i bya thabs ri zhes par 'phel rgyas btang ste kho jo'i gal 'gangs che ba'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhir gyur/ 'on kyang le we ti rang nyid ni dngos yod las brgal ba'i ring lugs kyi grub mtha' de'i nang zhugs med/khos gsar rtsom bgyis pa'i gtso bo'i brtsams chos gras su 〈'jong dbyibs can gyi mthong khung 〉(/916)dang / 〈rdzun chas spras pa'i rta pa/〉(1918) 〈so ras kyi gong dkris/〉(/922) 〈shel gyi ko mog〉(1929) 427

〈〈lcags ro 〉(1937)zhes pa sogs yod la/ da dung 〈za rngog gi lag shubs 〉(1927)dang / 〈nga'i gru steng gi dpe deb 〉(1948)ces pa'i 'bol rtsom khag gnyis dang / 〈tha lang gi chom rkun/〉(19/7) 〈mi lpags 〉(1926)zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung khag gnyis bcas bris yod pa ma zad tshe mjug tu kho pas da dung de snga bris pa'i snyan tshig yod do cog 〈dus tshod mang che ba 〉(1945)zhes pa dang / 〈ngal rtsol nus shugs 〉(1949)zhes pa'i bam po chen po gnyis su phyogs bsdus byas yod/le we ti'i snyan tshig gis gdung sems kyis non zhing kher rkyang yul pos mnar ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi thog nas ya nga snying rje bral ba'i dgrar 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs khor yug khrod gnas pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shes yon can 'bring chung tsho'i yul po dang / sgyu 'phrul/ byur chag gi tshor snang bcas sgyu rtsal gyi sgo nas mtshon par byas yod la/ bsam pa'i brtse dung 'di ni gzhi grub ring lugs kyi rtsom pa po ca mi'o yi 〈snang ba mi 'jog mkhan 〉zhes pa'i brtsams deb de'i bsam blo'i khyad chos kyi sngon sgrar gyur yod/ sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal thad dpe mtshon gyi sgo nas 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi sgeg chos mtshon par byas yod de/ khos par gzhi sgrig pa dang 'khrab khrid byed pa lta bu'i bya thabs kyi thog nas rtsom 'bri byas te dmigs bsal ya mtshan che ba'i blo khams 'god rgyur do snang gis bya dngos kyi 'gul tshul mdzes pa dang / 'gyur 'phrul mdzes pa rab rib mdzes pa bcas bris nas mi rnams la rmi lam sgyu ma dang gsang ba lkog gyur gyi mdzes dpyod kyi tshor snang zhig sbyin yod/ kho pa da dung don rkyen gyi phugs rtsa zhib 'god dang rjod byed gdam gses bya rgyur mkhas pa ma zad blo thabs dang ldan pa zhig kyang yin pas rjod byed la mdog dang bro ba gzugs sogs dmigs bsal gyi 428

go don ldan par byed la/ khos brda sprod dang tshegs shad sogs ni rbad de dgos med kyi dngos po zhig tu blta bas/ de thams cad dor te rtsom yig hril por tshegs shad sogs rtsa ba nas bed spyod byas med pa dper na kho'i ming grags che ba'i brtsams chos 〈yod tshad thams cad mun nag klong du 'thims 〉zhes pa'i nang 4‘skar 'od chem chem 'phro mtshams chad/ sa yi go las 'khor mtshams bzhag mgo bo gcig ni 'khyog nas nar/ de yi dbu skra mun pa'i klong du bskyod/ mtha' ma'i cong khang da dung ka rer langs/ nam phyed yol ba dang / cong sgra ting ting grags/mi’ zhes pa lta bu'o/snyan tshig hril pos bskal pa'i dus mtha' dang mi'i rigs 'chi khar phyogs pa'i 'jigs snang gi rnam pa 'bri 'god byas pa ni tshos mdog mun nag dang / snang brnyan yam yom dang chag grum/ zang zing che ba bcas dang /sa'i go la ni ha cang che ba'i mi shi ro'i mgo zhig dang 'dra bar 'khyog nas yod pa de/ ldir sgra grags pa'i cong sgra'i khrod du chos khang la brdabs nas ther tshal sbar tshal du song ba bcas/ 'di lta bu'i zhib 'god legs 'bri byas pa'i snang brnyan la 'bur gzugs kyi tshor snang phun sum tshogs po ldan zhing chos khang dang / skar ma/ sa'i go la/ cong sgra bcas mnyam du lhu lag tshang ba'i 'jim brkos kyi tshogs su grub nas mi'i mya ngan dang snying rje'i brtse sems de rengs po can dang dngos rdzas can du 'gyur bar byas so//47 yu ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni rtsom rig gi grub mtha' ji 'dra zhig red dam/'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni dus rabs 'di'i dus 'gor yo rob tu dar khyab che ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi grub mtha' zhig yin pa de dang thog dbyi 429

tha li nas dar ba ste/ dbyi tha li'i rtsom pa po ma li ne tis 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉(1909)zhes pa 'grems spel byas pa nas 'go tshugs pa zhig yin pa dang / rjes su hpha ran si dang / dbyin ji/ 'jar man/ u ru su sogs rgyal khab la dar zhing de'i khrod du u ru sur shugs rkyen che shos thebs yod/19 /1lo'i snga dus su zhe we li ya nying gis pi te pa'o ru 〈bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi sngon 'gro 〉zhes pa par du bskrun nas u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi yol ba phye ba dang / de'i phyi lo ma ya kho hphu si ci dang / pu'u er li'u kho/ ho li'e po nyi kho hphu sogs kyis thun mong thog 〈spyi tshogs kyi 'dod zhen la 'gram lcag thengs gcig gzhu ba 〉zhes pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs dang 〈〈bsgrags gtam 〉'grems spel byas te 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi tshab mtshon mi snar gyur/u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de gtso bo zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i snga nub tu dar khyab che zhing zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su ma ya kho hphu si ci'i sne khrid 'og 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa 'ga' zhig gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen las bral te rang nyid kyi brtsams chos la bsten nas gsar brjer bstod glu 'bul gyi yod/ lo rabs nyi shu'i dus mjug tu slebs skabs u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni du yal sprin thor lta bur gyur pa red/'byung 'gyur ring lugs gsar du thon pa des skabs de'i rgya che'i 'byor ldan gral rim pa chung 'bring tshos 'pho 'gyur chen po 'gro bzhin pa'i spyi tshogs la rgyus mnga' mi lon par 'ga' zhig gis mun mchongs 'gog rgol byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni yid skyo re chad kyi gnas su lhungs par brten/ 430

don stong ring lugs dang / srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs/ de bzhin blang dor mkho med smra ba'i bsam blo bcas kho tsho'i khrod du khyab gdal du 'gro ba'i cha rkyen gang legs byung ba mtshon yod/ kho tshos mun 'thom gyi sgo nas mi'i rigs kyi de snga'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal tshang ma dus las 'das zin pa dang /rengs por gyur nas skabs de'i tshod dpag byed dka' ba'i dus rabs mtshon thabs med pa'i ngos 'dzin byed cing / ma li ne ti dang 'dra bar u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pas kyang kho pa tsho'i 〈〈bsgrags gtam 〉nang ‘6phu'u zhi cin dang / thu'o si thu'o e hphu si ci/ thu'o er si tha'e sogs deng rabs 'tsho ba'i gru gzings kyi steng nas dor dgos/mi zhes skad cor rgyag pa dang / dus mtshungs ru'u par meng the dang / su'o lu'o ku'u po/ po lu'o kho/po li'u su'o hphu sogs mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa rnams la yang mthong chung tshad med byed kyi yod/u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pas dngos yod ring lugs dang mtshon rtags ring lugs dor ba dang de tshor snang chung dang sun 'byin byed pa dang dus mtshungs rig rtsal gyis deng rabs grong khyer gyi zang zing 'tsho ba 'bri 'god dang / 6 myur tshad mdzes pa mi dang ‘6stobs shugs mdzes pa ’ don gnyer/ rang byung khams chen po'i kha dog dang / sgra skyed/ bro ba bcas la lad mo byas te kho tsho'i rab rib kyi myong tshor mtshon dgos pa nan bshad byed kyi yod/ lhag don rjod byed thad sgyur bcos rab dang rim pa byas pa'i thog nas de bas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa tsho'i ‘‘srol rgyun la ngo rgol ’ gyi bya spyod mtshon gyi yod/ kho tshos rang snang gang shar gyi rjes grub tha snyad de 'dra bkol spyod dang / tha snyad kyi shong tshad cher bskyed/ rjod byed kyi bkag rgya gtor nas snyan tshig nang tshig rtsub dang kha skad nang 'dren byas pa/ tha na snyan tshig 431

gi bang rim sgrig stangs thad la'ang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'bur gzugs kyi skas dbyibs can dang rdo skas can gyi bang sgrig thabs rtsal bkol spyod byas pa bcas red/rang so'i chab srid bsam blo dang spyi tshogs lo rgyus mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi lta ba dang mdzes rig gi lta ba yang yongs su gcig 'dra ma yin/ zhe we li ya nying gi bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gnyis bar khyad par yod pa lta ci tha na grub mtha' gcig pa'i ho li'e po nyi kho hphu dang / pu'u er li'u kho/ de bzhin ma ya kho hphu si ci bcas kyi gsar rtsom phyogs lhung yang rbad de tha dad yin pa red/ ho li'e po nyi kho hphu'i snga dus kyi gsar rtsom tshang mar mngon gsal che ba'i si la hphu ring lugs kyi phyogs lhung ldan pas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi grong khyer gyi spyi tshogs la phyogs yongs nas khas len byed kyi med/ 'on kyang ma ya kho hphu si ci'i snga dus kyi gsar rtsom gyis grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa mtshon pa dang dus mtshungs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi tha shal rul sungs kyi 'tsho bar snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'khon 'dzin byed la/ tshan rig lag rtsal dang shes dpal gyi phyogs su gdeng 'jog dang dma' rim mi dmangs la'ang gdung sems snying rje'i bsam pa ma bcangs pa med/ lhag don rjes su kho pa ni de bas kyang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos yod ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom la kha phyogs nas 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khar bstod glu shugs chen 'bul mkhan zhig tu gyur pa red/u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi grub mtha' zhig gi ngos nas gzhi rkang don stong gi lta ba'i thog nas rig gnas kyi shul 432

dngos khas mi len pa dang / myur tshad dang stobs shugs kyi mdzes pa de 'bri byar bzung nas rang byung khams chen po'i sgra mdog don gnyer dang / yi ge gsar bzo byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa bcas de ltar lags mod/'on kyang de ni skabs de shed du u ru sur dar khyab che ba'i nyams zhan ring lugs dang mdzes pa kho na'i ring lugs kyi rtsom srol la gsar brje thengs gcig byas pa ni bsnyon du med la/ kho tshos rtse gcig ru 44sgyu rtsal gyis 'tsho bar kha phyogs dgos pa ri’don gnyer dang / sgra grags sdeb sbyor dang / sgra 'gros/ de bzhin snyan tshig yig phreng bang sgrig gi thabs rtsal bcas kyi thad 'di dang de lta bu'i rnam pa gsar bcos byas pa bcas la rjes rabs pas dpyad gzhi dang slob sbyong byed du rung ba ni gleng med do//48 8 ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dbar mthun pa'i phyogs ji 'dra yod dam/u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni 1910lo'i rjes su dar 'phel byung bas dbyi tha li las dus tshod cung 'phyi ba yod/ 19/3lor ma li ne te u ru sur bskyod nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dril bsgrags byas rjes 'byor chung gral rim mang du gnas pa'i rgyal khab der mgyogs myur 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi tsha rlabs shig 'phyur ba dang / rgyu mtshan der brten nas u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gnyis dbar mthun pa'i phyogs mang po yod de/ dang thog kho pa tshos hur brtson chen pos ma li ne ti'i 'bod skul dang len byas te srol rgyun rig gnas rnams phyogs yongs nas rtsis med btang zhing / 〈bsgrags gtam 〉nang ‘‘ 433

phu'u zhi cin dang / thu'o si thu'o ye hphu si ci/ thu'o er si tha'e sogs deng rabs 'tsho ba'i gru gzings kyi steng nas 'dor dgos mi zhes skad cor brgyab pa ma zad/ deng rabs 89snyan ngag pa'i rgyal po ’ par meng the dang / su'o lu'o ku'u po/ po lu'o kho sogs phyi dar mtshon rtags smra ba'i snyan ngag pa dang /khu'u phu'u ling / phu'u nying sogs sun 'byin dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom pa po bcas la mthong chung gi rnam 'gyur mtshon par byas/ gnyis nas kho tsho'ang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa dang 'dra bar las 'gul dang / myur stobs/ gsar gtod bcas la spyi bkur byed/ gsum nas srol rgyun gyi gsar rtsom bya thabs dor te sgra'i lad mo dang / rgyan ris brda rtags/ de bzhin tshos mdog skya ris bcas mnyam bsres 'dres sbyor gyis rab rib kyi rang snang myong tshor zhig mtshon dgos rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin/bzhi nas da yod kyi rjod byed bkas bcad tshang ma rtsis med btang ste rtsom pa por rang 'dod ltar tha snyad gsar bzo'i rang dbang sprod dgos pa'i bla byang bton pa sogs red/ ma ya kho hphu si ci'i snga dus kyi brtsams chos kyis 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom rtsa don de rnams mngon gsal dod pos mtshon yod la/ 'di dag gis rgyal khab gnyis po'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dbar la kha bral thabs med pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'brel ba ldan pa gsal bshad byas so/149 u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gnyis dbar mi mthun pa'i phyogs ji 'dra yod dam/ u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur 434
