ring lugs pa gnyis kyi spyi tshogs khor yug dang 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim sogs rbad de gcig mtshungs shig ma yin pa'i dbang gis rgyal khab 'di gnyis po'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa'i dbar khyad par chen po yod de/ gcig nas u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs 'go tshugs pa'i skabs/ dper na par meng the sogs la yid mi rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa lta bu srol rgyun rig gnas yod tshad dor dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin mod/ 'on te kho tshos brjod pa ni/ ‘‘yid ches kyi bsam pa bcangs sla ba'i mi su zhig gis par meng the'i dri zhim byug chu gtor ba'i g.yem sbyor la ches gting zab kyi brtse sems gtad srid dam/ yang brtse sems kyi yid smon 'di 'dra'i nang nas skabs de'i dpa' bo'i spobs nyams mtshon thub bam ri zhes pa la sogs pa'i nan gyis bton pa'i dri ba yin pa de ni/ nyams zhan ring lugs dang mdzes pa kho na'i ring lugs kyi rnam pa ches zab pa'i u ru su'i rig rtsal las rigs la sun 'byin pa yin stabs/ u ru su'i rig gzhung las rigs la zungs khrag gsar pa sbyin zhing kho tshos yar rgyas brtson len byed pa'i bsam pa'i 'phel phyogs mtshon yod/ gnyis nas las 'gul dang / myur stobs/gsar gtod bcas la spyi bkur byed pa'i gnad don thad u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa gnyis dbar rbad de 'dra mtshungs shig ma yin/ ma ya kho hphu si ci yang deng rabs 'tsho ba'i myur tshad dang stobs shugs 'bri 'god bya rgyur blo rtse gcig sgrim du gnas pa yin mod/ 'on kyang khos ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon gyis mi dmangs mang tshogs la sdug bsngal dang gnod 'tshe skyel ba de mthong thub kyi yod/ gsum nas rjod byed kyi rnam pa'i thad/ dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pas snyan tshig 46'ching med rang dbang ldan pa'i 435

tshig sbyor ’ kyis rmang gzhi byas te rang snang gang shar gyi sgo nas las 'gul gyi rigs mi 'dra ba'i rnam pa dang mnyam sgrig mtshon dgos rgyu dar 'phel gtong gi yod/ 'on kyang u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyis rjod byed de gzhi rtsa'i rtsa 'dzin zhig tu brtsis nas bton yod de/ kho tshos 〈bsgrags gtam 〉〉nang 641 rang 'dod ltar gyi rjes grub tha snyad spyad de (tha snyad gsar bcos )tha snyad kyi shong tshad rgya cher gtong dgos/ 2 kho tsho'i sngo na nas gnas pa'i rtsom rig la 'gog thabs med pa'i 'khon 'dzin bcangs dgos 〉’pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan yod/ bzhi nas chab srid kyi phyogs lhung thad he bag chen po rgyug pa 'di ni rgyal khab gnyis po'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dbar mi mthun pa'i gnad che shos de yin la/ sgyu rtsal lta bu'i thad kyi tha dad las kyang shin tu gting zab pa zhig red/ dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'byung ring lugs ni ma li ne tis gtso bo byed pa'i g.yas gzhogs pas legs pa'i gnas bab bzung yod stabs/ kho tshos drag shugs yod tshad la bstod glu len pa dang / mi nyung shas shig ni mtha' ma hpha shi si'i lag cha dang ngan rogs par gyur yod/ 'on kyang u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni ma ya kho hphu si cis gtso 'dzin byed cing g.yon gzhogs pas dbang sgyur gyi gnas bab bzung ba zhig yin pa dang /ma ya kho hphu si cis 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po dang zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i nyams myong dang bslab bya brgyud lhamatha' ma ma li ne ti'i snyan tshig gis btsan rgyal ring lugs la g.yu/la 'gyed kyi dmag brda btang / rjes su u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni blo gcig sems gcig gis zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brjer rgyab skyor byed mkhan rig rtsal tshogs pa ang dang por gyur pa dang / 1923lor kho tshos da dung g.yon gzhogs sgyu rtsal 'thab phyogs zhes pa btsugs/ ma ya kho hphu si ci yang zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su 66 436

gsar brje'i snyan ngag pa ’nyazhig tu gyur to/150 yu ru su'i bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur smra ba zhes pa de gang yin nam/u ru su'i bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni snyan ngag pa zhe we li ya nying gis gtso bo byed pa zhig yin zhing / 191 1lor khos pi te pa'o ru bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi sngon 'gro zhes pa'i bsgrags gtam spel te bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dar cha dngos su bsgrengs/bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyis gzhi rkang skabs de'i dngos don la yid ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur bcangs mod/ 'on kyang kho tshos rang don ring lugs de bsam blo'i rmang gzhir 'dzin pa dang / mi sger la bla med gong bkur byed pa'i lta ba dril bsgrags byed pa de'i thog nas gsar brje'i mtho rlabs 'gyur ba'i snga nub kyi 'byor ldan gral rim pa'i nyams zhan yid chad kyi bsam pa mtshon pa dang / ma ya kho hphu si cis ming grags che ba'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan tshig 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉zhes pa'i nang zhe we li ya nying ni mi bya sreg pa ltar ci'u ci'u zhes bya skad rgyag thub tsam mi’red ces skyon brjod drag po byas yod/ bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba dang len byed mkhan de tsam mang po ma byung ba dang / 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i rjes su ni de bas grub mtha' de go med tshor med du gyur/gsham du zhe we li ya nying gi snyan tshig dum bu zhig drangs na 'di ltar te /'dzam gling thog gi blos gtong yod tshadar‘bdag nyid’’kyi ched du red/gson por gnas pa'i dngos po/gson por sdod cig 437

glu len gyin yod/'jig rten hril por khyod dang nga las med/nga gnyis po nam zhar yang gcig rang yin pa ste/nga dang re 'dod red/ (〈bdag gnyid po lung nye chi'i gar dbyangs〉)yang /nga —nga /bdag nyid kyi gsar rtsom/de ni gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mdzes lha'i gsar rtsom gyi 'bras bu zhig red/ ces pa ltar ro/ (〈bdag nyid kyi re 'dod/〉)1 51 u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zhes pa de gang yin nam/u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs ni gtso bo u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs zhe/ sa pa de red/ 19/1lor zhe we li ya nying gis bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dar cha bsgrengs pa dang / 1912lor pu'u er li'u kho dang / kha men si ci / ho li'e po nyi kho hphu / ma ya kho hphu si ci sogs kyis mo si khor 〈〈spyi tshogs kyi 'dod zhen la 'gram lcag thengs gcig gzhu ba〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs par du bskrun pa'i nang ma ya kho hphu si ci dang / ho li'e po nyi kho hphu / pu'u er li'u kho gcen gcung gnyis bcas kyis 〈bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa'i rtsom rig gi lta ba bton yod la/ u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs 'go tshugs pa dngos su khyab bsgrags byas yod/ u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi srol gtod pa ni ho li'e po nyi kho hphu yin mod/ de'i gtso bo'i tshab mtshon mi 438

sna dang gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras che shos thob mi ni snga dus kyi ma ya kho hphu si ci red/ kho tshor hpha ran si'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa a po li na'e er gyi shugs rkyen zab mo phog yod pa dang / ma ya kho hpho si ci yang 64rdo skas can’mi nam skas dbyibs can gyi snyan phreng bang sgrig bya thabs la lhag par dga' zhing yul gyi thad mi tshor 'bur gzugs kyi tshor snang zhig sbyin gyi yod pa bcas kyis der 4‘'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs mi zhes thogs pa red/ma li ne ti dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs la chab srid thad dge mtshan ldan pa'i phyogs shig yod/ma ya kho hphu si cis de snga skad shugs chen pos‘6 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de nga tshor bltos nas bshad na srol rgyun gyi ming zhig yin pa dang / nga tsho'i bsdus ming du 4 khang hphu ’ (gung khran ring lugs ste 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa )zer gyi yod/ bsam blo'i thad nga tsho dang dbyi tha li'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa'i dbar mthun phyogs til 'bru tsam yang med/ mthun pa'i phyogs ni rgyu cha'i rnam pa'i thog gi las snon tsam red/’’ ces khyab bsgrags byed myong yod/'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ‘ dpal yon ’ gyis mi dmangs la bskrun pa'i gnod 'tsher dza drag gi rgol gtam bsgrags te skabs de'i u ru su'i 'byor chung gral rim gyi drag skyod pa tshos dngos yod la yid mi rangs shing gsar brje don gnyer byed pa'i bsam blo'i 'phel phyogs mtshon gyi yod/'on kyang nga tshos nges par du khas len dgos pa zhig ni/ skabs de'i ma ya kho hphu si ci tshud pa'i mi de tsho da dung 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje pa zhig ma yin par rtsom rig thog gyi gsar brje'i sna byis blo'i skyon ’gyi mtshon tshul tsam yin pa de red/ kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mi nyung ba zhig ni gsar brje 439

rgyun chad med par gting zab dang 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang bstun nas da gzod ma le ring lugs dang len byed 'go btsugs pa dang / rim bzhin 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i rtsom pa por gyur pa zhig red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal rnam pa'ang don stong ring lugs dang rnam pa ring lugs kyi phyogs su lhungs yod pa ni ldog tu med pa zhig ste/ dper na phu'u zhi cin dang / thu'o si thu'o ye hphu si ci/ thu'o er si tha'e sogs kyi 'bod skul dor dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'don mkhan ni kho tsho yin la/ kho tshos tha na snyan ngag pa'i brda chad rjod tshig rnams khrom lam grong tshig gi tshad du mar phab dgos pa'i 'dod tshul yang 'dzin gyi yod/ 152 ma ya kho hphu si ci ni snyan ngag pa ji 'dra zhig red dam/hphu la ci mir rnyu la ci mi lu'o we chi ma ya kho hphu si ci (1893/de/930)ni u ru su'i 'bur gzugs 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi tshab mtshon pa dang de snga'i su'u len gyi snga dus ches phul du byung zhing shes bya yon tan gyis phyug pa'i gsar brje'i snyan ngag pa zhig red/ kho pa ko lu'u ci ya'i nags don dpon po zhig gi khyim du skyes shing lo dgur son skabs khu'u tha dbyi zhi zhes pa'i rig gnas tshan khag gi slob 'bring du slob 'bring dang de rjes mo si khor slob sgyur byas/ 1905lor lo na bcu gnyis las ma son pa'i ma ya kho hphu si cis slob mtshams 'jog pa'i rngam ston khrom skor nang zhugs shing rjes su gsar brje'i dpe deb 'bor chen blta klog byas pa ma zad spyi tshogs ring lugs pa dang 'brel 'dris kyang byas/ 1908lo'i lo stod du gung khran tang gi 440

rtsa 'dzugs su zhugs pa nas bzung khos gsar brje'i dril bsgrags las don bsgrubs ring 'dzin bzung btson 'jug thengs mang phog myong ba dang /btson khang nang khos rtsom rig gi brtsams chos phon chen blta klog byas yod/'on kyang blo rig gi na tshod ma zin pa'i ma ya kho hphu si cir skabs der u ru sur gsar brje dang sgyu rtsal gnyis mnyam gnas mi rung bar 'dod pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi phyogs ris lta ba zhig dar srol che ba de'i shugs rkyen zab mo phog pa yin stabs/ khos tang gi rtsa 'dzugs nas phyir 'then te ri mo slob sbyong byed par song ba dang / u ru sur 'byung 'gyur ring lugs khyab pa'i rjes la 'ur de'i lta ba dang len byas shing der mgo 'khor ba dang de'i dar cha'i 'og rig gzhung las rigs su zhugs/ khos mngon gsal du 'grems spel byas pa'i 〈〈mtshan mo 〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig ang dang po de'i gzugs brnyan gsal la ma gas/la dang / tha snyad kyi don rtogs dka' ba zhig yin pa de ni/ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi‘ tshig mdzod kyi khrod nas tha snyad bcings bgrol gtong dgos ’ par 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal rtsa don gyi don 'grel ri mo zhig red/ /9/3lor khos bskyar du 〈zlos gar dang glog brnyan 'byung 'gyur ring lugs 〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'grems spel byas te mu mthud srol rgyun gyi rig gnas yod tshad dor dgos pa'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsam blo gtso bo dril bsgrags byas shing / 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom rtsa don de zlos gar dang glog brnyan nang spyod dgos snyam pa yin rung / kho pa rang nyid kyis de ltar bsgrubs med/ kho'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi 'grub 'bras gtso bo snyan tshig gi phyogs nas mngon pa ma zad nga tshos cis kyang do snang byed dgos pa zhig ni/ kho pa ni thog mtha' bar gsum du u ru su'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi legs pa'i phyogs kyi tshab byed mi sna 441

zhig yin pa dang / kho'i snyan tshig la bltas na ma gzhi rnam pa dang skad cha'i thad blo rgya chen pos gsar bcos byas pa zhig red/ khos rtag tu dpe gsar ya mtshan can gyi rjod byed dang gson nyams sgro 'dogs ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi grong khyer dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi skyug bro ba'i ngang tshul 'bri 'god kyis sun 'byin gyi ngar shugs dang mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'byung 'gyur la yid smon byed pa'i bsam pa mtshon gyi yod/ kho'i snyan tshig ni gzhi rkang rnam pa ring lugs su gyur cing gsal min rtogs dka' ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang de tsho'i nang gsar brje'i spro sems tshud yod la yig 'bru re re dang yig phreng so so'i khrod nas kho'i zhen log gi bsam pa dang sun 'byin gyi rnam 'gyur mtshon gyi yod pas khos nga'i snyan ngag ni 66'thab rtsod kyi snyan tshig ri’cig yin zhes bshad pa'i skad cha de ni ma 'tshams pa med pa zhig red/1915lor ma ya kho hphu si cis 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉〉zhes pa'i skad grags che ba'i snyan tshig ring po zhig 'grems spel byas pa der 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom rtsa don gang legs mtshon yod cing / brtsams chos de ni 1914lo'i lo stod nas 1915lo'i lo stod bar rtsom 'bri byas pa zhig red/zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su ma ya kho hphu si ci'i bsam blor 'gyur ldog chen po byung zhing bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gyi byang cha je cher song nas mtha' ma phul byung gi 'byor med gral rim gyi snyan ngag pa zhig tu gyur te gsar brjer bstod pa'i rtsom yig mang po bris yod/ 'on kyang kho'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom bya thabs dang bsam blo de da dung yun ha cang ring po zhig gi nang du sngar bzhin gnas yod pa red/ 442

/923lo'i bar ma ya kho hphu si ci ni sngar bzhin 'byung 'gyur ring lugs pa zhig red/ 'on kyang khos 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ched du dag 'bud byed pa dang chabs cig phyogs gzhan zhig nas kho pa dang ma li ne ti'i bar rtsa ba'i khyad par yod pa yang gsed 'grol gsal bshad byed kyi yod/ lo bcu'i ring gi kho'i bgrod lam thog nas kho pa 'gyur ldog 'gro bzhin pa dang /kho pa'i snyan tshig kyang rgyun chad med par sra brtan dang gsal cha dod pa'i phyogs su 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa'ang dngos 'brel gsal bshad byas yod la/rjes su kho'i snyan tshig rnams 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi khyad chos mngon gsal dod po med pa'i brtsams chos su gyur yod/ 1925lor khos tha na mngon sum 'dzems med ngang ‘ 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang su'u len srid gzhung gnyis lag gdang sbrel nas mdun du bskyod mi thub/ da lta ngas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs dang 'thab rtsod bya rgyu yin/ri zhes khyab bsgrags byas yod pa ltar/ rjes su khos gsar brje'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi thabs rtsal la rten nas phal byung gi brtsams chos du ma gsar rtsom byas yod byerdordo/ rag 153 ma ya kho hphu si ci'i 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉zhes pa de ni snyan tshig ji 'dra zhig red dam/〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉〉zhes pa'i snyan tshig hril po sngon 'gro'i rol dbyangs dang le tshan bzhi bcas khyon khag lnga las grub yod cing / snyan tshig gi kha byang phal par rol mo'i le tshan bzhi las grub pa'i rol dbyangs’’ zhes zer ba dang / snyan ngag pa gang de'i skad cha gzhir bzhag nas bshad na rol mo'i le tshan bzhi ste 64re 'bod bzhi ri’zhes pa rnams red/ 443

le tshan dang por mi sna gtso bo ‘ nga ri yis brtse grogs ma li ya sgug sdod byed pa dang ma li yas ‘ nga’mi dor ba'i gnas tshul bkod yod/ ‘4nga chu tshod bzhi par slebs yong ’’zhes ma li yas de snga nga rang la bshad myong / ‘‘nga ’’yis sems 'tshab dang blo mi bde ba'i ngang nas kho mor sgug nas bsdad mthar mtha' ma kho mo sgug thub tsam byung / 'on kyang kho mos ‘‘khyod kyis shes sam/ nga gnas la 'gro grabs yod 1 ces lab/ skabs der 46nga ’ yi bsam par kho mo ha lam 64mi gzhan gyis brkus tshar 'dug mi snyam nas snang ba ban bun lta bur gyur pa dang / sems nang khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar/ snyan ngag pa'i dga' grogs kyi brtse dung shor ba de ni yongs su ma li yas gser dngul don gnyer byed pa'i rkyen gyis red/ snyan ngag pas 'byor ldan gral rim gyi brtse dung 'di rigs la 'khon 'dzin byed kyi yod/ khos yid skyo spro langs kyi bsam pa de gzhan la bcangs pa'i brtse dung du 'gyur ba byas nas brtse dung 'di sems pa'i nang dang 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod nas phyir dbyung ngo /le tshan gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i nang don de le tshan dang po dang dam du 'brel yod/ le tshan 'di gnyis kyi nang snyan ngag pas rang gi yid skyo spro langs kyi bsam pa nas rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi sdug bsngal 'brel dran byas pa dang / yang gzhan la gdung sems mnyam skye byed pa nas gsar brjer lcag skul byed pa'i phyogs su 'phel rgyas phyin te kho'i ches mtho'i gsar brje'i spro sems dang dngos yod la shin tu yid ma rangs pa'i rnam pa mtshon par byas yod/ le tshan 'di gnyis te snyan ngag pa'i ‘‘khyod tsho'i sgyu rtsal gtor dgos/〉nya44khyod cho'i lam lugs gtor dgos/nya 44khyod tsho'i chos lugs gtor dgos ri’zhes pa'i nang gi ‘6khyod tsho'i sgyu rtsal gtor dgos 〉’zer ba de ni rig gnas sgyu 444

rtsal rnying pa yod tshad gtor dgos don yin pas/ 'di las don stong ring lugs kyi rnam pa dang srid gzhung med pa'i ring lugs kyi bsam blo 'byung srid pa ni smos med red/ gzhan yang zhe we li ya nying gi sgyu rtsal gtor dgos zhes pa ste kho'i sger gyis lte ba byed pa'i bdag nyid 'byung 'gyur ring lugs la sun 'byin byed pa'ang 'di'i nang tshud yod pa 'di ni dge mtshan che ba'i don snying ldan pa zhig red/ 4‘khyod tsho'i lam lugs gtor dgos ri’zer ba ni gsar brjer brten nas spyi tshogs lam lugs rnying pa yod tshad gtor dgos zhes pa'i don yin zhing khos tha na rang nyid kyi yod tshad blos gtong bya rgyur ji mi snyam par dmigs yul 'di sgrub thabs byed pa 'di ni snyan ngag 'di'i gsar brje'i rang bzhin ldan pa de red la/ 'dis rjes su khos gsar brje'i bsam blo dang len gyis 'byor med gral rim gyi snyan ngag pa zhig tu 'gyur ba ni ldog tu med pa zhig yin pa'ang gsal bshad byas so/ le tshan bzhi par brtse dung gi thog tu slar phyir log brgyab ste ma li ya'i snang brnyan bskyar du thon yod/ le tshan 'dir kho pas chos lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i bsam pa mtshon par byas yod de lte ba'i nang don ni snyan ngag pa gang des brjod pa'i 66khyod tsho'i chos lugs gtor dgos ’ zhes pa de red/ snyan ngag pas chos lugs kyis ma li yar dug skyon btang ba dang / 'dod spongs ring lugs dang chos lugs kyi sgrig srol gyis mdza' gcugs kyi me tog bskyar du bzhad pa'i brtse grogs gnyis kha bral du btang ba/ khrag dang mig chu'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'am yang na 6‘nga ’’rang nyid kyi bkra ma shis pa'i brtse dung gi bar chad gang gi phyogs nas bltas kyang chos lugs dang ye shu'i dkon mchog ni mi'i bsam blo 'ching mkhan nyes can pa zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed par brten/ khos ye shu'i dkon mchog ni ra‘rtsal yon gnyis med kyi 'dra 445

sku chung chung zhig yin pas kho par 4‘'di nas a la si ca bar grags pa'i 'gram lcag tsha nan zhig gzhu dgos mi’zhes kha rdung drag po gtong ba 'di'i thog nas kho pa'i zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs mtshon thub ces mi shod ka med red la/ khos nub phyogs kyi mis dus yun ring por bla na bkur ba'i dkon mchog dang dbang sgyur par 'dzin pa'i mthong chung gi bsam pa mtshon par byas yod/snyan tshig ring po 'di'i dang po'i kha byang du 〈dad ldan ang bcu gsum pa 〉zhes zer zhing / 〈〈gsung rab 〉tu 'khod par gzhigs na ye shur rang gi dad ldan mi bcu gnyis yod pas snyan ngag pas kho pa rang nyid dad ldan ang bcu gsum pa de yin zer gyi yod/ rjes su gsar 'gyur zhib bsher dpon pos snyan tshig gi ming de rang lha la phog thug btang ba zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas stabs/ snyan tshig gi kha byang mi bsgyur ka med byung zhing ming 'gyur byed skabs khos zhib bsher dpon la gal te khyod tshos mos mthun yod na/ ngas ches zhi dul gyi mi zhig byas pas chog mi de ni skyes pa ma yin par dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa zhig red ces bshad pas/ snyan tshig gi ming du'ang de ltar thogs/ de rang yang chos lugs pa dang skabs de'i srid 'dzin par 'phya smod dang 'gog rgol byed pa zhig red/154 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa〉 zhes pa de 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dpe mtshon snyan tshig cig red zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa〉 zhes pa de 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi dpe mtshon snyan tshig cig red zer ba'i sgyu mtshan ni sgyu rtsal thad der gsham 446

gsal gyi khyad chos gsum ldan pa ste/ gcig snyan tshig gi khrod du don stong ring lugs kyi lta ba mi nyung ba zhig yod pa ni snyan ngag pas rang gi snyan tshig nang bshad pa ltar te/ngas mi rnams la bskrun pa'i yod tshad/yig 'bru gnyis kyis brjod na 'di ltar te don stong zhes pa de'o/gnyis/ grong tshig phon che spyad de snyan tshig gi ra‘snyan tshig ma yin pa can ’’lag bstar byas pa dper na snyan tshig 'go tshugs ma thag 'di ltar bris 'dug ste/‘‘nga chu tshod bzhi par slebs yong ’ zhes ma li yas bshad/chu tshod brgyad pa/chu tshod dgu pa/ chu tshod bcu pa/lta zhing sa rub /smin ma rab tu bsdus pa'i/zla bcu gnyis pa'i sa srod/sge'u khung gi mdun nas bral te/mtshan mo'i 'jigs snang gi mi bde ba'i khrod du zhugs// zhes pa dang /snyan tshig nang da dung 'di 'dra'i tshig sgrub bris yod de/nam dgung spu gri khyer te rtse gcig mdun du bshar/rjes bsnyegs song /bsad song /—ltos dang kho bsad song /chu tshod bcu gcig tu 'gyel song / 447

de ni srog chad phog pa'i nyes can pa'i mgo bo ske gcod stegs bu'i thog nas lhung ba dang 'dra/zhes pa la sogs pa'i snyan tshig gi rjod byed 'di rigs tshang ma khyad par du 'phags pa'i snyan ngag gi skad yig ma yin par spyir btang gi grong tshig phal pa sha stag yin pa red/gsum/ snyan tshig khrod kyi ljongs bkod mi nyung ba zhig ni 'phrul bsam la brten nas mtshon par byas pa yin te/ le tshan dang po'i nang gi ljongs bkod gnyis tshang ma 'phrul snang sha stag yin pas de ni 6 nga nya yis brtse grogs sgug sdod byed skabs kyi sems 'tshab dang ra‘nga mi dga' grogs kyi brtse dung shor ba'i rjes kyi sems sdug 'bri 'god bya rgyur phan thogs chen po yod pa zhig red/ le tshan gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis kyang mang che ba 'phrul snang dang nye ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi thog nas snyan ngag pa gang de'i gsar brje'i lcag skul dang snga ltas mtshon par byas yod/ le tshan bzhi pa yongs su snyan ngag pa'i 'phrul shes yin te/ snyan ngag pa gang de'i dga' rogs shor zhing kho'i dga' rogs kyi brtse dung dkon mchog gis ljar gyis bsad stabs khos dkon mchog la kha mchu rgyag par song ba ste/wa ye/khyod/med/zhwa mo phud cigang yong gi yod/ zhes pa ltar/mi yul gyi snyan ngag pa zhig phar 'phyo tshur lding gi ngang nas 'phrul snang gi khrod du lha yul la gshegs/ 'di ltar snyan tshig nang mi yul dang lha yul 448

gnyis gcig gzugs su grub cing 'phrul snang dang dngos bden gnyis dbye ba 'byed du med par bden bden rdzun rdzun lta bu'i khyad 'phags kyi thabs rtsal khrod nas mi tshor snyan ngag pa gang de'i gting sbas blo pham gyi go don 'tshol du bcug yod//55 ma ya kho hphu si ci'i snyan tshig gsar rtsom gyi bya gzhag la lta stangs ji lta 'dzin dgos sam/ma ya kho hphu si ci'i gsar rtsom gyi bya bar sngar nas bzung yang ma dag pa'i dpyad brjod rigs gnyis byung yod pa ste / gcig ni snyan ngag pa gang de'i snga dus kyi gsar rtsom bya ba'i khrod kyi 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi phyogs lhung khas mi len pa de yin pa dang / gzhan zhig ni zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i rjes su byung ba'i kho'i gsar rtsom thad kyi gsar brje'i 'gyur ldog khas mi len pa de gnyis red/ zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje mtshams tshad du bzung nas ma ya kho hphu si ci'i snyan tshig gsar rtsom gyi bya ba de snga phyi dus rim gnyis su 'byed chog pa ste/ dus rim snga mar 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen cung zab pa phog yod pa nas rjes su rim bzhin shugs rkyen je chung du song ba ni kho pa'i thog ma'i brtsams chos 〈mtshan mo 〉zhes pa nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi tshab mtshon brtsams chos 〈dor ma gyon pa'i sprin pa 〉 (1915)zhes pa'i bar dang / yang de nas zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje'i gong gi 〈dmag 'khrug dang 'dzam gling 〉dang 〈sgal rus 'phred gling 〉zhes pa'i bar gyi 'gyur ba'i thog nas gsal por rtogs thub/ dus rim phyi mar spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos yod ring lugs kyi gsar rtsom bya thabs su bsgyur nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos yod ring lugs kyi gzhi gdan brtsams chos dang 449

dpe mtshon gyi brtsams chos 〈le nyin 〉 (1924)dang / 〈legs 〉(/928)zer ba sogs rtsom 'bri byas yod/ 'on kyang snga phyi bar gsum du 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen las thar thub med pa ni snyan ngag pa gang des 〈nga rang nyid 〉ces pa'i brtsams chos nang lha‘'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bya thabs yod tshad spyad de rlabs chen spyi tshogs kyi brjod bya gtso bo khong du chud pa byed dgos mi zhes bshad pa ltar red/ gal te dus rim snga mar snyan ngag par gsar brje'i dmangs gtso ring lugs pa'i blo dogs kyi gnas tshul 'ga' re'i mtshon tshul yod zer na/ dus rim phyi mar ni khos zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje de 4 nga'i gsar brjer ri rtsi ba ma zad bstod glu'i rang bzhin gyi snyan tshig phon che bris shing sa gnas khag tu skor skyod gtam bshad dang lcag skul dril bsgrags byed par bskyod pa de red/snyan ngag pa'i brtsams chos kyi khrod nas mthong thub pa ni/ rtsom yig 'ga' zhig la zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje dang spyi tshogs ring lugs gsar brjer spro sems 'khol ba'i bstod glu'i nang don ldan pa dper na (〈legs 〉dang / 〈 le nyin/〉 〈 g.yon phyogs mdun skyod glu dbyangs 〉sogs )lta bu dang / 'ga' zhig gis mtho dpon ngan ring lugs nas dma' ham 'dod kyi bsam pa'i bar lcag bsnun zur za byas pa dper na (〈tshogs 'du'i lkog gyur 〉dang / 〈dpon rigs la bstod pa/〉〉 〈su'u len gyi lam yig〉 〈'dre shig〉 〈〈'khrud khang /〉 〈nga dga' 〉sogs )lta bu/ 'ga' zhig gis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi mi ser spel ba'i 'phrog bcom gyi bya spyod la 'khon 'dzin drag po bcangs pa (〈nan 'dri 〉dang 〈a ri'i gtam rgyud 〉sogs )lta bu/yang 'ga' zhig gis brnyas bcos phog pa'i rgyal khab dang sa khul gzhan la gdung sems mnyam skye'i bsam pa rab tu mtshon par byed pa dang lhag par 450

krung go'i mi dmangs la de bas do snang chen po byed pa (〈krung gor the jus byed mi chog 〉zer ba sogs kyi mu 'brel snyan tshig )lta bu dang da dung rtsom dpyad snyan tshig (〈ler lun dang sa'e hrang 〉sogs )khag gcig kyang yod pa red/snyan ngag pa gang de'i rlabs che ba'i phyogs ni dngos yod ring lugs dang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs gnyis gcig tu phyogs bsdus dang / rigs mi 'dra ba'i bya thabs gnyis zhu thab gcig tu zhun sreg rtag tu tshig gzhug dbyangs mthun gyi yi ge spyad de rol dbyangs kyi phan nus je cher btang ba/dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge tshang ma 'dra mtshungs skabs gzhi nas tshig mtha'i sgra rgyan sbyor dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bzung ba ma zad tshig mtha'i sgra rgyan gyi sgra tshigs mang nyung nges med du sbyor ba/ snyan tshig 'ga' zhig ni skas dbyibs kyi khang rim gzhir bzung sgrig sbyor byed pa bcas red la/ snyan tshig gi khrod du da dung sgro 'dogs pa dang / dpe 'jog pa / g.yar dpe 'god pa sogs dngos yod ring lugs kyi rgyun spyod bya thabs 'bor che bed spyod byas yod/'on kyang snyan ngag pas kyang skabs shig ring kha skad rnal ma dang ring thung mi snyoms shing mthong dkon pa'i mngon brjod dang / deng rabs can gyi myur tshad dang mtshams tshigs de bzhin mchong skyod chen po dang srog chags can gyi sgra skyed kyi phan nus dang glo bur mtshams 'jog sogs kyi bya thabs don gnyer byed myong la/ lhag don snga ba'i dus su de bas mngon gsal dod po yod pa de rnams ni 'byung 'gyur smra ba'i shugs rkyen phog par the tshom med/snyan ngag pa'i mi tshe hril por phyogs yongs nas bltas na/ gzhi rkang snga dus kyi gsar rtsom nang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi rtags tham phog mod/ 'on kyang khos dngos yod dang / gsar brje/ phugs bsam bcas la bcangs 451

pa'i spro sems dang u tshugs kyis don gnyer byed pa'i snying stobs de ni 4‘dza drag che la 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba'i tshe srog gi me lce mi’lta bu yin pa dang / snyan ngag pas gzhi rkang snga phyi bar gsum du mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen las thar thub pa zhig byung med mod/ 'on kyang khos snyan tshig gsar rtsom byed skabs gang la dge mtshan ldan pa de nyams len byed kyi yod stabs/ kho'i brtsams chos ni gang ltar spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dngos yod ring lugs kyi gzhi gdan brtsams chos dang dpe mtshon kyi brtsams chos su gyur pa la ngo gnong mi dgos/ 19 3lor si ta lin gyis kyang lha ma ya kho hphu si ci ni su'u we ed dus rabs kyi ches phul du byung zhing shes bya yon tan gyis phyug pa zhig red ces ’ gzengs bstod gnang myong yod do/ 156 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉1zhes pa'i nang don ji 'dra red dam/ma li ne te'i rgyab skyor 'og dbyi tha li'i ri mo ba po cha'o nyis 19/0lo'i zla 2tshes 1/nyin 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas te 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam dang phan tshun ram 'degs byas shing 〈bsgrags gtam 〉gyi nang don hril po gsham gsal te/nga tshos khyab bsgrags bya rgyur/gcig lad mo'i rnam pa yod tshad la mthong chung dang / gsar gtod kyi rnam pa yod tshad la bstod glu len rgyu/gnyis/ gal 'gangs che sa ni 4‘mthun sbyor nya dang ‘8yid 'ong nyams 452

dga'i bro ba mi sogs ched spyod tha snyad kyi sger gcod dbang sgyur la 'gog rgol bya dgos/ 'di tsho tshang ma tshad las 'das pa'i rkyang skum gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i ming tshig yin pas/ de tsho med pa bzo rgyur brten nas lun po lang dang /ko ya ho/ lu'o tan bcas kyi brtsams chos thal ba'i rdul du rlog rgyu ni las sla 'grub bde zhig red/gsum/ sgyu rtsal gyi skyon yon brjod pa po ni bed med dam yang na gnod 'tshe ldan pa zhig red/bzhi/ nga tsho'i khrom gzhung 'khrug po dang / spobs pa/ smyo ngar/ myur skyod kyi glog 'khor can gyi deng rabs 'tsho ba bcas mtshon pa bya ched/ dang thog de snga spyod myong ba'i brjod don gtso bo yod tshad gtsang 'phyag bya dgos/lnga/ 6 smyon pa nya zhes pa'i ming de gsar gtod pa yod tshad kyi mgo gnon du spyod kyi yod/ 'on kyang da lta de ni gzi brjid kyi mtshan snyan zhig tu rtsi 'os/drug snyan tshig khrod kyi rang mos sdeb sbyor dang rol dbyangs khrod kyi gdangs dbyangs rtseg ma ltar / ri mo 'bri skabs nang gnas kyi kha gsab ni yongs su dgos nges shig red/ bdun/ ri mo 'bri ba'i nang 'jig rten gyi stobs shugs de stobs shugs kyi myong tshor zhig gi ngos nas mtshon pa bya dgos/brgyad/ rang byung mtshon pa byed skabs gal 'gangs che shos ni g.yo lhad med pa dang rnam par dag pa zhig yin dgos/ dgu las 'gul dang 'od zer gyis sha gzugs kyi dngos po'i rang bzhin gtor dgos/nga tshos ngo rgol bya rgyur/ 453

gcig deng rabs kyi ri mor dus tshod kyi ljang g.ya'i snum snyigs kyi kha dog yong thabs byed pa/gnyis/ spyir btang gi tshos gzhi'i steng srab la dma' ba'i gna' dpe'i nyams 'gyur bzo ba ma zad/ e cib kyi mi'i drang thig gi thabs rtsal la lad mo byas te ri mo nyid gcig nas byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra la gnyis nas khyad mtshar zhing gnyod chung nus med kyi mnyam bsres dngos po zhig tu mar phab/gsum/ bcos ma'i sgo nas 'brel gcod ring lugs pa dang rang tshugs smra ba'i lta bar gtogs pa'i 'byung 'gyur sgrog bshad byed pa /'brel gcod ring lugs pa dang rang tshugs smra ba 'di dag gis btsugs pa'i grub mtha' gsar pa dang kho tsho'i de snga'i grub mtha' gnyis bsdur na rnying rul phal pa dang sngar lam dam srung byed mkhan gcig mtshungs red/bzhi/ ri mo'i khrod kyi gcer bu ni rtsom rig khrod kyi 'gab mthun dang 'dra bar mi rnams skyug mer langs pa dang zhen log skye dgos pa zhig red/don tshan mtha' ma 'dir nga tshos 'grel bshad cig rgyag snyam pa ni/ nga tshos bltas na kun spyod las 'das pa'i don gnas gang yang mi 'dug nga tshos ngo rgol byed sa ni gcer bu'i sna gcig ma'i tshor snang de red/ gzhan gyis nga tshor brjod bya gtso bo la gnad 'gag med/ gnad don ji 'dra zhig — yin rung de ji ltar 'bri 'god bya rgyur rag las yod ces zer ba der nga tshos mos mthun byed kyi yod la nga tshos khas kyang len gyi yod/ 'on kyang lo lnga bcu'i sngon du skyon 'dogs dang the tshom gyi gzhi til 'bru tsam yang ma mchis pa'i gsal rtogs kyi gnas lugs de rigs de ring nga tshos gcer bu'i gnad don skor shod pa'i skabs su da dung yang de snga ltar gnas yod pa de 'dra gtan nas ma yin/ gang yin zhe na sgyu rtsal pas ranganyid kyi 'dod sred 454

gzhir bzung gdon 'dre zhugs pa ltar kho tsho'i zur mo'i gzugs po dmar rjen du bton pa dang / de snga'i spro gleng khang de tsho zhen log skye dgos pa'i sha gzugs dgram yul du gyur pa'i rkyen gyis red/nga tshos lo bcu'i dus yun nang ri mor gcer bu'i snang brnyan 'bri mtshams yongs su 'jog dgos pa'i bla bya 'don rgyu yin/ming sngon 'god pa/ ༅ po cha'o nyi/ ri mo ba/ (mi lan/)157 'byung 'gyur ring lugs la ro myong sgyu rtsal thad kyi mngon tshul ji 'dra yod dam/'byung 'gyur ring lugs de nyid rtsom rig nas 'go tshugs pa zhig yin mod 'on kyang ro myong sgyu rtsal thad grub 'bras chen po thob yod de/ dpyad gtam pa 'ga' zhig gis tha na 44de'i ro myong sgyu rtsal gyi thad la gal 'gangs che shos dang bag chags che shos kyi phan 'bras thob yod mi’pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ma li ne ti'i rgyab skyor 'og dbyi tha li'i ri mo ba po cha'o nyi dang / kho la/lu'o su'o lu'o/ pa kho sogs kyis kyang 1910lo'i zla 2tshes 11nyin 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉spel te kho tsho'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi lta ba gsal zhing phra ba khyab bsgrags byas/po cha'o nyi sogs kyi bsgrags gtam la ri mo'i las rigs khrod du tshur snang lan cha shugs che byung zhing rgyab skyor byed mkhan yang 'ga' zhig byung ba red/ kho tsho'i bsgrags gtam 'di dang ma li ni tis 1909lor 'grems spel byas pa'i 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam 〉gnyis phan tshun ram 'degs kyi sgo nas 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi las 'gul gting zab tu 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon yod/ bsgrags gtam de 455

gnyis kyi lta ba yang phan tshun nye po yod pa dang / 〈ri mo ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉gyi gtso bo'i snying don yang srol rgyun gyi sgyu rtsal yod tshad rtsis med btang ste ri mos 'gul med kyi rnam pa mtshon rgyu ma yin par 44'gul skyod kyi tshor snang minya'abri 'god bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ po cha'o nyi sogs kyis 1910lo'i zla ba 3tshes 3nyin tu'u ling gi khra le la zlos gar khang gi ltad mo ba'i mdun du bsgrags gtam de nyid khyab bsgrags byas shing / lo de'i zla 4tshes 11nyin slar yang 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo'i thabs rtsal skor gyi bsgrags gtam 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas te gom gang mdun spos kyis kho tsho'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skor gyi lta ba 'phel rgyas btang / 1912lo'i dpyid kur po cha'o nyis slar yang 'jim rko'i thad 'byung 'gyur ring lugs khyab spel gtong rgyu'i gsal bsgrags spel ba dang / lo der 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo ba tshos pha ri sir thengs dang po'i 'grems ston tshogs 'du tshogs/ rjes su lon ton dang per lin du'ang 'grems ston byas/ po cha'o nyis da dung ma li ne ti dang ming mnyam bkod kyi thog nas 〈mir btang ba'i yi ge 〉〉zhes pa 'grem spel byas pa dang /we nyi si'i hreng ma kho thang chen gyi cong khang thog steng nas gong gsal yi ge grangs nyis 'bum bkrams nas gna' bo'i we nyi sir kha rdung btang ba ma zad 6 we nyi si'i ’ mi rnams de snga'i zil rngam brjid chags kyi khrod nas nyams rgud song 'dug de ni khrel med sdar ma tshos dug skyon btang ba zhig dang phran tshegs kyi g.yo sgyu'i gnyer skyong rgya ru tshud nas ya nga ba'i gnas bab tu bskyal pa zhig red/ nga tshos kho tshor skye stobs kyi gson nyams ldan pa dang /bskyar du gnas 'phags mchog gyur du son pa zhig bya rgyu yin/mi ya mtshan can gyi glog 'od kyis mi rnams mig 'khrug klad 'chol lta bur 'gyur ba ma 456

zad yod tshad dbang du bsgyur te/ mtha' mjug dong tse'i dri ngan gyis sgrig 'god byas pa'i khang pa'i nang du 'phro ba'i zla 'od bcoms te we nyi sir bcings 'grol thob pa'i smon 'dun zhu ’’zhes skad cor brgyab/'byung 'gyur smra ba'i ri mos gtso bo 'gul stangs mtshon par byed pa dang lhag don myur tshad mgyogs po'i rlangs 'khor dang / me 'khor/ 'gran rtsod khrod kyi rkang 'khor / zhabs bro ba dang de bzhin 'gul skyod kyi khrod du gnas pa'i srog chags sogs kyi nang don mtshon rgyur de bas dga' po yod pa red/ kho tshos sgyu rtsal gyi khrod du nus shugs yod rgus dus gcig tu gnas pa'i dngos po 'bri 'god byas te dmigs bsal gyi khor yug nang dus gcig tu thon pa'i dngos po mtshon gang thub byed kyi yod/ /91 1lor po cha'o nyis 'grems spel byas pa'i ri mo 〈khrom gzhung gi skad sgra khang pa'i nang du khyab pa 〉zhes pa de ni de'i khrod kyi tshab mtshon ri mo zhig red/ ri mo de'i go don gtso bo mthong thos kyi tshor ba gnyis dus gcig tu 'bri 'god bya dgos rgyu bstan pa de red/ po cha'o nyis da dung 'byung 'gyur ring lugs de 'jim rko'i sgyu rtsal kyi thad la spyad de 1912lor 'jim rko'i 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi bsgrags gtam spel ba ma zad/ 〈shel dam de bar snang gi 'phel rgyas 〉(1912)zhes pa dang 〈yul gyi rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi dmigs bsal rnam pa 〉(1913)zhes pa sogs tshab mtshon rang bzhin gyi brtsams 'bras gsar 'bri byas yod pa red/ de min ar las kyi thad la'ang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs yod de/ 19/4lor an tung nyi a'o theng a'e li yas 〈'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ar las skor gyi gtam 〉zhes pa rtsom 'bri byas te ar las ni 'gyur med rtag brtan rang bzhin can zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa dang rjes su ar las dbu chenab a'o thu'o yis mo nyi 457

hi'i 1972lo'i dbyar dus o lin phi khe'i lus rtsal 'gran tshogs kyi ched du jus 'god byas pa'i gur gyi grub cha de ni 'byung 'gyur smra ba'i bri bya zhig yin pa red/rang rgyal la'ang 'byung 'gyur ring lugs kyi ri mo'i rtsa don gyi shugs rkyen phog myong yod/mngon mtshon ring lugs/158 mngon mtshon ring lugs zhes pa de gang yin pa dang / de ji ltar thon cing 'phel rgyas su song ba red dam/mngon mtshon ring lugs zhes pa de ni rig rtsal gyi grub mtha' zhig yin zhing dus rabs 'di'i dus stod nas lo rabs sum cu'i bar yo rob dang a me ri kha gling gi rgyal khab 'ga' zhig la dar 'phel chen po byung yod/ dang thog de ni ri mo'i thad kyi grub mtha' zhig nas rjes su rtsom rig dang / chos gar/ rol mo sogs kyi khyab khongs su rgya skyed byas/mngon mtshon ring lugs zhes pa'i ming de thog mar /90/lor byung zhing /lo der pha ri sir gnyer ba'i ma ti si'i ri mo'i 'grems ston thog hpha ran si'i ri mo ba ru'u li an a'o ku'u si the a'e er we yis snum tshon ri mo khag gcig 'grems ston byas pa de tsho'i ming du mngon mtshon ring lugs zhes btags yod/ 1911lor 'jar man gyi ri mo ba wo ling kor gyis 〈rlung dmar 〉zhes pa'i dus deb thog dpyad rtsom zhig 'grems spel byas pa'i nang 〈mngon mtshon ring lugs 〉zhes pa'i tha snyad bed spyod byas yod/ mngon mtshon ring lugs las 'gul gyi sngon byon pa ni 'jar man te le si tun gyi ri 458

mo'i tshogs pa 44zam khang 〉 (oṃrnye1)(1905—1913)zhes pa de mo nyi he'i rta pa sngon po'i khang pa ( slo7 )1911—1914)zhes pa de gnyis red/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi ri mo ba tsho chab srid dang mtshan nyid rig pa sogs kyi thad lta ba rbad de gcig mtshungs ma yin/ 'on kyang kho tsho tshang mas sgyu rtsal thad blo khog chen pos gsar bcos bya dgos rgyu'i re ba byed kyi yod la/dngos bri'i bya thabs la brten nas phyi rol gyi 'jig rten 'bri 'god bya rgyur sun 'byin gyis rang snang yul can gyi dngos yod mtshon dgos pa nan bshad byed kyi yod/ kho tshos sgyu rtsal gyi ri mo ni sgyu rtsal pa'i nang gnas dgos mkho'i phyi gnas kyi mtshon tshul zhig yin pas gtso bo sgyu rtsal pa'i phyi rol dngos po las byung ba'i nang sems kyi spro snang mtshon dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byed cing / ri mo'i mtshon bya bkod sgrig byed pa'i thad rtag tu sgro 'dogs dang gzugs 'gyur gyi bya thabs spyod mod 'on kyang tshos gzhi mthug la bkrag mdangs che ba dang / thig ris sbom la thogs rdug dang bral ba lta bus ri mo ba'i stobs shugs dang spro sems mtshon gyi yod/ 'jar man gyi rtsom rig las rigs khrod du mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun la tshur snang lan cha shugs che byung zhing / 'dzam gling dman chen dang po'i snga rjes su gzhi rgya che ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom rig kyi rtsom rig las 'gul zhig 'phyur te snyan tshig dang / brtsams sgrung / zlos gar sogs kyi khyab khongs nang grags can rtsom pa po khag gcig thon pa ma zad lhag don zlos gar thad grub 'bras shin tu chen po thob yod/mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi snyan tshig gis gtso bo ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi sdig nyes ther 'don dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi mi gshis dril bsgrags/ rtsom pa po'i nang sems kyi drag tu 'phyur ba'i spro sems mtshon pa 459

bcas byed kyi yod/ de'i tshab mtshon rtsom pa po'i gras su o si khru'i snyan ngag pa the la khor(1887—1914)dang / ce khe'i snyan ngag pa we hpher/(1890—/945) 'jar man gyi snyan ngag pa ha'e mu'u/(1887—1912)de bzhin pe en sogs yod pa red /brtsams sgrung thad/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi grags can tshab mtshon rtsom pa po ni o si khru'i kha hphu kha (1883/de1924)yin zhing kho'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos gras su 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉dang / 〈sa phug〉〈'dri gcod/〉 〈mkhar rdzong 〉sogs yod la brtsams chos 'di dag gis ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi mi'i gzhan 'gyur dang mi chung tsho'i dngangs skrag dang dga' sdug gi bsam pa mtshon par byas yod/ kho pa btsan sgrig byas pa'i byung ba dang zhib phra'i don dngos gnyis zung 'brel bya rgyur mkhas pas brtsams chos la mtha' dpyod kyi rang bzhin cung che tsam ldan yod/ ce khe'i rtsom pa po cha phe khos (1890/de1933)bris pa'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi brtsams sgrung la tshan rig gi 'char sgo'i khyad chos ldan zhing zlos gar thad la'ang kho par grub 'bras che tsam thob yod pa bcas red/mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar thad kyi sngon byon pa ni su'e ten gyi si the ling pa'o (1849/de1912)yin la kho'i 〈ta ma hri kor bskyod pa 〉zhes pa'i rol dbyangs gsum po de ches thog ma'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar la rtsis chog kho'i brtsams chos kyis chig lab kyi rnam pa spyad de 'char sgo dang / dngos yod/ yul dang dus mnyam bsres kyis zlos gar gyi de snga'i lam srol rnying pa gtor yod/ kho'i skad grags che ba'i 'khrab gzhung 〈rnam shes dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉zhes par mi dang 'dre gnyis gar stegs gcig gi thog mnyam gnas byas pas nang don khungs lung gtan nas med/ 460

'on kyang des nus ldan gyi sgo nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi zang zing ya ma gzugs kyi gnas tshul ther 'don byas yod/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i snga rjes su 'jar man la ming grags gang tsam ldan pa'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar ba 'ga' zhig byung yod de/ dper na thu'o ler (1893—1939)dang kha'e tse (1878—1945) lta bu'o/ thu'o ler gyi gal che'i brtsams chos gras su 〈'pho 'gyur ——mi zhig gis dmar 'dzing 〉(19/9)zhes pa dang / 〈mang tshogs dang mi/〉( 921) 〈'phrul 'khor gtor mkhan 〉(1922)zhes pa sogs yod/ kha'e tse'i gal che'i brtsams chos su 〈byu ru〉(1917)dang 〈zhogs pa nas nam gung bar/〉(/9/6) 〈sol rlangs bzo grwa 〉〉(1918 1920)zer ba sogs yod pa red/lo rabs nyi shu'i stod char mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun a rir khyab nas a ri'i zlos gar gra rgyas su btang yod/ a ri'i ming grags che shos kyi mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar ba ni a'o nyir (1888/de/953)yin la kho'i tshab mtshon bcoms chos su 〈gnam mtha'i phyi rol/〉(1920) 〈rgyal po chung si/〉(1920)〈spu ring spra/〉(1922) 〈mya ngan zhu ba 〉sogs yod pa red/lo rabs nyi shu'i smad char mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom rig nyams rgud du 'gro 'go tshugs mod/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling gi gzhi khyon nang sngar bzhin bag chags nges can sdod mus so/159 mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom rig la khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/gcig gtso bo rang ngos kyi tshor ba dang nang sems kyi spro snang mtshon 46 1

par byed pa/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos srol rgyun gyi dngos yod ring lugs la mtha' dpyod kyis phyi don 'jig rten ni ma gzhi nas gnas mus yin stabs der bskyar zlos byed pa ni don snying gang yang med par sems shing / phyi rol gyi snang tshul brgyud nang gnas kyi ngo bo ther 'don dang / mi'i phyi lpags bshus nas sbug gting sbas pa'i rnam shes la rtog 'jug bya dgos rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ kho tsho mi sna'i blang dor ma yin pa'i rtog pa 'og ma'i 'gul skyod mtshon pa bya rgyur dga' zhing rtag tu gsal min dpyod dka' ba'i nang don 'bri bar byed pas sgyu ma dang lkog gyur ring lugs kyi khyad chos ldan yod/ kho tsho'i sor mo'i 'du byed las thon pa'i mi sna'i nang sems 'gul skyod ni rnyog 'dzing che la tshul las ldog pa dang /rtag tu yul po dang / dngangs skrag re zad/ gang la bstun dgos mi shes shing ci bya gtol med kyi tshor snang zhig yong gi yod pa red/ zlos gar thad/nang gnas bsam pa dang spro snang gi gar stegs can zhig yong ba bya dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yod/ 'khrab chas dang / 'khrab ljongs/ sgra nus/'dra 'bag sogs la brten nas mi sna'i nang sems 'jig rten mtshon par byed pa dang / glog 'od dang / sgyu ma'i yul ljongs/ rmi lam 'phrul snang sogs la brten nas rnam par gzhogs spros mdzes rgyan sbyar te ltad mo ba'i tshor byed dbang pos thad kur rtogs su 'jug gi yod/gnyis/ brtsams chos khrod kyi spyi mtshan du gyur pa'i rang byung khams dang mi che'i skor gyi gnas lugs la rtog dpyod byed pa / mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos dngos yod 'cho ba'i khrod kyi rang mtshan dang / gson nyams ldan pa'i mi dang don gnad la snang 'jog mi byed par spyi mtshan du gyur pa'i rang byung khams dang mi tshe'i skor gyi gnas lugs de 'drar rtog 462

dpyod bya rgyur dga' po yod pa dper na/ sger dang mang tshogs kyi 'gal ba/mi'i gzhan 'gyur gyi gnad don sogs lta bu'o/ kho tshos spyi tshogs hril po'i gnad don la bsam gzhigs bya rgyur mthong che byed pa las mi sna'i rang gshis bskrun rgyur snang 'jog byed kyi med stabs/ mi sna'i rang gshis ni spyi tshogs tsam dang / gsal la ma gsal/ bya spyod kyang gtan tshigs rang bzhin gyis dbul ba zhig yin la mi sna 'ga' zhig ni tha na rus ming tsam yang med pa dper na/ 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyi dkrog sgrog rol dbyangs 〉zhes pa'i nang gi mi snar ‘‘hrang zha'o ’ (dmag dpon kyi rim pa zhig )dang lho sku drag ri 66rgan 'khogs ri ‘‘shi ro ’ zhes pa sogs las mi sna bye brag pa'i rus ming med pa red/gsum/ rtag tu mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs spyod pa/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung dang / zlos gar/ snyan tshig sogs kyi khrod du rgya khyab ngang mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs spyod kyi yod/ 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa'i brtsams sgrung nang mi 'bu sbur pa chen po zhig tu gyur pa 'di 'dra ni shin tu khungs lung med pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang der mtshon rtags kyi don snying ldan yod/ ko li yi'o er gyi gzugs 'gyur ba des ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs nang mi mi ma yin par 'gyur ba'i yongs khyab kyi snang tshul zhig mtshon par byas yod/ brtsams sgrung ring gas 〈mkhar rdzong 〉zhes pa'i nang gi 〈mkhar rdzong 〉de ni sgyu ma lta bu'i spyi tshogs can gyi mkhar rdzong zhig yin pa dang / de ni ming med la gang du bskrun yod med kyang mi shes pa'i mthong yang nam yang slebs thabs med pa'i gnas shig yin pa de ni sger gcod dpon ngan gyi las khungs sgrig gzhi'i mtshon rtags red/mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar bas rtag tu mtshon rtags rang bzhin gyi 463

gar stegs kyi gzugs brnyan spyod kyi yod/ a'o nyir gyi 〈spu ring spra 〉zhes pa'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo dbyang kho ni gzhi rkang bzo pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang khos mi'i rigs hril po'i tshab byed pa dang mi'i rigs kyi mtshon rtags yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byas yod/ khos dbyang kho ni khyod red la nga yang red/mi thams cad kho red/ nga dbyang kho red zer mkhan su yang mi 'dug don dngos thog 'di ni nga'i thog ma'i bsam gzhi de rang red ces dang / kho par bltos nas bshad na sngon chad dang rang byung gnyis kyi mthun sbyor shor zin la bsam blo'i thog tu'ang bde ba gsar pa zhig ma thob pa'i rkyen gyis da ni yar gnam la ma thug la mar sa la ma reg par bar snang phyed tsam du dpyangs nas yod/ dbyang kho mdun du bskyod mi gtub stabs phyir bshol rgyag rtsis byas/ kho pa dang 〈spu ring spra 〉gnyis lag pa btang ba'i go don yang de red/'on kyang khos ltag log phyir bshol brgyab kyang log sa'i yul zhig med pa ni spu ring spras kho pa lnga lam du brdzangs tshar bas red/ mi dang mi rang nyid kyi las dbang bar dmar 'dzing byed pa de ni sngar yang de 'dra red la ji srid bar du yang zlos gar gyi brjod bya gtso bo de yin/ de snga mi dang lha gnyis 'thab/ 'on kyang da lta ni mi rang gis rang la 'thab/ kho'i sngon chad dang 'thab la/ kho'i mtha' mjug gi 'gro sa dang yang 'thab sa’ces bshad yod pa'i thog nas zlos gar mi sna gtso bo dang bya spyod sogs tshang mar mtshon rtags kyi don snying ldan pa mthong thub/bzhi/ ya mtshan khungs med kyi don rkyen byung rim 'god pa/ dper na 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod )〉zhes pa'i nang mi bde thang zhig glo bur du 'bur gyur pa dang / 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyi dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉zhes pa'i nang mi dang 'dre gnyis mnyam du gleng mo byed pa sogs mngon 464

mtshon ring lugs kyi brtsams chos khrod du 'di dang de 'dra ba'i ya mtshan khungs med kyi brjod byas khengs yod do/160 mngon mtshon ring lugs de spyi tshogs kyi 'byung rkyen ji 'dra'i 'og thon pa yin nam/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus smad du yo rob kyi bzo las mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas kyi 'bras bur 'byor ldan gral rim nyin bzhin je phyug tu song zhing grangs 'bor je mang du 'gro ba'i 'byor med gral rim nyin bzhin je dbul du gyur yod/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor yo rob kyi ma rtsa ring lugs de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rim la bskyod cing / sger sdem gyi ma rtsa mgyogs myur rgya bskyed song ba dang / ma rtsa ring lugs nang khul gyi 'gal zla yang nyin re bzhin rno ngar je cher song / lhag don 'jar man gyi rgyal po we len srid khrir 'dzegs pa nas bzung ham sems kyis kun nas bslangs te dbyin ji dang / hpha ran si/ si phen/ phor tho'u gal sogs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa rnying gras tshos 'dzam gling dum bur bgo bar 'gram chu 'dzar zhing dmag shugs rgya skyed dang dmag 'khrug gra sgrig gis go skabs bsgugs nas tha na mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs pa rnying gras kyi rgyal khab tshud pa'i 'dzam gling hril po khyur mid gtong rtsis byas/ 1914lor mtha' ma 'jar man gyis btsan 'dzul byed pa'i 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po langs nas spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur cing spyi tshogs kyi nyen tshabs je cher song ba'i 'og gnod 'tshe dang sdug bsngal tshad med myong mkhan ni rgya che'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs dang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shes yon can 'bring chung rnams red/ skabs der spyi tshogs kyi grub char dza drag che ba'i 'gyur ldog byung ba 465

dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang 'pho 'gyur zab mo byung ba'i rkyen gyis srol rgyun gyi kun spyod dang chos lugs kyi dad sems thor zhig 'gro rgyur skul 'ded btang ste spyi tshogs hril po tshabs che'i bsam pa'i nyams nyen gyi khrod du lhungs pa red/ mi rnams la myong tshor zab mo byung ba ni deng rabs bzo las spyi tshogs kyis mi rnams mi ma yin par bsgyur pa dang / mis gsar gtod byas pa'i stobs shugs kyis de las ldog ste mi rnams la tshur dbang sgyur dang bran bkol byas stabs/ mi rang nyid kyi rin thang dang ngo bo shor ba'i gnas tshul byung ba dang / yang bsam pa'i nyams nyen gyis ldog tu med pa'i rig rtsal rnam pa'i gsar bcos byung ba de red/ dma' rim spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shes yon can 'bring chung tshor bltos nas bshad na kho tshos dngos su brgyud myong ba'i ya nga dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba'i khor yug gis kho tshor de thad tshor snang de bas skyen po yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ lhag don kho tsho'i khrod kyi skyo snang gi bsam pa de bas che tsam yod pa'i mi khag gcig gis spyi tshogs kyi rul sungs dang zhan 'gyur gyi gnas tshul 'ba' zhig mthong ba las re ba dang 'od zer mthong gi med stabs/mdun lam mun nag dang / som nyi/ sdug bsngal/ yul po bcas kyi gnas su lhungs pa red/ gnas stangs 'di lta bur kho tsho 'dod pa gtan nas tshim thabs med par rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'bod sgra phyir mngon byed snyam yang srol rgyun gyi rtsom rig rnam pas kho tsho'i rnyog 'dzing che ba'i nang sems 'jig rten dang / skabs de'i don dngos la yid ma rangs shing khong khro za ba'i rnam pa gtan nas mtshon thabs med pa dang tha na mi 'ga' zhig gis dmag 'khrug la zhen log dang dngos yod la 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pas nye bar drangs te da dung rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa brgyud mi chos ring lugs dang 466

mi'i rigs kyi brtse sems dril bsgrags byas te chab srid la shugs rkyen sprod snyam gyi yod pa bcas mdor na tshor snang skyen pa'i na gzhon sgyu rtsal pa tshos gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang tshogs pa btsugs shing dus deb par skrun dang /rtsom yig 'grems spel byas pa bcas las rngam zil gzhi khyon che ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rig rtsal las 'gul zhig grub pa yin no/16/ mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi 'byung rtsa gang yin nam/ bag chags gting zab ldan zhing gal 'gangs che ba'i rtsom rig gi grub mtha' ste mngon mtshon ring lugs la lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i rtsom rig gi 'byung rtsa zhig yod cing / de'ang dang thog nus pa 'don mkhan ni mtshon rtags ring lugs khrod kyi lkog gyur ring lugs de nyid red/ mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi sngon byon pa po te la'e er gyis thengs dang por rtsom sta ngas kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po mngon 'gyur byas te nang sems 'jig rten khrod kyi gting sbas kyi dngos po gsal 'don byas/ mtshon rtags ring lugs 'phel rgyas su song nas ma la me'i dus skabs su bskyod rjes lkog gyur ring lugs kyi khyad rtags mngon gsal ldan yod/ khos spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bcos sgyur ni 'gog thabs med pa zhig yin pa mthong ba dang / kho pa rang nyid lta bu'i snyan ngag pa ni grogs med kher rkyang zhig yin snyam ste rang gi sems dang rang gshis 'bri 'god dang gsal bshad bya rgyu tsam la brten nas bsam blo brtan lhing yong thabs byed par brten/ snyan ngag pa'i las 'gan yang phyi rol gyi don dngos mtshon thabs byed pa nas mun nag sdug bzod kyi nang sems 'jig rten shugs bstan dang mtshon thabs bya rgyu'i phyogs su mi sgyur ka med 467

byung ba te/ de yang ‘ skye ba'i gsang ba gsal mtshon gyis nga tsho bden par gnas pa zhig yong ba byas te/ nga tsho'i bsam pa'i byas rjes nyag gcig 'grub thabs bya dgos/ri’ de ni ma la le yis snyan ngag la nyam zhan dang /mun nag lkog gyur bcas kyi brjod bya gtso bo gtan la phab pa red/ snyan tshig gi rig gzhung 'di dag rjes su kho'i slob ma ste phyi dar mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi gal che'i snyan ngag pa wa la'e li'i dus skabs su de bas 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ wa la'e lis sna snyan ngag pa'i las 'gan ni dngos yod kyi don gnad dang 'brel ba med pa'i 'jig rten zhig gam sgrig srol zhig dang /yang na sgrig gzhi zhig gsar gtod bya rgyu de red/’ ces mngon gsal dod pos sgrog spel byed pa 'di dag don dngos thog gzhi rtsa'i char mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rig rtsal lta ba dang nye po yod/'on kyang mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi dngos brgyud sngon byon pa ni su'e ten gyi zlos gar ba dang brtsams sgrung ba si the ling pa'o yin par rtsi rung zhing de'i brtsams chos kyis mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi chu 'go drangs yod/ 162 kha spu kha ni rtsom pa po ji 'dra zhig red dam/kha hphu kha (1883—/924)ni o zhung btsan rgyal gyi dbang sgyur 'og gnas pa'i pu'u la kor skyes shing khyim tshang ni yi'u tha'e ba'i 'byor 'bring gral rim zhig red/ phas tshong zog sne mang sdeb 'tshong gi las ka byed la gshis ka rtsub cing sger gcod che ba zhig kyang red/ 1901lor kha hphu khas pu'u la ko slob grwa chen mor rtsom rig ched las sbyangs pa dang rjes su bca' 468

khrims slob sbyong byas/ 1906lor khrims rig pa'i po hri ste 'bum rams pa'i slob gnas blangs/ slob grwa thon rjes nyen 'gog 'gan len kung sir las ka byas/ slob 'bring du sdod skabs nas dbyi po hreng gi zlos gar la dga' ba ma zad mtshan nyid rig pa dang rang byung tshan rig la zhib 'jug byed myong yod/ slob grwa chen mor sdod skabs pu'u la ko'i rig rtsal las rigs kyi byed sgo 'ga' zhig la zhugs myong ba dang grogs po 'ga' zhig kyang bsgrigs myong /ma kho si pu'u lu'o te ni kho'i grogs po yag shos yin la de'i shugs rkyen 'og rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las ka byed 'go brtsams/ dus skabs de'i ring kho par gzhi grub ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ba khor kha'e kor gyi shugs rkyen thebs yod/kha hphu kha ni dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs kyi rnam pas dbul zhing sems sbug dog pa'i rang gshis can zhig yin stabs/ kho'i gzugs gzhir gnod 'tshe byung nas 1905lo'i rjes su rtag tu lus gso khang la sman bcos byas nas sdod dgos kyi yod pa dang / gzhi rkang brtson pa chen pos gsar rtsom la zhugs rung rang gi brtsams chos de ga dus yin rung blo yid tshim pa zhig yong gi med stabs 'grems spel byas pa'i rtsom yig kyang nyung shas tsam las med/lhag don 1922lor glo ba'i nad gzhi je phyir song bas las gnas dgongs zhus kyis lus gso khang du mi sdod ka med byung mthar 1924lor wi en na'i nye 'dabs kyi cir ling lus gso khang du grongs pa red/ 'chi khar pu'u lu'o te la rang gi brtsams chos yod tshad mer sreg gtong rgyu'i re ba bton mod/'on kyang pu'u lu'u tes kho'i kha chems ltar ma bsgrubs par kho grongs rjes bam po dgu las grub pa'i 〈kha hphu kha'i gsung 'bum 〉(1950—1958)zhes pa zhig legs sgrig dpe skrun byas/ 469

kha hphu kha'i brtsams chos kyi gas su brtsams sgrung gis gtso bor byas shing 'bol rtsom dang / 'phrin yig nyin tho sogs yod/ 1908lor kha byang du 〈lta zhib〉ces 'khod pa'i mgyogs stabs rags bris rtsom yig bdun 'grems spel byas/ gal 'gangs che ba'i brtsams sgrung 'bring thung gi gras su 〈bcad khra 〉(1912)dang / 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod/〉〉(1912)〈dka' sdug gi dmag khral rgyug ring /〉(1914) 〈grong gseb kyi sman pa/〉(1917) 〈tshan rig khang la 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu/〉(1917) 〈rngon pa ko la kho si dang krung go'i lcags ri ring po'i bzo skrun/〉(1918— 919) 〈bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i sgyu rtsal pa/〉(1922) 〈sa phug〉(1923/de1924)zer ba sogs yod la/ da dung 〈a ri/〉(/914)dang / 〈'dri gcod/〉(1918)〈mkhar rdzong 〉1922zer ba bcas kyi brtsams sgrung ring gras gsum yod pa de rnams mjug rdzogs par 'bri thub med/ kha hphu kha'i grags can brtsams sgrung 'bring thung 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉zhes pa phud da dung 〈sa phug 〉ces pa zhig yod pa de'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo srog chags shig yin pa des bza' bca' gsog nyar bya ched nus shugs gang yod spyad de sa phug cig brus pa red/ 'on kyang sa phug ni de lta'i bde'i 'jags dang ldan pa zhig ma yin pas dgra bos nyin zhig tshur rgol byed par 'jigs te ga dus yin rung dngangs skrag gis gnas bzod mi bde bar sems pa bkyags te sdod dgos kyi yod/ gzhi rkang khos blo jus yod tshad 'don spel byas rung sngar bzhin 44steng gi 'jig rten de las byung ba'i bde 'jags min pa'i tshor snang las thar med pa dang / rtag tu nyen kha chen po zhig gi khor yug tu lhungs tshar 'dug snyam gyi yod pa red/〉’ brtsams chos 'dir sems khams kyi gnas tshul shin tu zhib 'bri byas yod la/ rtsom pa pos mir gyur srog chags kyi 470

thabs rtsal spyad de ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs kyi mi chung tsho'i bsam pa'i gnas stangs ji ma ji bzhin mtshon par byas yod/ kho tsho ni dma' 'bebs dang gnod 'tshe phog yul gyi mi yin pas/ tha na tshe srog gi bde 'jags tsam la'ang 'gan srung thub kyi med stabs nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu bde ba skad cig tsam yang med pa red/ brtsams chos kyi don rkyen byung rim de ma gzhi khungs lung med pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i rjes kyi yo rob tu grogs med khor rkyang gi tshor snang dang dngangs skrag gi sems khams 'di 'dra ni yongs khyab kyi gnas tshul zhig red/kha hphu khas rang nyid gnyod chung nus med cig tu ngos 'dzin byed pa dang /tshe gang ring gnyen sgrig byas med la khyim tshang gi dro skyid kyang thob myong med pa ma zad/ snga phyi bar gsum du gzugs gzhi thang min dang rtag tu nad mnar gyi gdung bas non pa bcas kyis bsam blo sgyid lug nyam smad kyi gnas su gyar zhing / rlabs chen gyi zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brjes kho par shugs rkyen gang yang thebs med la/ ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi mun nag gi phyogs mang pos kho pa bsam blo'i nyams nyen gyi khrod du lhungs nas brtsams chos rnams tshig don gang gi cha nas kyang shin tu nyam zhan skyo snang gi tshul du 'dug pa de ni kho pa'i bkra ma shis pa'i las dbang dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig red la/ dus mtshungs skabs de'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi shes yon can 'bring chung tsho'i dus rabs kyi nad gzhi mtshon pa zhig kyang red/kha hphu kha'i brtsams chos ni srol rgyun gyi dngos yod ring lugs kyi brtsams chos dang mi 'dra bar sgyu rtsal thad rtse gcig tu rnam pa gsar pa don gnyer dang / gtso bor rang snang gi 'jig rten mtshon par byed pa/ rtag tu mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs spyad de gsar rtsom gyi lam bu gsar pa 'tshol zhib 471

byed pa bcas kyis kho pa ni 8‘tshul 'chal ’ smra ba'i rtsom rig gi sngon byon par 'bod do/ 163 kha hphu kha'i 〈a ri 〉ces pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras de'i nang don gang yin nam/〈a ri 〉ces pa'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo lo bcu drug tu son pa'i 'jar man gyi gzhon nu khar lu'o si man zhes pa de/ g.yog mo zhig gi slu 'brid 'og kho mo dang lkog tu sgab mthun gyis nal bu zhig skyes par brten nas pha ma gnyis kyi bka' chad phog ste a rir rgyang 'bud btang / a rir kho par 'phrad pa'i gegs bar dang sdug bsngal sogs kyi thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi zhan cha ji snyed ther 'don byas yod/ khrom gzhung du bkres skom gyis mnar ba'i bud med rnams ya nga ba'i ngang nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang /za khang nang ngal dub kyis bzo lta shor ba'i bzo pa rtag tu dran med du 'gyel ba/ nyen rtog pas gang sar ham shed kyis 'grig min phran bu byung rigs de mur 'dzin bzung byed pa/ khram pa tshos kho par bsnyad 'dogs rgyu 'phrog byed pa dang tha na rgyu mtshan med par kho pa brdungs nas gan rkyal du 'gyel ba sogs lta bu'o/ rtsom pa po gang de a rir bskyod myong med/ kho'i smyug 'og gi a ri ni rtog bzos yongs khyab can du bsgyur pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'jig rten yin pa las dpe mtshon can du gyur pa'i a ri'i zhib mo'i spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs ma yin/ rtsom pa pos mtshon par byed pa ni phyogs bzhi'i khor yug dang me cha dgra gshed lta bar gyar pa'i kher rkyang gi rang sger de nyid yin rje:rdo/ dmi ra me nor 472

/64 〈'dri gcod 〉kyi nang don gang red dam/〈〈'dri gcod 〉ces pa ni nang don shin tu spyi mtshan gyi cha ru gtogs shing don rkyen gyi byung rim btsan sgrig byas pa'i ya mtshan can zhig yin/brtsams sgrung de'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo ni dngul khang zhig gi spyi gnyer gyi las rogs pa yu'e se 6 5zhes pa de yin/ nyin zhig gi zhogs par gsang ba'i khrims khang gis glo bur du kho pa 'dzin bzung bya rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas/ kho pa dngos su btson 'jug byas med na'ang des rkyen pas kho pa'i bsam blor gzugs med kyi gnon shugs chen po zhig byung / kho pa ni dngos 'brel nyes med nyes 'dogs 'khel ba'i mi zhig yin tsang gang sar zhu 'bod byed du song ste khrims rtsod pas khrims khang ni lho mi ngan 'gebs srung bya yul yin stabs nyes can tshor ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi gnas tshul zhu 'bod byed sa yod ma yin ri zhes bshad pa dang / yang khos khrims khang gi ri mo ba 'tshol skabs ri mo bas 6‘khrims khang gis mi zhig la nag nyes yod lugs kyi gnas tshul bgrangs pa yin na phyin chad mi der nyes pa yod par yid ches brtan po byed kyi red ri ces bshad/ khos 'bru rigs tshong gnyer byed mkhan tshong pa zhig 'tshol skabs gzhi nas tshong pa de'i gyod gzhi gcig la lo nyi shu'i ring ka kor khrun thag mi chod par de'i ched du khyim gzhis rtsa brlag tu song ba'i gnas tshul shes rtogs byung rjes/ mtha' ma ‘8khos khrims khang 'di'i bya spyod yod tshad ni stobs che'i sgrig gzhis rgyab rtsa byed pa zhig dang / des las rgyu'i bya ba ni nyes med la nyes 'gel gyis 'dzin bzung byas nas 'dri rtsad byed khul dang / sgrig gzhi 'dir lkog za dang lkog rngan len mkhan gsang zhib pa dang /'gan mi khur ba'i lta srung ba/ yon tan til 'bru tsam yang med pa'i 'dri 473

gcod pa bcas ri’yod pa gzhi nas ha go don gsal byung ba red/ 'on kyang kho pa ni gang ltar nyin zhig gi dgong mor srog thog btang / brtsams sgrung de'i 'byung rkyen ded khungs ni ha cang mi gsal ba dang / mi rnams 'jigs skrag dang gdung ba skye dgos pa'i gnya' gnon gyi tshor snang zab mos bcings pa zhig yin pa de ni o zhung rgyal po'i rtsub spyod dbang sgyur 'og gi kha hphu kha'i myong tshor ngo ma yin no/165 〈'dri gcod 〉kyi brjod bya gtso bo gang red dam/kha hphu khas 〈'dri gcod 〉kyi khrod du bstan pa'i brjod bya gtso bo ni bden pa ni mthong yang rag thabs med pa zhig yin zhes pa de red/brtsams chos khrod kyi ye shu'i chos 'chad pas brtsamasasgrung nang gi mi sna gtso bor bden pa zer ba ni yod rgyu ni yod/ 'on kyang bden par snyeg sa'i 'gro lam thog bar bgegs sna tshogs yod la bar bgegs de dag sgrol yang mi thub pas/ der brten bden pa'ang rnyed thabs med pa zhig red ces gsal ston byas yod/ mi sna gtso bo5 yis 'tshol dgos pa'i bden pa ni ches mtho'i 'dri gcod las khungs de yin pa dang / der song nas rang la dag 'bud byed snyam pa yin mod/ 'on kyang ji srid bar gnas der slebs thub med pas mtha' ma de las sdog ste pham nyes byung ba dang gri btsags brgyab nas bsad de mjug bsdus pa red/ phyi tshul nas bltas na 'di ni khungs lung gtan nas med pa zhig yin rung des o zhung btsan rgyal dpon ngan lam lugs kyi rul sungs ngo bo ther 'don gting zab byas yod/ de lta bu'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod du mi rang sger gyi stobs shugs la brten nas gzhi rgya che ba'i dpon ngan gyi sgrig gzhi gtor snyam pa ni gtan nas sgrub thabs med pa zhig 474

yin na/ ngayis don gnyer byed pa'i dmigs tshad de'ang sgrub thabs ga la yod/ kha hphu kha'i brtsams chos khrod kyi mi mang che ba ni 'di 'dra sha stag yin te shin tu nyam nga ba dang / gnam bskos kyi las dbang la 'gran rgol bya thabs med pa / 'gran rgol ji 'dra zhig byas pa de thams cad pham nyes kyi sgo nas mjug 'gril ba bcas red/166 〈mkhar rdzong 〉〉gi nang don ji 'dra red dam/〈〈mkhar rdzong 〉gi mi sna gtso bo5 yis mkhar rdzong nye 'dabs kyi grong tsho'i nang khyim gzhis 'dzugs rgyur srid gzhung nas chog mchan gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu ched kha ba'i gos kyis bklubs pa'i sa gzhi bcags te mkhar rdzong ga la ba der bsnyegs/ mkhar rdzong de phar bltas na thag nyer gnas pa 'dra rung ji ltar dka' ngal khyad du bsad de bskyod kyang slebs rgyu nam yang med stabs/khos dang thog sa zhing thig len mkhan du brdzus te sngon la grong tshor zhugs nas mgron khang zhig tu gnas bcas/ de rjes ming la pa na pa si zer ba'i mi zhig sne shan du drangs te nyin gcig hril por song yang da dung mkhar rdzong du ma slebs/ der brten khos slar yang mkhar rdzong gi dpon po'i zur mo hphe li ta slu brid byas te kho mo brgyud dbang 'dzin pa dang 'brel ba byed snyam yang sngar bzhin mkhar rdzong la 'dzul rgyu'i dmigs yul ma 'grub/ brtsams sgrung bris tshar med pa dang rtsom pa po'i sngon rtsis kyi phugs 'bras ni5 'chi la khad der kho pa grong tshor sdod chog pa las mkhar rdzong du 'dzul mi chog pa'i mkhar rdzong gi brda tho zhig 'byor ba de red/ brtsams sgrung 'di'i 'byung rkyen ded khungs kyang gsal po med la don rkyen gyi byung rim yang btsan sgrig byas pa zhig red/ brtsams chos khrod kyi mkhar rdzong la mtshon rtags kyi don snying 475

ldan pa mngon gsal te de ni log spyod dpon ngan kyi sgrig gzhi'i mtshon byed yin/ de dgung du mthon por gnas shing mi dmangs dang rgyang thag ring ba dang / mi dmangs rnams de'i dbang sgyur 'og re ba ji 'dra zhig kyang sgrub thabs med par kher rkyang yul po'i sdug bsngal gyi khrod du 'chi rgyu las ma 'das so/167 〈mkhar rdzong 〉gi bsam blo'i nang don gang red dam/〈mkhar rdzong 〉gi brjod bya gtso bo ni 〈a ri 〉dang 〈'dri gcod 〉sogs dang 'dra bar bya thabs sna tshogs la brten nas brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo'i pham nyes mtshon par byed pa de'o/ btsams sgrung ring gras 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos mi tshos don du gnyer ba'i bden pa ste rang dbang dang /brtan lhing bca' khrims sogs ji yin tshang ma gzhi grub tu gnas pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang khungs lung med pa'i 'jig rten 'dis mi rnams la gzugs yod gzugs med kyi bkag rgya sna tshogs bzos nas khyod kyis ji ltar brtson pa dang du blangs kyang bden pa'i pha mthar son rgyu lta ci mtha' ma rtag tu rtsa med du 'gro rgyu'i phugs 'bras las ma 'das pa'i skor klog pa por brjod snyam pa de yin zhing / de bas ya nga ba zhig ni brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo gom gang mdun du spo thub pa byung song snyam pa tshang ma ni don dngos thog dmigs tshad las gom gang rgyang ring du phyir bshig brgyab pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ kho tshos chag sgo gang nas yong ba mi shes par sgyu 'phrul lta bu'i ya mtshan che ba'i 'jig rten 'di'i khrod du rgyun chad med par brtson pa lhur len gyis rang nyid kyi las dbang la kha lo sgyur snyam gyin yod pa red/ 476

brtsams chos 'di'i khrod kyi mi sna gtso bong ni gong smros mi sna gtso bo 'ga' zhig dang 'dra bar thog mtha' bar gsum du zhum med 'bad 'thab byed kyin yod pa dang / kho tsho'i mgo thog gi gzugs yod gzugs med kyi gnon shugs la 'gog rgol byed kyin yod pa red/ kho tshor pham nyes byung mod/'on kyang bden pa ni sngar bzhin gnas yod/ brtsams chos de'i mjug bsdus med/ 'on kyang rtsom pa pos bzhag pa'i mjug bsdu des mi rnams la mtha' mtsha grong tsho der gzhis chags pa bstan yod/ mjug tu brtsams chos kyis da dung nga tshor nga'atsho sdod skabs mnas sdod kyi gnang ba mi thob pa dang ji ltar byas kyang mkhar rdzong du slebs mi thub pa ni snol rtseg can gyi dpon ngan lam lugs dang / dpon ngan gyi sgrig gzhi/ de bzhin rengs gyur can gyi mi bcas kyi rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa bstan yod/ srid 'dzin gyi dpon rigs de tsho nyin ltar brel ba 'tshub 'tshub 'dra yang grub 'bras til 'bru tsam yang bton rgyu med la/ bang rim rtseg ma'i do dam gyi sgrig gzhi'i khrod du gsham rim gyis jus thag gcod 'gan gong rim la 'bud pa dang / gong rim gyis 'gan 'khri gsham rim du 'ded pa bcas kyis ji srid bar bya ba gang yang sgrub thub kyi med pa red/ mkhar rdzong chung chung de'i srid 'dzin gyi dpon po'ang mtho zhing zab la tshod dpag byed dka' ba zhig yin pa'i thog gar song gar slebs cha mi 'tshal ba dang / dbang grags shin tu ches bas mi tshang mas shes kyi yod kyang mthong rtsa ba nas myong med pa/ kho pa ni mi'i sems pa'i steng du gnas shing mi rnams la 'jigs skrag gi tshor snang sbyin mkhan gzugs med grib so tsam yin pa red/ 'on kyang kho pa ni dbang cha'i mtshon rtags shig yin pas/ mi rnams kho pa'i nye 'gram du nam yang bcar thabs med par/ khos ni mi rnams kyi re ba rtsa med gtong la mi 'chi ru'ang 'jug 477

gi yod/ 'dis nus ldan gyi sgo nas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod la 'brab rdung byas pa bsnyon du med pa der shes rtogs kyi rin thang nges can ldan yod do/168 〈〈mkhar rdzong 〉〉la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/〈mkhar rdzong 〉ni sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos mngon gsal ldan pa'i brtsams chos shig yin pa de zhib phra'i mtshon tshul gsham gsal phyogs 'ga' zhig ste/gcig 'phrul snang gi khyad chos zab mo ldan pa 'di ni phya‘kha hphu kha can ri’gyi gtso bo'i khyad chos shig red/ thog mar mi sna gtso bong slebs sa'i sa gnas de ni sus kyang mi shes pa'i thag ring lkog gyur gyi gnas shig yin pa dang / 'gro sa'i mkhar rdzong de ni de bas yod pa 'dra la med pa'ang 'dra zhing cha rgyus med pa'i gnas shig yin pa de nye ba'i mig mdun du gnas rung der ji srid bar slebs mi thub pa/ de dngos gzugs shig yin la yang grib so zhig kyang yin pa/ de bas mtshon rtags shig yin pa des dpon ngan gyi rgyal khab 'phrul 'khor mtshon gyi yod/ de nas5 gnas sdod bya yul grong tsho de ni ha lam 'jig rten hril po'i rnam sprul lta bur grub pas de'i phyi rol du sa gnas gzhan gang yang med pa red/ mdor na 'dir yod kun la rmi lam sgyu ma'i khyad chos kyis rab tu bcings shing lkog gyur dpog par dka' la mi rnams skyi g.ya' dgos pa zhig yod do/ de min mkhar rdzong de'i nang gi po rim gyi cho lo can 00 zhes pa de dang tha na pu'u krang kho la mu'u bcas tshang ma ni ming go myong ba las sngar nas su gcig gis mthong myong med pa'i mi sna sha stag red la/ 'di dag las mi rnams la rmi lam 'tshub po zhig rmis pa lta 478

bu'i tshor snang ster zhing mi rnams kyi mdun du 'char ba ni 'phrul snang gi dngos med 'jig rten zhig mtshon par byed do/ gnyis/ zur za'i ri mo lta bu'i 'bri thabs spyad pa / mkhar rdzong de'i nang su'o er ti nyi zhes pa'i dpon rigs shig yod pa de'i las ka ri ltar spungs yod/ khos bed spyod gtong bzhin pa'i yig cha'i yig khug chen po rnams gcig thog gcig rtseg gis ka ba lta bur grub nas phyogs bzhi'i gyang yang mi mthong / mi tshos rgyun chad med par yig khug rnying pa mar blangs shing yig khug gsar pa yar bsnan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yig cha'i ka ba de rnams rtag tu zhig 'gyel yong gi yod cing / yig khug zhig 'gyel gyi ldir sgra de ni kho'i gzhung las khang gi khyad chos su grub yod/ yang dper na mkhar rdzong gi bang chen pa na pa sis yig skyel gyi las 'gan thob rgyu'i ched du ga dus yin rung dbus su mthon por gnas shing las la brel ba'i dpon rigs tsho'i mdun sar nyin gang 'gul tsam yang mi byed par krong nger langs nas sdod kyi yod mod dpon rigs tshos ni ha lam kho par snang ba tsam yang mi 'joga'adi ltar dus yun ring po song ba'i nyin zhig yig mkhan gyis glo bur du sgrog tse'i 'og gi yig cha du ma'i khrod nas snga mo nas bris tshar ba'i yi ge zhig bton te kho par5 la skyel du mngags zer ba sogs 'di 'dra'i bkod gtsang 'phral gcod dang / sbyor bde don gsal gyi zur za'i ri mo lta bu'i 'bri thabs kyi thog nas dpon ngan ring lugs dang spyi tshogs kyi goms srol ngan pa sna tshogs la ther 'don gyis/ dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gi skyug bro ba'i gdong ris la zur za byas pa 'dis mi rnams la gson rjen ngo mtshar che ba'i tshor snang zhig sbyin nas phan 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon yod do/ 479

169 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa'i nang don gang red dam/〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa 'di ni kha hphu kha'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos red/ 'dir rtsom pa pos mi 'bu la 'gyur ba'i don rkyen gyi byung rim bkod pa'i thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod kyi mi'i gzhan 'gyur gyi gnad don gsal ston byas yod/ mis mi la gnya' gnon byed pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs lam lugs 'og gi mi chung tsho'i las dbang ni mi rnams ha las hang sangs dgos pa 'i skyo gar zhig red/ko li ku'o er ni kung si zhig gi skor skyod 'grem 'tshong ba zhig yin pa dang / kho pa ni rang 'khri'i las 'gan la bsam pa rnam dag gi bag yod tshul ldan pa zhig yin pas nyin ltar dka' sdug khyad gsod kyis phyogs bzhir 'grem 'tshong gi 'du 'god kyi las la rtse gcig gzhol ba las g.yo dang zol gyi dri mas ma sbags pa zhig yin/ nyin zhig gi zhogs pa kho pa gnyid las sad skabs rang nyid 'bu sbur pa chen po zhig tu gyur pa shes shing sgal pa ni lcags khrab nang bzhin mkhregs po chags yod pa dang / rdza mdog gi grod pa de ni gzhu dbyibs lta bu'i mkhregs leb du mar phye yod pa/ rkang lag phra mo mang pos kho pa'i mdun du ga byed 'di byed med pa lta bur gar stabs la rol bzhin yod pa bcas red/ kho pa ni chu tshod lnga pa'i me 'khor la bsdad de tshong zog 'grem 'tshong du 'gro dgos mod/ 'on kyang thir ldan chu tshod der lta skabs chu tshod drug dang phyed shar slebs tshar zhing me 'khor rjes ma de chu tshod bdun par 'gro bas de'ang phal cher rjes zin bzo mi 'dug snyam nas dngangs skrag chen po skyes/ de'i skabs kho'i pha ma gnyis dang gcung mos sgo 480

brdungs te kho las shar 'gro dgos pa'i skul lcag btang / yud tsam song rjes kung si'i drung yig 'go 'dzin yang slebs pa tshor nas sems nang de bas dngangs skrag chen po byung / khos sems 'tshab kyi khrod du nus shugs yod rgus rang nyid kyi lus po nyal khri'i steng nas phyir phyung bas chag sgra dang bcas sa steng du lhungs/ de mur kho'i 'khris kyi khang pa'i nang nas drung yig 'go 'dzin gyis gang du dngos po zhig zags song ba ma yin nam zhes bshad pa go de rjes drung yig 'go 'dzin gyis mgrin pa btegs te ko li ku'o er la las 'gan mi 'khur ba skyon du che zhes gshe gshe btang ba bar ma zad/‘4de ring zhogs pa spyi gnyer gyis nga rang la khyod kyi ngo gdong mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phal cher nye char khyod la do dam bya rgyur sprad pa'i dngul smar dang 'brel ba med dam snyam pa'i go rgyu bshad byung mi’zer/ spyi gnyer la kho par lkog za'i bya spyod med dam snyam pa'i dogs 'char byung ba'i gnas tshul thos rjes kho pa ni ma nyes kha g.yogs 'khel song snyam nas sems sdug chen po byung zhing / khos rang la dag 'bud kyi skad cha bshad pa yang drung yig gyis ga nas thos/ skabs der kho ga ler rang gi glen khob kyi lus bsnur te khas lde mig bskor nas sgo phye/ de ma thag drung yig 'go 'dzin bred thag chod nas skad cor dang bcas phyir bros/ a ma rang sar dran med du brgyal/ phas mur 'dzog sgong nas ha lam kho pa khang pa'i nang du yar 'jug rtsis byed pa 'dra zhing de mur ngu 'bod byed/ko li ma'o er sbur pa chen po zhig tu gyur pa'i rjes thog mar kho pa'i gcung mo ko le thes nyin ltar kho par zas sna skyel ba dang kho'i nang byi dor byed kyi yod/ kho'i khyim tshang la cha mtshon na de snga pha ma gnyis dang gcung mo'i 'tsho ba'i 'gan tshang ma khos khur gyi yod pas/ kho pa gzugs 'gyur ba'i rjes 481

su khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i gnad don thad sems khral chen po byung zhing rtag tu 'khris kyi khang pa'i nang nas gnyen nye tshos skad cha ji bshad nyan 'jog zab mo byed kyi yod/ za ma za rim bzhin khyim mi tshos phyin chad ji 'dra bya rgyu'i skor go bsdur byed pa dang tha na za ma mi za ba'i skabs su'ang gnad don de'i skor gleng mo byed kyi yod/ kho pa gzugs 'gyur ba'i rjes su khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor gnas tshul nyin re bzhin je sdug tu song bas/ rgan yol zhus zin pa'i a ma bskyar du mi'i lag g.yog tu mi 'gro mthu med byung ba dang / a mar dbugs 'tshang ba'i nad gzhis rkyen pas gom pa rgyag rgyur yang dka' ngal chen po yod mod 'tsho ba'i ched du 'tshem las la 'gro dgos shar/ lo bcu bdun son pa'i gcung mo yang tshong gnyer ba'i las 'gan sgrub tu song /thengs gcig kho'i gcung mo dang a mas kho'i khang pa'i nang chas dbor skyel byed skabs a mas kho mthong ste dkon mchog mkhyen zhes 'o dod 'bod pa dang chabs cig 'bol stan rgyab bsnyes ma'i thog tu 'gyel/ ko li ku'o er ma'i tshe srog la nyes skyon mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems khral gyis gcung mo'i mjug tu bsnyegs nas 'khris kyi khang pa der song / kho pa sems khral dang rang gis rang la sun 'byin sdug sbyong gis mnar ba'i rkyen gyis sems 'chol ba lta bus gyang ldebs dang gnam gcal sogs gang sar 'dzegs shing mtha' ma sgrog rtse chen po zhig gi steng du lhungs/ yud tsam song rjes kho'i pha log yong nas ko lu ku'o er khang pa'i nang nas phyir thon pa dang bza' zla yang dran med du brgyal ba mthong skabs khong khro 'gog thabs med par de ma thag rang gi ya nga zhing sha tsha ba'i bur bda' 'ded btang ba ma zad kho'i gzugs por dmigs nas ku shu 'phangs/ ku shu gcig kho'i sgal pa'i steng du phog nas sgal gseng nang du thim/ de ltar ko li ku'o er la rmas skyon byung ste 482

gzugs gzhi nyin re bzhin je zhan du song ba dang / gcung mos kyang kho par lta rtog mi byed cing kho'i sdod khang de'ang zog ro spungs sa'i gad snyigs khang pa zhig tu gyur pa red/ khyim tshang gi yong 'bab phran bu'i 'phar snon yong phyir khang pa gcig 'grul mi gsum la bogs mar btang / nyin zhig gi dgong mo gcung mos mgron por og len chung ba dkrol gtong byed skabs de'i snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs kyis yid bkug ste ko li ku'o ir rang dbang med par 'khris kyi khang pa de'i nang bskyod dgos byung / mgron po tshos ya mtshan gyi dngos po de mthong skabs khang pa phyir slog byed kyi yin zhes skad cor brgyab pas/ kho'i gcung mo yang khong khro chen po langs shing kho pa ni nang gi bkra ma shis pa thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin pas cis kyang phyir 'bud byed dgos zhes ngan smras byas/ khos de 'phral rang gi khang pa'i nang bros rtsis kyis yar tsam 'dzegs ma thag gcung mos la 'ur sgo mar 'then zhing sgo lcags kyang brgyab/ nyin de'i nam dgung kho pa go med tshor med ngang shi ba red/ nyin gnyis par kho'i pha ma gnyis dang gcung mos rdog khres phab pa'i snang ba dang bcas grong khyer phyi rol du spro gseng la chas song /kha hphu kha'i gsar rtsom gyi brjod snying ni nyams dman pa zhig yin mod/'on kyang shugs drag che ba'i sun 'byin gyi phyogs lhung ldan yod/ 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa'i nang rtsom pa pos ma rtsa can gyi gdug rtsub la sun 'byin dang ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs nang gi 'khyags pa ltar grang ba'i khyim tshang gi 'brel ba ther 'don byas shing / mi chung la 'phrad pa'i bkra ma shis pa'i don gnad la sems gting nas gdung sems mnyam skye byas yod/ 483

170 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces par sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉ces pa de ni mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig khrod kyi phul byung brtsams 'bras shig yin zhing der gsham gsal gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos ldan yod de/gcig tshul 'chal dang mtshon rtags de bzhin da ngos yod bcas zung du 'brel ba/ 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉〉ces pa'i mi sna gtso bo ko li yi'o er dang thog skor skyod 'grem tshong ba zhig yin pa nas rjes su 'bu sbur pa chen po zhig tu gyur pa 'di 'dra ni dngos dngos yod 'tsho ba'i gtan tshigs la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i tshul 'chal gyi don rkyen byung rim zhig red/'byor ldan gral rim gyi rtsom rig khrod du ku'o ko li dang / tha'o si thu'o ye hphu si ci/ che kho hphu/ hphu lo'u pa'e/ mo po sang sogs kyis kyang mi chung gi snang brnyan bskrun myong yod/ 'on kyang de tsho tshang ma dngos yod ring lugs kyi bya thabs spyad nas kho tsho'i bkra mashis pa'i las dbang 'bri 'god byas pa sha stag red/ khos tshul 'chal gyi bya thabs spyad pa song tsang brtsams chos der gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig mngon rgyu yod/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang mi 'bur 'gyur mi srid pa zhig yin rung mis mi la bshu gzhog gtong ba'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang mi chung mang dag cig ni shin tu ya nga ba'i gnas bab tu lhungs pa dngos bden red/ kho tsho 'tsho ba dka' sdug che la gnas bab nyag phra bas mi'i ma mthar dgos pa'i la rgya dang khe dbang tsam yang med pa ma zad sdug bsngal yod kyang shod pa'i yul dang bral bas mthar thug sdug shi thebs pa'i las dbang las thar rgyu ga la yod/ rtsom 484
