pa pos mi 'bur 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul 'bri 'god byas pa ni mtshon rtags tsam yin pa dang des ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang mi ni mi ma yin par 'gyur ba'i dngos don mtshon yod/ brtsams chos 'di'i nang tshul 'chal dang mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs spyad pa phud dngos yod 'tsho ba'i ljongs bkod kyang bris yod pa dper na / kung si'i drung yig 'go 'dzin gyis dpon po'i kha bzo ston pa dang / ko li ga'o er gyi gcung mos mgron por og len chung ba'i rol cha dkrol gtong byed pa sogs kyis 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉〉ces pa'i brtsams chos de'i mngon gsal dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos grub pa ste tshul 'chal dang mtshon rtags de bzhin dngos yod bcas zung du 'brel ba dang dngos yod las 'das pa dang dngos yod gnyis zung du 'brel ba lta bu'o/gnyis/ dngos bden zhib tshags kyi sgo nas sems khams kyi gnas tshul 'bri 'god byas pa/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyis rang snang gi 'jig rten dang nang sems kyi 'gul skyod 'bri 'god bya rgyu nan bshad byed pa ltar 〈gzugs 'gyur rtogs brjod 〉yang de las ma 'das/ ko li /'o er gyi phyi dbyibs 'gyur ldog byung ste 'bu sbur pa chen po zhig tu 'gyur ba yin pa las kho'i bsam pa'i 'jig rten la 'gyur ldog byung med pa dang / rjod byed kyi nus pa nyams pa yin pa las mi'i bsam blo'i brtse dung sngar bzhin gnas yod stabs brtsams chos su nang sems 'gul skyod skor gtso bo'i gnas bab tu bzung nas bris yod/ dper na kho'i gcung mos kho pa ni khyim tshang bkra ma shis pa'i 'byung rtsa yin par sems nas phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i sems thag bcad pa dang / kho pa rang gi khang pa'i nang du 'dzegs rjes gcung mos de 'phral sgo lcags brgyab pa sogs 'di lta bu'i brtse med snying rje bral ba'i las ka byas 485

kyang kho pas 'khon sems gtan nas ma bcangs la khos bsam pa ni da ji ltar bya dgos snyam pa de tsam yin pa dang / khos phyogs bzhi'i mun khung du blta tsam byas shing da lta rang nyid 'gul tsam yang byed mi thub pa'i gnas tshul gang mgyogs tshor shes byung / 'on kyang 'dis kho pa dngangs skrag ga la skye/ de las ldog ste rang gi phra la nyam chung ba'i rkang lag 'di tshos lam thag ring po de tsam du 'dzegs thub pa ni bsam yul las 'das zhig red snyam pa tsam las de min mi bde ba gang yang ma byung / drang po bshad na / kho'i lus po yongs rdzogs chag brgyab nas yod/ 'on kyang rim bzhin drag tu 'gro bzhin pa ltar yod la rjes su na tsha sangs drag yong nges red/ kho'i sgal pa'i steng gi ku shu rul pa dang de'i nye 'khor gnyan kha rgyas sa tshang mar sa rdul 'gos mod / 'on kyang snga sa nas de tsam sdug pa'i tshor snang rang med cing / khos zhi dul gyi brtse dung bcangs te rang gi khyim mi tshor bsam blo gtong gin yod la/don gnad 'di dngos 'brel sgrub thub pa yin na khos rang nyid rtsa med bzo rgyu'i chod sems de gcung mo las kyang shugs drag che ba yod pa red/ skad cha dum bu 'dis shin tu zhib tshags kyi sgo nas kho'i sems khams 'gul skyod kyi gnas tshul bstan yod/ kho pa 'bur ma 'gyur gong rang rtogs kyi sgo nas khyim mi yongs kyi 'tsho ba'i 'gan lci phrag tu 'khur ba ma zad tha na gron chung bsri tshags kyis gcung mo rol dbyangs slob grwa chen mor gtong rtsis kyang byas/'on kyang phyi gzugs 'gyur rjes khyim mi tshang mas kho pa khur po zhig tu rtsi ba dang / a phas sems gnag sbyor rtsub kyi sgo nas kho par ku shu gzhus te ku shu gzugs thog tu gting zab zug pa/ gcung mos gtum spyod drag pos kho par ngan smras dang phyir 'bud byas pa sogs gnyen tshan tsho'i spyod tshul la gzhigs na skyo snang dang khong khro bya 'os pa zhig los yin kyang / khos khyim mir 'khon 486

sems mi bcangs pas ma tshad de las ldog ste da dung zhi dul gyi brtse sems thog nas kho tsho dran snang byas/ kho'i sems bzang la de bas mi rnams sems 'gul thebs pa zhig yod/ brtsams chos su dngos bden zhib tshags kyi sems khams gnas tshul 'bor chen 'bri 'god byas pa des rig rtsom sgyu rtsal gyi yid dbang 'dren shugs la shugs snon je cher thebs yod do/171 cha phe kho ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/kha ler cha phe kho (1890—1938)ni dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar gyi ce khe si lo wa khe'i phul du byung ba'i zlos gar ba dang /brtsams sgrung ba/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan bcas yin la mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal pa chen po zhig kyang red/ kho'i mgrin pa'i mdud rgya grol 'drar thon pa'i brtsams 'bras rnams yig rigs mang por phab bsgyur gyis yo rob dang a me ri kha gling gi rgyal khab khag la khyab gdal byung yod pas/ hphu chi khos kho pa ni 6 ce khe'i rtsom rig khrod du 'dzam gling gi rang bzhin che shos ldan pa'i rlabs chen rtsom pa po ’ zhig red ces brjod kyi yod do/cha phe kho ni ce khe byang shar khul gyi ma li'i si wa thu'o nyi a'o we tsha'i zhes pa'i sa char skyes shing pha ni grong gseb kyi sman pa zhig red/ kho pa khra li slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i sde khag nas mthar phyin rjes gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan dang dus deb rtsom sgrig pa'i las ka yun ring byas//920lor mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi tshab mtshon brtsams chos 〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas pa nas bzung ming grags de mur 'phel zhing yo rob dang a me ri kha gling du mtshan snyan khyab/ 487

de rjes bstud mar 〈'bu srin gyi 'tsho ba/〉(gcen po dang mnyam las byas 1921)zhes pa dang / 〈yun 'tsho'i man ngag〉(1922) 〈dkar po'i nad/〉(1937) 〈a ma 〉(1938)zer ba sogs kyi 'khrab gzhung 'grems spel byas/brtsams chos 'di tsho'i nang 'ga' zhig gis rtags mtshan gsal ba'i sgo nas 'byor chen gral rim la zur za dang / 'byor ldan pas mi dmangs la gdug rtsub che ba'i 'phrog bcom dang smyo ham chen pos gnod 'tshe gtong ba ther 'don/ 'ga' zhig gis don drang tshig nan gyi sgo nas 'jar man hpha shi si'i stobs shugs la 'dul gtam sgrog pa dang hi the le dang de'i ngan rogs pas gang sar dmag 'khrug slong ba dang mi dmangs dung phyur mang po dmar gsod gtong ba'i sdig nyes nyer 'don byas pa bcas red/ zlos gar de tshos skabs der dril bsgrags dang skul slong gi nus pa chen po thon te yo rob mi dmangs tsho'i g.yul 'gyed kyi snying stobs dang 'gog rgol gyi sems shugs 'phel zhing hpha shi si gdon 'drer drag 'dul byed pa'i skul yig cig tu gyur yod/cha phe khos brtsams sgrung yang mi nyung ba zhig bris yod pa'i nang bag chags cung zab pa'i gras su tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang gi brtsams sgrung 〈nyer gcod bzo grwa 〉(1922)dang / 〈rdul phran gyi smyo bsam/〉(1924)〈nyi nya'i dus zing /〉(1936) 〈srog skyob ru khag dang po 〉(1937)zer ba sogs yod la/ de tshos btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug la ngo rgol dang hpha shi si'i sdig nyes ther 'don byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gi brjod bya gtso bo mtshon par byas pa dper na/ 〈rdul phran gyi smyo bsam 〉zhes pa'i nang don ni tshan rig mkhas pa zhig gis zil shugs 'gran zla bral ba'i rdul phran 'bar rdzas shig gsar gtod byas yod mod/ 'on kyang khos btsan rgyal ring 488

lugs pas rdul phran 'bar rdzas spyad de 'dzam gling dmag chen bslangs nas sa'i go la hril por dbang bsgyur pa'i ham sems sgrub rtsis byed pa'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi lkog g.yo'i jus ngan de shes rtogs byung rjes/ de 'phral gsar gtod de rtsa brlag tu btang nas rdul phran 'bar rdzas kyis mi rnams la nye bar bskrun nges pa'i gnod 'tshe gsar pa byol thub pa byung ba'i skor bris pa lta bu'o/ brtsams chos 'di dag gis 'byor chen gral rim gyi btsan 'dzul dang dmag 'khrug la dga' ba'i ngo bo ther 'don byas pa ma zad mi chos ring lugs dang dmangs gtso'i snying stobs kyang gsal mtshon byas yod pa red/ sgyu rtsal thad/ cha phe kho'i zlos gar dang brtsams sgrung gis dpe mtshon gyi sgo nas mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal nyams 'gyur mtshon gyi yod/brjod bya'i thad/ brtsams sgrung dang zlos gar gyi khyab khongs su tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang 'bri 'god byas te brjod bya'i 'pho 'gyur chen po mngon 'gyur byas pa ma zad/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin dang sa/tam rgyud kyi rang bzhin/ bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin bcas nyis rtseg gis gcig gyur yong ba byas pa red/bsam blo'i bkod pa'i thad/ si thi ling pa'o yi sgyu rtsal srol rgyun rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas btang ste rtser son sgro 'dogs kyi tshul 'chal rnam pa spyad nas nan che'i spyi tshogs kyi nang don mtshon par byed pa dang / shin tu 'khyog brjod kyi snang brnyan la bsten nas mi tsho'i rang snang gi tshor ba'i bden pa 'bur du thon pa byas pa dper na 〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉zhes pa'i nang gi 'phrul chas kyi mi'i snang brnyan de tsho ni/ gnya' gnon thebs pa'i ngal rtsol mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khe dbang yod tshad 'phrog pa 489

'khyog brjod kyi tshul du mtshon tshul zhig yin pa dang / mi rnams kyi phyi tshul nas bltas na brtse dung med pa 'dra yang don dngos thog brtse dung gis phyug pa'i 'phrul chas kyi mi de tshos gnya' gnon myong ba'i mi'i nang sems sdug bsngal dang rdzogs mtha' med pa'i skyo snang ji bzhin myong tshor thub kyi yod/de min rtsom pa pos yang rtag tu mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs spyad de brjod bya gtso bo gting zab dang rgya skyed yong ba byed kyi yod de brtsams chos mang che bar mtshon rtags rang bzhin gyi mi sna dang don rkyen gyi byung rim 'ga' yod pa dper na/ 〈rdul phran gyi smyo bsam 〉zhes pa'i nang gi tshan rig mkhas pa de ni shes yon can gyi kun spyod dang gzhung drang gi mtshon rtags yin pa lta bu'o/cha phe kho ni khyad du 'phags pa'i spyi tshogs kyi byed sgo spel mkhan mkhas can zhig kyang yin te/ rang nyid kyi mes rgyal shi gson chags 'jig dang thug pa'i lo rabs sum cu par hpha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing pa zhig gi ngos nas dril bsgrags skul slong byed sgo sna tshogs la zhugs shing /rgyal spyi'i rig gnas srung skyob rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs ce khe si lo wa khe yan lag mthun tshogs kyi 'go khrid de hur brtson chen pos si phen spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi hpha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug la ngag thog gi rgyab skyor byas yod//72 〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉zhes pa de ni zlos gar ci 'dra zhig red dam/ 〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉(/920)zhes pa de ni ce khe'i rtsom pa po cha phe kho'i zlos gar gyi tshab mtshon brtsams chos red la/ mngon mtshon 490

ring lugs zlos gar khrod kyi ches phul byung gi brtsams chos gras shig kyang yin pas des deng rabs zlos gar gyi lo rgyus thog gal 'gangs che ba'i gnas bab bzung yod/〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉zhes pa de ni le'u gsum ldan gyi gtam brjod zlos gar zhig yin pa dang / mdun du da dung sngon 'gro'i 'khrab tshan zhig kyang yod pa red/ 'khrab gzhung gi gzhi rtsa'i nang don ni 'di ltar te/ tshan nyid rig pa ba lu'o su'o mu'u la mthong dkon pa'i gdod ma'i srog ldan dngos po zhig rnyed son byung nas kho pa dang tsha bo gnyis kyis lo mang ring zhib tshags skyed bsring byas mthar de nyid kyis rgyu cha byas te bla srog med pa'i 'phrul chas kyi mi zhig bzos/ 'phrul chas kyi mi de ni nang khrol dang sha rus gdos bcas kyi phung po bcas las grub cing phyi dbyibs mi dang gnyis su med la mi gson po dang 'dra bar ngal rtsol sna tshogs kyang byed shes/ 'on kyang kho tshor tshor ba med la dung sems bcangs rgyu dang 'gog rgol bya rgyu sogs kyang shes kyi med pa red/ ma rtsa can gyis de 'dra'i 'phrul chas kyi mi khri stong mang po bzos nas rin thang chung ba'i ngal rtsol nus shugs su brtsis te 'dzam gling sa gnas khag la brin tshong byed kyi yod/ 'phrul chas kyi mis mi'i rigs kyi ngal rtsol sna tshogs kyi tshab byas pas mi'i rigs thon skyed kyi brgyud rim las yongs su kha bral nas 'tsho ba'i nus pa shor stabs kun spyod nyams pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol zhig pa/ bud med tshos kyang bu rgyud gso spel mi byed pa bcas kyis 'gro ba mi yi rigs rgyud chad par nye ba'i nyams nyen gyis gdong bsus te yong / rjes su 'phrul chas kyi mis drag po'i zing 'khrug bslangs te grong khyer dang grong gseb btsan bzung byas pas ma tshad 'gro ba mi rigs rtsa med du btang / 'dzam gling hril po mya ngam 491

gyi thang lta bur bsgyur nas rtsa brlag 'gro la khad kyi nyen tshabs che ba'i skad cig der/ 'phrul chas kyi mi pho mo gnyis dbar mdza' gtsugs kyi brtse dung byung bas mi'i rigs la da gzod 'das log dang rgyun mthud kyi re ba byung /〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉zhes pa 'di'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim gzhi rkang tshul 'chal khungs med dang ya mtshan can zhig yin mod/'on kyang 'dis rgya che la gting zab pa'i sems sdug gi bsam pa'i nang don zhig mngon mtshon byas yod/ rtsom pa pos tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang gi gtam rgyud 'di brgyud de ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs ni mi 'tsho sdod bya rgyur mi 'tshams pa'i 'jig rten zhig yin pa dmar rjen du ther 'don byas yod/ ngan rgu tshang ba'i sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyis mtha' ma mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'brel ba'i phyogs yongs kyi gzhan 'gyur gyi gnas tshul bskrun pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyis tshad gzhi mtho shos kyi khe spogs don gnyer bya ched tshan rig lag rtsal gsar shos rnams kyang ma rtsa'i bran g.yog tu bsgyur cing la 'ur rgyu nor longs spyod spel phyir tshan rig gi gsar gtod 'bras bu rnams rang snang gang dran du spyod pa tha na mi'i rigs kyi mdun lam brlag na'ang blos bcad gtong phod kho na las the tshom rtsa ba nas med na/ 'dod sred kyi 'chal rlung kun nas ldang zhing sdig nyes kyis kha khengs pa'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang du ni tshan rig dar rgyas kyi tshad gzhi ji tsam gyi mtho ba de tsam gyis mi'i rigs kyis myong dgos pa'i sdug bsngal dang gnod 'tshe yang de tsam che ba yod pa de red/ zur za'i ri mo dang 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud 'di brgyud/ rtsom pa po pos spyi tshogs mun nag dang goms srol ngan par sdang sems kyi 'du shes drag pos ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam lugs la dza drag che ba'i rgol gtam dang khrag dang mig chu'i gdung 492

'bod byas yod/ rtsom pa po'i smyug 'og tu 'phrul chas kyi mi de ni sngon thon gyi tshan rig lag rtsal gyi mtshon rtags shig tu ma zad/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs nang gdug rtsub che ba'i gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog myong zhing mi'i ma mtha'i khe dbang tsam yang brlag pa'i yo rob bzo pa'i ya nga ba'i 'tsho ba'i mtshon rtags shig kyang yin/ rtsom pa po gang des 'phrul chas kyi mir 64lu'o po the ri zhes pa'i ming gis 'bod pa ni don dngos thog de ni ce khe'i ‘6sdug las pa ’ dang na‘'u lag mi ces pa'i ming gi sgra sgyur yin zhing / 'phrul chas kyi mi de tsho'i gzugs brnyan 'bri 'god byas pa'i khrod nas rtsom pa pos sdug bsngal gyi gcong rong zab mor lhung pa'i bzo pa'i gral rim gyi bzod dka'i gnas bab la sems gting nas gdung sems mnyam skye byed pa rtogs sla'o/brtsams chos kyi khrod du 'byor ldan pa'i snang brnyan khag gcig kyang bris yod pa rnams la rtsom pa pos 'phya smod dang / zur lta/ khrel dgod bcas bgyis te bzo pa'i khrag dang rngul chu 'jib mkhan gzhan brten srin 'bu de dag la bcangs pa'i 'khon 'dzin zab mo mtshon par byas yod de/dper na lu'o su'o mu'u zhes pa'i spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi'i bzo grwa'i spyi khyab spyi gnyer ba tu'o ming zhes pa de ni g.yo lhad dran 'phrul mang zhing sems gnag sdug rtsub che ba'i mi sna skyug bro ba zhig yin pa dang / phyi tshul spam bzo 'dzin pa'i zog po 'dis mi'i ngo gdong du kun spyod zhi zhing dul la lta bzo dod pa'i nyams snang dang ldan pa'i bcos ma'i ngang tshul lhur len byed mod/ 'on kyang lkog tu ni g.yo sgyu'i jus ngan med na ma gtogs yod tshad shom mkhan mi tha shal ba zhig yin pas/ khos tsung thung gi bu mo ha'e lun na zhes pa btsan shed kyis rang gi chung mar bkug cing de'i tshab tu 493

'phrul chas kyi mi zhig bong bu rta brdzus su mngags/ khos mi'i rigs kyi las dbang la sems khur spu tsam mi byed par do snang bya yul gcig kho na yod pa ni mnga' thang rgyas pa'i stobs 'byor 'phel thabs byed pa de rang red/'di ni sgyu rtsal gyi dpe mtshon ngo ma zhig yin te/ kho'i gzugs thog nas 'byor ldan gral rim gyi ches tha shal dang ches ngo bor gyur pa'i khyad chos yod do cog mngon par byas yod do/173 te pu'u ling ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/te pu'u ling (1878—1957)ni 'jar man mngon mtshon ring lugs brtsams sgrung gi grags can rtsom pa po zhig yin pa dang / 'jar man hre the yan grong khyer gyi tshong chung rgyag mkhan yi'u tha'e pa dang / kho pa ni yun ring sman pa'i las ka dang lhag don smyo nad kyi sman pa lo mang byed myong yod/1911lor 〈rlung 'tshub 〉ces pa'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi dus deb thog brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈khra yol nag po 〉(1903)zhes pa 'grems spel byas rjes ming grags 'phral mar khyab/ kho'i gsar rtsom gyi bya bar dus rim gsum 'byed chog pa ste/ snga dus kyi gsar rtsom (1927lo'i sngon )dus rim skabs gal che'i brtsams chos khag gsum yod pa ni/ brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈wang lun thengs gsum mchongs pa/〉(1915)dang / 〈〈pho lun si than/〉〉(1920) 〈ri dang mtsho/ mi bo che 〉(/924)zer ba bcas red/ 〈lhang lun thengs gsum mchongs pa 〉zhes pa de ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus smad kyi krung go'i gnas tshul rgyab ljongs su byas nas 'jar man gyi mun nag spyi tshogs la go rgyu bshad pa zhig red/ wang lun ni ta'o ca'o chos lugs kyi chos spel mkhan 494

zhig dang la'o ci'i lhag bsam rnam dag gi rjes 'brang ba zhig yin zhing /kho'i bsam blo gtso bo ni 6'gog rgol bya rgyu med/ 'dzam gling gi kun thub 'phel tshad grub zin pas/ de yo 'khyog bya mi rung la/ rang gi kha phyogs kyang 'gyur ldog gtong mi nyan mi’zhes pa de yin pa dang / brtsams chos kyis mngon gsal dod pos 'gog rgol mi byed pa'i ring lugs dang las dbang smra ba'i bsam blo dril bsgrags byed pa dang chabs cig yang rgyal dbang sger gcod chab srid kyi gdug rtsub dang drang snyoms min par sun 'byin gyis de ni mi dmangs 'os langs byed pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen yin par bstan yod/ 〈ri dang mtsho/ mi bo che 〉zhes pa de ni tshan rig gi 'char snang gi brtsams sgrung zhig yin pa der spyi lo nyis stong bdun brgya lo'i rjes su mi'i rigs dang 'das log byung ba'i gna' bo'i srog chags bar sha khrag gi dmar 'dzing zhig byung ba'i skor 'bri 'god byas te/ mis tshad mtho'i dngos po'i dpal yon bskrun pa des mi dang rang byung bar gyi mthun sbyor gtor bshig btang ba ma zad/ mtha' ma mi'i rigs rang nyid kyang zhan 'gyur rtsa brlag gi phyogs su bskyod rgyu las ma 'das pa'i skor gsal ston byed snyam pa de yin pa/ brjod bya gtso bo'i skyo snang gi rnam pa shin tu zab mo yod pa red/bar dus kyi gsar rtsom (1928—/950)dus skabs su gal 'gangs che shos kyi brtsams sgrung ring gras khag bzhi yod pa ni/ 〈per lin gyi ya li hran ta thang chen/〉(/929)dang / 〈snying rje spu tsam med pa/〉(1935) 〈mi nub pa'i rgyal po'i rgyal khab 〉ces pa'i rol dbyangs gsum/ (1935/de1948)〈chig dgu bco brgyad lo'i zla bcu gcig 〉(1937/de1950)zer ba bcas red/ 〈per lin gyi ya li hran ta thang chen 〉zhes pa des 'grim 'grul bzo pa hphu lan tshi po po kho phu'u hphu zhes pa btson khang nas don rjes skyon spangs 495

dge sgrub bya sems yod kyang las su ma rung ba'i gtam rgyud brgyud we ma spyi mthun rgyal khab dus kyi mun nag spyi tshogs ther 'don byas gshis/ dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs thal 'tshub ltar langs pa dang / kun spyod nyams pa/ 'dre tshogs gar la rol ba/ chab srid rul sungs su gyur pa/ mi dmangs 'tsho thabs bral ba sogs kyi snang tshul ni tag tag hi the le srid khrir 'dzegs pa'i snga nub kyi 'jar man spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo'i khyad chos mtshon pa zhig red/〈chig dgu bco brgyad lo'i zla bcu gcig 〉ces pa'i rol dbyangs gsum ni te pu'u ling gi tshab mtshon brtsams chos yin pa dang / rtsom pa pos 'gran zla bral ba'i smyug rtsal dang / gzhi rgya che ba'i bkod pa/ lo rgyus snyan ngag gi rang bzhin ldan pa bcas kyi sgo nas 1918lo'i 'jar man gyi gsar brje'i brjid ldan rlabs che'i gzugs brnyan bkod nas li pu'u kho ne zhi dang lu'u sin pa'o sogs 'byor med gral rim gyi gtso 'dzin tsho'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri legs 'god byas yod pa dang / ma rtsa ring lugs rtsa med 'gro rgyu de ldog med kyi chos nyid cig yin pa'i lo rgyus kyi brjod bya gtso bo 'bur du btod de/ thengs dang por mes rgyal gyi re ba dang 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul gnyis thad kur zung du 'brel yod pas rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mno bsam nan zhib dang 'tsho ba la ngos 'dzin gsar pa byas yod pa mtshon yod/phyi dus kyi gsar rtsom (1950—1957)dus rim 'dir brtsams chos mngon gsal nyung du song yod/ gal che shos su 〈ha mu'u le the'am mtshan mo ring po mjug rdzogs pa 〉(/956)zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras gcig yod pa de'i brjod bya gtso bo ni/ hpha shi si'i bsam blo'i dug rgyun gtsang sel dang / 496

mi rigs kyi 'du shes dang mi rigs kyi sems khams phyogs nas 'jar man mi rigs kyi khongs mi mi re ngo res thengs 'di'i lo rgyus kyi chag sgo chen po'i nang 'khur 'os pa'i 'gan 'khrir rtog dpyod byas yod pa red/te pu'u ling gi brtsams sgrung gi nyams 'gyur ni sna mang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin zhing / khos mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi thabs rtsal gtso gzugs su byas nas grub mtha' khag gi dge mtshan rgya khyab tu nyams len byas pa dper na/ rtog pa rang yan pa dang / yul dus 'khrug pa/ mtshon rtags gab dpe/ tshul 'chal sgro 'dogs de bzhin zhib 'god legs 'bri'i dngos 'bri'i bya thabs sogs spyad de rang gi mdzes sdug lta bas mi ngom pa'i brtsams sgrung gi ma lag grub par byas so/174 the la khor ni snyan ngag pa ci 'dra zhig red dam/the la khor (1887—1914)ni o si khru'i snyan ngag pa dang mngon mtshon ring lugs snyan tshig khyab khongs nang gi gal 'gangs che ba'i gsar 'byed pa zhig red/ kho pa sar si pa'o ru skyes shing gzhon nu'i dus su sman rdzas rig par dga' zhen che bas sar si pa'o ru lo gsum ring sman rdzas zhib 'jug gi las ka byed myong yod/ /908lo nas /9/0lo'i bar wi en na slob che'i sman rdzas rig pa'i sde khag tu zab sbyong lo gsum byas/ 1912lor dmag skul dang blangs kyis dmag la zhugs te dbyin si su'u lu'u kho'i bca' sdod dmag dpung khongs su sman gnyer dka' bcu pa'i las gnas khur/ /9/4lor 'dzam gling dmag chen dang por zhugs nas 'thab sa shar mar sman rdzas zhib bsher pa'i las 'gan khur/ kho pas dmag 'khrug gi me lce 'ur 'ur 'bar zhing me rdzas kyi du zhag long long 'khrigs pa'i g.yul sa mdun mar bskyod de/ 497

grangs las 'das pa'i mi ro dang / khrag dron rgyu ba'i sdug bsngal/ mi dmangs rnams g.yang sa'i gcong rong du lhung bar byed pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug gis gzhon nu khri stong mang po'i rang srog don med ngang glud rdzas su bsdangs pa bcas kyi gnas tshul mthong bas/ gdug rtsub che la 'jigs snang skye dgos pa'i ngang tshul de dag gi rkyen pas kho pa srog rlung 'khrugs pa lta bur gyur te rang gi rang la me mda' brgyab/ rjes su sman khang nas myur skyob byas pas 'chi nyen las thar/ 'on kyang dmag 'khrug la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'khon 'dzin byed pa'i bsam blo'i rma kha nam yang sos thabs med na/ dmag 'khrug la ngo rgol byed pa'i brjod bya de kho pa'i gsar rtsom gyi nang don gtso bo mi 'gyur ci la srid/the la khor gyis 1904lo nas bzung snyan tshig rtsom 'go tshugs/ 'on kyang 1913lor gzhi nas 〈zhun brdar ba 〉zhes pa'i zla re'i dus deb thog 'grems spel byed 'go btsugs/ kho'i snyan tshig ni phyogs gcig nas per ljam gyi snyan ngag pa me the ling kho dang hpha ran si'i snyan ngag pa lan po yi mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag grub mtha'i shugs rkyen thebs yod pa dang / phyogs gcig nas yang mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi snyan ngag grub mtha'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig red/ kho par 〈rmi lam gyi khrod du gnas pa'i sa'e pa si ti an 〉dang / 〈yul por gnas pa'i ston kha/〉 〈mtshan mo'i glu 〉bcas kyi gal che'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs deb gsum yod pa de dag ni yig 'bru re re bzhin khrag dang / sgra gdangs re re bzhin mig chus bran pa'i skyo snang gi gdung ba'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa sha stag zhig yin zhing /de tshos yid shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug dang 'byor chen gral rim gyi dbang sgyur gyis mi rnams la bzos pa'i tshabs 498

che'i sdug bsngal ther 'don byas pa ma zad/ snyan ngag pa gang de'i mun nag 'khrugs pa'i spyi tshogs khrod du sdug bsngal yod kyang gzhan la shod sa med pa dang / gar 'gro der 'gro med pa'i yi mug gi bsam pa'ang mtshon par byas yod/ snyan tshig mi nyung ba zhig gis ni da dung yid 'ong rmad du byung ba'i tshig lam nas snyan ngag pa gang de'i mdzes sdug ldan pa'i mi che'i phugs bsam dang / zhi bde dang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba spro sems 'khol pos don gnyer byed pa'i bsam pa'i re ba lhug por brjod yod/ 'di ltar dmag 'khrug la 'gog rgol dang / dngos yod kyi sdug bsngal zhu 'bod/ rang dbang don gnyer byed pa/ zhi bder dga' zhing gces pa bcas kyi lte ba'i bsam blo de kho'i brtsams chos hril por bstar la brgyus shing gsar rtsom gyi gzhi rtsa'i brjod bya gtso bor grub yod/the la kho ni sgyu rtsal gyi byang tshad shin tu mtho ba'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin pas khos bris pa'i snyan tshig ni go don gting zab dang / rtsom gshis nyams dang ldan pa/ spro snang rab tu rgyas pa snyan ngag gi bro ba yol gor 'khyil/snyan ngag gi mdzes nyams kyis mig gi dga' ston rdzogs par byed/ khos gzugs bkod bsam gzhigs la'ang do snang lhage par byed pas sbyor dpe legs pa'i blo khams kyi rtog bzor brten nas rang gi sems gting gi brtse dung mngon par mtshon/ rjod tshig re re bzhin tshang ma dmag 'khrug dang 'brel ba med pa ma mchis pa de rnams dka' sdug las mnar dang / nyen 'jigs khri stong gi rnam par bris yod pa red/ khos 'dems 'god byas pa'i go don mtshon byed du rtag tu phyogs bzhir keng rus kyis khengs pa dang /sprin 'thibs smug 'khrigs lta bu'i tshig sbyor ma gtogs drang phyogs nas dmag 'khrugs gi 'jigs snang dang gnod 'tshe sogs kyi skor tshig gcig 499

kyang kha gsal du bton pa med rung / mi rnams kyi mig lam du skyi g.ya' ba'i khor yug de dag shar na/ sems khong skyo gdung gis non zhing btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug ni mi'i rigs la sngar na ma grags pa'i god chag tshabs chen bzos pa zhig yin pas khong khro gting nas skye bar byed/'on kyang khos mi che'i phugs bsam dang bde skyid kyi skor 'bri skabs/ rnam 'gyur ngo mtshar che la zhi dul mdzes sdug ldan pa'i go don mtshon byed kyi tshig sbyor spyad de mi rnams kyi blo mos yid smon dang dung sems wa ler 'phyur ba zhig bzo gi yod/ the la khor gyis da dung sna mang can gyi sgyu rtsal thabs rtsal la brten nas snyan tshig gi mtshon shugs je cher gtong ba ste/ mtshon rtags kyi bya thabs 'bor chen spyad pa phud da dung rtag tu nyin re'i mthong snang chung ba'i dpar ngos su sna mang 'dres 'dzing dpyod par dka' ba'i gnyid lab dang rmi lam 'phrul snang gi thabs rtsal 'dres sbyor byed pa des snyan tshig gi go don de bas rgya che zhing dpog dka' ba zhig tu gyur pa bcas/ mdor na kho pa'i snyan tshig gis deng rabs 'jar man skad kyi rtsom rig la shugs rkyen shin tu gting zab sprad yod do/175 we hpher ni snyan ngag pa ci 'dra zhig red dam/hphu lan tshi we hpher (1890—1945)ni ce khe'i grags can snyan ngag pa dang mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi thog ma'i gsar 'byed pa'i gas shig red/ kho'i gsar rtsom gyis 'jar man skad kyi rtsom rig la shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs yod/we hpher ni grong khyer phu rag gi bzo grwa'i bdag po zhig gi khyim du skyes 500

shing gzhon nu'i dus nas mngon mtshon smra ba'i snyan ngag pa zhig gi ngos nas rtsom rig las rigs thog rang gi shes rtsal ngom 'go tshugs/ lo bcu bdun du son skabs wi en na 〈dus rabs tshags par 〉gyi zhor 'god rtsom tshan thog snyan tshig ang dang po 〈phu rag grong khyer gyi me tog ldum ra 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas/ 191/lor snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs ang dang po 〈'dzam gling gi grogs po 〉zhes pa 'grems spel byas rjes de 'phral ming grags 'phel/kho'i gtso bo'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs kyi gras su 〈nga tsho 〉(1913)dang /〈rang gzhan/〉(1915) 〈'dri gcod kyi nyin mo 〉(1919)zhes pa sogs yod/snyan tshig gi gzhi rtsa'i brjod bya gtso bo ni mi'i kun spyod dang 'gan 'khrir rtog 'jug byed pa de red/ snyan ngag pas bsam pa dag cing spro sems 'khol pos kho par sdug bsngal bzo ba'i gnad don gyi dris lan 'tshol gyin yod la/ brjod bya mi 'dra ba'i thog nas bsam blo rdog rdog gcig yang skor skyar skor gyis mtshon par byed pa ste/ rang nyid kyi bya spyod de nges par du sems bzang gi gdams par bstun dgos zhes pa de red/ 'di'i thog nas kun spyod thad kyi sems bzang zhes pa de kun las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gnas su bzhag yod pa mthong thub/ snyan ngag pa gang des phyogs gcig nas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi don dngos la khong khro drag po byed cing kun spyod nyams pa dang / mi gshis ngan rul du gyur pa la sems gting nas ci drags snyam pa'i sems phral byed/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis mi gshis kyi bden bzang mdzes gsum don gnyer byed kyi yod/khos gting zab kyi mi chos ring lugs kyi brtse dung bcangs te btsan rgyal ring lugs dmag 'khrug gi sdig nyes zhu 'bod byed pa'i dmag 'khrug skor gyi snyan tshig mi nyung ba zhig 'bri myong yod mod/ 'on kyang snyan tshig de dag gis 501

dmag 'khrug gi phyi gnas 'phel tshad bris pa shin tu nyung ngur zad kyi mang che ba ni nyes rgu tshang ba'i dmag 'khrug gis mi'i sems gting du bzhag pa'i rma kha'i na zug 'bri rgyur shugs snon brgyab pa de red/ kho'i sor rtse las byung ba'i brtsams chos nang dmag 'khrug ni sha rus rtsa thor 'gro ba'i dmar gsod cig ma yin la 'dam rdzab kyi 'thab 'obs dang gdug rtsub che ba'i drag shugs shig tu'ang mtshon par byas pa ma yin par/ dmag 'khrug ni sems nang gi dngangs 'tshab che ba'i rmi lam dang / mi'i rigs kyi thun mong dang yongs khyab kyi kun spyod nyams pa'i sgyu ma'i dran 'phrul zhig tu bris yod/ khos nan bshad byed pa ni dmag 'khrug gis mi chos la rgol ba'i rang gshis de yin gshis/ des rkyen pas mi'i rigs kyi gdung sems mnyam skye dang mdza' grogs snying rje'i bsam pa shor zhing mi'i rigs gcen gcung ltar mthun pa'i re ba yod tshad nyams te mi rnams ni dud 'gro ltar ya nga snying rje bral ba'i sger sems can zhig tu gyur par 'dod/ 'di lta bu'i spyi mtshan gyi char gtogs pa'i kun spyod la rtog 'jug byas pa des btsan rgyal ring lugs dmag 'khrug gi gral rim ngo bor 'gebs srung byas pas der dge mtshan mi ldan pa'i bag chags nges can ldan yod/we hpher gyi snyan tshig gi nyams 'gyur ni sbyor bde don gsal zhi zhing dul ba dang / go don ni snyan 'jebs phun sum tshogs shing cha 'tsham pa bcas yin pa'i khrod nas rtag tu sems sdug yid skyo'i ngang tshul zhig mngon gyi yod/snyan tshig gis da dung dpe mtshon du gyur pa'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rtsom tshul yang mtshon par byas la/ snyan tshig hril por snyan ngag pa gang des nan bshad byed pa'i rang ngos kyi spro snang rab 'phel gyi rnam pas spud de/dza drag che la brtse dung gis gtams pa'i ngang tshul khrod du rtsom pa po rang nyid 502

kyi mthong thos rnams yid dbang 'phrog pa'i tshig sbyor gyi lam nas drangs yod/'di ltar byas pas/ kho'i sor rtse las thon pa'i ri dang chu/ rtswa dang shing /lang tsho dang yid 'ong ma/ bgrang bya'i khur gyis lci ba'i rgas po bcas tshang mar rang ngos brtse dung gi khyad chos zab mos bcings par gyur/ 'on kyang kho'i brtsams chos khrod du spyir btang gi mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi brtsams chos dang mi 'dra bar smyo ba lta bu'i skad cor med la/ re zad 'jigs skrag gi rnam pas khengs pa'i tshig sbyor yang med par sems sdug dang / zhi dul/yid skyo ba lta bu tsam gyi brjod stangs kyi thog nas 'tshab 'tshub med par klog pa por kho'i tshad med kyi mya ngan bsam pa brjod par byed pa des/ mi rnams la byams brtse zol med dang / 'grogs bde gshib bde'i tshor snang zhig sbyin pa ma zad 'di 'dra'i zol med dngos tshor gyi bya thabs brgyud klog pa po'i yid dbang rab tu 'phrog par byed/we hpher gyis da dung mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar 'khrab gzhung yang mi nyung ba zhig bris yod pa'i nang tshab mtshon brtsams chos ni 〈the lo ya'i bud med 〉(/913)dang 〈me long khrod kyi mi 〉(1920)zhes pa gnyis red/rtsom pa pos zlos gar rigs kyi khrod du spyi mtshan du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i skor gyi gnad don gyi dris lan 'tshol zhib byas yod pa de dag bden par grub pa'i da lta'i dngos yod dang rgyang thag ring po yod pa red/ der brten mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i spyi mtshan gyi snying bsdus don gnyer byed pa'i re 'dod tsam las mtshon thub med/gtam rgyud kyi dus tshod gsal la ma gsal dang / sa gnas mtshams sbyor bya rgyu rab rib/ spro sems rab 'phel gyi rjod tshig dang ya mtshan kyag kyog che la tshig mkhregs rtogs dka'i shugs bstan go don gnyis mnyam bsres byas 503

pas mi rnams kyis de bas dpyod par dka' ba zhig yod do/176 〈'dzam gling gi grogs po 〉zhes pa'i nang don gang red dam/1911lor par du bskrun pa'i 〈'dzam gling gi grogs po 〉zhes pa de ni ce kho'i snyan ngag pa we hpher gyi tshab mtshon brtsams chos red la/ mngon mtshon ring lugs snyan tshig gi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i brtsams chos kyi gras shig kyang red/ brtsams chos hril po'i dbyangs rta gtso bo ni mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi gzhi rtsa'i brjod bya gtso bo de yin te/ nus shugs yod rgyas mi dang mi'i bar dang / mi dang spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba'i khrod kyi gting zab la 'byung la khad du slebs pa'i nyams nyen las thar ba bya rgyu dang / nub phyogs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba skyel stangs skyob thabs med pa'i ngan rul gyi phyogs su bskyod zin pa dang mi'i rigs hril po 'gro lam med pa'i g.yang sar lhungs te sngar med kyi god chag chen po mgo thog tu 'bab bzhin yod pa gsal ston byed pa de red/ de'i bsam blo'i nang don gsham gsal phyogs 'ga' zhig las mngon pa ste/thog mar/ snyan ngag pas gnad la 'phigs pa'i sgo nas ma rtsa ring lugs kyi gser dngul gyi stobs shugs las spyi tshogs rul sungs su 'gyur bar byas pa ste/ gser dngul dang ma rtsa zer ba'i gri dngo rnon po de'i 'ogami dang mi'i bar gyi srol rgyun gyi mthun sbyor 'brel ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar mi snang bar gyur nas lhag lus su yod pa ni dmar rjen gyi khe gyong gdong gtug te nyid yin pa ther 'don byas yod/ khos 〈shel gyi rtsig pa 〉sogs 504

snyan tshig gi khrod du deng rabs 'dzam gling gi skyo gar gtso bo ni/ mi rnams skyob thabs med pa dang / ya nga snying rje med la mi dang mi'i bar phan tshun kha bral nas yod pa de red ces yang skor skyar skor gyis bshad yod/ kho'i snyan tshig gi mngon par gsal ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi thog nas mi dang mi'i bar skad brda mi 'phrod pa dang / bsam blo mi mthun pa/ brtse dung mi gcig pa bcas phan tshun bar ‘‘shel gyi rtsig pa ’ gcig min gnyis min du bslangs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi tshabs che'i nyams nyen 'bri 'god byas yod/ snyan rtsom de tsho'i khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo ni phru gu rnams kyis brjod pa'i a ma dang / g.yo zol can gyi phyogs dor ba'i skyes dman/ lam 'gro ma rgyugs pa'i mi che'i bshul lam gyi khrod du dka' sdug gi tshe mjug skyel mkhan rgas po bcas yin zhing / 'di lta bu'i bkra ma shis pa dang / spyi tshogs kyis brjed pa/dka' sdug yod rgu myong mkhan mi rnams ni 'tsho ba'i bar chad ji snyed kyi rkyen pas ma mtha'i lto gos kyi 'gan srung tsam la'ang dka' ngal sna tshogs 'phrad kyin yod na/ rang nyid kyi phugs re dang bsam 'dun mngon 'gyur yong ba zer ba ni de bas gleng thabs ga la yod/ kun spyod phyogs yong nas nyam smad du gyur pa dang / mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel bar phyogs yongs nas gzhan 'gyur gyi rnam pa thon pa 'di ni tag tag deng rabs ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs nang gi mthong ba tsam gyis hang sangs dgos pa dang / thos pa tsam gyis 'jigs snang skye dgos pa'i dus rabs kyi skyo gar de red/〈〈'dzam gling gi grogs po 〉zhes pa'i nang don gzhan zhig ni rlabs chen dang 'od zer ldan pa'i mi gshis la bstod glu phul te/ sems bzang kun spyod ni 'dzam gling skyob byed mchog tu gyur pa'i gnyen por bstan pa de red/kho'i 〈khyed kyis gsan dang 〉zhes pa dang / 〈'dzam gling gi grogs po 〉 505

zhes pa'i snyan tshig khrod du snyan ngag pa gang des mi rnams kyis sdig nyes kyi 'dam rdzab nang nas mig cher gdangs te de snga'i rgyun ldan rang bzhin can gyi brtse dung dang bde skyid/ 'gan 'khri dang sems bzang bcas slar gso bya dgos shing de'ang dang thog bzang ngan legs nyes byed pa'i lta ba slar gso byas nas kun spyod dar 'phel yong thabs kyi re 'bod byas yod/ snyan ngag pa gang des rang nyid ‘‘kun spyod kyi grogs po mi’zhig tu brtsis te sems rtsa 'khol pos bzang bar yid smon dang / 'dzam gling steng gi mi yod do cog spun mched ltar mdza' mthun yong ba'i re smon byed kyin yod/ khos mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas 4‘nga ni khyed kyi red/ nga ni tshang ma'i red/ nga tshos phan tshun gcen gcung ltar gces na/ rkang btsugs nga rang la kha gtad gcog rgyu'i bsam blo ma gtong / gal te nam nyi ma zhig la nga tsho phan tshun dpung pa brkyangs nas 'tham 'khyud bya rgyu byung na de 'dra'i legs pa la ang mi’zhes glu dbyangs btang /snyan ngag pa gang des da dung spro snang bag phebs ldan pa'i rtsom nyams dang mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i khyad chos kyi thog nas gser 'od 'phro ba'i byis pa'i dus skabs kyi gnas tshul 'bri 'god byas yod/ brtse ba dang bzang bas khengs pa'i ma bcos byis pa'i sems kyi 'jig rten khrod du mi rnams phan tshun gces shing dga' ba dang / phugs bsam ni mngon 'gyur yong thabs med pa shes nas smag rum mun 'khrigs lta bur gyur pa de 'dra ma yin pa/ 'dir g.yo len ham 'phrog med la gser dngul gyi btsog sgrib kyang med pa/ 'dir yod pa ni gzhung drang bcos min gyi rol rtsed dang lhad med byis blo'i brtse dung rnams yin te 44khyod chung dus 'phrul mdar rtsed mo rtsed myong ngam/ shing gi spor tog dang 'khur thag ljang khu bsgar ba'i me 506

mda' yod dam/ me mda'i skam par skyon btang myong ngam/ nga gzhas gtong gin mno bsam la rtse gcig rol ba'i skabs khyod kyis kyang nga dang 'dra bar ngus shig de 'dra'i sems pa mkhregs po ma byed/’ mdor na snyan rtsom de dag gis mi chos ring lugs kyi spro sems zab mos mi'i rigs kyi gcen gcung lta bu'i mthun sbyor 'brel ba dang / bzang ba dang mdzes pa'i 'od zer ldan pa'i 'byung 'gyur la blo kha phyogs yod/ der spyi tshogs kyi don snying de tsam zab mi srid na'ang mi tshos ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dngos yod la bcangs pa'i 'khon sems spel bar byed pas na yar thon gyi don snying nges can ldan yod do//7྅ ha'e mu'u ni snyan ngag pa ci 'dra zhig red dam/ha'e mu'u ni (/887—/9/2)'jar man mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa grags can zhig red/ kho pa zhi li zhi ya'i zhib dpyod dpon zhig gi khyim du skyes shing na gzhon dus su per lin du slob grwa chung 'bring thon rjes we er tshi pa'o dang / ye na/ per lin bcas sa gnas su khrims lugs slob sbyong byas/ /9/1lor 'os sgug 'dri gcod pa'i las 'gan khur/ de'i ring mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi rig gzhung mkhas pa lu'u pi na dang zlos gar ba thu'o le sogs dang 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba dam zab byung ba ma zad snyan tshig gsar rtsom gyi bya ba'i 'go brtsams/ 19/2lo'i dgun khar per lin grong 'dabs ha hphur gtsang po'i thog 'khyags shud glod skabs mi zhig 'khyags dong du lhungs pa mthong nas de ma thag zhum pa med par 'khyags dong du mchongs te nus shugs yod rgus mi de skyob par song yang mtha' ma gzugs po 'khyags rengs thebs shing lus stobs zad pas rkyen lam du shor ba red/507

skabs der kho pa lo nyi shu rtsa lnga las son med/ha'e mu'u ni 'jar man snga dus mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi snyan ngag grub mtha'i tshab mtshon mi sna gtso bo zhig yin pa dang kho'i snyan ngag la mtshon rtags ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa po te la'e er dang / lan po/ ko a'o er ko bcas kyi shugs rkyen zab mo phog pas/ mtshon rtags dang rmi lam sgyu ma'i bya thabs phon che spyad de rang gi snyan 'jebs don zab kyi rang snang brtse sems mtshon pa byed kyi yod/ kho 'tsho sdod skabs par du bskrun pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs gcig rang yod pa ni 〈mi 'gyur ba'i nyin gcig 〉(/9/ /)zer ba de yin zhing / grongs tshar ba'i rjes su slar yang 〈'tsho ba'i grib ma 〉(/9/2)zhes pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs gcig par du bskrun pa dang / ring min dmag chen gyi god chag 'byung nges pa ma 'ong lung du bstan pa'i grags can snyan rtsom 〈dmag 'khrug 〉〉ces pa zhig kyang bsdu rub byas yod/bsam blo'i nang don thad/ dmag 'khrug dang / drag shugs/ gnya' gnon sogs la 'gog rgol gyi ngar shugs shugs che mtshon pa dang / rtag tu grong khyer chen po'i 'tsho ba dang / dmag 'khrug co brlag sogs skabs der mi rnams kyis do snang che shos byed pa'i gnad don brjod byar bzung ste dran skyen blo rnos 'tsho ba'i brjod don 'dzin pa dang / 'gangs che'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don rab dang rim par 'phral mar rang gi lta stangs brjod kyi yod/ kho'i snyan rtsom las 'byor 'bring gral rim shes yon can gyi bsam blo'i phyogs lhung mtshon pa ste/ dmangs gtsor re smon dang mi tshe'i mthun sbyor dang brtan lhing yong re byed pa dang chabs cig sger sdem 'byor ldan gral rim gyi sger gcod dbang sgyur la sun 'byin gyis ma rtsa ring lugs spyi 508

tshogs khrod kyi mi'i 'jigs snang dang / mgo rmongs/ re chad bcas kyi bsam pa mtshon par byed/ khos rtag tu tha shal gyi dma' rim ar khang dang /ljan ljin gyis sbags pa'i dbul po'i sdod gnas/ khu sim 'gul med du gnas pa'i dur sa/ 'jigs skrag skyi g.ya' dgos pa'i btson khang sogs mi sdug pa'i 'tsho ba'i ljongs bkod de rnams 'god 'bri byed par brten nas rang gi mya ngan gyi bsam pa mtshon thabs dang / mun nag spyi tshogs la bcangs pa'i 'khon sems 'don thabs byed kyi yod/ha'e mu'u ni shes rig 'gran zla bral zhing grub 'bras phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin pas/ khos brjid nyams che la don legs tshig snyan gyi gna' dpe'i snyan ngag nyams 'gyur dang 'ching med rang dbang ldan la bab bstun 'gyur ldog mang ba'i deng rabs ring lugs kyi snyan tshig thabs rtsal gnyis zung du sbrel te/ rang gi snyan 'jebs don zab dang / bkod legs spus dag khams dwangs mdzes sdug bcas kyi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gsar gtod byas/ kho'i snyan tshig gi rtsom lus kyi tshig sbyor gral snyom zhing ngar nyams dod la go rgyu zab pa dang / mtshar sdug ya mtshan che ba'i bsam bkod bcas dang ldan pa ma zad/ skyo shas kyi nyams snang dang 'chi ba'i sngon tshor sogs kyis spud pa'i nang tshul 'chal dang / mtshon rtags/ gab dpe/yul dus 'khrugs pa sogs kyi sgyu rtsal rnam pa snol spel byas pas 'gyur bas gtams pa'i don legs tshig snyan dang / tha mal pa'i ngang tshul las 'das pa'i grung sha dod pa'i rnam pa zhig mngon gyi yod/ha'e mu'u yis dang dung brtsams sgrung 'ga' zhig kyang bris yod cing /kho'i brtsams sgrung 'bring gras phyogs bsdus 〈rkun po 〉zhes pa ni kho'i snyan tshig las kyang de bas mngon gsal dod pa'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi khyad 509

chos ldan pa zhig red/ khos mi sna ya ma gzugs sna tshogs bdams te brtsams sgrung gi mi sna gtso bor bzung nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi khungs med skyug bro ba'i ngang tshul ther 'don byed pa dang dus mtshungs/ spyi tshogs mun nag dang goms srol ngan par snying nas 'dzin pa'i rang ngos kyi khro sems mtshon par byed pa bcas so/78 po en ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/pe en (/886—1956)ni 'jar man gyi grags can mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa zhig red/ kho pa /886lo'i zla 5tshes 2nyin ye shu'i chos 'chad pa zhig gi khyim du skyes shing mar pa'o dang per len du lha rig pa dang sgra rig pa slob sbyong byed myong / /905lor ched las bsgyur te gso rig slob sbyong byas gshis 1912lor slob grwa thon rjes per lin du sman pa byas nas bsdad/ dus skabs de'i ring kho pa dang per lin gyi mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom pa po'i bar 'brel 'dris dam zab byung thog gsar rtsom gyi bya ba'i 'go brtsams/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i ring dmag khongs su sman pa'i las gnas khur zhing dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril rjes slar yang per lin du sman pa byas/ 932lor phu'u lu'u hri sgyu rtsal khang gi yon hri la bdams thon byung / 1933lor khos hi the le hpha shi si srid dbang la rgyab skyor bya rgyu'i gsal bsgrags spel/ 'on kyang ring min hpha shi si'i drag shugs kyi bya spyod la 'dod pa mi rangs pa'i rkyen gyis rim bzhin na tshu'i srid dbang dang 'brel thag ring du song / /936lor 〈〈snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes pa par du bskrun pa'i nang drag shugs la 'khon 'dzin dang zhi bde'i 'tsho bar re smon byed pa'i bsam tshul mngon yod pas/ hpha shi si ring lugs pa'i rgol 510

rdung dang ngan smras phog pa ma zad lo der kho pa sman pa dka' bcu pa'i mthun tshogs las phyir 'bud byas shing tshabs che'i gnod 'tshe rab dang rim pa phog pa'i rkyen gyis rtsom 'bri mtshams 'jog mi bya mthu med byung / 1945lor hpha shi si'i stobs shugs rtsa med song bas lo bcu phrag gcig ring go med tshor med du gyur pa'i pe en gyis slar yang smyu gu lag tu thogs te gsar rtsom gyi bya ba'i 'du 'god la zhugs/ lo rabs lnga bcu'i nang yo rob nub mar kho'i brtsams chos dar khyab chen po byung ba ma zad/ gdeng 'jog kyang nyin bzhin je mthor song yod/pe en gyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs gtso bo khag lnga yod cing /912lor par du bskrun pa'i 〈bam ro dang de min 〉zhes pa de ni sman khang gi nad pa dang bam ro brjod byar byas pa zhig red/ brtsams chos der mun pa 'thibs pa lta bu'i 'jigs skrag gi khyad chos ldan la mi yul la zhen log dang re zad kyi bsam blo'i rnam pas khengs shing / mi tshe ni rmi lam ltar rin thang dang don snying til 'bru tsam yang med na 'chi rgyu 'ba' zhig da gzod dngos 'brel gyi thar pa yin pa'i dril bsgrags byas pa dang / snyan tshig shog grangs re re bzhin tshang mar 'dzam gling gi mtha' mjug nyin mor gtug grabs yod skor gyi nyams smad kyi bsam blo sim yod/ /9/7lor par du bskrun pa'i 〈sha 〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs der 'chi ba dang don stong gi brjod bya gtso bo mu mthud rgya skyed byas yod pa ma zad/ dmag 'khrug ni mi'i rigs kyi ldog tu med pa'i god chag cig tu ngos 'dzin byas yod/ snyan ngag pa gang des phyogs gcig nas dmag 'khrug gi khrag dri bro ba'i sdig nyes la zhe 'khon 'dzin pa dang / yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas dmag 'khrug ni mi'i rigs kyi g.yol thabs med pa'i las dbang dang thar 511

thabs med pa'i bka' chad lta bur ngos 'dzin byas pa bcas/ mdor na 〈sha 〉zhes pas snyan ngag pa gang de'i 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i mno sems dang dran gso mtshon par byas yod//936lor par bskrun byas pa'i 〈snyan ngag 'dems sgrig 〉〉ces par dus rabs kyi khyad chos zab mo ldan zhing snyan ngag pa gang des skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don la bsam zhib dang gdeng 'jog byas pa thad mar mtshon yod/ snyan ngag pas mi chos ring lugs kyi langs phyogs thog langs te mngon sum 'dzem med ngang dmag 'khrugs dang drag shugs/ mis mi la gnya' gnon gtong ba'i skyug bro ba'i snang tshul yod tshad bcas la 'khon 'dzin gyi rnam 'gyur gsal ston byas pa ma zad/ skyid sa gtsang ma spar ba gang yang med ces 'jar man gyi dngos yod rul sungs dang tha shal la rno ngar chen pos tshig mtshon btab par brten/ kho par hpha shi si'i stobs shugs kyi rdung rdeg dang gnod 'tshe phog lo rabs lnga bcu par bris pa'i 〈rlangs sgyur dwangs 'byed 〉(1953)dang 〈mjug dbyangs 〉(/955)zhes pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs gnyis kyang brjod bya gtso bo don stong dang 'chi ba'i thog tu bskyar log gis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs khrod shes yon can gyi yul po dang / 'jigs snang / mgo rmongs/ spyi tshogs mun nag dang goms srol ngan par sdang sems 'chang ba bcas kyi rnyog 'dzing che ba'i bsam pa mtshon yod/pe en gyi snyan tshig ni skyo snang sems sbug dog pa'i nyams 'gyur ldan zhing 'jig rten khams dang mi che'i skor gyi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis phyug pa zhig red/ khos rtag tu nyam zhan gyi khyad chos dang skyug bro ba'i blo khams la brten nas don stong dang 'chi ba'i brjod bya gtso bo de mtshon par byed pa 512

dang / kho'i brtsams chos kyi khrod nas mi rnams kyis mthong ba ni gson nyams bral ba'i grong khyer chen po'i spyi tshogs dang / gnag sems 'dod rngam che la ma rabs tha shal dang sdig nyes kyi 'obs ring du lhung nas yar don mi thub pa'i mi khag gcig de bzhin sdug bsngal dang re zad thor zhig dang 'chi ba bcas kyi gnas tshul yin pa red/ khos mtshon rtags dang rmi lam sgyu ma'i bya thabs shugs che spyad de shi ro dang rus dkar gyis don stong mi tshe'i mtshon rtags dang / lce 'bab dang rlung dmar gyis dmag 'khrug dang zhi bde'i mtshon rtags byed pa 'di lta bus brtsams chos hril por mngon chung kyag kyog gi tshor snang zhig sbyin te lkog gyur ring lugs kyi khyad chos ldan par byas/ rjod byed brda chad thad tshig nyung don gsal gtsor bzung thog da dung ched spyod tha snyad dang grong tshig 'ga' re'ang bar bsnan byas pa bcas kyis/ brag ri g.yang gzar gyi steng du gnas pa'i lteng ka las 'bab pa'i chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra bar dwangs shing gsal la thogs pa med pa zhig yod pa red/ deng rabs 'jar man gyi snyan ngag las rigs la kho'i snyan tshig nyams 'gyur gyi bag chags zab mo thebs yod/179 zlos gar gyi khyab khongs nang mngon mtshon ring lugs la grub 'bras ji 'dra thob yod dam/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i stod char yo rob dang a me ri kha gling sogs su dar khyab che ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs rtsom rig gi bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun gyi grub 'bras gtso bo de brtsams sgrung dang zlos gar gsar rtsom thad thob yod/su'e ten gyi rtsom pa po si the ling pa'o yi dus phyi'i gsar rtsom gyis 513

mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi thog ma'i srol phye/ snga dus kho pa dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom pa po zhig yin pa dang / dus phyis deng rabs ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen gting zab phog ste rmi lam gyi snang tshul dang 'phrul snang gi yul khams shugs cher bris/ kho'i 〈ta ma hri kor bskyod pa 〉〉(/897—/904)zhes pa'i rol dbyangs gsum ni mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i brtsams chos red/ brtsams chos de'i don rkyen byung rim ni kha thor ya bral zhig yin pa dang / mi sna'i gnyid lab dang 'phrul snang gis gar stegs kyi lte ba'i gnas bab bzung ste ‘ 'gal ba'i thod gtug med na zlos gar med ’ dgos pa'i srol rgyun gyi rig gzhung yongs su bskyur nas gtso bo mi'i rang ngos kyi rtog pa dang rang snang gi tshor ba mtshon pa byed pa dang / zlos gar gyi don rkyen byung rim dang mi sna'i bya spyod kyi khungs sne tshang ma mngon gsal dod pos nyung 'phri byas te shin tu phal pa'i gnas bab tu bzhag yod/ kho'i brtsams chos gzhan zhig ste 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉zhes pa de'i rnam pa ni de bas khungs lung med pa zhig yin te/ brtsams chos der mi shi ro dang / mi gson po/ rnam shes/'phrul snang bcas tshang ma dus gcig tu gar stegs thog 'dzegs shing skad cor rgyag pa dang / phan tshun ngan smras kha rtsod dang tshig mtshon 'debs pa bcas kyis khungs med ya mtshan che ba'i khyad chos mngon gyi yod/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi nus ldan brtsams chos zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung 'di gnyis kyis mngon gsal dod pos ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod mi rnams kyi yul po dang god chag 'phrul snang dang 'jigs skrag gi tshor ba mtshon pa dang / mi'i rang ngos kyi bsam pa de tshor yod thogs yod kyi sgyu rtsal gyi gzugs brnyan zhig tu phyi bsgyur byas te ma rtsa ring lugs kyi gser dngul 5/4

stobs shugs kyis kha lo bsgyur pa'i 'og gi mi'i sems gting gi skyug bro ba'i tha shal gyi re 'dod sna tshogs ther 'don byas pa ma zad/ mthong ba tsam gyis hang sangs dgos pa'i rnam pa'i thog nas mi rnams kyi mig mdun du bshams yod/'jar man la 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i rjes su mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar gang myur gra rgyas kyi phyogs su bskyod nas kha'e sa dang /thu'o ler/ pa la he bcas phul du byung ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar ba gsum thon yod/ kha'e sa (/878—/945)ni g.yon phyogs mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi ches phul byung gi tshab byed mi sna yin pa dang / kho'i gsar rtsom ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'jar man gyi zlos gar lo rgyus thog gal 'gangs che ba'i lam tshad rdo ring zhig red/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar nang 'di pa'i 'khrab gzhung gi 'khrab ston grangs 'bor mang shos zin gyi yod/ kho'i mi tshe gang por khyon sdom 'khrab gzhung drug cu lhag tsam dang 'khrab tshan rkyang pa'i dgod bro'i zlos gar bdun bcas gsar rtsom byas yod pa'i nang gtso bo'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos kyi gras su 〈zhogs pa nas nam dgung bar 〉zhes pa dang / 〈byu ru 〉rol dbyangs gsum/ 〈la si gcig〉 (wa si gnyis/〉 de bzhin chos lugs kyi lkog gyur zlos gar 〈dmyal ba 'gro lam ——mi yul 〉zhes pa'i rol dbyangs gsum bcas yod pa de dag gis rtsom pa po gang des ma rtsa ring lugs kyi don dngos la 'gog rgol byed pa'i khro sems rab tu mtshon yod pa ma zad/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi gser dngul 'brel bas bzos pa'i tshabs che'i sdig nyes ther 'don gting zab byas yod/ yang zlos gar ba gzhan zhig ste en si ze thu'o ler (1893—/939)zhes pa ni de bas drag skyod che ba'i g.yon gzhogs kyi langs phyogs 5/5

ldan pa zhig red/ khos 〈'pho 'gyur 〉dang / 〈sgor dang mang tshogs/〉 〈'phrul 'khor gtor mkhan/〉 〈thab me bsad pa/〉 〈bcings 'grol thob pa 'i a'o than 〉sogs phul byung brtsams 'bras rab dang rim pa'i nang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug la rgol gtam shugs che sgrog pa dang /sgor dung phyur mang po'i 'byor bdag gi gser sgor gyis kha lo bsgyur pa'i lam lugs la sun 'byin/ hpha shi si ring lugs kyi khrag dri bro ba'i drag spyod ther 'don bcas byas pa ma zad/ mngon sum 'dzem med ngang mi dmangs kyi 'gog rgol la bstod glu 'bul ba dang / sems rtsa 'khol pos rlabs che'i gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub kyi 'bod skul bcas byas te me ltar tsha ba'i gsar brje'i spro sems mtshon par byas yod/ khos spro sems 'di rigs thal drags pa'i phyogs su bskul stabs mi sna dang don rkyen byung rim tshang ma shin tu lkog gyur du grub cing srid don dpyad gtam gyi bro ba zab mo ldan pa zhig tu gyur yod/ pa la ho yang skabs de'i skad grags che ba'i 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa po zhig yin pa dang / kho'i brtsams chos kyis chos lugs kyi 'du shes zab mo mngon yod la/ brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo tshang ma rang rlom khengs dregs che la rta rkyang mi rkyang gis spyi tshogs la 'gog rgol byed mkhan rang don ring lugs kyi dpa' bo sha stag yin zhing tshab mtshon brtsams chos su 〈chu log chen po 〉dang / 〈po er sngon po 〉zer ba sogs yod/ce khe'i cha phe khos (1890—1938)kyang mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar la legs skyes chen po phul yod/ khos thengs dang por zlos gar gsar rtsom nang tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'char snang drangs te zlos gar gyi brjod bya dang mtshon bya'i khyab khongs rgya cher btang yod/ kho'i 〈spyod go mang ba'i 'phrul chas kyi mi 〉dang 〈dkar po'i nad 〉ces pa tshang ma skabs shig ring 5/6

ming grags shin tu che ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi nus ldan brtsams chos red/a ri'i a'o nyir (/888—1953)ni mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi snying bcud gcig bsdus byed mkhan sgyu rtsal pa chen po zhig yin zhing //936lor no per bya dga' thob/ kho'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos 〈gnam mtha'i phyi rol 〉dang 〈spu ring spra/〉 〈rgyal po chung si 〉zer ba sogs kyis mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar de chu tshad gsar pa zhig tu 'phel rgyas btang yod/mdor na mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi zlos gar de dus rabs 'di'i dus 'gor dar 'go tshugs nas lo rabs sum cu par khyon yongs nas nyams rgud du song yo/da/ de'i ring yo rob dang a me ri kha gling gi rgyal khab khag la lo nyi shu lhag tsam ring dar khyab byung ste si the ling pa'o dang / cha phe kho/ a'o nyir lta bu'i 'dzam gling du grags pa che ba'i zlos gar gyi mkhas dbang thon yod cing kho tsho'i gsar rtsom gyis 'dzam gling gi zlos gar lo rgyus thog le'u gsar pa zhig bsnan yod/ kho tshos srol rgyun gyi zlos gar lta bar sgyur bkod dang / mngon mtshon smra bas tshur snang smra ba'i tshab byas te gtso bo mi'i rigs kyi gting zab tu gnas pa'i rtog pa'i grub cha'i khrod kyi rtog pa med pa dang rtog pa 'og 'gyu sngog 'don dang / mi sna'i nang sems 'jig rten de mdzes sdug bkrag mdangs che la rnam mang phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu mtshon par byas yod/ kho tshos zlos gar gyi don rkyen byung rim nyung 'phri dang zlos gar gyi 'gal ba thod gtug gi nus pa nyams zhan du btang nas spyi'i gar stegs kyi phan nus la bsam gzhigs bya rgyur gcigs 'dzin byas te gar stegs kyi bzo bkod dang / 'khrab ljongs kyi sgrig sbyor/ glog 'od kyi 517

phan nus/ rol dbyangs dang 'khrab chas bcas mngon gsal dod po'i gnas bab tu bzhag pa 'di thams cad kyis zlos gar gyi mtshon byed bya thabs dang mtshon byed thabs rtsal phun sum je tshogs dang 'phel rgyas su btang yod do//80 si the ling pa'o ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/a'o si the ling pa'o (/849 —/9/2)ni su'e ten deng rabs zlos gar sgyu rtsal thad kyi mkhas dbang zhig dang mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi rlabs che'i sngon byon pa zhig red/ brtsams 'bras mang ba'i rtsom pa po 'dis mi tshe gang por zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung dang brtsams sgrung drug cu lhag tsam bris nas 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi nor mdzod nang 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nor rdzas khag gcig bsnan yod/si the ling pa'o ni si thog khor mo'i gru gzings khe 'tshong rgyag mkhan khyim tshang zhig tu skyes shing /867lor wu'u phu'u sa la slob grwa chen mor yig rgyugs 'phrod/ rjes su slob grwa chung ba'i dge rgan dang / tshags par khang gi gsar 'gyur 'god po/ gong ma tshang dpe mdzod khang gi bdag gnyer bcas kyi las gnas 'khur/ /870lor gsar rtsom byas pa'i zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung 〈rgyang 'bud 'khel mi 〉zhes pa der rgyal thog bco lnga pa kha er gyis gzengs bstod thob rjes de ma thag ming grags 'phel/ kho'i gsar rtsom de dus skabs gsum du 'byed chog pa ste/snga dus kyi gsar rtsom ( 886lo'i sngon du )la mtha' dpyod dngos yod ring lugs kyi dus skabs zer zhing kho'i gsar rtsom ni su'e ten mtha' dpyod dngos yod ring lugs rtsom rig gi ches mtho'i grub 'bras ldan par bkur gyi 5/8

yod/ khos chab srid thad stong bsam spyi tshogs ring lugs la mos bkur dang / thal bskyod kyi lta ba'i thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs mun nag gi don dngos la sun 'byin/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi bzang brdzu dang tha shal gyi spyod ngan ther 'don bcas byed kyi yod/ sgyu rtsal thad kho par ti keng si dang thu'o er si tha'e yi shugs rkyen zab mo phog yod/ kho'i tshab mtshon brtsams chos ni zur za'i brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈khang pa dmar po 〉(1879)zhes pa de yin zhing / rtsom pa pos khang pa dmar po'i nang bsdad na'ang yon tan la thogs pa med pa'i na gzhon rtsom rig pa dang sgyu rtsal pa kha cig gi rgyun gtan gyi 'tsho ba 'bri 'god byas pa brgyud ma rtsa ring lugs kyi cha rkyen 'og sgyu rtsal ni rtsa med 'gro ba'i phyogs su bskyod bzhin pa'i skyo gar gsal ston byas yod de/ sgyu rtsal pa kha cig gis sgyu rtsal 'tsho bar brten nas 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tha shal gyi 'dod blo dang bstun thabs byas par brten re zhig lam 'gro chen po byung ba dang / snyan ngag pa thar khos tshab byed pa'i sgyu rtsal pa kha cig gis dngos yod la zhen log dang / 'tsho ba dang kha bral ba/ sgyu rtsal gyi ba so'i mchod rten nang yid rtse gnyis dang bral ba'i sgo nas gzhol bas/ rnam pa ring lugs kyi thar med rwa dung du tshud pa/'jim rko mkhas pa mong tha nu'u sis tshab byed pa'i mi sna khag gsum pa des 'tsho bar lhag bsam rnam dag dang / sgyu rtsal la lhag bsam rnam dag sgyu rtsal gyi bla med las 'gan sgrub phyir 'thab rtsod bcas byas pas/ mthar rtsa med 'gro ba'i phugs 'bras las thar thabs ma byung ba'i gnas tshul bkod pa bcas red/ de min su'e ten gyi chos lugs sgyur bcos de 'byung rkyen ded khungs su byas nas bris pa'i lo rgyus kyi zlos gar 〈〈sku zhabs a'o la'o hphu 〉zhes pa des/ chos dbang dang rgyal pos srid dbang sger gcod byed pa'i lam 519

lugs la 'gog rgol byed pa'i yar thon gyi brjod bya gtso bo mtshon yod pa ma zad/ spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas zil rlabs dgung du 'phyur ba'i mi dmangs kyi 'os langs la bstod glu phul yod/bar dus kyi gsar rtsom (/887—1901)ni rang byung ring lugs kyi dus skabs su gtogs yod/ skabs 'dir si the ling pa'o ni kung ku'u er gcen gcung dang tsu'o la'i rang byung ring lugs kyi rig gzhung la bsam blo rtse gcig tu myos gyur pas rang nyid rang byung par slog byed mkhan ‘6par rgyag pa mi zhig gi ngos nas spobs pa skye 'os pa zhig tu rlom nas khor yug dang /rigs rgyud/ rgyud 'dzin gyi khyad chos bcas ni deng rabs skyo gar gyi 'byung rkyen du ngos bzung ste 〈sras mo kru'u li 〉(/887)dang 〈pha 〉(1887)zhes pa'i 'khrab gzhung gnyis bris pa red/ sku drag gi sras mo kru'u li ni smyo nad phog pa lta bu'i smyo ham che ba'i rang gshis can zhig yin pas/ ngo tsha khrel med kyis rang khyim gyi bran g.yog dang skab mthun yong re byed pa dang / pa'i rgyu nor rku ba/ spu gris rang gi gre ba gcod pa sogs kho mo'i smyo 'tshub che ba'i rang gshis de thams cad ni khyim tshang gi gnyen rgyud khrid pa las byung ba zhig yin te/ dper na kho mo'i a ma ni dbang rtsa'i nad gzhi phog pa zhig yin stabs/ kho mo'i lus thog tu spyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin rtsa yal du song nas de bas mang ba ni myos gyur gyi 'dod sred dang srog chags kyi 'khrig spyod rang nus yin pa red/ phyi dus kyi gsar rtsom (/902—/9 2)ni deng rabs ring lugs kyi dus skabs su gtogs shing / dus skabs 'di'i ring khos deng rabs ring lugs kyi rtsom rig bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun la dang zhen chen pos sgyu rtsal gyi lta ba tshur snang smra ba nas mngon mtshon smra ba'i phyogs su bsgyur pa dang / rang snang gi 520

'jig rten de gsar rtsom gyi gtso gnas su bzhag ste khungs med ya mtshan can gyi don rkyen byung rim dang / gting zab dpog dka'i mtshon rtags dang shugs bstan gyi go don shugs che spyod kyi yod/ brtsams chos khrod du 'tsho ba'i ngang tshul je nyung du btang nas de bas mang ba ni 'jig rten khams dang mi che'i skor gyi gnas lugs kyi khyad chos ldan pa dang / spyi mtshan can gyi snying bsdus ni kho'i gzhi rtsa'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsa don du gyur yod/ kho'i 〈ta ma hri kor bskyod pa 〉zhes pa'i rol dbyangs gsum (1904)dang / 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉(1907)zhes pa gnyis pos mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi rka mgo btod yod/18 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉kyi nang don ji 'dra red dam/ 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉ni su'e ten gyi zlos gar ba si the ling pa'o yi phyi dus kyi tshab mtshon brtsams chos red la/mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi rmang gzhi 'ding ba'i brtsams chos shig kyang yin pas/ 'dzam gling zlos gar lo rgyus thog gal 'gangs che ba'i gnas bab bzung yod/ rtsom pa pos 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉de nyid ched mngags kho pas bdag gnyer byed pa'i zlos gar khang chung ngur bris pa'i 'khrab gzhung yin pas ‘ zlos gar chung gras ri kyi khongs su bzhag yod/ 'khrab gzhung der 'khrab tshan dang le'u sogs kyi dbye ba mi phye bar 'khrab ljongs kyi 'gyur ldog gzhir bzung zlos gar khag bzhir dbye yod cing / mi sna gtso bo yang bzhi yod pa ni rgas po heng mer dang /bud med gshin mo/ hrang zha'o dang slob grwa chen mo ba bcas red/521

'khrab ljongs dang po ni heng mer gyi khyim du yin pa dang / kho'i khyim du 'dzul yong mkhan slob grwa chen mo ba de'i pha de snga 'byor ldan pa chen po zhig yin pa nas rjes su heng mer gyis smyon pa'i sman khang du bskyal nas gnod 'tshe'i 'og shi ba red/ skabs 'dir khos slar yang slob grwa chen mo ba de'i bla srog 'phrog rgyu'i re ngan bcangs shing de ldog thabs kyi cha rkyen ni kho pa'i byi phrug bu mo de slob grwa chen mo bas mna' mar bsu dgos pa de red/'khrab ljongs gnyis pa ni hrang zha'o yi khyim du yin pa dang / khos res gza' nyi ma'i dgong dro 'char can gshin po tshor ston mo skong tshogs byed pa der yong mkhan gyi mgron po'i gras su lus la gshin gos dkris pa'i shi zin pa'i gzhung tshab dang / mya ngan gyi gos mnabs shing nan gyi cho lo ldan pa'i sku drag gi 'phrul gzugs/ da dung hrang zha'o yi zla bo gshin mo yod la/ shi bo gson po chabs cig za cog gi 'gram du skad cha tshig gcig kyang mi shod par rgyas za rgyas 'thung byed pa'i chul ni ‘8thog steng gi tsi gus bza' chas so 'brad rgyag bzhin pa'i sgra dang gnyis su ma mchis/’’ gshin mo ma shi gong heng mer gyi zur mo byed myong bas hrang zha'o dang heng mer gnyis bar la yang rang shugs su 'khon 'gras zhugs shing / heng mer gyis hrang zha'o 'chi lam du skyel thub pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam nas ma rtsa 'bor che spyad de hrang zha'o yi ma rkang 'dzin shog yod tshad nyos pa red/ 'khrab ljongs gsum pa ni bu mo'i gzim sbug tu yin pa dang / nad gzhi lci mos non bzhin pa'i bu mo gzhon nu mas slob grwa chen mo bar heng mer gyis btang ba'i ma byan rgan mo de ni khrag 'jib gdon 'dre zhig dang 'dra bar nga tshos 'tsho bcud rnams 'jib tshar ba dang / mos bzos pa'i kha lag la bcud til 'bru tsam yang med pas/da ni kho mo 'chi la khad kyi ya nga'i gnas bab 'di 'drar lhungs 'dug ces 522

bshad/ 'khrab ljongs bzhi pa ni sprul sgyur yul ljongs yin stabs/ khang pa mi mngon pa dang / gnam yol steng po kho ling gis bris pa'i ‘‘'chi ba'i gling phran 1’gyi ri mo gsal/ slob grwa chen mo bas 'das zin pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma de'i ched du mya ngan gyi skyo glu len zhing mi'i rigs kyi 'byung 'gyur ni bab chags bden can gyi zhi 'jam dro skyid dang ldan la lhad med mchog gyur gyi brtse dung gi mdud pas 'ching ba zhig yong ba'i smon lam 'debs/zlos gar gis tshul 'chal gyi zlos gar rnam pa dang / spyi tshogs mun nag dang goms srol ngan par sdang sems 'dzin pa'i bsam pa'i thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod kyi mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba'i phyogs yongs kyi gzhan 'gyur gyi rnam pa ther 'don byas yod de/ mi rnams ni phan tshun phyir 'bud dang / phan tshun mgo skor/ phan tshun 'phrog bcom/ phan tshun lkog gnod bcas 'di ni mis mi za ba dang / mis mi la 'tshe ba mis mi gsod pa'i skyi g.ya' ba'i 'jig rten zhig yin zhing / mun thom dang / sdig nyes/ sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba bcas kyi 'jig rten 'di nyid ni 44ji srid bar 'gyur ldog mang bas dpog dka' ba dang / ji srid bar sdig pa'i nyes pa zab cing sdug bsngal rdzogs mtha' bral ba zhig yin mi pa red/ mthon por gnas pa'i ngan rgu tshang ba'i gser dngul gyi stobs shugs kyis thams cad kha lo bsgyur nas snying 'gul bla 'dar gyi skyug bro ba'i zlos gar gcig mjug gnyis mthud du 'khrab pas/ spyi tshogs ngan rul dang / kun spyod nyams smad/ mi gshis zhan gyur/ mi'i srol rgyun gyi rin thang dang mdzes pa'i mi gshis bcas rtsa yal du song / 'on kyang rtsom pa po gang nyid ni skyo snang re chad du ma lhungs par mi'i rigs kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'byung 'gyur la sngar bzhin spro sems rab 'khol gyi re sgug dang bla med mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 523

yid smon byed bzhin yod/ khos mi chos ring lugs kyi brtse dung zab mo bcangs te 'byung 'gyur mi'i rigs la sna dro 'jam gyi nyi 'od dang / gtsang sbra ldan pa'i khyim tshang / tshul ldan lugs mthun gyi grogs po/ lhad med mchog gyur gyi brtse dung ’ bcas rnyed rgyu'i smon lam btab/ legs par btab pa'i smon lam 'di yang gyen 'phyur gyi sa me dang gsog bsags kyi me ri dang 'dra bar yig 'bru re re dang tshig 'phreng so so'i khrod nas zer 'od chem mer 'phros te mi rnams la snying stobs 'phel ba dang / go rtogs sad pa/stobs shugs sbyin pa bcas kyis ma rtsa ring lugs mun nag gi dngos yod spyi tshogs la sun 'byin pa'i brtsams chos de'i chab srid kyi brjod bya gtso bor shugs snon chen po thebs yod pa ma zad/ brtsams chos de rang la'ang gsal tshad nges can zhig sor 'jog byas yod//82 〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ji 'dra yod dam/〈gshin po'i rnam shes kyis dkrol sgrog rol dbyangs 〉ni si the ling pa'o yi rtser son brtsams 'bras dang mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar gyi ches phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos kyi gras shig red/ des dngos yod ring lugs dang yongs su mi mthun pa'i bya thabs te ya mtshan can gyi tshul 'chal gyi don rkyen byung rim bar bsres dang / ches mngon che ba dang ches ya mtshan can gyi sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thog nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs khrod mis mi za ba'i mun nag gi ngo bo dmar rjen du ther 'don byas yod/ khungs med btsan sgrig byas pa'i byung rim dang rnam mang phun sum tshogs pa'i khungs sne gnyis mnyam 'dre snol spel bgyis pa 'di ni brtsams chos de'i gzhi rtsa'i khyad 524

rtags su grub/ zlos gar der mi sna bcu lhag tsam don yong ba de dag gnas stangs mi gcig cing rang gshis mi mtshungs la thob thang mi 'dra ba sha stag yin mod/ 'on kyang tshang ma heng mer zer ba'i dngul rtsa'i 'byor chen pa de'i mtha' skor du rnyog gleng dam sgril byung nas zhib cing phra la sna mang 'dres 'dzing che ba'i dra ba can gyi spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba zhig grub yod la/ heng mer ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi lkog g.yo can dang ham sems can gyi dpe mtshon zhig yin pas/ kho'i gzugs thog nas sdug rtsub dang / bzang rdzu/ngan rtsa che ba'i spyod ngan ma lus gcig bsdus su mtshon gyi yod/ lwa ring nag po gyon pa'i mi 'di ni gshin rje las kyang 'jigs skrag che zhing ‘‘tshe gang ring rang phan gzhan gnod kyi bya ba 'ba' zhig sgrub kyin yod/’’ khos slob grwa chen mo ba'i pha smyon pa'i sman khang du bskyal nas 'jigs bskul 'og bkrongs pa dang / sku zhabs gzhung tshab kyi gre ba thag pas bsdams te bkums pa ma zad/ 'o ma bzho mkhan gzhon nu ma zhig kyang gtsang por 'bud rgyag byas te rkyen lam du btang / kho pa gang du slebs pa der dmar gsod dang mi shi rkyen byung gi gnas tshul lhag gyin yod/ yang mi sna gzhan zhig ste hrang zha'o ni ma gzhi khyim tshang gi 'bab khungs dman gras su gtogs pa'i mi 'khyam khram pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang ‘ thab tshang ma byan gyi sa nas dngos po bar zos bya rgyur mnga' brnyes pa zhig mi yin pas/ sku drag gi khyim tshang ga ge mo zhig gi ming rku 'khyer byas te gling chen a me ri kha'i dang blangs dmag khongs su hrang zha'o yi dpon gnas shig thob/ nan gyi cho lo ldan pa si khan si ko ni nor bu'i rigs rku 'khyer byed mkhan yin pa dang / shi nas nyin shas song rung mya ngan gyi gos gyon pa'i 'phrul gzugs su sngar bzhin khang pa'i phyogs bzhir nyul 'khyam byed/ da dung khang pa thog khar sdod mkhan gzhung tshab pa de'ang 'das ma thag pa yin mod/ 'on te gshin gos dkris te mgron khang 525

du phar tshur 'gro 'ong byed/ gshin po'i rnam shes dang mi ngan gyi khyu tshogs 'di dag gis phan tshun bda' 'ded dang / phan tshun 'tshe res byas te bya bya tshang dang khyi khyi khang nang du'ang 'dug bzod mi bde ba bzos/ kho tsho'i bar gyi 'brel ba ni zang zing nag 'tshub che la 'khyags pa ltar grang zhing go ldog rnyog 'phrul che ba bcas yin pas/ ji ltar byas rung go sgrig le mthud cig yong thabs med pa red/ mi dang mi ma yin dang / 'dre dang 'dre ma yin gyi gzugs brnyan sogs btsan sgrig tshul 'chal gyi don rkyen byung rim 'di 'dra brgyud de rtsom pa po gang des ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs la dza drag che ba'i gdung 'bod byas yod/khyad chos gnyis pa ni shugs drag che ba'i rang snang gi khro sems de yin zhing / brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna mi nyung ba zhig gi 'khrab tshig dang 'khrab chas tshang ma ni rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs mun nag dang goms srol ngan par 'dzin pa'i rang snang gi brtse dung phyi'i dngos po can du gyur pa zhig ste/dper na slob grwa chen mo ba'i snang brnyan de ni rtsom pa po'i mgrin tshab pa 'phrul med cig tu grub yod pa dang / khos skad gsang mthon pos/ 46'jig rten 'di ni smyon pa'i sman khang dang / gzhang khang / ro khang bcas yin pas/ye shu'i ci tu'u 'jig rten 'dir byon na dmyal bar lhungs pa dang khyad par med mi’ces ku co shugs che 'don pa'i skad cha dum bu 'dis rtsom pa po'i lta ba gson rjen du mtshon yod/ gshin mos gtam gleng ni chu rgyug pa ltar 'khon thogs dang bral bas rtsom pa po'i tshab tu gtam bshad ring po gcig mjug gnyis mthud du spel ba 'dra ste/ 6 ngas gsug za bar ma brten la/ 'jigs skul la'ang ma brten/ sdug myong dang 'gyod bshags la brten yod/mi lha nga tshos nor 'khrul gyi las ka byed myong / nga tshos nyes pa bsags yod/ nga tsho phyi nang mtshungs pa zhig min pa de ni nga tsho tshang mas rang gi ngo bo 'gebs 526

srung gis rang nyid kyi nor 'khrul la kha rdung gtong gin yod pas ri red ces pa'i skad cha dum bu 'di ni rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis 'jig rten gyi mi rnams la lta ba'i gdeng 'jog tu grub yod pa las gshin mo'i byab chung bla 'dar gyi rang gshis dang mthun pa gtan nas med/ de'i thog nas rtsom pa pos spyi mtshan can du gyur pa'i snying bsdus la do snang byed pa las zhib cha che ba'i 'tsho bar snang 'jog mi byed pa dang / kha gsal rno ngar can gyi gtam gleng la brten nas mun nag gi don dngos la 'gog rgol byed pa'i bsam pa mtshon par byas te/ zlos gar de nyid sgro 'dogs kyi khyad chos zab la snying bsdus kyi spro snang che ba'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur ba byed pa de nga tshos gsal bar rtogs thub/ kho'i smyug 'og tu/ nyung 'phri byas pa'i bden pa'i rang bzhin de ni zhib gnad yod tshad dor ba'i brda rtags tsam du gyur cing /spyi mtshan can gyi bsam pa'i spro snang gis snga phyi bar gsum du thams cad las mchog tu gyur pa'i gnas bab bzung ba'i thog nas/ shugs drag che ba'i snying bsdus ni rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs kyi nang gnas ngo bo ther 'don byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i bya thabs su gyur yod/ 'di lta bu'i spyi mtshan can du gyur pa'i spro snang dang shugs drag che ba'i rang snang gi bsam pa 'di phyi rabs kyi 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa pos rgyun 'dzin gyis mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi grub mtha'i mngon gsal che shos kyi khyad chos shig tu grub bo//83 hra the en ha'e mu'u ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/hri the en ha'e mu'u (/878—1942)ni 'jar man gyi skabs shig ring ming grags che ba'i mngon mtshon ring lugs zlos gar ba dang brtsams sgrung 527

rtsom pa po zhig red la lhag don dgod bro'i zlos gar thad kyi skad grags ldan pa zhig red/ kho pa la'e pi zhi'i dngul khang gi khyim tshang zhig tu skyes pa dang han no we dang per lin du na gzhon gyi dus 'da' bar byas/ /897lo nas 1902lo'i bar snga rjes su mo nyi he dang / ko then ken/ la'e pi zhi/ hphu la'o pa'o sogs sa gnas kyi slob grwa chen mor mtshan nyid rig pa dang rtsom rig slob gnyer byas/ 1903lor hphu lan dzi pu'u la'e dang mnyam du mo nyi hor 〈zhus phe li lung 〉zhes pa'i dus deb gsar gnyer byas pa ma zad gsar rtsom gyi bya ba'i 'go brtsams/ kho'i zlos gar gyis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi don dngos la sun 'byin drag po byed kyin yod stabs 'byor ldan gral rim srid gzhung rim byon gyi sdang zug phog pa ma zad rtag tu 4‘kun spyod gnod pa ’’zer ba'i nyes 'dogs kyis 'khrab ston bkag sdom byed kyin yod/ /912lo'i rjes su kho pa thag ring gi mi yul mi 'grim ka med byung ste per cam dang / ho lan/ sud si sogs rgyal khab la yul gyar gyi 'tsho ba lo mang bskyal/ na so rgas rjes yid skyo sems sdug gis mnar zhing nad gdon lci mos srog dbang bsdus/ las dbang la bar chad mang ba'i rtsom pa po 'di 'tsho sdod skabs rtsom rig las rigs kyis do snang de tsam byas med/ kho pa 'jig rten gzhan du gshegs rjes da gzod ming grags ches cher 'phel nas deng rabs 'jar man gyi shes bya yon tan gyis phyug pa'i zlos gar ba'i gras shig tu bkur bar byas hri the en ha'e mu'u yi tshab mtshon brtsams chos ni 〈dor ma 〉zhes pa'i rol dbyangs gsum (19/1)dang / 〈rgyu ngor lta mkhan col chung ba/〉(1914)〈chig dgu bcu gsum lo 〉(/915)bcas yin pa dang / de dag ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus stod kyi we len btsan rgyal dus rabs kyi 'tsho ba'i spyi 528

tshogs kyi skyon yon brjod pa'i zlos gar yin zhing / de rnams kyis sgra yod mdog ldan gyi sgo nas grong mi dkyus ma'i khyim tshang zhig rlung rta rab 'phel gyis 'byor chen gral rim gyi gnas bab tu 'dzegs rjes slar yang nyams rgud thor zhig tu song ba'i snang tshul 'bri 'god byas yod pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi g.yo len btsan 'phrog dang / phar 'brid tshur slu/ sems gnag gdug rtsub/ btsan shed sger gcod bcas kyi skyug bro ba'i gdong ris ji bzhin ther 'don byas pa dang chabs cig kho pa tsho'i tha shal gsob rdzu dang gting med rnam g.yeng gi bsam pa'i 'jig rten yang mtshon par byas yod/ zlos gar 'khrab ston byas rjes spyi tshogs steng g.yo 'gul shugs che thebs shing / 'byor ldan pa'i rnag khrag 'byin byed gtsag bu lta bur gyur stabs/ gleng phyogs kyi 'ur sgra che bas ring min dgag byar gyur pa'i las dbang las thar thabs ma byung / de min 〈sgam chung 〉(1912)zhes pa dang 〈spyi 'bangs hri pher 〉〉(/914)zhes pa'i dgod bro'i zlos gar gnyis yod pa de ni grong mi dkyus ma'i skor gyi brjod bya bkod pa zhig ste/ der grong mi dkyus ma'i ma rabs tha shal dang / mtho 'byar dma' rdung / rang khe ser sna/ tha mal dpa' bkong bcas kyi gdong ris ngo ma a na pa nar gson nyams dod pos mtshon par byas yod/hri the en ha'e mu'u yis par kra kho'i 〈mi yul gyi zlos gar 〉〉zhes pa'i bsam bkod la lad mo bgyis te mi sna bskyar mngon dang byung rim 'brel mthud kyi bya thabs bzung nas/ rang gis gsar rtsom byas pa'i dgod bro'i zlos gar hril po sgyu rtsal gyi tshogs spyi gcig tu sbrel te der 〈'byor ldan gral rim gyi dpa' bo'i 'tsho ba 〉zhes pa'i spyi ming btags/ dgod bro'i zlos gar gyi tshogs spyi de ni gnad smin gyi zur za dang rno ngar che ba'i khrel dgod kyis 529

rang gi gzhi rtsa'i khyad rtags su bsgrubs pas/ de ni dga' 'dzum khro med dang bcase pa tshang ma rtsom yig gi tshul dang 'phya smod zur za'i phyogs bsdus kyi gzugs su grub yod ces brjod chog rtsom pa por 'phya smod bya thabs gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni sgro 'dogs brgyud 'phya smod kyi phan 'bras shugs che thon par byed pa dper na/ mi sna'i ldog phyogs kyi khyad rtags gang zhig 'bur btod kyis rgya skyed dang 'ud sgrog bya thabs la brten nas sgro 'dogs shugs che byas pa brgyud mi rnams kyi dgod sgra 'dren pa lta bu dang /gcig ni mi sna'i bla med kyi phyi tshul 'dra chags dang tha shal gyi nang sems gnyis dbar dza drag gi 'gal ba 'bri 'god byas pa brgyud/ ldog phyogs mi sna'i snang brnyan gyi bcos ma'i rnam 'gyur dang gdug rtsub che ba'i spyod tshul ngo ma ther 'don byed pa de gnyis red/ gzhan yang rtsom pa pos rtag tu legs bshad dang yang na sbrag tar du spyod byed yi ge lta bu'i rjod tshig bsdus ma bed spyod byed kyi yod/ de ni rjod tshig de rigs skor yang dgod bro dang /'gul stangs kyi rang bzhin phun sum tshogs shing mngon med kyi 'khrab tshig 'bor che ldan pas/ bsnyad pa'i tshig la tshar rgyu yod kyang go ba'i don la rdzogs rgyu med pa ltar mi tshor phun sum tshogs pa'i bro ba dang bsam bkod bya yul zhig 'jog gi yod pas red/hri the en ha'e mu'u yis brtsams sgrung 'bring thung 'ga' zhig kyang bris yod pa rnams bam po gsum ldan gyi brtsams sgrung phyogs sgrig 〈dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus stod kyi gnas tshul dngos bris 〉〉zhes pa'i nang bsdus yod cing /brtsams chos de dag la brtse dung rab tu g.yo zhing rang snang gi khyad chos shugs che ldan pas/ mngon mtshon ring lugs lhugs rtsom brtsams chos kyi tshad ldan mig dper rtsi'o/ 530

/84 thu'o ler ni rtsom pa po ci 'dra zhig red dam/en si the thu'o ler (/893—1939)ni 'jar man g.yon gzhogs mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi 'khrab gzhung rtsom pa po dang thal skyod kyi dmangs gtso ring lugs pa zhig red/ kho pa deng skabs po lan mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i sa mo chin grong brdal du skyes shing pha ni sa gnas de ga'i tshong pa grags pa che ba zhig yin pas khyim tshang gi cha rkyen shin tu 'dzoms po yod/kho par chung dus nas slob gso gang legs thob pa dang / rjes su hpha ran sir bskyod nas slob grwa chen mo zhugs/ 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po langs pa'i rjes slob mtshams bzhag ste 'jar man du phyir log gis dang blangs dmag la zhugs/ zla ba bcu gsum ring gi g.yul sa mdun ma'i 'tsho bas khos btsan rgyal ring lugs dmag 'khrug gi sdig nyes ngo bo mthong thub pa byung ste/ dmag 'khrug la brtsi bkur zhu ba nas btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug la snying khong rus gting nas ngo rgol byed mkhan zhig tu gyur//9/6lor lus rmas byung ste dmag khongs nas phyir 'then gyis mo nyi he dang ha'e ter pa'o sogs su mu mthud slob grwa chen mor slob sbyong byas/ 1918lor thal skyod kyi rang btsan spyi tshogs dmangs gtso tang la zhugs pa ma zad mo nyi he'i bzo pa'i las mtshams 'jog pa'i nang the zhugs byas/ khos gtam bshad spel ba dang / 'grems yig 'bri ba/ gsar brje dril bsgrags bcas byas pas lan te stabs mi legs par btson du tshud/ btson khang nang zlos gar 'khrab gzhung ang po 〈'pho 'gyur te mi zhig gi 'thab rtsod 〉ces pa bris nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug la 'gog rgol byed dgos zhes mngon gsal dod pos mang tshogs skul slong byas/ 1919531

lor khos mo nyi he'i su'u we ed spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi kru'u zhi byas pa dang /pa hpha li ya'i 'os langs skabs slar yang dmar dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms par bsko bzhag byas/ khos gsar brje pa zhig gi ches bla na med pa'i spyod bzang ni dmag pham mkhan la khong yangs dkyel che bya dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin byas te bzung dmag phon che glod bkrol dang / log spyod kyi dmag dpung la bskyar rgol ma byas stabs/ dgra bor dmag shugs bskyar sgrig dang gshin po bskyar log gi tshur rgol go skabs byung ste dmar dmag gi dmag yongs dgra lag tu tshud pa'i ya nga ba'i phugs 'bras bzos shing kho pa rang nyid kyang log spyod khrims khang nas lo lnga'i btson 'jug gi bcad khra btang / 1924lor btson grol byung rjes khos mu mthud zlos gar gsar rtsom gyi bya ba bsgrubs/ 933lor hi the les srid dbang bzung bas kho pa phyi rgyal du yul gyar mi bya mthu med kyis dbyin ji dang a ri sogs su bsdad//939lor a ri'i nyi'u yog tu me mdas rang srog bcad/ kho'i zlos gar gsar rtsom la dus rim gsum du 'byed chog ste/snga dus kyi gsar rtsom (1923lo'i sngon )la gsar brje dang dmag 'khrug brjod bya gtso bor mtshon pa dang rab 'phel gyi spro sems ldan yod/ khos phyogs gcig nas mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i drang bden rang bzhin dril bsgrags byed pa dang / gsar brje'i yar thon gyi nus par bstod glu 'bul ba/yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas gsar brje'i drag shugs de kun spyod dang 'tsham min la the tshom za bas/ sngon bskyod kyi gsar brje pa dang rjes lus kyi mang tshogs bar gyi rno ngar che ba'i dpyad sdur de zlos gar gyi byung rim lte bar grub yod/ snga dus kyi brtsams chos gras su 〈'pho 'gyur te mi zhig gi 'thab rtsod 〉(/9/9)ces pa dang / 〈sgor dang mang tshogs/〉(/92/) 〈'phrul 532

'khor gtor mkhan 〉(1922)zer ba sogs yod la/ brtsams chos rjes ma de ni dbyin ji'i lu'u te'i las 'gul skabs kyi thon las bzo pa'i 'os langs kyi gnas tshul bkod pa zhig red/ de min 〈btson khang nang gi glu dbyangs 〉(1921)dang 〈khug rta'i dpe deb 〉(1924)ces pa'i snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs deb gnyis kyang bris yod/bar dus kyi gsar rtsom (1924/de1932)ni/ gtso bo gsar brje tshar rjes kyi dma' rlabs dus skabs kyi rtsom pa po'i gsar brje'i bsam zhib mtshon par byas yod/ dus skabs 'di'i ring gi brtsams chos ni zhi zhing 'jam la go don zab pa'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa dang / 'jig rten khams dang mi che'i skor gyi gnas lugs rang bzhin gyis phyug pa zhig yin pas/dus bab kyi rnam pa gsar pa'i 'og ji ltar gsar brje'i phugs bsam rgyun 'khyodas bya rgyu de ni khos rtog 'jug byed pa'i lte ba'i gnad don red/brtsams chos su 〈gzab gzab gnang dang nga tsho da dung gson por bsdad yod 〉(1927)ces pa dang / 〈bcings bkrol thob pa'i a'o than/〉(1929)〈thab me bsad pa/〉(1930) 〈〈a ri'i ngo mtshar/〉(1931) 〈lha mo long ba 〉(1932)zer ba sogs yod do/phyi dus kyi gsar rtsom (1933/de 939)ni skyo snang gdung ba'i nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig red/ dus skabs 'di'i ring kho pa dbyin ji dang a rir bca' sdod dang / gsar rtsom gyi lte ba'i brjod bya ni hpha shi si'i rtsub spyod srid dbang la 'gog rgol dang / hpha shi si'i gcan gzan gyi gdong ris dang ngo tsha zhe khrel bral ba'i nyes spyod ther 'don byed pa de red/ 'khrab gzhung la 〈zhi bde mi dgos sam/〉(1937) 〈chos 'chad pa ha er 〉(1939)zer ba sogs yod/533
